words.enDefinition: formal association of people with similar interests

examples.en: The bakers' guild sets training standards for every apprentice in the city.
examples.zh: 面包师「同业公会」为全城的学徒制定培训标准。

examples.en: Members of the guild meet quarterly to agree on flour prices.
examples.zh: 「公会」成员每季度碰头商定面粉价格。

words.enDefinition: occurring at or dependent on a particular season

examples.en: The cannery hires seasonal workers for the six-week peach harvest.
examples.zh: 罐头厂在为期六周的桃子收获季雇佣「季节工」。

examples.en: Ice-cream sales are highly seasonal, so stock is cut every October.
examples.zh: 冰淇淋销售「季节性」很强，所以每年十月都削减备货。

words.enDefinition: any animals kept for use or profit

examples.en: The market bans livestock deliveries during the hottest hours of July.
examples.zh: 市场禁止在七月最热时段运送「牲畜」。

examples.en: Trucking livestock overnight keeps the animals much cooler and calmer.
examples.zh: 夜间运输「牲畜」能让动物更凉爽、更安静。

words.enDefinition: an association of companies for some definite purpose

examples.en: A consortium of three builders won the contract to widen the dry dock.
examples.zh: 由三家建筑商组成的「联合体」赢得了扩建干船坞的合同。

examples.en: The airline joined a banking consortium to fund its new fleet.
examples.zh: 这家航空公司加入了一个银行「财团」，为新机队筹资。

words.enDefinition: contemptibly narrow in outlook

examples.en: Petty expenses like staples and tape are bought from the till float.
examples.zh: 订书钉、胶带这类「小额」杂项开支直接从备用现金里购买。

examples.en: The petty traders along the quay set up before the ferry docks.
examples.zh: 码头边的「小商贩」们在轮渡靠岸前就摆好了摊。

words.enDefinition: having decayed or disintegrated; usually implies foulness

examples.en: The grocer threw out a crate of rotten oranges before opening.
examples.zh: 杂货店开门前扔掉了一箱「腐烂的」橙子。

examples.en: Wooden pallets left in the rain go rotten within two winters.
examples.zh: 露天淋雨的木托盘过两个冬天就会「朽掉」。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to the system for delivering mail

examples.en: Postal delays pushed the catalogue launch back by a full week.
examples.zh: 「邮政」延误使产品目录的发布整整推迟了一周。

examples.en: The firm keeps a postal address in York for official letters.
examples.zh: 公司保留了一个约克的「邮寄」地址用于收发公函。

words.enDefinition: support through subsidies

examples.en: The region subsidizes night buses so market porters can get home safely.
examples.zh: 该地区「补贴」夜间巴士，让市场搬运工能安全回家。

examples.en: Grain imports were subsidized after two bad harvests in a row.
examples.zh: 连续两季歉收后，粮食进口获得了「资助」。

words.enDefinition: person who holds extreme views

examples.en: Police kept extremist groups away from the meat market on market day.
examples.zh: 集市日当天，警方阻止「极端分子」团体靠近肉类市场。

examples.en: The paper accused the protesters of listening to a few extremists.
examples.zh: 报纸指责抗议者听信了少数「极端分子」。

words.enDefinition: approve and express assent, responsibility, or obligation

examples.en: The senate voted to ratify the fishing accord with its neighbour.
examples.zh: 参议院投票「批准」与邻国的捕鱼协定。

examples.en: Members must ratify the merger before it can take effect.
examples.zh: 并购必须先由会员投票「批准」才能生效。

words.enDefinition: not conditional

examples.en: The firm offered an unconditional apology and refunded every affected order.
examples.zh: 公司作出「无条件」道歉，并退还所有受影响订单的货款。

examples.en: Their support for the strike fund was unconditional, without any strings.
examples.zh: 他们对罢工基金的支持是「无条件的」，不附带任何要求。

words.enDefinition: to express or include something as an essential or visible part

examples.en: The shop's hand-painted signs embody the owner's belief in slow craft.
examples.zh: 店铺的手绘招牌「体现」了店主对手工慢作的坚持。

examples.en: The new constitution embodies rights for small traders and market sellers.
examples.zh: 新章程「包含」了小商贩和集市卖家的各项权利。

words.enDefinition: not yet payable

examples.en: The court found undue pressure behind the farmer's signature on the lease.
examples.zh: 法庭认定农户在租约上签字时受到了「不当」压力。

examples.en: Charging interest before the invoice is due would be undue.
examples.zh: 发票未到期就计收利息，属于「未到期」收费。

words.enDefinition: person authorized to act for another

examples.en: She voted by proxy while recovering from surgery at home.
examples.zh: 她在家养伤期间由「代理人」代为投票。

examples.en: Shareholders who cannot attend may appoint a proxy before the meeting.
examples.zh: 无法出席的股东可在会前指定「代理」。

words.enDefinition: merchant who owns or manages a shop

examples.en: The tradesman who runs the ironmongery shop sponsored the rowing club.
examples.zh: 经营五金铺的这位「商人」赞助了划船俱乐部。

examples.en: Tradesmen in the arcade agreed to open late on Fridays.
examples.zh: 拱廊里的「店主们」商定每周五延长营业。

words.enDefinition: a place where things are stored; a person rich in information

examples.en: The archive is a repository of shipping records going back two centuries.
examples.zh: 这座档案馆是存放两个世纪以来航运记录的「宝库」。

examples.en: Grandma is a repository of recipes that the shop still bakes today.
examples.zh: 祖母简直是一座配方「宝库」，店里至今仍按她的配方烘焙。

words.enDefinition: a large public exhibition; a detailed explanation of a topic

examples.en: The dairy expo is the largest exposition of farm machinery in the county.
examples.zh: 乳品展是该县规模最大的农业机械「展览会」。

examples.en: Her short exposition of the export rules cleared up our confusion.
examples.zh: 她对出口规则的简明「阐述」解开了我们的疑惑。

words.enDefinition: performance of a musical composition or a dramatic role etc.

examples.en: The cellist's rendition of the old folk tune brought the hall to silence.
examples.zh: 大提琴手对那首老民谣的「演绎」让全场安静下来。

examples.en: His rendition of the national anthem opened the trade dinner.
examples.zh: 贸易晚宴以他对国歌的「演奏」开场。

words.enDefinition: the act of getting possession of something

examples.en: The procurement team compared four quotes before choosing the steel supplier.
examples.zh: 「采购」团队比较了四份报价后才选定钢材供应商。

examples.en: Public procurement rules require an advert in the local paper.
examples.zh: 公共「采购」规则要求在当地报纸上刊登公告。

words.enDefinition: one having charge of buildings or grounds or animals

examples.en: The custodian of the market hall locks the gates at nine each night.
examples.zh: 市场大厅的「管理员」每晚九点锁上大门。

examples.en: As custodian of the ledgers, she alone may open the archive room.
examples.zh: 作为账册的「保管人」，只有她能打开档案室。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to the economic system of mercantilism

examples.en: The mercantile exchange set coffee prices for the whole coast.
examples.zh: 这家「商业」交易所给整个海岸定出了咖啡价格。

examples.en: Liverpool grew rich on mercantile trade with the sugar islands.
examples.zh: 利物浦靠与蔗糖群岛的「商业」贸易致富。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to the function or responsibility or activity of management

examples.en: Managerial experience matters more than diplomas when hiring a floor supervisor.
examples.zh: 招聘车间主管时，「管理」经验比文凭更重要。

examples.en: The restructure created two new managerial posts at the depot.
examples.zh: 重组在货场新增了两个「管理」岗位。

words.enDefinition: someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money

examples.en: The marketer tested three slogans on shoppers at the outlet mall.
examples.zh: 这位「营销人员」在奥特莱斯商场对顾客测试了三条广告语。

examples.en: Good marketers ask customers questions instead of guessing the answers.
examples.zh: 优秀的「营销人员」会向顾客提问，而不是凭空猜测。

words.enDefinition: a warning to consider something before acting; a qualifying statement in a contract

examples.en: One caveat before you sign: the warranty excludes transport damage.
examples.zh: 签字前有个「注意事项」：质保不包括运输损坏。

examples.en: The contract carries a caveat about late delivery of the fittings.
examples.zh: 合同中有一条关于配件延迟交付的「警告」条款。

words.enDefinition: bear the expenses of

examples.en: The branch will defray the delivery charges for orders above two hundred pounds.
examples.zh: 订单超过两百英镑，分店将为客户「负担」运费。

examples.en: Sponsorships defray the cost of the youth football kit each season.
examples.zh: 赞助商每季「负担」少年足球队服的开支。

words.enDefinition: transactions (sales and purchases) having the objective of supplying commodities (goods and services)

examples.en: Locals complain that heavy commercialism has drained the market of its character.
examples.zh: 当地人抱怨浓重的「商业主义」气息让市场失去了本色。

examples.en: The magazine warns readers against pure commercialism in choosing a bank.
examples.zh: 杂志提醒读者，选银行时别被纯粹的「商业至上」论调牵着走。

words.enDefinition: an item given in part payment toward a new purchase

examples.en: The dealer offered three hundred pounds for our van as a trade-in.
examples.zh: 经销商对我们的货车给出三百英镑的「以旧换新」折价。

examples.en: Bring the old drill in; it still counts as a trade-in this month.
examples.zh: 把旧电钻带来，本月它仍可作「以旧换新」抵价。

words.enDefinition: person who brings an action in a court of law

examples.en: The plaintiff produced receipts proving the roof leaked within the warranty.
examples.zh: 「原告」出示了收据，证明屋顶在保修期内就漏雨。

examples.en: After three hearings, the plaintiff agreed to settle out of court.
examples.zh: 三次开庭后，「原告」同意庭外和解。

words.enDefinition: in law; the territory within which power can be exercised

examples.en: The dispute falls outside the tribunal's jurisdiction, so it moves to arbitration.
examples.zh: 这起争议不在仲裁庭的「管辖权」之内，将转交仲裁。

examples.en: Which court has jurisdiction over supply contracts signed at sea?
examples.zh: 在海上签署的供货合同归哪个法庭「管辖」？

words.enDefinition: form containing a set of questions; submitted to people to gain statistical information

examples.en: The survey team handed a questionnaire to every customer leaving the showroom.
examples.zh: 调研团队给每位走出展厅的顾客发了一份「调查问卷」。

examples.en: It took the shopkeeper ten minutes to complete the council's questionnaire.
examples.zh: 店主花十分钟就填完了市政会的「问卷」。

words.enDefinition: table (in a restaurant or bar) surrounded by two high-backed benches

examples.en: Our booth at the food fair sits right beside the tasting counter.
examples.zh: 美食节的「展位」就在试吃柜台旁边。

examples.en: Book your booth early; corner spots sell out by March.
examples.zh: 「展位」要早点订，转角位到三月就订光了。

words.enDefinition: change by sale or merger in the controlling interest of a corporation

examples.en: The takeover by a Dutch firm saved the shipyard but cut jobs.
examples.zh: 被一家荷兰公司「收购」救活了船厂，却也裁掉了岗位。

examples.en: Staff learned of the takeover from the morning papers, not from the board.
examples.zh: 员工是从晨报而非董事会得知「收购」消息的。

words.enDefinition: the customary manner in which a language (or a form of a language) is spoken or written

examples.en: Electricity usage doubles in December, so the deposit rises accordingly.
examples.zh: 十二月用电「量」翻倍，保证金也相应上调。

examples.en: The manual shows the correct usage of the dough press with photos.
examples.zh: 手册用照片演示压面机的正确「用法」。

words.enDefinition: the period during which a person holds an office, post, or right of occupancy

examples.en: During her tenure as manager, overtime claims fell by half.
examples.zh: 在她担任经理的「任期」内，加班申领减少了一半。

examples.en: The professor's tenure ended after twenty years at the fisheries institute.
examples.zh: 这位教授在渔业研究所二十年的「任期」结束了。

words.enDefinition: the classification of someone or something with respect to its worth

examples.en: The annual appraisal decides who gets the winter bonus this year.
examples.zh: 年度「考评」决定谁拿今年的冬季奖金。

examples.en: An independent appraisal valued the orchard at double last year's price.
examples.zh: 独立「评估」给果园的估值是去年价格的两倍。

words.enDefinition: required by law, rule, or authority; compulsory

examples.en: Steel-capped boots are mandatory for every worker inside the sawmill.
examples.zh: 锯木厂内人人必须穿钢头靴，这是「强制性」要求。

examples.en: Attendance at the fire drill is mandatory for all shift workers.
examples.zh: 所有轮班工人都「必须」参加消防演习。

words.enDefinition: the property of a more than adequate quantity or supply

examples.en: This year's abundance of plums lets the stall cut prices early.
examples.zh: 今年李子供应「充裕」，摊主早早降了价。

examples.en: An abundance of cheap imports squeezed the local weavers badly.
examples.zh: 廉价进口货「大量」涌入，让当地织工日子很难过。

words.enDefinition: written proposal or reminder

examples.en: The clerk circulated a memorandum about the new filing deadlines.
examples.zh: 文员传阅了一份关于新归档期限的「备忘录」。

examples.en: Sign the memorandum of understanding before the joint venture starts.
examples.zh: 合资项目启动前，先签署「谅解备忘录」。

words.enDefinition: an English coin worth one twentieth of a pound

examples.en: Grandfather paid one shilling for the haircut that started his barbershop career.
examples.zh: 祖父当年花一「先令」理发，从此开始了他的理发师生涯。

examples.en: The old ledgers record wages of twenty shillings a week.
examples.zh: 旧账本上记着每周二十「先令」的工钱。

words.enDefinition: formal command or admonition

examples.en: The judge issued an injunction halting demolition of the market hall.
examples.zh: 法官下达「禁令」，叫停市场大厅的拆除。

examples.en: The supplier ignored the injunction and shipped the copies anyway.
examples.zh: 供应商无视「强制令」，照样把仿品发了货。

words.enDefinition: plant where beer is brewed by fermentation

examples.en: The old brewery now rents its vaults to a cheese maker.
examples.zh: 老「啤酒厂」如今把地窖租给了一位奶酪师。

examples.en: Buses leave from the brewery gates for the hop fields.
examples.zh: 通勤班车从「啤酒厂」大门出发，前往啤酒花田。

words.enDefinition: low area where the land is saturated with water

examples.en: The farm's wetland attracts birds that help control the pests naturally.
examples.zh: 农场的「湿地」引来鸟类，天然帮忙控制虫害。

examples.en: Draining the wetland for a car park broke the planning rules.
examples.zh: 把「湿地」排干建停车场违反了规划法规。

words.enDefinition: added to complete or make up a deficiency

examples.en: Two supplementary shifts were added to cover the harvest fortnight.
examples.zh: 为赶收成，临时「增补」了两个班次。

examples.en: The bank asked for supplementary documents before approving the loan.
examples.zh: 银行要求先补交「附加」材料再审批贷款。

words.enDefinition: conformity with rules or standards

examples.en: The panel is known for its fairness when settling shop disputes.
examples.zh: 这个仲裁小组处理店铺纠纷时以「公正」著称。

examples.en: Workers accepted the rota once its fairness had been demonstrated.
examples.zh: 排班表证明其「公平」后，工人们接受了安排。

words.enDefinition: the custodian of a collection (as a museum or library)

examples.en: The curator arranged the trade tools by decade in the new wing.
examples.zh: 「馆长」把贸易工具按年代陈列在新展厅。

examples.en: Our curator borrowed a complete steam press for the printing display.
examples.zh: 「策展人」为印刷展借来了一台完整的蒸汽压机。

words.enDefinition: something that is regarded as a chance event

examples.en: The butcher runs a monthly lottery with a ham as first prize.
examples.zh: 肉铺每月举办一次「抽奖」，头奖是一整只火腿。

examples.en: Winning the export contract felt like winning the lottery, she said.
examples.zh: 她说，赢得出口合同就像中了「彩票」一样。

words.enDefinition: specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee

examples.en: Counting the till is the closing chore nobody in the shop enjoys.
examples.zh: 清点收银机是店里没人愿意干的收尾「杂务」。

examples.en: Feeding the hens is a morning chore before the market run.
examples.zh: 赶集之前，喂鸡是每天早晨的「琐事」。

words.enDefinition: an unintentional omission resulting from failure to notice something

examples.en: By a simple oversight, the invoice went out without the VAT number.
examples.zh: 纯属「疏忽」，发票寄出时忘了写增值税号。

examples.en: Checking the manifest twice prevented another oversight like last month's.
examples.zh: 舱单核对两遍，避免了再出现上个月那样的「疏漏」。

words.enDefinition: the support, especially regular custom, given by customers to a business

examples.en: The bakery owes its survival to the steady patronage of office workers.
examples.zh: 面包店能撑下来，全靠上班族稳定的「光顾」。

examples.en: Loyal patronage lets the bookseller order risky titles with confidence.
examples.zh: 有了老顾客的「惠顾」，书店才有底气进冷门书。

words.enDefinition: the practice of giving expert advice within a particular field

examples.en: Her consultancy advises small farms on cold storage and packing.
examples.zh: 她的「咨询公司」为小农场提供冷藏和包装方面的建议。

examples.en: He left the bank to start a two-person logistics consultancy.
examples.zh: 他离开银行，开办了一家两人的物流「咨询公司」。

words.enDefinition: in accordance with convention or custom

examples.en: A deposit of one fifth is customary when booking the marquee.
examples.zh: 预订大帐篷时付五分之一定金是「惯例」。

examples.en: It is customary here to tip the market porters at Christmas.
examples.zh: 当地「惯例」是圣诞节给市场搬运工小费。

words.enDefinition: person who carries a message

examples.en: A bicycle messenger carried the signed contract across the city at noon.
examples.zh: 中午，一名骑自行车的「信使」把签好的合同送过全城。

examples.en: Send the keys by messenger; do not leave them with the porter.
examples.zh: 钥匙请交给「送件人」带走，不要留给门房。

words.enDefinition: of words or propositions so related that each is the negation of the other

examples.en: The bakery and the cheese shop are complementary, not rivals.
examples.zh: 面包房和奶酪店是「互补」生意，不是对手。

examples.en: Her design skills and his engineering form a complementary partnership.
examples.zh: 她的设计功底与他的工程技术形成了「互补」搭档。

words.enDefinition: having no limits in range or scope

examples.en: The contract promises unlimited refills of the house filter coffee.
examples.zh: 合同承诺本店过滤咖啡「无限量」续杯。

examples.en: Unlimited overtime is not a plan; it is a warning sign.
examples.zh: 「无节制」的加班不是计划，而是警报。

words.enDefinition: an act of being a tenant or occupant

examples.en: Her tenancy of the flower stall runs to the end of September.
examples.zh: 她租下花摊的「租期」到九月底。

examples.en: The new tenancy agreement adds a clause about winter heating.
examples.zh: 新的「租赁」合同增加了冬季供暖条款。

words.enDefinition: protection against future loss

examples.en: The insurer granted full indemnity for the flooded storeroom last week.
examples.zh: 保险公司上周对被水淹的储藏室给予全额「赔偿」。

examples.en: Ask for an indemnity clause before moving the wine collection.
examples.zh: 搬运这批藏酒之前，先要求加入「免责赔偿」条款。

words.enDefinition: in fortunate circumstances financially; moderately rich

examples.en: The prosperous market garden supplies greens to three coastal towns.
examples.zh: 这家生意「兴隆的」市场菜园向三个海滨城镇供应蔬菜。

examples.en: Ferry links made the island prosperous within a single decade.
examples.zh: 轮渡通航后十年，小岛便「繁荣」起来。

words.enDefinition: not financially safe or secure

examples.en: Speculative buying pushed tin futures far above the factory price.
examples.zh: 「投机性」买入把锡期货价格推得远高于工厂售价。

examples.en: His speculative bid for the dockland site shocked the auction room.
examples.zh: 他对码头地块的「投机性」出价震惊了整个拍卖厅。

words.enDefinition: an allegation that something imposes an illegal obligation or denies some legal right or causes injustice

examples.en: The union filed a grievance over the new weekend rota.
examples.zh: 工会就新的周末排班提出了「申诉」。

examples.en: Every grievance gets a written reply within ten working days.
examples.zh: 每起员工「不满」投诉都会在十个工作日内书面答复。

words.enDefinition: restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier

examples.en: The factory cafeteria serves soup and rolls until half past two.
examples.zh: 工厂「自助食堂」的汤一直供应到两点半。

examples.en: Renovating the staff cafeteria cut queue times at lunch by half.
examples.zh: 翻新员工「餐厅」后，午餐排队时间缩短了一半。

words.enDefinition: the state of being contingent on something

examples.en: A contingency fund covers ferry cancellations during the storm season.
examples.zh: 一笔「应急」基金用来应对风暴季的轮渡停航。

examples.en: The builder priced in a contingency for wet weekends on site.
examples.zh: 施工方在报价中留出了应对工地雨天的「意外」余量。

words.enDefinition: the guidance of ships or airplanes from place to place

examples.en: Heavy fog made navigation through the strait impossible until noon.
examples.zh: 中午之前大雾弥漫，海峡「航行」根本无法进行。

examples.en: Modern navigation kits let small fishing boats run at night safely.
examples.zh: 现代「导航」设备让小渔船能安全夜航。

words.enDefinition: relating to or having ability to think in or work with numbers

examples.en: The clerk's numerical error doubled the discount on the invoice.
examples.zh: 文员的「数字」错误把发票上的折扣翻了一倍。

examples.en: Applicants take a short numerical test before the interview round.
examples.zh: 面试环节之前，申请者要先做一项简短的「数字」测验。

words.enDefinition: characterized by speed; moving with or capable of moving with high speed

examples.en: Thanks to a speedy response, the spill never reached the harbour.
examples.zh: 由于「迅速」处置，泄漏物没有流入港口。

examples.en: We wish you a speedy recovery and a seat back on the team.
examples.zh: 祝你早日「康复」，早日回到团队。

words.enDefinition: the first event in a series

examples.en: A good opener gets the pitch noticed before anyone checks their phone.
examples.zh: 一个精彩的「开场白」能在别人掏手机之前就抓住注意力。

examples.en: The festival's opening night is the traditional opener for the tourist season.
examples.zh: 艺术节开幕之夜历来是旅游季的「开场戏」。

words.enDefinition: statute enacted by a city government

examples.en: A city ordinance bans market stalls from blocking the fire exits.
examples.zh: 市「条例」禁止市场摊位堵塞消防出口。

examples.en: Under the new ordinance, shops must display their opening hours outside.
examples.zh: 根据新「法令」，商店必须在门外张贴营业时间。

words.enDefinition: bordering on or living or characteristic of those near the sea

examples.en: The maritime museum charts a century of coasting trade routes.
examples.zh: 这座「海事」博物馆绘制了一个世纪的沿海贸易航线。

examples.en: Every maritime insurance claim needs a copy of the cargo manifest.
examples.zh: 每宗「海事」保险索赔都需要一份舱单副本。

words.enDefinition: continuing forever or indefinitely

examples.en: The lease grants a perpetual right of way across the mill yard.
examples.zh: 租约授予穿过磨坊场院的「永久」通行权。

examples.en: Their perpetual bargaining wore out every supplier in the district.
examples.zh: 他们「没完没了的」讨价还价磨光了本地区所有供应商的耐心。

words.enDefinition: confer a trust upon

examples.en: We entrust only the night safe keys to the senior cashier.
examples.zh: 我们只把夜间保险箱钥匙「托付」给资深出纳。

examples.en: Parents entrust the school with their children's lunch money each week.
examples.zh: 家长们每周把孩子的午餐钱「交给」学校保管。

words.enDefinition: avoiding waste

examples.en: The smaller van is economical to run, saving us petrol every week.
examples.zh: 小型货车开起来「省油」，每周都帮我们省下汽油钱。

examples.en: Buying flour in sacks is more economical than small packets.
examples.zh: 整袋买面粉比小包装更「划算」。

words.enDefinition: the face value of a currency note, coin, or security

examples.en: The cashier keeps small denominations ready for the morning bus fares.
examples.zh: 收银员备好小「面额」钞票，方便早上找零公共汽车票钱。

examples.en: Church collections record every denomination, down to the copper coins.
examples.zh: 教会募捐记录每一种「面值」，连铜板也不放过。

words.enDefinition: to fulfil a promise or an obligation

examples.en: Customers can redeem these vouchers at any branch before Christmas.
examples.zh: 顾客可在圣诞节前于任何分店「兑换」这些代金券。

examples.en: He redeemed his promise to reopen the workshop within a month.
examples.zh: 他「兑现」了一个月内重开作坊的承诺。

words.enDefinition: made of or containing metal

examples.en: A metallic taste in the tap water prompted tests at the pumping station.
examples.zh: 自来水里有股「金属」味，泵站随即安排了检测。

examples.en: The artist paints with metallic inks that catch the shop window light.
examples.zh: 艺术家用带「金属光泽」的墨水作画，正好映衬橱窗的光。

words.enDefinition: undergoing no change when acted upon

examples.en: The coastal depot stayed unaffected by the rail strikes last week.
examples.zh: 上周铁路罢工期间，沿海货场的运营「未受影响」。

examples.en: Her pricing stayed unaffected by the rumours circling the trade.
examples.zh: 四处流传的行情传闻让她的定价依然「不受影响」。

words.enDefinition: act of turning to for assistance

examples.en: Small shops have little recourse when a wholesaler collapses with their deposits.
examples.zh: 批发商卷走定金倒闭时，小店铺几乎没有「追索」途径。

examples.en: The contract leaves us no recourse but to wait out the delay.
examples.zh: 合同没给我们留任何「追索权」，只能干等延误结束。

words.enDefinition: the remaining parts of something that has been wrecked

examples.en: Divers photographed the wreckage of the coal barge near the breakwater.
examples.zh: 潜水员拍下了防波堤附近运煤驳船的「残骸」。

examples.en: The garage towed the wreckage off the coast road before rush hour.
examples.zh: 高峰期之前，修车厂把事故「残骸」拖离了滨海公路。

words.enDefinition: deliberately avoiding; keeping away from or preventing from happening

examples.en: Tax avoidance through offshore accounts drew sharp questions at the hearing.
examples.zh: 听证会上，通过离岸账户「避税」的做法遭到尖锐质询。

examples.en: His careful avoidance of the wet paint saved the new sign.
examples.zh: 他小心「避开」未干的油漆，保住了新招牌。

words.enDefinition: grow by addition

examples.en: Interest will accrue on the loan from the day the ship sails.
examples.zh: 贷款利息自船只开航之日起开始「累积」。

examples.en: Loyalty points accrue faster on wholesale orders than retail ones.
examples.zh: 批发订单的会员积分「累积」速度比零售快。

words.enDefinition: the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required

examples.en: A shortfall in donor funds delayed the new ambulance by months.
examples.zh: 捐款「缺口」使新救护车的采购推迟了几个月。

examples.en: The harvest left a shortfall of two hundred tonnes for the contract.
examples.zh: 这次收成使合同出现了两百吨的「亏空」。

words.enDefinition: relating to the mood of verbs that is used simple in declarative statements

examples.en: Send an indicative price first; the firm quote follows the survey.
examples.zh: 先发一个「参考」价，勘察之后再报实价。

examples.en: Their cautious tone was indicative of a long negotiation ahead.
examples.zh: 他们谨慎的语气「表明」前面还有一场漫长的谈判。

words.enDefinition: not safe; involving risk of harm, loss, or failure

examples.en: The inspector declared the scaffolding unsafe after two days of storms.
examples.zh: 风暴过后两天，检查员宣布脚手架「不安全」。

examples.en: Stacking crates above head height is unsafe in a busy aisle.
examples.zh: 在繁忙通道把货箱堆过头顶很「危险」。

words.enDefinition: payment or reward (especially from a government) for acts such as catching criminals or killing predatory animals or enlisting in the military

examples.en: The government pays a bounty for every fox-proof fence installed.
examples.zh: 政府为每个防狐围栏发放「奖励金」。

examples.en: A bounty of fifty pounds drew dozens of volunteers to the river clean-up.
examples.zh: 五十英镑的「赏金」吸引了几十名志愿者参加河道清理。

words.enDefinition: water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere

examples.en: This month's rainfall already tops the whole of last summer.
examples.zh: 本月的「降雨量」已经超过去年整个夏天。

examples.en: Low rainfall pushed hay prices up before the fair even opened.
examples.zh: 集市还没开，「降雨量」偏少就抬高了干草价格。

words.enDefinition: something owned; any tangible or intangible possession that is owned by someone;

examples.en: Staff must keep their belongings in the lockers, not under the counter.
examples.zh: 员工必须把「随身物品」放进储物柜，不能塞在柜台下面。

examples.en: She gathered her belongings and left the workshop for the last time.
examples.zh: 她收拾好「个人物品」，最后一次离开了作坊。

words.enDefinition: skilled worker who practices some trade or handicraft

examples.en: Each artisan signs the bottom of the bowls thrown in this studio.
examples.zh: 这间工作室出的每只碗，底部都有「工匠」的签名。

examples.en: The shop is run by an artisan who still cuts glass by hand.
examples.zh: 店主是一位仍坚持手工切割玻璃的「手艺人」。

words.enDefinition: having many parts or sides

examples.en: A multilateral deal cut tariffs for every port on the route.
examples.zh: 一项「多边」协议为航线上的所有港口削减了关税。

examples.en: Multilateral talks on freight standards resume in Geneva next month.
examples.zh: 货运标准的「多边」会谈下月在日内瓦重启。

words.enDefinition: tending to float on a liquid or rise in air or gas

examples.en: Cork floats because it is naturally buoyant even when soaked.
examples.zh: 软木即使泡透也能浮着，因为它天生「有浮力」。

examples.en: Buoyant demand for bicycles kept the hire shop open all winter.
examples.zh: 自行车需求「火爆」，租车店整个冬天都没歇业。

words.enDefinition: distance measured in miles

examples.en: The van's mileage doubled once we added the Friday market run.
examples.zh: 加了周五集市路线后，货车的「里程」翻了一倍。

examples.en: She claims mileage from the depot to every farm she audits.
examples.zh: 她按从货场到每个受审农场的「英里数」报销车费。

words.enDefinition: the charge for mailing something

examples.en: The postage on our sample boxes rose again this January.
examples.zh: 今年一月，样品箱的「邮费」又涨了。

examples.en: We always add postage to the invoice for mail-order deliveries.
examples.zh: 邮购订单的「邮资」会计入发票。

words.enDefinition: small and inadequate amount

examples.en: Scarcity of clean water raised the price of bottled stock at the depot.
examples.zh: 净水的「稀缺」抬高了货站瓶装水的价格。

examples.en: A scarcity of seasonal pickers left half the orchard unpicked.
examples.zh: 采摘工「短缺」让半个果园的果子无人摘收。

words.enDefinition: a formal or official announcement or notice

examples.en: You will get a notification when the repaired till is ready.
examples.zh: 修好的收银机好了，你会收到「通知」。

examples.en: Ten days' written notification is required before closing the stall.
examples.zh: 歇业摊位须提前十天发出书面「通知」。

words.enDefinition: slow-moving; (of a market or business) not active or brisk

examples.en: Sales stayed sluggish through February, with hardly any weekend custom.
examples.zh: 二月份生意「萧条」，周末几乎没什么客人。

examples.en: The sluggish ferry service pushed shoppers toward the inland mall.
examples.zh: 「迟缓的」轮渡服务把购物者推向了内陆商场。

words.enDefinition: do without or cease to hold or adhere to

examples.en: The hotel waived the cancellation fee because of the ferry strike.
examples.zh: 因轮渡罢工，酒店「免除」了取消费。

examples.en: Suppliers rarely waive the minimum-order rule for brand new shops.
examples.zh: 供应商很少为新店铺「放弃」最低起订量的规定。

words.enDefinition: written declaration made under oath; a written statement sworn to be true before someone legally authorized to administer an oath

examples.en: The witness signed an affidavit swearing she saw the truck leave at six.
examples.zh: 证人签署了一份「宣誓书」，保证自己六点看见卡车离开。

examples.en: The bank requires a signed affidavit before releasing the estate funds.
examples.zh: 银行要求先提交签署的「宣誓书」才发放遗产资金。

words.enDefinition: something immaterial that interferes with or delays action or progress

examples.en: Poor harbour access is the main impediment to bigger cruise calls.
examples.zh: 港口通道不畅是大型邮轮靠泊的主要「障碍」。

examples.en: A speech impediment never held him back at client meetings.
examples.zh: 言语「障碍」从未影响他出席客户会议。

words.enDefinition: to enlarge beyond bounds or the truth

examples.en: The brochure overstates the van's range; flat hills drain the battery faster.
examples.zh: 宣传册「夸大」了货车的续航，平缓的坡地更耗电池。

examples.en: Do not overstate the savings; buyers will test every claim.
examples.zh: 别「夸大」节省的金额，买家会逐条验证。

words.enDefinition: making something valid by formally ratifying or confirming it

examples.en: Parliament's ratification of the harbour deal took eleven long months.
examples.zh: 议会「正式批准」港口协议花了十一个月。

examples.en: Union members still await ratification of the new shift agreement.
examples.zh: 工会会员正等待「批准」新的轮班协议。

words.enDefinition: past due; not paid at the scheduled time

examples.en: The third reminder says our account is two weeks overdue.
examples.zh: 第三份催款单说我们的账款已「逾期」两周。

examples.en: Return the pressure washer before Friday or it counts as overdue.
examples.zh: 高压清洗机周五前归还，否则按「过期」计。

words.enDefinition: to send goods to a person or place to be sold or forwarded

examples.en: The potter consigns her bowls to the gallery rather than selling direct.
examples.zh: 陶艺师把碗「寄售」给画廊，而不是直接销售。

examples.en: The farm consigns its cheese to the city market every Thursday.
examples.zh: 农场每周四把奶酪「托运」进城销售。

words.enDefinition: fraudulent; having a misleading appearance

examples.en: A bogus inspector tried to charge shops for fake safety checks.
examples.zh: 一名「假冒的」检查员想向店铺收取假安全检查费。

examples.en: The bogus fifty-pound notes fooled two tills before the bank flagged them.
examples.zh: 「伪造的」五十英镑假币骗过两台收银机后才被银行识别。

words.enDefinition: solidify, firm, or strengthen

examples.en: The auditor asked us to substantiate every travel claim with receipts.
examples.zh: 审计师要求我们用收据「证实」每一笔差旅报销。

examples.en: Rumours of a buyout were never substantiated by the board.
examples.zh: 董事会从未「证实」过收购传闻。

words.enDefinition: not limited or restricted

examples.en: She gave the design her unqualified approval and ordered a full print run.
examples.zh: 她对设计「毫无保留」地认可，并下令全量印制。

examples.en: Unqualified praise from the food magazine doubled our weekend bookings.
examples.zh: 杂志「毫无保留的」称赞让周末预订翻倍。

words.enDefinition: evaluate or estimate the nature, quality, ability, extent, or significance of

examples.en: An expert came to appraise the collection before the estate sale.
examples.zh: 遗产拍卖前，一位专家前来「估价」这批藏品。

examples.en: Managers appraise each trainee's progress at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 月底时，经理们会「评估」每位学员的进步。

words.enDefinition: to refuse to accept, acknowledge, or honour as valid, especially a claim, debt, or obligation

examples.en: The buyer repudiated the contract when the bolts failed the third test.
examples.zh: 螺栓第三次检测不合格后，买方「拒绝履行」合同。

examples.en: The heirs repudiate any claim that grandfather owed the bank money.
examples.zh: 继承人「否认」祖父欠银行钱的说法。

words.enDefinition: pay back for some expense incurred

examples.en: The firm will reimburse your train fare if you keep the ticket.
examples.zh: 只要保留车票，公司就会给你「报销」火车费。

examples.en: We reimbursed the customer in full after the cooler arrived damaged.
examples.zh: 冷藏箱到货损坏后，我们向顾客作了全额「赔付」。

words.enDefinition: an accounting account used to hold items pending classification

examples.en: The mystery payment sits in the suspense account until the clerk sorts it out.
examples.zh: 这笔来路不明的款项先挂在「暂记」账户，等文员查明。

examples.en: A suspense account caught the duplicate rent transfer for three weeks.
examples.zh: 一个「暂记」账户挂了三周重复划转的租金。

words.enDefinition: piece of unexpected good fortune, especially a sudden financial gain

examples.en: The land sale brought the village a windfall of half a million pounds.
examples.zh: 卖地给村子带来五十万英镑的「意外之财」。

examples.en: A windfall tax cut into the energy company's surprise profits.
examples.zh: 「暴利」税削减了能源公司意外所得的利润。

words.enDefinition: not growing or changing; without force or vitality

examples.en: Trade has been stagnant since the mill closed last autumn.
examples.zh: 自去年秋天磨坊关闭以来，生意一直「停滞」。

examples.en: Wages stayed stagnant while rents kept climbing in the port district.
examples.zh: 港区租金一路上涨，工资却原地「踏步」。

words.enDefinition: criminal falsification by making or altering an instrument with intent to defraud

examples.en: Police confirmed the signature on the bill of sale was a forgery.
examples.zh: 警方确认买卖单据上的签名是「伪造的」。

examples.en: The gallery quietly withdrew two paintings suspected of being forgeries.
examples.zh: 画廊悄悄撤下了两幅疑为「赝品」的画作。

words.enDefinition: secret agreement

examples.en: The fuel distributors firmly denied collusion on the regional price lists.
examples.zh: 燃油经销商坚决否认在地区价目单上存在「串通」。

examples.en: Two bidders were banned after evidence of collusion at the tender.
examples.zh: 投标中出现「勾结」证据后，两家投标人被禁赛。

words.zhGloss: 招股说明书；发售说明书
words.enDefinition: formal written offer to sell securities (filed with the SEC) that sets forth a plan for a (proposed) business enterprise
acceptedZhAnswers: 招股说明书；发售说明书

examples.en: Read the prospectus carefully before you put savings into the bond.
examples.zh: 把积蓄投入债券前，请仔细阅读「招股说明书」。

examples.en: The bakery's prospectus promised three new shops within two years.
examples.zh: 面包店的「发售说明书」承诺两年内新开三家门店。

words.enDefinition: diplomat appointed by a government to protect its commercial interests and help its citizens in a foreign country

examples.en: The consul helped the crew recover their wages in a foreign port.
examples.zh: 「领事」帮船员在外国港口讨回了工资。

examples.en: Trade complaints go through the consul's office before reaching the ministry.
examples.zh: 贸易投诉先经「领事馆」办公室处理，再转交主管部门。

words.enDefinition: one that is absent or not in residence

examples.en: Friday's shift had three absentees, so the depot ran short-handed.
examples.zh: 周五的班次有三名「缺勤者」，货场人手不足。

examples.en: The landlord chased every absentee tenant about the winter rent.
examples.zh: 房东向每位「不在场的」租户追讨冬季租金。

words.enDefinition: compensation (given or received) for an insult or injury

examples.en: The court ordered the factory to pay reparation for the polluted stream.
examples.zh: 法院责令工厂为污染的溪流支付「赔偿」。

examples.en: Full reparation for the smashed crates was settled within a week.
examples.zh: 砸坏货箱的全部「赔偿」一周内就结清了。

words.enDefinition: stating an amount as less than it actually is, especially in accounts or tax

examples.en: The auditor called the missing fuel log an understatement of costs.
examples.zh: 审计员称缺失的燃料记录是对成本的「少报」。

examples.en: Reporting the vintage as one crate was a deliberate understatement.
examples.zh: 把那批年份酒报成一箱是刻意的「少报」。

words.enDefinition: stone that is used to mark a grave

examples.en: The stonemason carved the merchant's name deep into the tombstone.
examples.zh: 石匠把这位商人的名字深深刻进「墓碑」。

examples.en: Lichen covered the old tombstones along the churchyard's east wall.
examples.zh: 教堂院墙东边的旧「墓碑」上长满了地衣。

words.enDefinition: assets that are saleable though not material or physical

examples.en: Goodwill is an intangible asset, yet it sold the bakery for more.
examples.zh: 商誉是一种「无形」资产，却让面包店卖出了更高价。

examples.en: Reputation still counts as intangible value on most balance sheets.
examples.zh: 声誉在大多数资产负债表上仍属于「无形」价值。

words.enDefinition: consisting of a haphazard assortment of different kinds

examples.en: A sundry box in the storeroom holds string, labels, and spare keys.
examples.zh: 储藏室的「杂物」盒里装着细绳、标签和备用钥匙。

examples.en: Sundry debts under fifty pounds were written off in March.
examples.zh: 三月里，五十英镑以下的「杂项」欠款被核销了。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being fraudulent

examples.en: Selling margarine as butter is plain deceit, the inspector said.
examples.zh: 检验员说，把人造黄油当黄油卖纯粹是「欺骗」。

examples.en: Years of small deceits finally collapsed the whole trading partnership.
examples.zh: 多年的小小「欺诈」最终拖垮了这家贸易合伙行。

words.enDefinition: activity involved in maintaining something in good working order

examples.en: Monthly upkeep of the cold room costs more than the electricity.
examples.zh: 冷藏间每月的「养护」费用比电费还高。

examples.en: The tenant covers internal upkeep while the landlord repairs the roof.
examples.zh: 租户承担室内「维护」，屋顶修缮归房东。

words.enDefinition: not producing or capable of producing

examples.en: An unproductive afternoon of meetings cost the depot a delivery run.
examples.zh: 一下午开会毫无「产出」，害得货场少跑一趟送件。

examples.en: The northern field is unproductive, so we graze sheep there instead.
examples.zh: 北边那块地「长不出东西」，我们改在那里放羊。

words.enDefinition: any heavy material used to stabilize a ship or airship

examples.en: Gravel served as ballast until the timber cargo was loaded at noon.
examples.zh: 中午木材装船之前，先用砂石充当「压舱物」。

examples.en: Shifting ballast in the storm tilted the old barge dangerously.
examples.zh: 风暴中「压舱物」移位，旧驳船险情骤起。

words.enDefinition: remote and undeveloped area

examples.en: Farmers from the green hinterland bring butter to the coast market weekly.
examples.zh: 绿色「腹地」的农户每周把黄油带到海边市场。

examples.en: The port grew rich by taxing goods moving into its hinterland.
examples.zh: 港口靠对运入「腹地」的货物征税而致富。

words.enDefinition: cancel officially

examples.en: The board voted to rescind the parking levy after the protests.
examples.zh: 抗议之后，董事会投票「撤销」了停车税。

examples.en: The college rescinded the offer when the transcripts failed to arrive.
examples.zh: 成绩单迟迟未到，学院「取消」了录取通知。

words.enDefinition: formal or authoritative proclamation

examples.en: The mayor's edict ordered all stalls shut by eight each evening.
examples.zh: 市长的「法令」要求所有摊位每晚八点前收摊。

examples.en: An imperial edict opened the river trade to every licensed boat.
examples.zh: 一纸「敕令」向所有持照船只开放了内河贸易。

words.enDefinition: deprive of by deceit

examples.en: The pair defrauded pensioners out of savings with a fake roof repair.
examples.zh: 两人用假屋顶维修「骗取」了养老金领取者的积蓄。

examples.en: Companies that defraud buyers face bans under trading standards rules.
examples.zh: 「欺诈」买家的公司将依据交易标准法规被禁业。

words.enDefinition: contestant (human or animal) not considered to have a good chance to win

examples.en: As an outsider to the trade, he asked questions buyers never dared.
examples.zh: 作为业外「外人」，他问出了买家从不敢问的问题。

examples.en: Outsiders rarely get to see how the fish auctions really run.
examples.zh: 「行外人」很少能看到鱼类拍卖的真实运作。

words.enDefinition: the act of throwing cargo overboard to save a ship; discarding something burdensome

examples.en: The captain ordered the jettison of half the cargo to save the brig.
examples.zh: 为保住双桅船，船长下令「弃掉」一半货物。

examples.en: They jettisoned the plan for a second pier after the survey.
examples.zh: 勘察之后，他们「放弃」了修建第二个码头的计划。

words.enDefinition: without cause

examples.en: The lawyer's gratuitous advice saved the stallholder a court fee.
examples.zh: 律师「无偿的」指点为摊主省下了一笔诉讼费。

examples.en: Critics called the extra charges gratuitous, with no service behind them.
examples.zh: 批评者称这些「无缘无故」加收的费用背后并无任何服务。

words.enDefinition: person who has deposited money in a bank or similar institution

examples.en: Each depositor at the credit union is covered up to the limit.
examples.zh: 信用社的每位「存款人」都在限额内受到保障。

examples.en: The bank wrote to every depositor about the new branch hours.
examples.zh: 银行致函每位「储户」，告知新的营业时间。

words.enDefinition: have and control fully and exclusively

examples.en: One mill family monopolized flour milling across the whole valley.
examples.zh: 一家磨坊家族「垄断」了整个山谷的面粉研磨。

examples.en: Don't let one client monopolize your whole week of deliveries.
examples.zh: 别让一个客户「独占」你整周的配送时段。

words.enDefinition: so high or severe that it prevents something from being done or bought

examples.en: Cold storage fees are prohibitive in summer, so she sells fast.
examples.zh: 夏季冷藏费「贵得吓人」，所以她快进快出。

examples.en: Prohibitive parking charges pushed many shoppers to the out-of-town mall.
examples.zh: 「高得离谱」的停车费把许多购物者推向了城外商场。

words.enDefinition: incapable of being retracted or revoked

examples.en: Once you sign, the transfer becomes irrevocable under the new rules.
examples.zh: 按新规，签署之后转让即「不可撤销」。

examples.en: He called the acceptance letter irrevocable and booked the shipper.
examples.zh: 他说这份接受函「不可撤销」，随即预订了承运人。

words.enDefinition: lacking zest or vivacity

examples.en: The listless afternoon crowd left the vendors checking their phones.
examples.zh: 午后人群「无精打采」，摊主们只好刷起了手机。

examples.en: A listless welcome at the door cost the shop its regulars.
examples.zh: 门口「有气无力的」待客方式赶走了店里的老主顾。

words.enDefinition: acting or arriving or performed exactly at the time appointed

examples.en: The punctual milk float still arrives before the shops open.
examples.zh: 「准时的」送奶车仍在店铺开门前抵达。

examples.en: Being punctual at the fish auction means first choice of the catch.
examples.zh: 在鱼类拍卖场「守时」意味着能优先挑货。

words.enDefinition: the fraudulent appropriation of funds or property entrusted to your care but actually owned by someone else

examples.en: The treasurer was arrested for embezzlement of the raffle money.
examples.zh: 财务主管因「侵吞」抽奖款而被捕。

examples.en: Auditors uncovered embezzlement after two van payments went astray in spring.
examples.zh: 春天两笔购车款去向不明后，审计人员查出了「贪污」。

words.enDefinition: represented or appearing as such; pretended

examples.en: The inspection's ostensible purpose was safety; finding accounts came second.
examples.zh: 这次检查「名义上」为安全，查账才是其次。

examples.en: His ostensible reason for visiting was a broken freezer door.
examples.zh: 他来访「表面上」是为了那扇坏了的冰柜门。

words.enDefinition: strike in which the workers walk out

examples.en: A one-hour walkout delayed every delivery from the depot on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二一小时的「罢工」让货场的所有派送都延误了。

examples.en: The kitchen walkout ended once the owner restored the Sunday pay.
examples.zh: 老板恢复周日工资后，后厨「罢工」结束了。

words.enDefinition: make less central

examples.en: The chain plans to decentralize purchasing, giving each region its own buyers.
examples.zh: 连锁企业计划将采购「分权」，让各地区自设采购员。

examples.en: They decentralized the accounts office into three smaller regional hubs.
examples.zh: 他们把会计室「下放」为三个更小的地区中心。

words.enDefinition: someone chosen to judge and decide a disputed issue

examples.en: The arbitrator heard both carriers before fixing the shared berth fees.
examples.zh: 「仲裁人」听取两家承运方陈述后，确定了共用泊位费。

examples.en: An independent arbitrator settled the dispute over the rotten shipment.
examples.zh: 一位独立「仲裁员」了结了腐烂货物的纠纷。

words.enDefinition: an increase to counteract a perceived discrepancy

examples.en: The contract allows an annual escalation of storage fees with inflation.
examples.zh: 合同允许仓储费随通胀逐年「上调」。

examples.en: Quick talks last week prevented an escalation of the pricing dispute.
examples.zh: 上周的快速谈判阻止了价格争端的「升级」。

words.enDefinition: document effecting a property transfer

examples.en: The solicitor drafted the conveyance for the old mill and its yard.
examples.zh: 律师为老磨坊及其场院起草了「产权转让契据」。

examples.en: Sign the conveyance on Friday; the keys pass at noon.
examples.zh: 周五签署「转让契据」，钥匙中午交接。

words.enDefinition: being in demand by especially employers

examples.en: Apprenticeships turn raw helpers into marketable tradespeople within two years.
examples.zh: 学徒制能在两年内把新手培养成「抢手的」技工。

examples.en: The surplus wool is marketable if we clean and grade it first.
examples.zh: 多余羊毛只要先洗净分级就很「有销路」。

words.enDefinition: expend, as from a fund

examples.en: The treasurer disburses the float every Monday morning against receipts.
examples.zh: 财务每周一早晨凭收据「拨付」备用金。

examples.en: Grants were disbursed to the ferry fund after the audit.
examples.zh: 审计之后，补助金「拨付」给了轮渡基金。

words.enDefinition: someone who makes an offer

examples.en: The highest bidder took the pallets of tinned pears at noon.
examples.zh: 中午，出价最高的「竞买人」拍走了整托盘的罐装梨。

examples.en: One bidder asked to inspect the engines before the auction opened.
examples.zh: 拍卖开始前，一位「投标人」要求先查验那批发动机。

words.enDefinition: stock broker's business; charges a fee to act as intermediary between buyer and seller

examples.en: The brokerage earns its fee on every charter it fixes for us.
examples.zh: 这间「经纪行」按撮合的每份租船合同收取佣金。

examples.en: She left the city brokerage to run the family freight firm.
examples.zh: 她离开城里的「经纪公司」，回家经营家族货运生意。

words.enDefinition: relating to the near future

examples.en: The short-range forecast promises three dry days for the harvest.
examples.zh: 「短期」预报显示未来三天天气晴好，适合收割。

examples.en: Short-range planning covers the summer fair; the depot expansion is longer term.
examples.zh: 「近期」规划涵盖夏季集市；货场扩建则是更长远的事。

words.enDefinition: farmer who breed or raises livestock

examples.en: The stockman moves the herd to the high pasture every June.
examples.zh: 「牲畜饲养员」每年六月把牛群赶到高地牧场。

examples.en: A good stockman notices a lame ewe long before the vet does.
examples.zh: 好的「牧场工人」比兽医更早发现跛脚的母羊。

words.enDefinition: not conducive to commercial success

examples.en: The treasurer admits the mural fund is kindly but uncommercial.
examples.zh: 保留那幅褪色壁画是善意之举，却「无商业价值」。

examples.en: The new manager called the free teas for tramps uncommercial.
examples.zh: 新经理说，给流浪汉免费上茶这种做法「不赚钱」。

words.enDefinition: the act of intervening (as to mediate a dispute, etc.)

examples.en: Quick intervention by the harbourmaster saved the pontoon from drifting.
examples.zh: 港务长及时「介入」，救回了漂走的浮桥。

examples.en: Government intervention held the ferry fares flat through the summer.
examples.zh: 政府「干预」让轮渡票价整个夏天保持不变。

words.enDefinition: something (as a course of action) that is recommended as advisable

examples.en: On the vet's recommendation, we switched the herd to morning milking.
examples.zh: 根据兽医的「建议」，我们把牛群改为早晨挤奶。

examples.en: Her recommendation of the new tills carried weight with the board.
examples.zh: 她对新型收银机的「推荐」在董事会很有分量。

words.enDefinition: the act or process of finishing something

examples.en: Completion of the cold store slipped a week behind schedule.
examples.zh: 冷库的「完工」比计划推迟了一周。

examples.en: Payment is due on completion, not on signing the contract.
examples.zh: 款项在「竣工」时支付，而不是签合同时。

words.enDefinition: power to be effective; the quality of being able to bring about an effect

examples.en: The new rota's effectiveness shows in the shorter queue times.
examples.zh: 新排班表的「成效」体现在更短的排队时间上。

examples.en: We tested the glue's effectiveness on wet timber before ordering.
examples.zh: 下单之前，我们先在湿木料上测试了胶水的「效力」。

words.enDefinition: hypothesis that has been formed by speculating or conjecturing (usually with little hard evidence)

examples.en: Speculation in warehouse land pushed rents up before the bypass opened.
examples.zh: 绕城公路开通前，仓库用地的「投机」已把租金推高。

examples.en: Press speculation about a takeover unsettled the whole factory floor.
examples.zh: 媒体对「收购」的猜测让整个工厂车间人心浮动。

words.enDefinition: based in scientific and industrial progress

examples.en: Technological upgrades let the dairy track every churn by radio tag.
examples.zh: 「科技」升级让奶场能用射频标签追踪每一个奶桶。

examples.en: Old weavers remember when technological change emptied the mill towns.
examples.zh: 老织工还记得「技术」变革让磨坊城镇人去楼空的岁月。

words.enDefinition: restricting according to rules or principles

examples.en: The regulatory body inspects every fish market twice a year.
examples.zh: 「监管」机构每年对每个鱼市场检查两次。

examples.en: Regulatory approval for the new stone jetty took eighteen months.
examples.zh: 新石砌突堤的「审批」花了十八个月。

words.enDefinition: someone who enlists workers to join a union

examples.en: The organiser split the hundred stalls into eight numbered rows.
examples.zh: 「组织者」把一百个摊位分成八条编号的通道。

examples.en: As fair organiser, she books the stage and the security team.
examples.zh: 作为集市「主办方」，她负责预订舞台和安保团队。

words.enDefinition: a worker who takes part in a strike

examples.en: Each striker on the picket line took a turn holding the banner.
examples.zh: 纠察线上的每个「罢工者」轮流举着横幅。

examples.en: One striker read the company's offer aloud to the assembled crowd.
examples.zh: 一名「罢工者」向聚集的人群宣读了公司的方案。

words.enDefinition: voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause

examples.en: An anonymous donation of two hundred pounds repaired the school roof.
examples.zh: 一笔两百英镑的匿名「捐款」修好了校舍屋顶。

examples.en: The market's charity stall takes any donation for the lifeboats.
examples.zh: 集市慈善摊位接受任何金额的「捐赠」，用于救生艇基金。

words.enDefinition: failure to act with the prudence that a reasonable person would exercise under the same circumstances

examples.en: The court found negligence in leaving the loading gate unlocked overnight.
examples.zh: 法院认定，装卸门整夜未锁属于「疏忽」。

examples.en: His negligence with the gas rings nearly burned the kitchen down.
examples.zh: 他对燃气灶的「疏忽」差点把厨房烧掉。

words.enDefinition: tending to select; characterized by careful choice

examples.en: The wholesale club is selective about which producers it stocks.
examples.zh: 这家批发俱乐部对上架的生产商挑选得很「严格」。

examples.en: Selective cutting keeps the apple orchard healthy without heavy sprays.
examples.zh: 「有选择的」修剪让苹果园不用大量喷药也保持健康。

words.enDefinition: the act of making some area of land or water more profitable or productive or useful

examples.en: The mine's history includes the exploitation of generations of navvies.
examples.zh: 这座矿井的历史包含了对几代挖土工的「剥削」。

examples.en: Sensible exploitation of the peat bog funds the village school.
examples.zh: 对泥炭沼泽的合理「开发」支撑着村小学的运转。

words.enDefinition: legal proceeding in a court; a judicial contest to determine and enforce legal rights

examples.en: Costly litigation over the fence line dragged on for three years.
examples.zh: 围绕围栏界线的「诉讼」费用高昂，拖了三年。

examples.en: The insurer settled quickly to avoid litigation over the flooded stock.
examples.zh: 为避免水淹存货的「诉讼」，保险公司迅速和解。

words.enDefinition: making an important discovery

examples.en: A breakthrough in packaging kept the berries fresh for ten days.
examples.zh: 包装上的「突破」让浆果保鲜了十天。

examples.en: The young baker's breakthrough came with her seeded sourdough loaf.
examples.zh: 这位年轻面包师的「成名」靠的是她的籽料酸面团面包。

words.enDefinition: not made or become different

examples.en: Freight rates stayed unchanged through the whole of the spring season.
examples.zh: 整个春季，运费都保持「不变」。

examples.en: The recipe remains unchanged since the shop opened in 1962.
examples.zh: 自1962年开店以来，配方一直「未变」。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to or resembling a bureaucrat or bureaucracy

examples.en: Bureaucratic delays kept the export licence waiting for long months.
examples.zh: 「官僚」拖沓让出口许可证一压就是好几个月。

examples.en: Small traders complain about bureaucratic forms for every cattle move.
examples.zh: 小商贩抱怨每次转运牲口都要填「官样」表格。

words.enDefinition: formal confirmation that a person, product, or organisation meets specified requirements

examples.en: Organic certification for the creamery took two full growing seasons.
examples.zh: 奶油厂的「有机认证」花了整整两个生长季。

examples.en: Check the electrician's certification before he touches the fuse board.
examples.zh: 电工动手检修保险丝盒之前，先查验他的「资格证书」。

words.enDefinition: relating to or part of a binding legal agreement

examples.en: The haulier has no contractual duty to wait beyond thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 承运人「合同上」没有义务等候超过三十分钟。

examples.en: Their contractual right to the yard ends when the lease expires.
examples.zh: 租约到期，他们对场院的「合同」权利即告终止。

words.enDefinition: the act of enrolling

examples.en: Enrollment in the evening bookkeeping class doubled this autumn term.
examples.zh: 这个秋季学期，晚间簿记课的「报名人数」翻倍。

examples.en: Free enrollment attracted many dock workers to the safety course.
examples.zh: 免费「注册」吸引了码头工人来上安全课。

words.enDefinition: the state of being without a flaw or defect

examples.en: The baker's croissants are folded to perfection, layer upon layer.
examples.zh: 面包师的羊角包层层折叠，做得「完美」。

examples.en: Practice brought her icing work close to perfection by spring.
examples.zh: 到了春天，练习已让她的裱花近乎「完美」。

words.enDefinition: money set aside (as by a legislature) for a specific purpose

examples.en: The council's appropriation for harbour repairs passed without any debate.
examples.zh: 市政会港口修缮的「拨款」案未起争议便获通过。

examples.en: Next year's appropriation doubles the whole market square's maintenance budget.
examples.zh: 明年的「拨款」让市场广场维护预算翻倍。

words.enDefinition: a person who travels regularly between home and work

examples.en: The early ferry carries every commuter from the island before eight.
examples.zh: 早班轮渡八点前把岛上的每位「通勤者」送到对岸。

examples.en: Commuter parking by the station doubled the café's morning trade.
examples.zh: 车站旁的「通勤」停车让咖啡馆早市翻倍。

words.enDefinition: the act of pulling down or destroying a building or structure

examples.en: Demolition of the old grain silo begins after the nesting season.
examples.zh: 筑巢季一过，老谷仓筒仓就开始「拆除」。

examples.en: The demolition crew salvaged the slate before the walls came down.
examples.zh: 「拆除」队赶在墙倒之前抢救出了石板瓦。

words.enDefinition: an aggressive willingness to compete

examples.en: Cutting the turnaround time restored the port's competitiveness against Rotterdam.
examples.zh: 缩短周转时间重振了港口对鹿特丹的「竞争力」。

examples.en: The new subsidy shields farmers' competitiveness while input costs climb.
examples.zh: 投入成本攀升之际，补贴保护着农户的「竞争力」。

words.enDefinition: undisputed credibility

examples.en: The dealer guarantees the authenticity of every coin he sells.
examples.zh: 这位商人保证所售每枚钱币的「真实性」。

examples.en: Experts questioned the authenticity of the storm-damaged ledger's oldest pages.
examples.zh: 专家对那本遭风暴损毁账簿的「真伪」提出质疑。

words.enDefinition: state powerful enough to influence events throughout the world

examples.en: The grain deal linked a farming region with an industrial superpower.
examples.zh: 粮食交易把农业区和一个工业「超级大国」联系在一起。

examples.en: As an energy superpower, the state funds its own port upgrades.
examples.zh: 作为能源「超级大国」，该国自掏腰包升级港口。

words.enDefinition: section of a section; a part of a part; i.e., a part of something already divided

examples.en: Delivery terms appear in subsection four of the supply agreement.
examples.zh: 交货条款在供货协议第四「小节」。

examples.en: Check subsection (b) of the lease carefully before claiming the rebate.
examples.zh: 申领仓储返款前，先查看「分项」(b)。

words.enDefinition: having faults or defects; not working properly

examples.en: The faulty thermostat froze two whole crates of cream overnight.
examples.zh: 「失灵的」恒温器一夜之间冻坏了两箱奶油。

examples.en: We traced the billing errors to faulty software from the upgrade.
examples.zh: 账单出错的原因是升级带来的「有缺陷」软件。

words.enDefinition: the surrender of an insured interest to the insurer when claiming a total loss under marine insurance

examples.en: Notice of abandonment reached the insurers within the policy's deadline.
examples.zh: 「委付」通知在保单期限内送达了保险人。

examples.en: The abandonment of the flooded cargo ended the salvage attempt.
examples.zh: 「弃货」宣告了水淹货物的打捞努力结束。

words.enDefinition: the expertness characteristic of a professional person

examples.en: Her professionalism on the night of the fire impressed the inspectors.
examples.zh: 火灾当晚她表现出的「职业素养」令检查员印象深刻。

examples.en: Clients stay with the firm because of its quiet professionalism.
examples.zh: 客户留下来，靠的是公司低调的「专业精神」。

words.enDefinition: government building with five sides that serves as the headquarters of the United States Department of Defense

examples.en: The Pentagon announced new supply rules for all defence contractors.
examples.zh: 「五角大楼」宣布了对所有国防承包商的新供应规定。

examples.en: Reporters waited outside the Pentagon for the morning procurement briefing.
examples.zh: 记者们在「五角大楼」外等待采购简报。

words.enDefinition: consortium of independent organizations formed to limit competition by controlling the production and distribution of a product or service

examples.en: The freight cartel fixed haulage rates across the northern routes.
examples.zh: 货运「卡特尔」操纵了北部各条线路的运价。

examples.en: Cartel members share out the annual quotas at the spring meeting.
examples.zh: 「同业联盟」成员在春季会议上分配年度配额。

words.enDefinition: the act of conferring legality or sanction or formal warrant

examples.en: Customs authorization cleared the frozen lamb for the Sunday market.
examples.zh: 海关「许可」放行了周日市场的冷冻羊肉。

examples.en: Payment requires the written authorization of two signatories, not one.
examples.zh: 付款需要两名签署人的书面「授权」，一名不行。

words.enDefinition: remove the value from; deprive of its value

examples.en: The government moved to devalue the currency after the harvest failed.
examples.zh: 歉收之后，政府着手让货币「贬值」。

examples.en: Rising imports devalued the craft skills the village was proud of.
examples.zh: 进口货涌入让村里引以为豪的手艺「贬值」了。

words.enDefinition: belief in the importance of the individual and the virtue of self-reliance and personal independence

examples.en: The workshop prizes individualism, so each bench paints its own designs.
examples.zh: 作坊崇尚「个人主义」，每条工位都画自己的图案。

examples.en: His quiet individualism shows in the odd hours he keeps at the forge.
examples.zh: 他内敛的「个人主义」体现在铁匠铺里那些不寻常的作息上。

words.enDefinition: criminal offense of making false statements under oath

examples.en: The witness faced perjury charges after contradicting her own ledger.
examples.zh: 证人的说法与她自己账本矛盾，面临「伪证」指控。

examples.en: Lying under oath about the shipment dates amounts to perjury.
examples.zh: 就发货日期当庭撒谎即构成「伪证」。

words.enDefinition: forward movement

examples.en: The dredging crew finally made headway after the third week.
examples.zh: 第三周之后，疏浚队总算取得「进展」。

examples.en: We are making headway on the backlog of undelivered orders.
examples.zh: 未交付订单的积压问题正在逐步「解决」。

words.enDefinition: furnishing added support

examples.en: Wrapping and labelling are ancillary services charged by the hour.
examples.zh: 打包贴标属于「辅助」服务，按小时收费。

examples.en: The sawmill built an ancillary kiln to dry its own boards.
examples.zh: 锯木厂建了一座「附属」窑炉，烘干自产板材。

words.enDefinition: nonpayment of a debt when due

examples.en: The loan report flags any delinquency longer than ninety days.
examples.zh: 贷款报告会标记任何超过九十天的「拖欠」。

examples.en: Rising delinquency among the shop tenants worried the estate office.
examples.zh: 店铺租户「欠款」增多，让资产管理处担忧。

words.enDefinition: the development of industry on an extensive scale

examples.en: Industrialization moved the weaving from cottages into the new mills.
examples.zh: 「工业化」让织布从农家小屋搬进了新厂房。

examples.en: The railways drove industrialization faster than the old canals ever had.
examples.zh: 铁路推动「工业化」的速度远超旧日的运河。

words.enDefinition: run-down apartment house barely meeting minimal standards

examples.en: The whole family crowded into one room of the riverside tenement.
examples.zh: 全家挤在河畔「廉价公寓楼」的一个房间里。

examples.en: The council inspected the tenement stairwells before winter set in.
examples.zh: 入冬之前，市政会检查了这栋「旧公寓楼」的楼梯间。

words.enDefinition: the procedure of calculating; determining something by mathematical or logical methods

examples.en: The wage computation now runs automatically from the clock cards.
examples.zh: 工资「计算」如今由打卡记录自动完成。

examples.en: A slip in the duty computation cost the importer three hundred pounds.
examples.zh: 关税「计算」上的一处失误让进口商损失三百英镑。

words.enDefinition: misleading falsehood

examples.en: Selling the leaky barn as watertight is misrepresentation, plain and simple.
examples.zh: 把漏谷仓说成滴水不漏，纯属「虚假陈述」。

examples.en: The buyer sued the estate agent for misrepresentation over the inflated acreage.
examples.zh: 买方以面积夸大的「虚假陈述」为由起诉了房产中介。

words.enDefinition: (law) a gift of personal property by will

examples.en: A bequest of five hundred pounds funded the library's reading room.
examples.zh: 一笔五百英镑的「遗赠」资助了图书馆的阅览室。

examples.en: Her bequest left the workshop and its tools to the apprentices.
examples.zh: 她的「遗嘱」把作坊和工具留给了学徒们。

words.enDefinition: not having a job

examples.en: The jobless rate in the fishing quarter doubled last winter.
examples.zh: 去年冬天，渔业区的「失业率」翻了一番。

examples.en: Jobless yardsmen queued at the ferry office for mainland work.
examples.zh: 「失业的」船厂工人在轮渡办事处排队找对岸的活计。

words.enDefinition: rule of personal conduct

examples.en: The old trader's first precept was never to promise a price twice.
examples.zh: 老商人的第一条「准则」是从不二次承诺同一价格。

examples.en: Fair weighing is the market's founding precept, carved above the gate.
examples.zh: 公平称重是这个市场的立市「准则」，就刻在大门上方。

words.enDefinition: let off the hook

examples.en: The signed disclaimer does not absolve the carrier of care duties.
examples.zh: 签署的免责声明并不能「免除」承运人的照管义务。

examples.en: The tribunal absolved the driver because the fog was unforeseeable.
examples.zh: 因大雾无法预见，法庭「裁定司机无责」。

words.enDefinition: distribute anew

examples.en: The co-op votes to redistribute profits among its smallest members first.
examples.zh: 合作社投票决定把利润优先「再分配」给最小的成员。

examples.en: Surplus pallets were redistributed to the market gardeners at cost.
examples.zh: 富余托盘按成本价「调拨」给了市场菜农。

words.enDefinition: (law) an agreement or concession made by parties in a judicial proceeding (or by their attorneys) relating to the business before the court; must be in writing unless they are part of the court record

examples.en: The contract's main stipulation is delivery before the first frost.
examples.zh: 合同的主要「约定」是在初霜前交货。

examples.en: One stipulation forbids the subletting of stalls without written consent.
examples.zh: 其中一条「规定」禁止未经书面同意转租摊位。

words.enDefinition: sum of money allotted on a regular basis; usually for some specific purpose

examples.en: The apprentice receives a small stipend plus lodging above the bakery.
examples.zh: 学徒领取少量「津贴」，并住在面包店楼上。

examples.en: Her council stipend covers the ferry pass and work boots.
examples.zh: 她的议会「津贴」够付轮渡月票和工作靴。

words.enDefinition: judgment of not guilty

examples.en: The acquittal surprised everyone who had read the weighing records.
examples.zh: 看过称重记录的人都对这个「无罪判决」感到意外。

examples.en: After two hung juries, the third trial ended in acquittal.
examples.zh: 两次陪审团僵持后，第三次审判以「无罪开释」告终。

words.enDefinition: causing or able to cause nausea

examples.en: The crossing left several passengers queasy and leaning over the rail.
examples.zh: 这段航程让几位乘客一阵阵「恶心」，只好靠着船舷。

examples.en: He felt queasy about signing the deal without a survey.
examples.zh: 不做勘察就要签合同，他心里有点「发怵」。

words.enDefinition: the narrow part of a bottle near the top

examples.en: The single weighing bridge is the bottleneck at harvest time.
examples.zh: 收获季，唯一的过磅桥成了「瓶颈」。

examples.en: Hiring two more packers eased the packing bottleneck before Christmas.
examples.zh: 圣诞前多雇两名打包工缓解了「瓶颈」。

words.enDefinition: the conversion of wasteland into land suitable for use of habitation or cultivation

examples.en: Land reclamation added two acres to the quay for the timber yard.
examples.zh: 「填海造地」给码头增添了两英亩的木材场。

examples.en: Reclamation of the salt marsh took the villagers a decade.
examples.zh: 村民花了十年「开垦」那片盐沼。

words.enDefinition: habitual absence from work

examples.en: Monday absenteeism doubles whenever the ferry runs a late night.
examples.zh: 轮渡每开晚班，周一的「旷工」就会翻倍。

examples.en: The new bonus for full attendance cut absenteeism by half.
examples.zh: 新的全勤奖金让「缺勤」减少了一半。

words.enDefinition: seemingly boundless in amount, number, degree, or especially extent

examples.en: Her boundless energy kept the stall open through every storm.
examples.zh: 她「无穷的」精力让摊位在每场风暴里都照常营业。

examples.en: The apprentice showed boundless curiosity about every machine in the yard.
examples.zh: 学徒对货场里每台机器都怀着「无穷的」好奇。

words.enDefinition: (law) a voluntary repudiation of a person's legal claim to something

examples.en: Read the disclaimer on the ticket before boarding the hayride.
examples.zh: 乘干草车之前，先读一下票面上的「免责声明」。

examples.en: The catalogue carries a disclaimer about colour variations in yarns.
examples.zh: 目录里附有关于纱线色差的「免责声明」。

words.enDefinition: marked by abrupt transitions

examples.en: Trading turned choppy after the new fuel levy was announced.
examples.zh: 燃油附加费公布后，交易变得「震荡」。

examples.en: Choppy seas delayed the pilot boat by more than two hours.
examples.zh: 海面「波涛起伏」，引航船延迟了两小时。

words.enDefinition: relating to or involving money

examples.en: The judge awarded pecuniary damages for each of the lost contracts.
examples.zh: 法官就每一份丢失的合同判赔「金钱」损失。

examples.en: Pecuniary penalties apply to late filings at the trade registry.
examples.zh: 登记处对迟交的文件课以「金钱」处罚。

words.enDefinition: make unfashionable, outdated, or obsolete

examples.en: The outmoded card index finally gave way to a simple database.
examples.zh: 「过时的」卡片索引最终让位于简单的数据库。

examples.en: Buyers shunned the outmoded packaging style despite its fairer price.
examples.zh: 尽管价格公道，买家还是嫌弃那「老套的」包装。

words.enDefinition: deprive of status or authority

examples.en: The group was ordered to divest its stake in the ferry line.
examples.zh: 集团被要求「出售」其在轮渡公司的股份。

examples.en: The scandal finally divested the chairman of his trade honours.
examples.zh: 丑闻最终让这位主席被「剥夺」了贸易荣誉。

words.enDefinition: uninterrupted in time and indefinitely long continuing

examples.en: Three weeks of unremitting rain turned the market path to mud.
examples.zh: 「连绵不断的」三周降雨把赶集小道泡成了泥浆。

examples.en: Her unremitting care kept the orchard alive through the drought.
examples.zh: 她「不间断的」照料让果园熬过了旱季。

words.enDefinition: descriptive of any event or stimulus or process that has an effect on the effects of events or stimuli or process that occurred previously

examples.en: The retroactive pay rise covered every shift back to January.
examples.zh: 这次加薪「追溯」到一月份以来的每个班次。

examples.en: A retroactive tax on last year's exports angered the shippers.
examples.zh: 对去年出口「追溯」征税惹恼了货运商。

words.enDefinition: to give someone or something too much work, weight, or responsibility

examples.en: Don't overburden the night crew with day-shift repairs as well.
examples.zh: 别把白班的维修活也压给夜班，让他们「负担过重」。

examples.en: The old mule track was overburdened once the quarry reopened.
examples.zh: 采石场重开后，骡马道「不堪重负」。

words.enDefinition: someone who intrudes on the privacy or property of another without permission

examples.en: An interloper with cheap butter undercut every stall on the row.
examples.zh: 一个「闯入者」用廉价黄油把整排摊位的价都压了下去。

examples.en: The guild fined any interloper who sold within the walls.
examples.zh: 公会会对在城墙内兜售的任何「搅局的外来者」处以罚款。

words.enDefinition: declare invalid

examples.en: The judge moved to annul the lease signed by a minor.
examples.zh: 法官准备「废止」未成年人签署的租约。

examples.en: The registry annulled the merger papers because of missing signatures.
examples.zh: 因缺少签名，登记处「撤销」了合并文书。

words.enDefinition: full in all respects

examples.en: The plenary session votes on the harbour dues every autumn.
examples.zh: 「全体」会议每年秋季就港口税费表决。

examples.en: She holds plenary authority to sign contracts below ten thousand pounds.
examples.zh: 她拥有「完全」授权，可签署一万英镑以下的合同。

words.enDefinition: work produced by hand labor

examples.en: Her handicraft of rush baskets sells out by eleven most Saturdays.
examples.zh: 她的灯芯草篮子这种「手工艺品」多数周六十一点前就卖光。

examples.en: The museum shop stocks only local handicraft goods this season.
examples.zh: 博物馆商店本季只售卖本地「手工艺品」。

words.enDefinition: mass of precious metal

examples.en: The vault guards bullion shipments between the mint and the bank.
examples.zh: 金库护卫着铸币厂与银行之间的「金银锭」运输。

examples.en: Customs officers weighed all the bullion before sealing the strongbox.
examples.zh: 海关封箱之前称量了那些「金银块」。

words.enDefinition: a delay, or the amount by which something falls behind schedule

examples.en: Slippage in the delivery schedule pushed the fair back a week.
examples.zh: 交货计划的「延误」把集市推迟了一周。

examples.en: We allow one day's slippage between the ferry and the auction.
examples.zh: 轮渡与拍卖之间，我们预留了一天的「延误」余量。

words.enDefinition: not bound or pledged

examples.en: Two uncommitted growers still have not joined the export pool.
examples.zh: 还有两户「未表态的」种植户没有加入出口联营。

examples.en: Keep the van uncommitted until we know the festival dates.
examples.zh: 在确认节日档期之前，先别把货车「派定」用途。

words.enDefinition: to leave hurriedly and secretly, typically to avoid arrest or creditors, often taking money or property

examples.en: The cashier absconded with the weekend takings before the audit.
examples.zh: 审计之前，出纳带着周末的营业收入「潜逃」了。

examples.en: The tenant absconded owing two months' rent and the keys.
examples.zh: 租户欠下两个月房租，拿着钥匙「跑路」了。

words.enDefinition: revoke formally

examples.en: The new council voted to abrogate the old mooring rules.
examples.zh: 新市政会投票「废除」旧系泊规则。

examples.en: No partner may abrogate the pact without a year's notice.
examples.zh: 任何一方不得在不提前一年通知的情况下「废止」协议。

words.enDefinition: (usually followed by `to') able to be traced to

examples.en: Every crate is traceable back to the orchard by its stamp.
examples.zh: 凭印记，每只货箱都能「追溯」到来源果园。

examples.en: The missing payment was traceable to a mistyped account number.
examples.zh: 这笔失踪款项可以「追查」到一个误输的账号。

words.enDefinition: property inherited from one's ancestors; a heritage

examples.en: The orchard is the family patrimony, worked by four generations.
examples.zh: 这座果园是家族「祖产」，已传四代。

examples.en: Selling the patrimony to developers split the whole village council.
examples.zh: 把「祖业」卖给开发商让整个村委会分裂成两派。

words.enDefinition: appropriate (as property entrusted to one's care) fraudulently to one's own use

examples.en: The bookkeeper embezzled nearly nine thousand pounds from the petty cash.
examples.zh: 记账员「侵吞」了零用现金中近九千英镑。

examples.en: Anyone who embezzles club funds loses membership on the spot.
examples.zh: 任何人「贪污」俱乐部资金都会被当场除名。

words.enDefinition: wrongful conduct by a public official

examples.en: The report accused the harbourmaster of malfeasance over the mooring fees.
examples.zh: 报告指控港务长在系泊费上存在「渎职」行为。

examples.en: Council auditors uncovered malfeasance in two of the parking contracts.
examples.zh: 市政审计人员在两份停车合同中发现了「不法行为」。

words.enDefinition: divide society into social classes or castes

examples.en: The new seniority rules stratify the workforce into three pay bands.
examples.zh: 资历规则把员工「分层」为三个工资档。

examples.en: The new software stratifies the customers by their yearly spend.
examples.zh: 新软件按年度消费额对客户进行「分层」。

words.enDefinition: someone who travels about selling his wares (as on the streets or at carnivals)

examples.en: A hawker cried fresh mackerel along the quayside at dawn.
examples.zh: 清晨，「小贩」沿码头叫卖新鲜鲭鱼。

examples.en: All hawkers must display their market badge near the barrow.
examples.zh: 「叫卖小贩」须把集市徽章挂在推车附近。

words.enDefinition: official approval

examples.en: The new rota earned the approbation of every driver on shift.
examples.zh: 新排班表赢得了值班司机的交口「称赞」。

examples.en: Official approbation of the jetty design finally arrived in March.
examples.zh: 突堤设计的官方「认可」三月送达。

words.enDefinition: someone who travels about selling his wares (as on the streets or at carnivals)

examples.en: The pedlar called at the farm kitchens with ribbons and thread.
examples.zh: 「小贩」带着缎带和线团挨家敲开农舍厨房的门。

examples.en: A licensed pedlar may trade in the market before ten.
examples.zh: 持照「行商」可以在十点前进市场摆卖。

words.enDefinition: something that is lost or surrendered as a penalty;

examples.en: Forfeiture of the deposit followed the third missed delivery date.
examples.zh: 第三次误期交货后，定金被「没收」。

examples.en: The clause allows forfeiture of the stall licence for unpaid dues.
examples.zh: 条款允许对欠缴费用的摊位执照作「没收」处理。

words.enDefinition: someone legally empowered to witness signatures and certify a document's validity and to take depositions

examples.en: The notary stamped both paper copies of the partnership deed.
examples.zh: 「公证人」在合伙契约的两份纸质副本上盖了章。

examples.en: Bring your passport; the notary must verify every single signature.
examples.zh: 带上护照，「公证人」必须核实每一个签名。

words.enDefinition: only partly formed or developed; not yet complete

examples.en: Their claim to the old towpath remains inchoate until registration.
examples.zh: 登记完成之前，他们对旧纤道的权利主张尚属「初步」阶段。

examples.en: An inchoate idea for a night market filled his notebook.
examples.zh: 笔记本里记着他关于夜市的「初步」构想。

words.enDefinition: secure against future loss, damage, or liability; give security for

examples.en: The clause indemnifies the depot against claims from damaged freight.
examples.zh: 条款「保障」货场免受货损索赔。

examples.en: Insurers indemnify the stallholders for storm losses above the excess.
examples.zh: 保险公司对超过免赔额的风暴损失向摊主「赔付」。

words.enDefinition: an incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment (especially if it is regarded as a right)

examples.en: A company flat is a perquisite of the depot manager's post.
examples.zh: 公司公寓是货场经理这个职位的一项「额外补贴」。

examples.en: Free boiler fuel was once a perquisite of the boilermen.
examples.zh: 免费的锅炉燃料曾是锅炉工的一项「特权待遇」。

words.enDefinition: the act of paying money

examples.en: The defrayment of the harbour dues took three counter visits.
examples.zh: 港口税费的「缴纳」跑了三趟柜台。

examples.en: Full defrayment of the repair bill satisfied the yard owner.
examples.zh: 维修账单的全部「付清」让场主放了心。

words.enDefinition: commission paid to a factor or agent for services

examples.en: The factor's factorage on wool sales is two and a half percent.
examples.zh: 代理商按羊毛销售额抽取百分之二点五的「代理佣金」。

examples.en: Factorage rises once the yearly sales pass the agreed threshold.
examples.zh: 年销售额超过约定线后，「代理佣金」随之上调。

words.enDefinition: capable of being corrupted

examples.en: The venal customs man waved the crates through for a note.
examples.zh: 那个「贪赃的」海关人员收了钱就放行货箱。

examples.en: Voters doubted the venal alderman's promises about the fish market.
examples.zh: 选民不相信那个「可以收买的」市政参事关于鱼市的承诺。

words.enDefinition: an exorbitant or unlawful rate of interest

examples.en: The court struck down the loan as usury, charging forty percent a month.
examples.zh: 这笔月息百分之四十的放贷被法庭认定为「高利贷」而判无效。

examples.en: Medieval guilds punished usury far more harshly than petty smuggling.
examples.zh: 中世纪行会对「放高利贷」的惩罚远比小本走私严厉。

words.enDefinition: businessperson who transports goods abroad (for sale)

examples.en: The wool exporter books hull space three months ahead each spring.
examples.zh: 羊毛「出口商」每年春天提前三个月预订船位。

examples.en: As an exporter, she must declare every crate at the border.
examples.zh: 作为「出口商」，她必须在边境申报每一只货箱。

words.enDefinition: loss of goods through decay, damage, or waste, especially of inventory or raw materials

examples.en: Normal spoilage of two percent is built into the cheese budget.
examples.zh: 奶酪预算中计入了百分之二的正常「损耗」。

examples.en: The heatwave pushed spoilage in the cold store beyond all records.
examples.zh: 热浪使冷库中的「腐坏损失」超出以往所有记录。

words.enDefinition: an oil well with a strong natural flow so that pumping is not necessary

examples.en: The new well came in as a gusher, crude soaking the derrick floor.
examples.zh: 新井成了「自喷井」，原油漫过井架平台。

examples.en: Drillers capped the gusher before it flooded the valley road.
examples.zh: 钻井工人在「喷油井」淹没谷区道路之前把它封住了。

words.enDefinition: easily managed (controlled or taught or molded)

examples.en: The new apprentice is tractable, learning the press in a week.
examples.zh: 新学徒很「听话」，一周就学会了操作压机。

examples.en: A tractable crew accepted the new night rota without complaint.
examples.zh: 「好说话的」船员们毫无怨言地接受了新的夜班安排。

words.enDefinition: (law) the act of rescinding; the cancellation of a contract and the return of the parties to the positions they would have had if the contract had not been made

examples.en: The rescission of the charter left the ship idle in August.
examples.zh: 租船合同的「解除」让这条船八月闲置。

examples.en: Courts grant rescission when both sides can be restored to their starting positions.
examples.zh: 当双方都能恢复到签约前状态时，法院会准予「合同撤销」。

words.enDefinition: provide with computers

examples.en: The depot plans to computerize its stock records by October.
examples.zh: 货场计划在十月前把库存记录「电脑化」。

examples.en: They computerized the payroll years before the market office did.
examples.zh: 他们的工资系统「实现电脑化」比市场办公室早了好几年。

words.enDefinition: the quality of not being open or truthful; deceitful or hypocritical

examples.en: Customers quickly sensed the insincerity behind the shop's rehearsed apology.
examples.zh: 顾客很快察觉到店铺背台词式道歉背后的「不真诚」。

examples.en: Her insincerity at the supplier meeting cost us the discount.
examples.zh: 她在供应商会议上的「虚情假意」让我们丢了折扣。

words.enDefinition: an agent who handles something or someone

examples.en: Each cargo handler wears gloves rated for the frozen racks.
examples.zh: 每位「装卸工」都戴着适用于冷冻货架的手套。

examples.en: A calm handler keeps the stallion settled at the sales ring.
examples.zh: 沉着的「驯马师」让种马在拍卖场里保持安静。

words.enDefinition: fee paid for a nominally free service

examples.en: The guest lecturer received an honorarium rather than a salary.
examples.zh: 客座讲师收到的是一笔「酬金」，而非工资。

examples.en: An honorarium of fifty pounds thanked the retired inspector for his talk.
examples.zh: 五十英镑的「谢礼」答谢了退休稽查员的演讲。

words.enDefinition: person who pays money for something

examples.en: The payer must quote the invoice number on every transfer.
examples.zh: 「付款人」在每笔转账时都必须注明发票号。

examples.en: As the payer of last resort, the fund settles unpaid wages.
examples.zh: 作为最后的「付款方」，基金用于结清欠付工资。

words.enDefinition: (of paper money) not convertible into coin at the pleasure of the holder

examples.en: The irredeemable bonds pay interest forever but never return the principal.
examples.zh: 这种「不可赎回的」债券永远付息，但永不还本。

examples.en: Critics called the new irredeemable notes little better than confetti.
examples.zh: 批评者称新发行的「不可兑换」纸币与废纸相差无几。

words.enDefinition: a ship that trades along a coast

examples.en: The old coaster carries timber between the small river ports.
examples.zh: 这艘旧「沿海贸易船」在小河港之间运送木材。

examples.en: A coaster built in 1911 still plies the sheltered bays.
examples.zh: 一艘1911年建造的「沿岸商船」仍在平静的海湾间往返。

words.enDefinition: benefice to which no spiritual or pastoral duties are attached

examples.en: The archive post is a sinecure, an hour of sorting and long lunches.
examples.zh: 档案室这份差事是个「闲职」，整理一小时、午餐大半天。

examples.en: He quietly turned the honorary chairmanship into a well-paid sinecure.
examples.zh: 他把荣誉主席一职变成了薪酬丰厚的「挂名差事」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of cargo that can be held by a boat or ship or a freight car

examples.en: A shipload of Moroccan oranges arrived before the frost fair.
examples.zh: 一「整船」摩洛哥橙子在霜冻集市前到港。

examples.en: They ordered a shipload of slate for the courtyard roofs.
examples.zh: 他们订购了「一船」石板用于庭院屋顶。

words.enDefinition: of or limited to or involving supervision

examples.en: Her supervisory duties cover the weighbridge and the night gate.
examples.zh: 她的「监督」职责涵盖过磅桥和夜间大门。

examples.en: The board created a new supervisory committee for the ferry refit.
examples.zh: 董事会为轮渡翻新设立了一个新的「监督」委员会。

words.enDefinition: an advertisement (usually printed on a page or in a leaflet) intended for wide distribution

examples.en: A brightly printed flyer announced the pony club's open day.
examples.zh: 一张印制鲜艳的「传单」宣布了小马俱乐部的开放日。

examples.en: Volunteers handed a flyer to every car waiting at the level crossing.
examples.zh: 志愿者向每个在铁路道口等候的人发「宣传单」。

words.enDefinition: grant of financial aid as from a government to an educational institution

examples.en: A state subvention keeps the island ferry running through winter.
examples.zh: 州「补助金」让岛上轮渡整个冬天继续运营。

examples.en: The orchestra survives on a small municipal subvention each year.
examples.zh: 乐团每年靠一笔小额市政「补贴」维持。

words.enDefinition: be earlier in time; go back further

examples.en: The clerk noticed the receipt was antedated by three days.
examples.zh: 文员发现这张收据的日期被「倒填」了三天。

examples.en: Printed guides antedate the tower by at least a century.
examples.zh: 印行的这些指南比塔楼「早」了至少一个世纪。

words.enDefinition: servant employed to do a variety of jobs

examples.en: As general factotum, Marta opens the shop, fixes the boiler, and does the books.
examples.zh: 身为「杂务总管」，玛尔塔要开店、修锅炉、还要记账。

examples.en: The young factotum knows every key and every trader's moods.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的「打杂工」熟悉每把钥匙和每位商人的脾气。

words.enDefinition: political system governed by the wealthy people

examples.en: Shipping families formed a plutocracy that ran the port for decades.
examples.zh: 航运家族组成了一个把持港口数十年的「财阀统治集团」。

examples.en: Critics say the council has drifted into a plutocracy of mill owners.
examples.zh: 批评者说市政会已沦为磨坊主们的「财阀统治」。

words.enDefinition: a frame or hook on which clothes are hung

examples.en: Return each padded hanger to the rail after the fitting.
examples.zh: 试衣后请把每个软垫「衣架」放回挂杆。
