examples.en: Wet coats bent every single wooden hanger in the cloakroom.
examples.zh: 湿大衣压弯了衣帽间里所有木质「衣架」。

words.enDefinition: file of memoranda or notices that remind of things to be done

examples.en: Her tickler file reminds the office of every licence renewal.
examples.zh: 她的「备忘」档案提醒办公室每一个执照续期。

examples.en: Check the tickler before you promise any firm delivery date.
examples.zh: 在承诺任何交期之前，先查一下「备忘录」。

words.enDefinition: an exhibition of cowboy skills

examples.en: The autumn rodeo draws stockmen and their families from three counties.
examples.zh: 秋季「牛仔竞技会」吸引了三个郡的牧场工人及其家人。

examples.en: Rodeo week doubles the takings of every saloon in town.
examples.zh: 「竞技表演周」让镇上每家酒馆的进账翻倍。

words.enDefinition: make a budget

examples.en: Careful budgeting kept the bakery open through two price spikes.
examples.zh: 精心的「预算编制」让面包店撑过了两次涨价风潮。

examples.en: Budgeting for the refit starts with the shipyard's written quote.
examples.zh: 翻新工程的「预算」工作从船厂的报价开始。

words.enDefinition: terseness and economy in writing and speaking achieved by expressing a great deal in just a few words

examples.en: The sheer conciseness of the tender impressed the harbour board.
examples.zh: 投标书的「简洁」给港务局留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: The judges praised the manual's conciseness and its clear diagrams.
examples.zh: 评委称赞手册的「简明扼要」和清晰的图示。

words.enDefinition: an obligation to pay money to another party

examples.en: The firm's indebtedness tripled after work began on the second cold store.
examples.zh: 第二座冷库动工后，公司的「负债」翻了三倍。

examples.en: Rising indebtedness among the young smallholders worried the cooperative's treasurer.
examples.zh: 小农户「负债」不断上升，让合作社司库忧心。

words.zhGloss: 特大超市；大型超级市场
words.enDefinition: huge supermarket (usually built on the outskirts of a town)
acceptedZhAnswers: 特大超市；大型超级市场

examples.en: The new hypermarket on the ring road draws shoppers from three towns.
examples.zh: 环路旁新开的「大型超级市场」吸引了三个城镇的购物者。

examples.en: Small greengrocers struggle badly once a huge hypermarket opens nearby.
examples.zh: 附近一开「特大超市」，小蔬果店就很难熬。

words.enDefinition: someone whose business is advertising

examples.en: The advertiser booked every billboard along the coast road for June.
examples.zh: 「广告商」包下了沿海公路六月所有的广告牌。

examples.en: Local advertisers pay the ferry bulletin to reach daily travellers.
examples.zh: 本地「广告主」付费在轮渡简报上触达每日旅客。

words.enDefinition: commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country

examples.en: Exportation of raw wool once funded the whole valley's trade.
examples.zh: 生羊毛「出口」曾养活整个山谷。

examples.en: New rules now restrict the exportation of unprocessed timber logs.
examples.zh: 新规限制了未加工原木的「出口」。

words.enDefinition: Same as Transshipment.

examples.en: Transhipment at Rotterdam adds four days to the delivery schedule.
examples.zh: 在鹿特丹「转运」会使交货期多出四天。

examples.en: The transhipment of grain from barge to silo runs overnight.
examples.zh: 粮食从驳船「转载」入筒仓的工作连夜进行。

words.enDefinition: time unit of approximately 30 days

examples.en: Rent is due on the first day of each month.
examples.zh: 租金在每「月」一号到期缴付。

examples.en: The refit slipped a month, pushing the launch into October.
examples.zh: 翻新工程拖了「一个月」，下水仪式推迟到十月。

words.enDefinition: unit of weight equivalent to 1000 kilograms

examples.en: The barge carries six hundred tonnes of gravel per run.
examples.zh: 驳船每趟运送六百「吨」砂砾。

examples.en: Prices rose ten pounds per tonne after the quay closed.
examples.zh: 码头关闭后，价格每「吨」上涨十英镑。

words.enDefinition: the number 1,000,000,000,000 (10¹²) in the short scale used in modern English

examples.en: The infrastructure plan promises a trillion pounds of port spending.
examples.zh: 基础设施计划承诺投入「万亿」英镑的港口开支。

examples.en: Trade in the bloc tops a trillion dollars a year.
examples.zh: 该集团的年贸易额超过「万亿」美元。

words.enDefinition: the amount of capital that a corporation is authorized or stated to have

examples.en: The charter lists the corporation's stated capital at two million, unchanged since incorporation.
examples.zh: 公司章程载明「设定资本」为200万，自注册以来未变。

examples.en: Dividends may not be paid out of stated capital in most jurisdictions.
examples.zh: 在多数法域，「设定资本」不得用于派发股息。

words.enDefinition: ledger recording each stockholder's shareholdings

examples.en: The company secretary updates the stockholder's ledger whenever shares change hands.
examples.zh: 每当股份易手，公司秘书都会更新「股东分户账」。

examples.en: A dispute over voting rights was settled by tracing entries in the stockholder's ledger.
examples.zh: 一场投票权之争，最终靠追查「股东分户账」的记录得以解决。

words.enDefinition: stock warrants that remain outstanding

examples.en: Diluted earnings per share must count all stock warrants outstanding from the convertible loan.
examples.zh: 计算稀释每股收益时，必须把可转债附带的全部「流通在外认股权证」算进去。

examples.en: Exercise of stock warrants outstanding would raise fresh cash but dilute the founder's control.
examples.zh: 「流通在外认股权证」一旦行权会带来新资金，但也会稀释创始人的控制权。

words.enDefinition: customs duty imposed mainly to raise government revenue

examples.en: The levy on imported coffee is a revenue duty, set simply to fill the treasury.
examples.zh: 对进口咖啡征收的税是「财政关税」，设立的目的就是充实国库。

examples.en: Unlike protective tariffs, a revenue duty stays low enough to keep trade flowing.
examples.zh: 与保护性关税不同，「财政关税」保持低位，以便贸易照常流动。

words.enDefinition: dividends declared payable that have not yet been claimed by shareholders

examples.en: Checks that shareholders never cashed ended up as dividend payable unclaimed on our books.
examples.zh: 股东从不兑付的支票，最后都成了账上的「未领股利」。

examples.en: The ledger keeps dividend payable unclaimed in a separate line until shareholders come forward.
examples.zh: 账簿把「未领股利」单列一行，直到股东现身认领。

collocations: tie out the dividend payable unclaimed

words.enDefinition: amounts a business owes to suppliers for goods or services received

examples.en: Open an account payable entry the day the goods arrive, not when the invoice does.
examples.zh: 货物一到达就要开立「应付账款」记录，而不是等发票到了再记。

examples.en: Each account payable carries its due date so cash is never paid away early.
examples.zh: 每一笔「应付账款」都标注到期日，保证现金绝不提前流出。

words.enDefinition: funds tied up in inventory or stores

examples.en: The district's stores fund covers textbooks and lab supplies for every public school.
examples.zh: 学区的「库存物资基金」覆盖每所公立学校的教材和实验用品。

examples.en: Auditors traced purchases from the stores fund to the warehouse ledger line by line.
examples.zh: 审计员逐行核对「库存物资基金」的采购与仓储台账。

words.enDefinition: sale intended to clear remaining stock at reduced prices

examples.en: January's clearance sales emptied the warehouse of last season's camping gear.
examples.zh: 一月的「清仓甩卖」把仓库里上季的露营装备一扫而空。

examples.en: Accounting-wise, clearance sales still bring revenue even when every item goes at a loss.
examples.zh: 从会计角度看，「清仓甩卖」即使件件亏本也照样确认收入。

words.enDefinition: the United States federal tax authority (IRS)

examples.en: The internal revenue service publishes updated withholding tables every December.
examples.zh: 「国内税务局」每年十二月都会发布最新的预扣税率表。

examples.en: My cousin works for the internal revenue service auditing small-business returns in Ohio.
examples.zh: 我表姐在「国内税务局」工作，负责稽查俄亥俄州小企业的申报表。

words.enDefinition: the grouping of accounts into classes in a chart of accounts

examples.en: Clear classification of accounts keeps every asset, liability, and income item in its own family.
examples.zh: 清晰的「账户分类」让每项资产、负债和收益科目都各归其类。

examples.en: The trainee mixed prepayments with payables until the supervisor redid the classification of accounts.
examples.zh: 实习生把预付和应付混在一起，直到主管重做了「账户分类」。

words.enDefinition: lien on inventory as security for a debt

examples.en: The bank holds an inventory lien on every crate of stock it financed.
examples.zh: 银行对其融资的每一箱存货都设有「存货留置权」。

examples.en: We could not sell the bonded wine because the lender's inventory lien had priority.
examples.zh: 因为贷款人的「存货留置权」优先，我们无法出售那批保税葡萄酒。

words.enDefinition: mortgage loans on real estate that are receivable by the lender

examples.en: Our thrift's largest asset is real estate loans receivable from the housing boom decades ago.
examples.zh: 我们储蓄机构最大的资产，是几十年前住房热留下的「应收不动产抵押贷款」。

examples.en: Rising delinquencies in real estate loans receivable forced the credit union to boost reserves.
examples.zh: 「应收不动产抵押贷款」逾期攀升，信用社被迫增提拨备。

words.enDefinition: an audit that is optional rather than legally required

examples.en: As a private company we commission an optional audit each year to reassure the bank.
examples.zh: 我们是私营公司，每年自行安排一次「随意审计」，好让银行放心。

examples.en: Because no statute demanded it, the family business treated the optional audit as pure reassurance.
examples.zh: 由于法律并无强制要求，家族企业只把「随意审计」当作纯粹的安心举措。

words.enDefinition: accounting for the value of human resources as assets

examples.en: Human asset accounting would treat trained staff as an asset instead of an expense.
examples.zh: 「人力资产会计」主张把受过培训的员工记作资产，而不是费用。

examples.en: Critics argue human asset accounting values people who could simply walk away tomorrow.
examples.zh: 批评者认为，「人力资产会计」把明天就可能离职的人算成了价值。

collocations: tie out the human asset accounting

words.enDefinition: loss of revenue over a short period

examples.en: Closing for the refit means a short-term revenue loss we have budgeted to survive.
examples.zh: 停业装修意味着一笔「短期收入损失」，我们已在预算中安排好如何扛过去。

examples.en: The recall caused a short-term revenue loss, but customer trust recovered within two quarters.
examples.zh: 召回带来了「短期收入损失」，不过两个季度内客户信任就恢复了。

words.enDefinition: income credits that are recognized later than the related cash or billing

examples.en: Subscription prepayments sit as delayed income credits until each issue actually ships.
examples.zh: 订阅预付款在每期杂志实际寄出前，都挂作「递延收益贷项」。

examples.en: At year end we released half of the delayed income credits tied to completed milestones.
examples.zh: 年末，我们把与已完成里程碑挂钩的一半「递延收益贷项」转为收入。

words.enDefinition: an associate-grade membership of a chartered accountancy body

examples.en: After passing the intermediate exams she was admitted as an associate of chartered accountants.
examples.zh: 通过中级考试后，她获准成为「特许会计师准会员」。

examples.en: The letters ACA behind his name mean associate of chartered accountants, a full member.
examples.zh: 他姓名后面的 ACA 三个字母代表「特许会计师准会员」，是正式会员资格。

words.enDefinition: an investment fund that primarily holds bonds

examples.en: When rates spike, bond funds drop too—there is no magic shelter.
examples.zh: 利率急升时「债券基金」同样下跌，世上没有魔法避风港。

examples.en: Grandma splits her savings between two bond funds, one short-duration and one inflation-protected.
examples.zh: 祖母把积蓄分放进两只「债券基金」，一只短久期，一只抗通胀。

words.enDefinition: debt backed by collateral or other security

examples.en: The mortgage is secured debt, so the bank can seize the house if payments stop.
examples.zh: 这笔按揭属于「有担保债务」，一旦断供银行可以收走房子。

examples.en: In bankruptcy, secured debt is paid first; unsecured lenders split whatever scraps remain.
examples.zh: 破产清算时「有担保债务」优先受偿，无担保债权人只能分残余。

words.enDefinition: the Bank for International Settlements (BIS), an international organisation that serves central banks and fosters monetary and financial stability

examples.en: Regulators read the bank for international settlements quarterly review for early warning signs.
examples.zh: 监管机构研读「国际清算银行」的季度评论，寻找早期的风险信号。

examples.en: The Basel rules originated from committees hosted by the bank for international settlements in Switzerland.
examples.zh: 巴塞尔协议源自「国际清算银行」在瑞士主办的各委员会。

collocations: engage the bank for international settlements
instruct the bank for international settlements
evaluate the bank for international settlements

words.enDefinition: market in which futures contracts are traded

examples.en: Grain traders watched the futures market nervously as drought reports spread.
examples.zh: 干旱传闻四起，粮食交易商紧张地盯着「期货市场」。

examples.en: Before online trading, corn farmers drove to Chicago just to see the futures market.
examples.zh: 网上交易出现之前，种玉米的农民得亲自跑到芝加哥去看「期货市场」。

words.enDefinition: an interest rate that assumes no risk of default by the borrower

examples.en: Textbooks call the Treasury bill yield the default-free interest rate for discounting safest cash flows.
examples.zh: 教科书把短期国债收益率称作「无违约风险利率」，用于折现最安全的现金流。

examples.en: Any corporate bond must yield more than the default-free interest rate to compensate for risk.
examples.zh: 公司债的收益率必须高于「无违约风险利率」，才谈得上补偿风险。

words.enDefinition: shares of companies that provide public utilities such as electricity or water

examples.en: Retirees like my aunt hold utility stock for dividends that rarely get cut.
examples.zh: 我姨妈这样的退休族持有「公用事业股票」，图的是几乎不减派的股息。

examples.en: Rising rates dent utility stock prices because income investors drift toward newly issued bonds.
examples.zh: 利率上行会压低「公用事业股票」，因为收息资金转向了新发的债券。

words.enDefinition: the buying and selling of equities

examples.en: Latency matters enormously in equity trading, where milliseconds decide who gets the price.
examples.zh: 「股票交易」中延迟至关重要，几毫秒就决定谁能成交到那个价。

examples.en: She left equity trading for a quieter role in compliance after ten years on the floor.
examples.zh: 在交易大厅十年之后，她离开「股票交易」，转做清静一些的合规岗位。

words.enDefinition: the management of a new business venture or joint enterprise

examples.en: The MBA program teaches venture management through live pitches to real investors.
examples.zh: 这门MBA课程通过向真实投资人路演来教「创业管理」。

examples.en: Her venture management class paired each team with a founder wrestling with real payroll problems.
examples.zh: 「创业管理」课上，每个小组都对接一位正被真实工资问题折磨的创始人。

words.enDefinition: the price at which shares may be subscribed

examples.en: Existing shareholders can buy new shares at the subscription price set in the rights issue.
examples.zh: 老股东可以按供股方案确定的「认股价格」买入新股。

examples.en: The subscription price of forty dollars was set ten percent below the market.
examples.zh: 「认股价格」定在40美元，比市价低一成。

words.enDefinition: company that provides loans and other financing services

examples.en: The dealership arranged our car loan through a finance company rather than a bank.
examples.zh: 车行帮我们通过一家「金融公司」办车贷，没走银行。

examples.en: Higher rates lately pushed many borrowers from banks to the local finance company.
examples.zh: 近来利率走高，不少借款人从银行转向了本地「金融公司」。

words.enDefinition: guarantee or insurance scheme covering exporters against certain commercial or political risks

examples.en: The exporter bought an export risk guarantee covering the buyer's default in Argentina.
examples.zh: 出口商购买了「出口风险担保」，覆盖阿根廷买方的违约风险。

examples.en: With an export risk guarantee in place, the bank finally released the shipment financing.
examples.zh: 有了「出口风险担保」，银行终于放行了这批货的融资。

words.enDefinition: the set of insurance policies or risks held by an insurer

examples.en: The reinsurer slices its insurance portfolio by region before selling parts to competitors.
examples.zh: 这家再保险公司先按地区切分「保险业务组合」，再把部分分给同行。

examples.en: A single hurricane can wreck an insurance portfolio concentrated along one coastline.
examples.zh: 一场飓风就能重创集中在某段海岸线的「保险业务组合」。

words.enDefinition: cash or amounts received as interest

examples.en: Last quarter's interest receipts jumped after the fund shifted into Treasury bills.
examples.zh: 资金转入短期国债后，上季度的「利息收入」明显增加。

examples.en: Auditors matched interest receipts from the bank statement to the amounts booked.
examples.zh: 审计员把银行流水里的「利息收入」与入账金额逐笔核对。

words.enDefinition: the consolidation of stock or share capital

examples.en: Under the consolidation of stocks, ten old shares become one new share.
examples.zh: 这次「股份合并」中，十股旧股换一股新股。

examples.en: The board proposed consolidation of stocks to satisfy the exchange's minimum price rule.
examples.zh: 董事会提出「股份合并」，以满足交易所的最低股价规则。

words.enDefinition: risks arising from marketing or selling activities

examples.en: Marketing risks hit hardest when demand collapses right after the harvest.
examples.zh: 「营销风险」最狠的时刻，是丰收刚过需求就崩塌。

examples.en: The co-op hedges marketing risks by pre-selling half the crop to supermarket chains.
examples.zh: 合作社通过向连锁超市预售一半收成，来对冲「营销风险」。

words.enDefinition: capital used by producers in production

examples.en: Farm co-ops rebuild producers' capital each season by retaining part of member payouts.
examples.zh: 农业合作社每季从社员分成中提留一部分，重建「生产者资本」。

examples.en: Economists of that era treated producers' capital as the real engine of manufacturing.
examples.zh: 那个年代的经济学家把「生产者资本」视为制造业的真正引擎。

words.enDefinition: the market segment of high-net-worth individuals or clients

examples.en: Private banks fight hardest over the high net worth market in Singapore and Zurich.
examples.zh: 私人银行在新加坡和苏黎世的「高净值市场」争夺最凶。

examples.en: Wine, art, and jets now form their own industry serving the high net worth market.
examples.zh: 名酒、艺术品和公务机如今自成一门生意，专为「高净值市场」服务。

collocations: secure the high net worth market
visit the high net worth market
lease the high net worth market

words.enDefinition: preferred stock on which unpaid dividends accumulate until paid

examples.en: Miss a payout on cumulative preferred stock and the arrears roll forward until paid.
examples.zh: 「累积优先股」一旦漏派，欠息会滚动累积，直到补足为止。

examples.en: Common shareholders saw nothing for three years because cumulative preferred stock swallowed every surplus.
examples.zh: 「累积优先股」吞掉了全部盈余，普通股东连续三年颗粒无收。

words.enDefinition: investment in a portfolio of securities rather than a controlling stake

examples.en: Foreign portfolio investment flows out of emerging markets the moment real rates turn negative.
examples.zh: 实际利率一转负，「组合投资」资金立刻撤出新兴市场。

examples.en: Unlike a takeover, portfolio investment buys bonds and shares without seeking any control.
examples.zh: 与收购不同，「组合投资」只买债券和股票，并不谋求控制权。

words.enDefinition: the ability of a business to meet its long-term obligations

examples.en: Auditors attach a going-concern note whenever business solvency looks doubtful.
examples.zh: 只要「企业偿付能力」存疑，审计师就会附上持续经营提示。

examples.en: Twelve months of negative cash flow quietly eroded the manufacturer's business solvency.
examples.zh: 连续12个月现金流为负，悄悄侵蚀了这家制造商的「企业偿付能力」。

words.enDefinition: charge made against capital rather than against income

examples.en: The court ruled the payout was a charge against capital, not a deductible expense.
examples.zh: 法院裁定这笔支出属于「冲减资本」，不能作为费用抵税。

examples.en: Lawyers warned that treating the buyout as a charge against capital would trigger tax penalties.
examples.zh: 律师提醒，把买断款列为「冲减资本」会引来税务处罚。

words.enDefinition: the interest rate charged on credit or a loan facility

examples.en: The cooperative charges members a credit rate of six percent, far below the payday lenders.
examples.zh: 合作社给社员的「信贷利率」只有6%，远低于发薪日贷款机构。

examples.en: Small traders complain the bank's credit rate climbs whenever their sales dip.
examples.zh: 小商户抱怨，生意一走弱，银行的「信贷利率」就往上爬。

words.enDefinition: file of information used to assess a customer's creditworthiness

examples.en: One missed utility bill can linger in your credit file for years.
examples.zh: 一次拖欠水电费，可能在你的「信用档案」里留好几年。

examples.en: The loan officer pulled his credit file and spotted an error from a former address.
examples.zh: 信贷员调出他的「信用档案」，发现了一条来自旧住址的错误记录。

words.enDefinition: loan on concessional or below-market terms

examples.en: The development bank offered a soft loan with a twenty-year grace period.
examples.zh: 开发银行提供了「软贷款」，宽限期长达二十年。

examples.en: Disaster-hit farmers repaid their soft loan in produce rather than cash.
examples.zh: 受灾农民以实物而非现金偿还「软贷款」。

words.enDefinition: the quantity of capital demanded

examples.en: Cheap credit after 2010 inflated the demand for capital among mid-size manufacturers.
examples.zh: 2010年后的低息信贷推高了中型制造商的「资本需求量」。

examples.en: Rail projects dominate the region's demand for capital for the next decade.
examples.zh: 未来十年，铁路项目将主导本地区的「资本需求量」。

words.enDefinition: particular instance of selling

examples.en: The sale of the old maltings funded the new cold store.
examples.zh: 老麦芽厂的「出售」为新建冷库提供了资金。

examples.en: Horse sales fill every inn in the market town each autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，马匹「交易」让集镇上每家客栈都住满。

words.enDefinition: period of time containing 365 (or 366) days

examples.en: The lease runs for a year from the first of May.
examples.zh: 租约自五月一日起为期一「年」。

examples.en: Sales doubled year on year after the new bypass opened.
examples.zh: 绕城公路开通后，销量「年」年翻倍。

words.enDefinition: having little money or means; of low quality

examples.en: Poor families relied on the co-op's cheap weekly flour ration.
examples.zh: 「贫穷的」家庭靠合作社的廉价面粉配给度日。

examples.en: The poor soil on the headland grows only fodder oats.
examples.zh: 海角上「贫瘠的」土壤只长饲料燕麦。

words.enDefinition: lacking strength; (of a market) soft or declining

examples.en: Demand for slate stayed weak through the whole building season.
examples.zh: 整个建筑季，石板需求都很「疲软」。

examples.en: The pound closed the week weak against a rising euro.
examples.zh: 英镑本周收「弱」，对面上扬的欧元。

words.enDefinition: the flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food

examples.en: The butcher hangs the meat for three weeks before cutting.
examples.zh: 肉铺把「肉」悬挂三周后才切割。

examples.en: Meat shipments need the chiller running from dock to market.
examples.zh: 「肉类」运输需要冷藏箱从码头到市场全程运转。

words.enDefinition: fractional monetary unit of several countries

examples.en: The price per litre rose by just a cent or two.
examples.zh: 每升价格只涨了一两「分」钱。

examples.en: Shops round the bill total to the nearest five cents.
examples.zh: 商店把账单总额凑整到最接近的五「分」。

words.enDefinition: Through; by means of; through the agency of; by; for; for

examples.en: Freight runs at twelve pounds per crate during the winter months.
examples.zh: 冬季运费为「每」箱十二英镑。

examples.en: Rooms are priced per night, breakfast included in the rate.
examples.zh: 客房按「每」晚计价，含早餐。

words.enDefinition: in the middle of; surrounded by

examples.en: The stallholders kept pricing amid the noise of the morning rush.
examples.zh: 摊主们在早市喧嚣「之中」坚持报价。

examples.en: Shares steadied amid talk of a takeover bid from the north.
examples.zh: 在北部收购意向传闻「之中」，股价企稳。

words.enDefinition: skill in dealing with people or difficult situations without causing offence

examples.en: With great tact, the manager deferred the rent rise until spring.
examples.zh: 经理十分「得体」地把涨租推迟到春天。

examples.en: Telling a loyal supplier his prices run high takes real tact.
examples.zh: 要告诉老供应商他的报价偏高，很需要「分寸」。

words.enDefinition: written proposal or reminder

examples.en: Send a short memo to every stallholder about the winter hours.
examples.zh: 给每位摊主发一份关于冬季营业时间的简短「备忘录」。

examples.en: The memo on fuel allowances reached the drivers too late.
examples.zh: 关于燃油补贴的「内部通知」送抵司机时已经太迟。

words.enDefinition: (law) a legal document issued by a court or judicial officer

examples.en: The bailiff served the writ an hour before the market opened.
examples.zh: 集市开市前一小时，执法官送达了「法院令状」。

examples.en: A writ stopped the demolition of the old toll house.
examples.zh: 一纸「法院命令」叫停了老收费站住宅的拆除。

words.enDefinition: a very strong wind, typically force 7–10 on the Beaufort scale

examples.en: A sudden gale tore the tarpaulins off three stalls overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜「大风」掀翻了三个摊位的防水布。

examples.en: The shipping forecast warns of gale-force winds along the strait.
examples.zh: 航运预报警告海峡沿岸将有「大风」天气。

words.enDefinition: wharf usually built parallel to the shoreline

examples.en: Crates were stacked along the quay before the tide turned.
examples.zh: 涨潮之前，货箱堆放在「码头」边。

examples.en: The fishing boats tie up at the stone quay each evening.
examples.zh: 渔船每晚都停靠在石砌「顺岸码头」。

words.enDefinition: former measure of the United States economy; the total market value of goods and services produced by all citizens and capital during a given period (usually 1 yr)

examples.en: The ministry linked the harbour toll cut to a rise in GNP.
examples.zh: 主管部门把削减港口税费与「国民生产总值」上升挂钩。

examples.en: GNP figures for the island include the ferry company's mainland earnings.
examples.zh: 岛屿的「国民生产总值」数字包含轮渡公司在大陆的收入。

words.enDefinition: that which is deserved or owed

examples.en: Traders pay their guild dues before the spring fair opens.
examples.zh: 商贩在春季集市开市前缴纳「会费」。

examples.en: The treasurer collects harbour dues from every one of the visiting boats.
examples.zh: 司库向每艘来访船只收取港口「规费」。

words.enDefinition: federal law enforcement agency that is the principal investigative arm of the Department of Justice

examples.en: The FBI traced the counterfeit bills to a print shop in Leeds.
examples.zh: 「美国联邦调查局」把假钞来源追查到利兹的一家印刷厂。

examples.en: An FBI liaison officer briefed the port police about the smugglers.
examples.zh: 一名「联邦调查局」联络官向港警通报了走私者情况。

words.enDefinition: your basis for belief or disbelief; knowledge on which to base belief

examples.en: Signed delivery notes are the evidence a court will actually accept.
examples.zh: 签过字的送货单才是法庭真正认可的「证据」。

examples.en: Without evidence of approval, the payments simply look like someone's private spending.
examples.zh: 缺少审批的「证据」，这些付款看上去就像某人的私人开销。

words.enDefinition: the state of being retired from one's business or occupation

examples.en: The senior partner's retirement left the firm without its best tax specialist.
examples.zh: 高级合伙人的「退休」让事务所失去了最好的税务专家。

examples.en: She saved into the pension scheme for thirty years before her retirement last spring.
examples.zh: 她向养老金计划存了三十年的钱，才在去年春天迎来「退休」。

words.enDefinition: profit remaining after expenses; a company's earnings

examples.en: Quarterly earnings beat forecasts, so the share price jumped before lunch.
examples.zh: 季度「盈利」超出预期，股价午饭前就跳涨了。

examples.en: Growth in earnings means little if the cash never actually reaches the bank.
examples.zh: 如果现金从未真正进账，「盈利」增长再多也意义有限。

words.enDefinition: someone who maintains and audits business accounts

examples.en: Our accountant flagged the missing receipts before the tax office ever asked.
examples.zh: 还没等税务局来问，我们的「会计师」就先发现了缺失的票据。

examples.en: The accountant reconciled the whole year in one weekend because the records were tidy.
examples.zh: 凭着整洁的账目记录，「会计师」一个周末就把全年账目对平了。

words.enDefinition: charge (a person or a property) with a payment, such as a tax or a fine

examples.en: The council assessed the property at a higher value, so the rates rose sharply.
examples.zh: 当局对该物业重新「评定税额」，结果地方税一下子涨了不少。

examples.en: HMRC can assess additional tax up to twenty years after a fraudulent return.
examples.zh: 只要申报涉假，HMRC 在二十年之后仍可补「评定税额」。

words.enDefinition: the imposition of taxes; the practice of the government in levying taxes on the subjects of a state

examples.en: Double taxation treaties stop the same profits being taxed in two countries.
examples.zh: 双边税收协定避免了同一笔利润在两国被重复「征税」。

examples.en: The seminar compared taxation of wages with taxation of dividends for owner-managers.
examples.zh: 研讨会上比较了经营者领取工资与分得股利两种方式下的「征税」差异。

words.enDefinition: involving financial matters

examples.en: The ministry's fiscal response to the drought included tax holidays for affected counties.
examples.zh: 财政部对旱灾的「财政」应对，包括给受灾县减税。

examples.en: Local auditors praised the county's sound fiscal management after the rainy-day fund doubled.
examples.zh: 县里的准备金翻倍后，审计部门称赞其「财政」管理稳健。

words.enDefinition: (of an amount) owed and required to be paid

examples.en: Half the invoice is payable on order and half on delivery.
examples.zh: 发票金额一半在订货时「应付」，一半在交货时支付。

examples.en: Interest is payable quarterly, so mark the March, June, September, and December dates.
examples.zh: 利息按季度「应付」，记得把三月、六月、九月和十二月的日期标出来。

words.enDefinition: money granted for advanced study or research

examples.en: Her research fellowship covers tuition plus a stipend for two years.
examples.zh: 她的「奖学金」覆盖学费，还附带两年生活费。

examples.en: Winning the fellowship meant he could quit the night shift and write full time.
examples.zh: 拿到「奖学金」后，他辞掉了夜班，全职写作。

words.enDefinition: the occupation of maintaining and auditing records and preparing financial reports for a business

examples.en: She left accountancy for teaching after twelve years of busy season pressure.
examples.zh: 受够了十二年的忙季压力，她离开「会计工作」改行教书。

examples.en: Good accountancy is invisible when it works; you only notice it when something breaks.
examples.zh: 「会计工作」做得好时毫不起眼，只有出了纰漏才会被注意到。

words.enDefinition: impossible or nearly impossible to see; imperceptible by the eye

examples.en: The mended crack is invisible once the wall has been repainted.
examples.zh: 墙面重新粉刷之后，修补过的裂缝就「看不见」了。

examples.en: Security ink makes the signature invisible until you shine the special lamp on it.
examples.zh: 防伪墨水写下的签名要用专门的灯照才会显形，平时完全「看不见」。

words.enDefinition: to check that two sets of records agree and explain any differences between them

examples.en: I reconcile the till against the daily report before locking up each night.
examples.zh: 每晚锁门前，我都会把收银机的现金与日报「对帐」。

examples.en: The bank feed lets us reconcile supplier accounts in minutes instead of hours.
examples.zh: 有了银行流水接口，我们几分钟就能把供应商账户「对帐」完毕，不用再耗上几小时。

words.enDefinition: high standing achieved through success or influence or wealth etc.

examples.en: Winning the audit of the football club brought the firm real prestige.
examples.zh: 赢得足球俱乐部的审计业务，为事务所带来了实实在在的「声望」。

examples.en: The qualification carries prestige, yet starting salaries in the region stay modest.
examples.zh: 这张资格证书很有「声望」，但该地区的起薪依然不高。

words.enDefinition: payment to the holder of a patent or copyright or resource for the right to use their property

examples.en: Every ebook sold earns the author a royalty of about seventy percent.
examples.zh: 每售出一本电子书，作者都能拿到约七成的「特许权使用费」（版税）。

examples.en: The band still collects a royalty whenever a streaming service plays their old records.
examples.zh: 每当流媒体播放乐队的老唱片，他们仍会收到一笔「特许权使用费」。

words.enDefinition: liable to account for one's actions

examples.en: One named clerk is accountable for every key in the building.
examples.zh: 指定了专人，对大楼里的每一把钥匙「负有责任」。

examples.en: Managers are accountable for expenses incurred by their teams, so approvals get taken seriously.
examples.zh: 经理要对团队的费用开支「负有责任」，因此审批再也不敢马虎。

words.enDefinition: record in which commercial accounts are recorded

examples.en: Post every cash sale to the ledger before you close the shop.
examples.zh: 打烊之前，要把每笔现金销售都过入「分类账」。

examples.en: The clerk copies each day's figures into the ledger in neat black ink.
examples.zh: 书记员用工整的黑墨水把每天的数据誊进「分类账」。

words.enDefinition: someone who lends money or gives credit in business matters

examples.en: The lender requires six months of bank statements before approving any mortgage.
examples.zh: 「出借者」要求先看六个月的银行流水，才肯批按揭。

examples.en: Before signing, compare what each lender charges for late payments.
examples.zh: 签约之前，先比较各家「出借者」的逾期收费标准。

words.enDefinition: document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts

examples.en: The auditor asked to see her credentials before letting her near the files.
examples.zh: 审计员核验了她的「凭证」（资历证明），才让她接触档案。

examples.en: A forged credential nearly landed the firm with a very costly hire.
examples.zh: 一份伪造的「凭证」差点让公司付出惨痛的招聘代价。

words.enDefinition: tax excessively

examples.en: Economists warned the treasury would overtax small traders and drive them informal.
examples.zh: 经济学家警告，财政部门若对小商贩「抽税过重」，会逼他们转入地下经营。

examples.en: The protest grew because drivers felt the new levy overtaxed an already squeezed trade.
examples.zh: 抗议愈演愈烈，因为司机们觉得新税费让本已艰难度日的行业「抽税过重」。

words.enDefinition: (of goods or funds) subject to taxation

examples.en: Free gifts to staff can still be taxable benefits worth reporting each year.
examples.zh: 给员工的免费赠品仍可能是「可征税的」福利，每年都值得申报。

examples.en: Only the first thirty pounds is taxable; the rest stays within the allowance.
examples.zh: 只有头三十英镑「可征税」，其余部分都在免税额度之内。

words.enDefinition: one (as a retailer or distributor) that stocks goods

examples.en: Ask your local stockist; most garden centres keep the larger pots in spring.
examples.zh: 请向当地的「存货商」询问，多数园艺中心春天都备有大号花盆。

examples.en: The brand appoints one official stockist per county to keep prices steady.
examples.zh: 该品牌每个郡只指定一家官方「存货商」，以维持价格稳定。

words.enDefinition: receiving a salary

examples.en: Salaried staff keep the same pay even when the workshop runs quiet.
examples.zh: 车间再清闲，「有薪金的」正式员工工资照拿不变。

examples.en: The firm prefers a salaried controller to hourly bookkeeping, whatever the overtime.
examples.zh: 无论加多少班，公司都宁可雇「有薪金的」主计长，也不用按小时计酬的簿记员。

words.enDefinition: someone who maintains and audits business accounts

examples.en: The comptroller signs every cheque above five thousand before it leaves the office.
examples.zh: 超过五千英镑的支票，都要经「主计长」签字后才能离开办公室。

examples.en: Our comptroller doubles as company secretary, which saves the board one salary.
examples.zh: 我们的「主计长」兼任公司秘书，为董事会省下了一份薪水。

words.enDefinition: an unsecured corporate bond backed only by the issuer's general credit rather than specific collateral

examples.en: The railway funded its expansion with a debenture backed only by its general credit.
examples.zh: 这条铁路发行「债券」融资，仅凭公司整体信用作担保。

examples.en: Debenture holders rank behind secured lenders but ahead of shareholders if the firm fails.
examples.zh: 公司一旦倒闭，「债券」持有人排在有担保债权人之后、股东之前。

words.enDefinition: someone who records the transactions of a business

examples.en: The bookkeeper catches duplicated invoices that the software's own checks keep missing.
examples.zh: 系统自检反复漏掉的重复发票，都被「簿记员」一一揪了出来。

examples.en: A careful bookkeeper is worth more to a corner shop than any accounting suite.
examples.zh: 对街角小店来说，一位细心的「簿记员」比任何会计软件都更值钱。

words.enDefinition: relatively small amount of money given for services rendered (as by a waiter)

examples.en: Service is included, so you never need to add a gratuity at this hotel.
examples.zh: 这家酒店已含服务费，无须再另付「小费」。

examples.en: The courier refused the gratuity, saying doing the job properly was simply his work.
examples.zh: 快递员婉拒了「小费」，说把活干好本来就是分内之事。

words.enDefinition: tax levied on the basis of a fixed amount per person

examples.en: The clinic charges a capitation fee of twenty pounds per registered patient.
examples.zh: 这家诊所按登记病人收取每人二十英镑的「按人计算」费用。

examples.en: Capitation funds schools by headcount, so losing thirty pupils costs real money.
examples.zh: 「按人计算」的经费按学生人数拨款给学校，流失三十名学生就是实实在在的损失。

words.enDefinition: towards the inside or centre of something

examples.en: The office door opens inwards, so we mounted the coat hooks inside the frame.
examples.zh: 办公室的门是「向内」开的，所以我们把挂衣钩装在了门框内侧。

examples.en: Fold the flaps inwards first, then the parcel closes flat without extra tape.
examples.zh: 先把纸板折页「向内」折，包裹就能平整合上，不用多缠胶带。

words.enDefinition: manifesting partiality

examples.en: Long-standing clients enjoy preferential rates on every audit they refer to us.
examples.zh: 老客户给我们转介的每一单审计都享受「特惠的」费率。

examples.en: The bank offered preferential terms because our accounts had been flawless for years.
examples.zh: 由于我们多年账目无可挑剔，银行给出了「特惠的」贷款条件。

words.enDefinition: the most common medium of exchange; functions as legal tender

examples.en: Money works only when everyone accepts it, which is why failed currencies vanish fast.
examples.zh: 「货币」只有在人人接受时才起作用，所以失败的货币消失得很快。

examples.en: From cowrie shells to digital wallets, money keeps changing shape but not its job.
examples.zh: 从贝壳到电子钱包，「货币」形态一直在变，职能却没变。

words.enDefinition: relating to money, finance, or the management of funds

examples.en: After the merger, her title changed to financial controller of the combined group.
examples.zh: 合并之后，她的头衔变成了集团的「财务」总监。

examples.en: Consultants mapped every financial risk the hospital faced, from currency swings to unpaid claims.
examples.zh: 顾问们梳理了医院面临的每一项「财务」风险，从汇率波动到未付赔款。

words.enDefinition: United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds

examples.en: The empty lorry weighs almost a full ton before loading.
examples.zh: 空载的卡车就有差不多一「吨」重。

examples.en: Freight rates are quoted per ton for the building sand.
examples.zh: 建筑用砂的运费按「吨」报价。

words.enDefinition: bank that provides services in a locality on behalf of another bank

examples.en: Our small town bank clears out-of-town checks through its correspondent in Chicago.
examples.zh: 我们小镇银行通过芝加哥的「代理银行」清算外地支票。

examples.en: Without a correspondent abroad, the exporter's dollar transfers stalled for days.
examples.zh: 没有海外「代理银行」，出口商的美元汇款卡了好几天。

words.enDefinition: financier who owns or is an executive in a bank

examples.en: The town's oldest banker still signs every mortgage personally, a tradition since 1962.
examples.zh: 这位镇上资历最深的「银行业者」仍坚持亲自签每笔按揭，1962年以来一直如此。

examples.en: Ask any banker here about 2008 and the conversation stops mid-sentence.
examples.zh: 随便问这里哪位「银行业者」2008年的事，话都会说到一半停住。

words.enDefinition: person held as security for the fulfilment of a condition

examples.en: Negotiators waited three days before the kidnappers freed their hostage unharmed.
examples.zh: 谈判专家等了三天，绑匪才毫发无损地释放「人质」。

examples.en: In the siege film, the clerk becomes an unwitting hostage in his own bank.
examples.zh: 在这部围困题材电影里，职员在自己工作的银行里成了不知情的「人质」。

words.enDefinition: someone who commits capital in order to gain financial returns

examples.en: The angel investor wiring fifty thousand tonight wants weekly updates, not monthly.
examples.zh: 天使「投资者」今晚打款5万，要求每周汇报进展，而不是每月。

examples.en: Patient investors held through two crashes and finally saw the fund double.
examples.zh: 耐心的「投资者」扛过两次崩盘，终于等来基金翻倍。

words.enDefinition: an economic system based on private ownership of capital

examples.en: Critics of capitalism point to the crash of 1929, defenders to rising living standards since.
examples.zh: 批评「资本主义」的人提1929年大崩盘，辩护者则拿出此后不断上涨的生活水平。

examples.en: Our instructor compares capitalism and cooperatives by asking who decides what gets produced.
examples.zh: 老师比较「资本主义」与合作社模式，只问一个问题：产品由谁决定。

words.enDefinition: to record a cost as an asset on the balance sheet, or to convert reserves into capital

examples.en: Accountants capitalize the new roof over twenty years instead of expensing it this quarter.
examples.zh: 会计师把新屋顶按二十年「资本化」摊销，而不是本季度一次性计入费用。

examples.en: Startups capitalize development costs aggressively, which flatters today's profits and stores up trouble.
examples.zh: 初创公司激进地把开发成本「资本化」，当期利润好看，隐患却埋下了。

words.enDefinition: relating to or involving money

examples.en: The report blames the spiral on monetary expansion during the war years.
examples.zh: 报告把这场恶性循环归咎于战时的「货币」扩张。

examples.en: Venezuela's experience shows what happens when monetary policy loses all credibility.
examples.zh: 委内瑞拉的例子说明，「货币」政策彻底失信时会发生什么。

words.enDefinition: a legal status or process for a person or company unable to repay outstanding debts

examples.en: Filing for bankruptcy stopped the collection calls but cost the family its second car.
examples.zh: 申请「破产」止住了催收电话，代价是家里卖掉了第二辆车。

examples.en: Chapter 11 bankruptcy lets the airline keep flying while it renegotiates its debts.
examples.zh: 「破产」重组让这家航空公司得以一边飞行一边重谈债务。

words.enDefinition: a firm promise or guarantee that something will be done or is true

examples.en: The contractor gave written assurance that the scaffolding would be gone by Friday.
examples.zh: 承包商书面「保证」脚手架周五前拆除。

examples.en: The bank wanted assurance that the collateral had never been pledged twice.
examples.zh: 银行要求「保证」抵押品从未被重复质押。

words.enDefinition: person whose material wealth is valued at more than a million dollars

examples.en: The self-taught programmer became a millionaire before turning thirty, mostly through employee shares.
examples.zh: 这位自学成才的程序员靠员工股票，三十岁前成了「百万富翁」。

examples.en: Millionaire neighbors still argue about the cheapest brand of coffee, my mother says.
examples.zh: 我妈说，有些「百万富翁」邻居至今还在为哪个牌子的咖啡最便宜争执。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to the work of an actuary

examples.en: The insurer cut premiums after its actuarial team re-ran the mortality tables.
examples.zh: 「精算」团队重跑生命表后，保险公司下调了保费。

examples.en: Her actuarial internship meant long days testing pension assumptions against real data.
examples.zh: 「精算」实习的日子漫长，她反复用真实数据检验养老金假设。

words.enDefinition: articles of commerce

examples.en: Grain is a commodity, so one farmer's wheat sells at the same price as another's.
examples.zh: 粮食是「商品」，这个农民的小麦和那个农民的只能卖一样的价。

examples.en: The trading floor still shouts commodity prices—oil, copper, soybeans—every morning.
examples.zh: 交易大厅每天清晨仍在喊「商品」行情：原油、铜、大豆。

words.enDefinition: the funds of a government or institution, or the place where they are kept

examples.en: Wars historically emptied the royal treasury faster than any plague.
examples.zh: 历史上拖垮王室「国库」的，往往不是瘟疫而是战争。

examples.en: The company treasury holds enough cash to survive eighteen months of zero revenue.
examples.zh: 公司「金库」里的现金足以撑过18个月的零收入。

words.enDefinition: (law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business

examples.en: The proprietor of the corner bakery greets every customer by name at five a.m.
examples.zh: 街角面包店的「所有人」每天清晨五点就能叫出每位客人的名字。

examples.en: As proprietor, she signs the lease, bakes the bread, and sweeps the floor.
examples.zh: 身为「所有人」，她签租约、烤面包、还得扫地。

words.enDefinition: payment of money sent to a person in another place

examples.en: Each month, Amara sends a remittance home that covers her mother's medicine.
examples.zh: 阿玛拉每月寄「汇款」回家，正好够母亲的药费。

examples.en: The remittance arrived late because the beneficiary's name was spelled wrong.
examples.zh: 受益人名字拼写有误，「汇款」晚到了几天。

words.enDefinition: the withdrawal of capital from a country or corporation

examples.en: The fund announced disinvestment from coal miners, effective by the next quarter.
examples.zh: 该基金宣布对煤矿企业「撤资」，下季度起生效。

examples.en: South Africa in the eighties showed how disinvestment can pressure a whole regime.
examples.zh: 八十年代的南非表明，「撤资」能给整个政权施加多大压力。

words.enDefinition: an officer charged with receiving and disbursing funds

examples.en: Our club treasurer reconciles the tin-box cash against receipts every Sunday.
examples.zh: 社团的「司库」每周日把铁盒现金与收据对清。

examples.en: The corporate treasurer watches FX exposures daily now that half of sales are overseas.
examples.zh: 海外销售占了一半之后，公司「司库」每天盯着汇率敞口。

words.enDefinition: mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined

examples.en: Trains carry iron ore from the mine to the smelter nightly.
examples.zh: 列车每晚把铁「矿石」从矿区运往冶炼厂。

examples.en: The assay confirmed rich iron ore in the second shaft.
examples.zh: 化验证实二号矿井里有品位很高的「矿石」。

words.enDefinition: short position in a security, or short-term bonds in some market jargon

examples.en: When the biotech's trial failed, the shorts doubled their money overnight.
examples.zh: 生物科技公司试验失败，「空头」一夜之间赚了一倍。

examples.en: Regulators worry that shorts spread rumors to drive prices down before covering.
examples.zh: 监管层担心「空头」散布谣言压低股价，再低位回补。

words.enDefinition: estimate the capital value of (a company) at an unreasonably or unlawfully high level

examples.en: Railway mania showed how speculators overcapitalize a company until its dividends can never be paid.
examples.zh: 铁路狂热期证明，投机者会把公司「过度资本化」，股息永远发不出来。

examples.en: Auditors argued the firm had overcapitalized its brand, inflating assets that later had to be written down.
examples.zh: 审计师认为公司对品牌「过度资本化」，虚增的资产后来不得不减记。

words.enDefinition: the act of cancelling; calling off some arrangement

examples.en: The cancellation of the duplicate policy saved the client double premiums.
examples.zh: 重复保单「注销」后，客户不用再付双份保费。

examples.en: Ask for a written confirmation of the cancellation so the charge never resurfaces.
examples.zh: 「注销」务必拿到书面确认，免得这笔费用再冒出来。

words.enDefinition: the act of ceding

examples.en: The treaty's cession of the islands included fishing rights within twelve miles.
examples.zh: 条约中岛屿的「转让」还包括十二海里以内的捕鱼权。

examples.en: Each reinsurance cession moves part of the risk to the reinsurer's books.
examples.zh: 每一笔再保险「转让」（分保）都把部分风险转移到再保险人的账上。

words.enDefinition: an unincorporated business owned by a single person who is responsible for its liabilities and entitled to its profits

examples.en: Her flower shop is a proprietorship, so business debts land on her personally.
examples.zh: 她的花店是「个人独资企业」，经营债务要由她个人承担。

examples.en: Tax filing is simplest under a proprietorship, which is why many freelancers start there.
examples.zh: 「个人独资企业」报税最简单，很多自由职业者都从这里起步。

words.enDefinition: abbreviation of versus, used to show opposition or comparison between two sides or options

examples.en: The programme lists Cider vs Perry as the final contest.
examples.zh: 节目单把苹果酒「对阵」梨酒列为决赛项目。

examples.en: Buyers weighed quality vs price before signing the winter contract.
examples.zh: 买家在「对比」质量与价格后才签冬季合同。

words.enDefinition: the lack of financial resources

examples.en: The contractor's insolvency left half-finished estates and hundreds of unpaid subcontractors.
examples.zh: 承包商「无力偿债」，留下半拉子楼盘和几百个拿不到钱的分包商。

examples.en: Technically, insolvency begins when liabilities exceed assets, even before any court filing.
examples.zh: 严格说，负债超过资产那天就是「无力偿债」的开始，法院受理还早得很。

words.enDefinition: coins collectively

examples.en: The museum displays the coinage of every dynasty, from square-holed cash to silver dollars.
examples.zh: 博物馆陈列着历代「硬币」，从方孔铜钱到银元。

examples.en: Shops in the mountains refused paper, so travelers carried their coinage in canvas sacks.
examples.zh: 山里店铺不收纸币，旅人只能用帆布袋扛着「硬币」赶路。

words.enDefinition: One who assures. Specifically: One who insures against

examples.en: The assurer paid the claim within a week of the accident report.
examples.zh: 事故报告提交一周内，「保险人」就完成了赔付。

examples.en: Read what the assurer excludes before signing; flood damage often is not covered.
examples.zh: 签约前看清「保险人」的免责条款，水灾损失往往不在保障内。

words.enDefinition: the person who accepts a mortgage

examples.en: The mortgagee listed the cottage for auction after eleven missed payments.
examples.zh: 连续11期欠款后，「承受抵押者」把小屋挂牌拍卖。

examples.en: Both the mortgagor and the mortgagee must consent before the deed transfers.
examples.zh: 房契过户前，「承受抵押者」与抵押人都得点头。

words.enDefinition: not furnished with funds

examples.en: The pension promise is unfunded, backed by future taxes rather than set-aside assets.
examples.zh: 这项养老金承诺「未设基金」作支撑，靠的是未来的税收。

examples.en: The project stayed unfunded for two years until a private donor appeared.
examples.zh: 项目「无资金支持」搁置了两年，直到一位私人捐助人出现。

words.enDefinition: the act of investing money again, such as putting income or returns back into securities or a business

examples.en: Retirees who skip reinvestment lose the compounding that quietly builds the second half of the balance.
examples.zh: 退休族若不做「再投资」，就错过了悄悄滚出后半座山的复利。

examples.en: The firm's reinvestment of profits into newer machines kept its edge for a decade.
examples.zh: 公司把利润「再投资」到新设备上，领先优势保持了十年。

words.enDefinition: the business or process of accepting insurance risks in exchange for premiums

examples.en: Tight underwriting after the floods means beachfront policies are nearly impossible to renew.
examples.zh: 洪灾之后「承保」收紧，海滨保单几乎无法续保。

examples.en: Loose underwriting of subprime mortgages was the crack the 2008 crisis ran through.
examples.zh: 对次级贷款的宽松「承保」，正是2008年危机撕开的那道裂缝。

words.enDefinition: the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), a multilateral trade agreement (1947; updated as GATT 1994) that governed much of world trade before and within the WTO framework — not a United Nations agency
acceptedEnVariants: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade

examples.en: Tariff schedules under GATT were negotiated in rounds lasting years at a time.
examples.zh: 「关税与贸易总协定」下的关税税则要经过历时数年的多轮谈判确定。

examples.en: Our lecturer traced how GATT 1994 folded the old agreement into the WTO system.
examples.zh: 老师梳理了「关税与贸易总协定」1994年版本如何把旧协定并入 WTO 体系。

words.enDefinition: the state of owing something (especially money)

examples.en: The couple dug out of debt in four years by cooking every meal at home.
examples.zh: 小两口四年里顿顿在家做饭，终于还清了「债务」。

examples.en: Countries rarely forgive debt outright; they usually stretch it over decades.
examples.zh: 各国很少直接豁免「债务」，通常是把期限拉长几十年。

words.enDefinition: United Nations agency to promote trade by increasing the exchange stability of the major currencies

examples.en: The IMF approved an emergency loan after the currency lost half its value.
examples.zh: 本币贬值一半后，「国际货币基金」批准了紧急贷款。

examples.en: Critics say IMF rescue packages shield lenders more than ordinary people.
examples.zh: 批评者认为，「国际货币基金」的救助方案保护的更多是放贷方，而不是普通人。

words.enDefinition: used before a benefit word to mean “without” that benefit (for example ex dividend, ex rights)

examples.en: Shares trade ex dividend next Monday, so buyers after that miss the payout.
examples.zh: 下周一股票「除息」交易，之后买入就拿不到这次分红。

examples.en: After the rights issue, all old shares trade ex rights for a month.
examples.zh: 配股完成后，全部旧股将「除权」交易一个月。

words.enDefinition: the possessive form of who; belonging to which person

examples.en: I met two sisters at the trailhead, one of whose boots were brand new.
examples.zh: 在登山口遇到两姐妹，说不出那双新靴子是「谁的」。

examples.en: The puppy chewed the slippers, and nobody would say whose they were.
examples.zh: 小狗咬坏了拖鞋，却没人承认那是「谁的」。

words.enDefinition: period of the year marked by special events or activities in some field

examples.en: The mango season here lasts barely six weeks, and the whole town celebrates.
examples.zh: 这里的芒果「季节」只有短短六周，全镇都为此欢庆。

examples.en: My aunt waits for the rainy season to plant her chillies.
examples.zh: 姨妈总等雨「季」来了才下辣椒种。

words.enDefinition: anything (such as a document or a phonograph record or a photograph) providing permanent evidence of or information about past events

examples.en: Grandma's diary is a record of sixty years of market prices.
examples.zh: 外婆的日记是六十年市场物价的「记录」。

examples.en: The clinic keeps a record of every injection I've had since birth.
examples.zh: 诊所保存着我出生以来每次打针的「记录」。

words.enDefinition: someone who controls resources and expenditures

examples.en: The new school director visited every classroom in her first week.
examples.zh: 新上任的学校「主管」第一周就走遍了每间教室。

examples.en: Our community centre's director personally books the hall for festivals.
examples.zh: 社区中心的「主管」会亲自为节庆预订礼堂。

words.enDefinition: the day immediately before today

examples.en: Yesterday the market smelled of peaches; today it smells of rain.
examples.zh: 「昨天」市场里满是桃子的香气，今天却是一股雨味。

examples.en: I mailed the parcel yesterday, so it should reach Auntie by Friday.
examples.zh: 「昨天」我把包裹寄出去了，周五前应该能到姨妈家。

words.enDefinition: change resulting in an increase

examples.en: A ten percent increase in rent pushed us to the cheaper street.
examples.zh: 房租「上涨」一成，逼得我们搬去了便宜的那条街。

examples.en: The bakery noticed an increase in customers after the radio mention.
examples.zh: 电台提到之后，面包店的顾客明显「增加」了。

words.enDefinition: a lid or other object placed over something to close or protect it

examples.en: The pan's glass cover lets me watch the soup without lifting anything.
examples.zh: 锅上的玻璃「盖子」让我不用掀开就能看着汤。

examples.en: A plastic cover over the bike seat keeps the rain off.
examples.zh: 车座上罩个塑料「盖」能挡雨。

words.enDefinition: worker who holds or is invested with an office

examples.en: The city official measured our flooded street twice and promised a drain.
examples.zh: 市里来的「官员」把被淹的街道量了两遍，承诺增设排水口。

examples.en: A customs official opened our suitcase at the border and laughed at the noodles.
examples.zh: 边境的海关「官员」打开我们的行李箱，看着里面的面条笑了。

words.enDefinition: the body of faculty and students at a university

examples.en: My sister's university sits ten minutes from the sea, which she chose first.
examples.zh: 姐姐的「大学」离海边十分钟路程，这是她选校的首要理由。

examples.en: The university gates open to townspeople every Sunday for the orchard walk.
examples.zh: 每周日「大学」的校门向镇民开放，供大家进果园散步。

words.enDefinition: 16 ounces avoirdupois

examples.en: The recipe asks for half a pound of butter, which startled my metric scales.
examples.zh: 食谱要半「磅」黄油，我的公制秤一时不知所措。

examples.en: At the market, a pound of tomatoes costs less than one coffee downtown.
examples.zh: 在市场买一「磅」番茄，比市中心一杯咖啡还便宜。

words.enDefinition: a person who holds a position of authority in an organisation, government, or the armed forces

examples.en: The admissions officer called my mother by her full name, which charmed her.
examples.zh: 招生「干事」连名带姓地称呼我妈，把她逗乐了。

examples.en: A customs officer waved our van through after one glance at the lanterns.
examples.zh: 海关「官员」瞥了一眼车上的灯笼，就挥手放行了我们的面包车。

words.enDefinition: only one; not married or not in a romantic relationship

examples.en: Everyone at the reunion asked why I was still single, then ate my snacks.
examples.zh: 聚会所有人都在问我为什么还「单身」，然后吃光了我的零食。

examples.en: A single umbrella stood by the door, nobody claimed it.
examples.zh: 门边立着一把「孤零零的」伞，没人认领。

words.enDefinition: the reflexive or emphatic form of she/her

examples.en: Grandma replanted the balcony by herself, refusing all offers of help.
examples.zh: 外婆坚持「自己」动手，一个人重新栽种了阳台的花，谁帮忙都不要。

examples.en: She caught herself laughing at her own joke halfway through.
examples.zh: 讲到一半，她连「自己」都被自己的笑话逗笑了。

words.enDefinition: an opportunity to do something; a possibility that something will happen

examples.en: There's a chance the ferry still runs if the storm passes by noon.
examples.zh: 如果风暴中午前过去，「说不定」轮渡还会开。

examples.en: I took the chance to ask the baker for the burnt loaf at half price.
examples.zh: 我趁机「抓住机会」，向面包师提议把烤糊的面包半价卖给我。

words.enDefinition: male with the same parents as someone else

examples.en: My brother taught me to swim by letting go a little further each lesson.
examples.zh: 「哥哥」教我游泳的办法是每次松手远一点点。

examples.en: Her brother paints the shop sign anew every spring festival.
examples.zh: 她的「兄弟」每年春节都把店招牌重新刷一遍。

words.enDefinition: the way a machine, system, or organisation works; also a surgical procedure

examples.en: The whole bakery operation runs on two ovens and one stubborn alarm clock.
examples.zh: 整个面包坊的「运营」全靠两台烤箱和一个固执的闹钟。

examples.en: Grandpa's knee operation was scheduled right after the autumn harvest.
examples.zh: 爷爷的膝盖「手术」安排在秋收一结束就做。

words.enDefinition: a living organism such as a tree, flower, or grass that typically grows in soil

examples.en: The new plant on my desk needs weekly watering and monthly praise.
examples.zh: 书桌上这盆新「植物」每周浇一次水，每月还要夸一夸。

examples.en: Every plant on the windowsill leans toward the same pane of glass.
examples.zh: 窗台上的每盆「植物」都朝同一块玻璃倾斜。

words.enDefinition: female human offspring

examples.en: Their daughter runs the family noodle shop better than either parent.
examples.zh: 他们的「女儿」把家里的面馆经营得比父母任何一方都好。

examples.en: My daughter calls from the market asking how much fish is too much fish.
examples.zh: 「女儿」从市场打来电话，问我买多少鱼才算买多了。

words.enDefinition: vote to select the winner of a position or political office

examples.en: The village election turned the market square into a debate hall for a week.
examples.zh: 村里的「选举」让市场广场变成了一周的辩论场。

examples.en: During the election, every lamppost wore a poster by Friday.
examples.zh: 「选举」期间，到周五每根灯杆都贴上了海报。

words.enDefinition: the time yet to come

examples.en: Saving twenty yuan a month feels small until the future asks for it.
examples.zh: 每月存二十块看着不起眼，直到「未来」开口要用。

examples.en: She plans her future around one spreadsheet and two rainy-day funds.
examples.zh: 她用一张表格和两笔应急金规划「未来」。

words.enDefinition: a planned series of actions intended to achieve a particular goal, in war, politics, or marketing

examples.en: The poster campaign against littering covered every bin in the district.
examples.zh: 反对乱丢垃圾的「宣传运动」覆盖了全区每个垃圾桶。

examples.en: Our class campaign for longer library hours gathered two hundred signatures.
examples.zh: 我们班争取延长图书馆开放时间的「活动」收集了两百个签名。

words.enDefinition: the property of an object that is perceived as red, blue, green, etc.; also UK spelling of color

examples.en: The wall changes colour between the morning sun and the evening lamp.
examples.zh: 这面墙在朝阳和夜灯下会呈现不同的「颜色」。

examples.en: Choose a paint colour you can live with for ten years, Dad advised.
examples.zh: 爸爸建议，选「颜色」要选能忍受十年的。

words.enDefinition: a flow of electricity, water, or air; also the present period of time when used as an adjective in other senses

examples.en: The river's current pulls leaves downstream faster than the ducks swim.
examples.zh: 河里的「水流」把落叶冲向下游，比鸭子游得还快。

examples.en: Check the current before swimming; the estuary looks calm and isn't.
examples.zh: 下水前先看「水流」，河口看着平静，其实不然。

words.enDefinition: a formal accusation that someone has committed an offence; also an amount of money asked for a service

examples.en: The repair shop added a mystery charge that turned out to be cleaning.
examples.zh: 修理店收了一笔莫名的「费用」，原来只是清洁费。

examples.en: The dropped charge against my neighbour came with an apology letter.
examples.zh: 对邻居的「指控」撤销了，还附了一封道歉信。

words.enDefinition: the act of fighting; any contest or struggle

examples.en: The fight over the last parking spot lasted four minutes and two reverse gears.
examples.zh: 为了最后一个车位的「争夺」持续了四分钟、倒了两次车。

examples.en: The brothers' fight over the TV remote is a nightly tradition.
examples.zh: 兄弟俩抢电视遥控器的「斗争」是每晚的保留节目。

words.enDefinition: the act of working out the form of something (as by making a sketch or outline or plan)

examples.en: The bakery's design mixes a village counter with a city glass wall.
examples.zh: 这家面包店的「设计」把乡村柜台和城市的玻璃墙混搭在一起。

examples.en: She copied the paper lantern's design for her woodwork homework.
examples.zh: 她照着纸灯笼的「样式」完成了木工课作业。

words.enDefinition: physical force against a surface; also stress caused by demands or difficulties

examples.en: A cool cloth eased the pressure in Grandma's head, with no questions asked.
examples.zh: 外婆头部的「压力」，靠一条凉毛巾就能缓解，外加不许多问。

examples.en: The pressure in my ears eased once we left the tunnel.
examples.zh: 出了隧道，我耳朵的「压迫感」就缓解了。

words.enDefinition: something that interests you because it is important or affects you

examples.en: My main concern was the leaking roof, not the peeling paint.
examples.zh: 我最「担心的事」是屋顶漏水，而不是墙皮剥落。

examples.en: She voiced her concern about the long walk home after dark.
examples.zh: 她说出了自己对天黑后走长路的「担忧」。

words.enDefinition: an urgent or peremptory request

examples.en: His demand for a window seat emptied the whole negotiation table.
examples.zh: 他非要靠窗座位不可的「要求」让整桌谈判不欢而散。

examples.en: The tenants' list of demands reached the landlord's desk on Monday.
examples.zh: 租客们的「要求清单」周一就摆上了房东的桌面。

words.enDefinition: social class comprising those who do manual labor or work for wages

examples.en: Harvesting the paddy took three weeks of labour and one borrowed tractor.
examples.zh: 收割水稻花了三周「劳动」和一台借来的拖拉机。

examples.en: The brick kiln relied on migrant labour every dry season.
examples.zh: 砖窑每年旱季都依赖外来「劳工」。

words.enDefinition: assets available for use in the production of further assets

examples.en: Her cousin lent starting capital for the noodle cart, interest-free.
examples.zh: 她表哥为那辆面摊车提供了免息「启动资金」。

examples.en: Without capital, the print shop stayed a plan in a notebook.
examples.zh: 没有「资金」，那家打印店始终只是笔记本里的一个计划。

words.enDefinition: earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something

examples.en: My first attempt at sourdough fed the birds instead of the family.
examples.zh: 我第一次「尝试」做酸面包，成果喂了鸟而不是家人。

examples.en: Each attempt at the driving test cost him a week of practice.
examples.zh: 每次「尝试」考驾照，他都要先练上一周。

words.enDefinition: concerned with work or important matters rather than play or trivialities

examples.en: Dad turned serious the very moment the medical report opened.
examples.zh: 医疗报告一翻开，爸爸立刻「严肃」了起来。

examples.en: Our club wants serious members, not ones who vanish after the first hike.
examples.zh: 社团要的是「认真」的成员，而不是第一次远足后就消失的人。

words.enDefinition: statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation

examples.en: Nobody could remember the answer until the smallest cousin whispered it.
examples.zh: 没人记得「答案」，直到年纪最小的表弟悄悄说出。

examples.en: Her answer to the tricky question was to offer everyone tea.
examples.zh: 面对刁钻的问题，她的「回应」是请大家喝茶。

words.enDefinition: the final match between the winners of all previous matches in an elimination tournament

examples.en: Grandpa fell asleep before the final ended and blamed the ref.
examples.zh: 「决赛」还没结束爷爷就睡着了，还怪裁判。

examples.en: The badminton final drew the whole lane to one courtyard screen.
examples.zh: 羽毛球「决赛」把整条巷子的人都聚到了一块大屏前。

words.enDefinition: (military) an offensive against an enemy (using weapons)

examples.en: The paper described the editorial as a personal attack, not criticism.
examples.zh: 报纸称那篇社论是人身「攻击」，而非批评。

examples.en: My bold chess attack collapsed the moment he traded queens.
examples.zh: 他一换后，我的棋局「攻势」就崩了。

words.enDefinition: make known; make an announcement

examples.en: Grandma announced the engagement before the couple even finished eating.
examples.zh: 小两口还没吃完，外婆就「宣布」了订婚的消息。

examples.en: The principal announced the snow day over the crackling loudspeaker.
examples.zh: 校长通过沙沙作响的喇叭「宣布」了雪假。

words.enDefinition: the region that is outside of something

examples.en: The dog waited outside the bakery every day at closing time.
examples.zh: 那只狗每天打烊时分都在面包店「外面」等着。

examples.en: Leave the wet boots outside, or the hallway smells all week.
examples.zh: 湿靴子放「门外」，不然楼道一整周都有味儿。

words.enDefinition: female person who has the same parents as another person

examples.en: My sister navigates night markets better than any phone map.
examples.zh: 我「姐姐」逛夜市比任何手机地图都靠谱。

examples.en: Her sister sends postcards from small towns nobody can pronounce.
examples.zh: 她「妹妹」从名字都念不顺的小镇寄来明信片。

words.enDefinition: counting everything together; complete with nothing left out

examples.en: The total bill came to less than the two of us feared.
examples.zh: 「总共」的账单比我们俩担心的要少。

examples.en: After the total power cut, the whole lane cooked on one stove.
examples.zh: 彻底断电后，「整条巷子」的人都在一个炉子上做饭。

words.enDefinition: the sound of laughing

examples.en: A laugh from the kitchen told us the cake had collapsed.
examples.zh: 厨房传来一声「大笑」，我们就知道蛋糕塌了。

examples.en: Her loud laugh carries two tables away in the teahouse.
examples.zh: 在茶馆里，她的「笑声」隔着两张桌子都能听见。

words.enDefinition: the act of going to see some person or place or thing for a short time

examples.en: The family visit stretched from lunch until the last bus.
examples.zh: 这次家庭「拜访」从中午一直持续到末班车时间。

examples.en: A quick visit to the dentist turned into two fillings.
examples.zh: 一次「看牙」的小拜访，变成了补两颗牙。

words.enDefinition: green color or pigment; resembling the color of growing grass

examples.en: The door turned green before my aunt lost interest in housework.
examples.zh: 门被刷成「绿色」后不久，姨妈就对家务失去了兴趣。

examples.en: The green shutters made the grey house look newly built.
examples.zh: 「绿色」的百叶窗让灰扑扑的房子像新盖的一样。

words.enDefinition: a device for receiving radio broadcasts; radio as a medium of communication

examples.en: Grandpa fixes the old radio every spring and tunes it to the opera station.
examples.zh: 外公每年春天都修一修那台旧「收音机」，调到戏曲台。

examples.en: The news reached our village by radio long before any newspaper.
examples.zh: 消息通过「无线电广播」传到我们村，比任何报纸都早。

words.enDefinition: the state prevailing during the absence of war

examples.en: The ceasefire held, and the village slept in peace for the first night in months.
examples.zh: 停火生效后，村里几个月来头一回在「和平」中入睡。

examples.en: Grandpa guards his peace by fishing alone before sunrise, always.
examples.zh: 外公靠日出前独自钓鱼守着自己的「安宁」。

words.enDefinition: straight or straightforward, without stops, bends, or detours

examples.en: The direct bus to campus skips the market and saves fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 「直达」校区的公交不绕市场，省下十五分钟。

examples.en: Give me a direct answer: is the rent going up or not?
examples.zh: 给我一个「直截了当的」回答：房租到底涨不涨？

words.enDefinition: the print media responsible for gathering and publishing news in the form of newspapers or magazines

examples.en: The local press photographed the flooded underpass before the council arrived.
examples.zh: 议会的人还没到，「新闻界」就把被淹的地下通道拍了个遍。

examples.en: Grandma trusts the village press more than any city channel.
examples.zh: 比起城市频道，外婆更信村里的「媒体」。

words.enDefinition: direct or control; projects, businesses, etc.

examples.en: My aunt and uncle operate the corner shop in alternating shifts.
examples.zh: 姨妈和姨夫轮班「经营」街角小店。

examples.en: Who exactly operates the ferry during the storm season, though?
examples.zh: 风暴季是谁在「运营」渡轮？

words.enDefinition: an intermediate part or section

examples.en: Grandma plants mint in the middle of the vegetable patch.
examples.zh: 外婆把薄荷种在菜地「中央」。

examples.en: The bench sits in the middle of the market, always crowded.
examples.zh: 那张长椅在市场「正中」，总是挤满了人。

words.enDefinition: having all necessary parts; finished or total

examples.en: The jigsaw lay complete on the table for exactly one hour.
examples.zh: 拼图「完整」地在桌上摆了整整一个小时。

examples.en: The collection is complete once the last stamp arrives from Dalian.
examples.zh: 等大连的最后一枚邮票寄到，这套收藏就「齐」了。

words.enDefinition: free from external control and constraint

examples.en: The ferry keeps running in the storm; it's stubbornly independent.
examples.zh: 风暴天渡轮照常运行，倔强得很「独立」。

examples.en: Grandma has been financially independent since she opened the stall at forty.
examples.zh: 外婆四十岁摆摊起，经济上就「独立」了。

words.enDefinition: the side that is forward or prominent

examples.en: The bakery's front window always shows tomorrow's celebration cakes first.
examples.zh: 面包店的「前面」橱窗最先摆出明天的蛋糕。

examples.en: Sit at the front of the bus if you want to feel every pothole.
examples.zh: 想感受每一个坑洼，就坐公交车「前排」。

words.enDefinition: lighter consisting of a thin piece of wood or cardboard tipped with combustible chemical; ignites with friction

examples.en: The camp stove refused to light until the third match.
examples.zh: 直到第三根「火柴」，炉子才点着。

examples.en: Grandpa lights his pipe with a single wooden match and one long breath.
examples.zh: 外公只用一根木「火柴」和一口长气点烟斗。

words.enDefinition: merchandise issued for sale or public showing (especially a record or film)

examples.en: The album's release date slipped twice, then arrived on my birthday.
examples.zh: 专辑的「发行」日期推迟了两次，最后落在我生日那天。

examples.en: The film's long-awaited release drew queues around the old cinema.
examples.zh: 影片「上映」让老影院门口排起了长队。

words.enDefinition: most important element

examples.en: The fire chief inspected every one of our lane's extinguishers himself.
examples.zh: 消防「队长」亲自检查了我们巷子的灭火器。

examples.en: As chief of the volunteer brigade, Auntie Mei assigns the night shifts.
examples.zh: 梅姨是志愿消防队的「头儿」，负责排夜班。

words.enDefinition: done or taking place in a short time; moving fast

examples.en: A quick breakfast of buns and tea got me to the exam on time.
examples.zh: 包子加茶的一份「快手」早餐让我赶上了考试。

examples.en: She gave the draft a quick read and found three typos.
examples.zh: 她把草稿「快速」读了一遍，揪出三个错别字。

words.enDefinition: the astonishment you feel when something totally unexpected happens to you

examples.en: The surprise wasn't the cake; it was Grandma pretending to be shocked.
examples.zh: 「惊喜」不是蛋糕，而是外婆假装吓了一跳的样子。

examples.en: Snow in April was a surprise the farmers did not welcome.
examples.zh: 四月下雪，这份「意外」农民们可不欢迎。

words.enDefinition: an orange of low brightness and saturation

examples.en: The dog's brown ears flop differently when it is happy.
examples.zh: 狗「棕色」的耳朵一高兴就摆出不一样的弧度。

examples.en: We painted the fence brown to hide the rain stains.
examples.zh: 我们把栅栏刷成「褐色」，好遮住雨水留下的印子。

words.enDefinition: hypothetical description of a complex entity or process

examples.en: Grandpa built a scale model of our street for the heritage fair.
examples.zh: 外公为民俗展搭了一条我们这条街的「模型」。

examples.en: The airplane model on his shelf took two winters to finish.
examples.zh: 他架子上的飞机「模型」花了两个冬天才完成。

words.enDefinition: someone who controls resources and expenditures

examples.en: The friendly night-shift manager knows every regular's order by heart.
examples.zh: 夜班「经理」熟记每位常客的点单。

examples.en: Our building's manager chases the lift repairman better than anyone.
examples.zh: 我们楼的「管理员」追起电梯修理工来比谁都勤。

words.enDefinition: planned undertaking

examples.en: Our street's mural project took one summer and forty buckets of paint.
examples.zh: 我们这条街的壁画「项目」用了一个夏天和四十桶颜料。

examples.en: The rooftop garden project began with three buckets and one argument.
examples.zh: 屋顶花园「计划」始于三只桶和一场争论。

words.enDefinition: to a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common

examples.en: Grandma saves the chicken wing tips especially for the soup.
examples.zh: 外婆「特意」把鸡翅尖留起来煲汤。

examples.en: The stall sells out early, especially on rainy market days.
examples.zh: 雨天赶集时，摊位总是早早卖完，「尤其」抢手。

words.enDefinition: framework of wood or metal that contains a glass windowpane and is built into a wall or roof to admit light or air

examples.en: The kitchen window frames the market exactly like a slow film.
examples.zh: 厨房「窗户」框出的市场景象宛如一部慢镜头电影。

examples.en: Rain taps the bedroom window all night in typhoon season.
examples.zh: 台风季，雨点整夜敲打着卧室「窗」。

words.enDefinition: the unlimited expanse in which everything is located

examples.en: There's barely space for one more chair in this study room.
examples.zh: 这间书房几乎没有「空间」再放一把椅子。

examples.en: The van filled up, and we found space for the bicycle on the roof.
examples.zh: 面包车装满了，我们在车顶找到了放自行车的「空位」。

words.enDefinition: be pertinent or relevant or applicable

examples.en: The generous student discount applies only on weekdays before noon.
examples.zh: 学生「折扣」只在工作日中午前「适用」。

examples.en: The same rule applies to the library and the computer lab.
examples.zh: 这条规定在图书馆和机房同样「适用」。

words.enDefinition: under normal conditions

examples.en: I usually miss the first bus and walk past the morning market instead.
examples.zh: 我「通常」会错过头班车，改为步行穿过早市。

examples.en: Grandpa usually waters the plants before the sun reaches the balcony.
examples.zh: 外公「通常」赶在太阳照到阳台之前浇花。

words.enDefinition: Everybody; -- commonly separated, every one.

examples.en: Everyone on our floor chips in for the cleaner's festival gift.
examples.zh: 我们这层楼「每个人」都凑份子给保洁阿姨买节日礼物。

examples.en: Everyone laughed when the parrot recited the professor's opening line.
examples.zh: 鹦鹉背出教授的开场白时，「大家」都笑了。

words.enDefinition: pair who associate with one another

examples.en: The elderly couple shares one umbrella and argues over the pace.
examples.zh: 这对老「夫妇」合撑一把伞，还要争谁走得太快。

examples.en: A young couple occupied the corner table since before we queued.
examples.zh: 那对年轻「情侣」从我们排队前就占着角落那桌。

words.enDefinition: in truth (often tends to intensify)

examples.en: The soup was, indeed, well worth the two-block morning queue.
examples.zh: 这碗汤「的确」值得排两条街的队。

examples.en: Grandpa said the frost would come early, and indeed it did.
examples.zh: 外公说霜期会提前，「果然」应验了。

words.enDefinition: an essential and distinguishing attribute of something or someone

examples.en: The tailor judges quality by the seams, not the label.
examples.zh: 裁缝看衣服「品质」只看针脚，不看商标。

examples.en: Market tomatoes beat supermarket ones on quality and taste every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，市场番茄的「品质」都胜过超市货。

words.enDefinition: definitely or positively (`sure' is sometimes used informally for `surely')

examples.en: You may certainly borrow the tent; just dry it afterwards.
examples.zh: 你「当然」可以借帐篷，只要之后晾干就行。

examples.en: The recipe will certainly fail if you skip the resting step.
examples.zh: 省掉醒面那一步，这道食谱「肯定」会失败。

words.enDefinition: marked by correspondence or resemblance

examples.en: The two rooftop gardens look similar, but one grows chilies secretly.
examples.zh: 两个屋顶花园看着「相似」，其中一个却偷偷种了辣椒。

examples.en: My handwriting is quite similar to Dad's, except on envelopes.
examples.zh: 我的字和爸爸的「很像」，写信封时除外。

words.enDefinition: to give instruction or help someone learn

examples.en: Grandma taught me to fold dumplings faster than any video could.
examples.zh: 外婆「教」我包饺子，比任何视频都快。

examples.en: The retired captain offered to teach rowing to the younger scouts.
examples.zh: 退役船长主动提出教年轻童子军「划船」。

words.enDefinition: an iconic mental representation

examples.en: The temple's image of the guardian was repainted every spring.
examples.zh: 寺庙里守护神「像」每年春天都要重新描漆。

examples.en: My first mental image of the city came from Grandma's stories.
examples.zh: 我对这座城市的最初「印象」来自外婆的故事。

words.enDefinition: absolutely essential

examples.en: Grandma says sunscreen is necessary even on cloudy beach days.
examples.zh: 即使是阴天的海滩，防晒霜也是「必要的」。

examples.en: It wasn't necessary to bring the whole toolbox to fix one chair.
examples.zh: 修一把椅子带整套工具箱，实在「没有必要」。

words.enDefinition: thing constructed; a complex entity constructed of many parts

examples.en: The old bridge's stone structure survived three floods this century.
examples.zh: 老桥的石头「结构」扛过了本世纪三次洪水。

examples.en: The essay needs a clearer structure: one idea per paragraph.
examples.zh: 这篇文章「结构」需要更清晰：一段只讲一件事。

words.enDefinition: a device used to make and receive calls; a telephone

examples.en: My poor phone survives almost everything except Grandpa's pocket sand.
examples.zh: 我的「手机」什么都扛得住，除了外公口袋里的沙子。

examples.en: The shop fixed my phone screen while I ate two dumplings.
examples.zh: 趁我吃两个饺子的工夫，店里就修好了「手机」屏幕。

words.enDefinition: to have something inside or as a part of something larger

examples.en: The welcome pack contains maps, keys, and one suspicious cookie.
examples.zh: 迎宾包里「装着」地图、钥匙，还有一块可疑的饼干。

examples.en: Grandma's soup contains nothing that is written in any recipe book.
examples.zh: 外婆的汤里「含」的东西哪本菜谱都找不到。

words.enDefinition: visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface

examples.en: The framed picture above the fireplace is older than the house.
examples.zh: 壁炉上方那幅「画」比房子年头还久。

examples.en: She drew a picture of the courtyard from the balcony every evening.
examples.zh: 她每晚都在阳台上画一幅院子的「画」。

words.enDefinition: separate part of a whole

examples.en: A single piece of chocolate ends every argument in our house.
examples.zh: 在我们家，一块「巧克力」能终结所有争执。

examples.en: The vase broke into five pieces; the cat looked innocent.
examples.zh: 花瓶碎成五「块」，猫一脸无辜。

words.enDefinition: an isolated fact that is considered separately from the whole

examples.en: The tailor noticed every detail, down to the mismatched buttons.
examples.zh: 裁缝注意到每个「细节」，连不配对的纽扣都不放过。

examples.en: Check the bus detail on the ticket before you leave tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚出门前，先核对票上的「细节」信息。

words.enDefinition: cut down on; make a reduction in

examples.en: Cycling to the market reduced my spending and my patience for parking.
examples.zh: 骑车去市场「减少」了开销，也「减掉」了我找车位的耐心。

examples.en: Grandpa reduced his coffee to one cup after the doctor's talk.
examples.zh: 医生谈话后，外公把咖啡「减」到了一天一杯。

words.enDefinition: absolutely; altogether; really

examples.en: The repair was simply a loose screw after all that worry.
examples.zh: 白担心一场，问题「只是」一颗松掉的螺丝。

examples.en: That new noodle place is simply too crowded to enjoy.
examples.zh: 那家新面馆「简直」挤得没法好好吃。

words.enDefinition: licensed medical practitioner

examples.en: The doctor replaced my grandfather's handwritten notes with a printed list.
examples.zh: 「医生」把外公手写的用药单换成了打印版。

examples.en: Our family doctor remembers birthdays better than my phone does.
examples.zh: 家庭「医生」记生日比我的手机还牢。

words.enDefinition: form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement

examples.en: The open-air movie started an hour late because of the rain.
examples.zh: 露天「电影」因为下雨晚开了一小时。

examples.en: Grandma narrates every movie, five minutes ahead of the plot.
examples.zh: 外婆给每部「电影」都配解说，还总比剧情快五分钟。

words.enDefinition: set up or found

examples.en: The night market established itself on our street in a single spring.
examples.zh: 夜市只用了一个春天就在我们这条街「立足」。

examples.en: The scholarship established by Auntie Mei's class still funds two students.
examples.zh: 梅姨班级设立的「奖学金」至今还资助着两名学生。

words.enDefinition: machine for performing calculations automatically

examples.en: The library computer still runs the card catalogue faster than my laptop.
examples.zh: 图书馆的「电脑」查卡片目录比我的笔记本还快。

examples.en: Grandpa's computer plays chess and nothing else, by his choice.
examples.zh: 外公的「电脑」只下棋，别的都不装，这是他的选择。

words.enDefinition: belonging to or for the use of one particular person or group only

examples.en: The rooftop is private, so our drying racks stay untouched.
examples.zh: 屋顶是「私人的」，我们的晾衣架从没人动。

examples.en: Keep the gate locked at night; the courtyard is private property.
examples.zh: 把门锁好，院子是「私人」地方。

words.enDefinition: ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation

examples.en: Her approach to stubborn stains starts with an overnight soak.
examples.zh: 她对付顽固污渍的「方法」是先泡一夜。

examples.en: The young teacher's calm approach turned the noisiest class around.
examples.zh: 老师平和的「方式」让最吵闹的班都变了样。

words.enDefinition: the relative magnitude of something with reference to a criterion

examples.en: A small amount of chili oil goes a long way in this soup.
examples.zh: 这汤里放「少量」的辣椒油就够劲了。

examples.en: Count the exact amount twice before handing over the rent.
examples.zh: 交房租前把「数目」点两遍。

words.enDefinition: drawback or difficulty that is not readily evident

examples.en: The offer sounded perfect, so naturally we hunted for the catch.
examples.zh: 优惠听起来完美，我们自然开始找「蹊跷」。

examples.en: There's always a catch: the free gym trial ends with a hard sell.
examples.zh: 总有「陷阱」：免费健身体验的最后是硬推销。

words.enDefinition: an elaborate and systematic plan of action

examples.en: The council's new scheme pairs empty nesters with student tenants.
examples.zh: 议会的「方案」让空巢老人和学生租客结对。

examples.en: Under the new recycling scheme, our lane separates three bins.
examples.zh: 按新的回收「计划」，我们巷子要分三个桶。

words.enDefinition: grant made by a law court

examples.en: The court's award covered the repairs to our crushed fence.
examples.zh: 法院的「判给金」覆盖了被撞坏篱笆的修理费。

examples.en: Her lawyer explained how the award would be paid in instalments.
examples.zh: 律师解释了「裁定赔偿额」将如何分期支付。

words.enDefinition: the process whereby a person concentrates on some features of the environment to the (relative) exclusion of others

examples.en: Grandpa's attention drifts away unless the radio mentions the weather.
examples.zh: 只要广播不提天气，外公的「注意力」就会飘走。

examples.en: Pay attention when the recipe says add eggs one at a time.
examples.zh: 菜谱说鸡蛋要一个个加时，「注意」照做。

words.enDefinition: to succeed in doing or getting what you wanted, usually after effort

examples.en: Grandma achieved her goal of reading the whole newspaper daily.
examples.zh: 外婆「实现」了每天读完整份报纸的目标。

examples.en: The team achieved a full house for the first night market.
examples.zh: 团队让首届夜市「办到」了满场。

words.enDefinition: subdivision of a written work; usually numbered and titled

examples.en: Chapter three patiently explains why Grandma salts the eggplant twice.
examples.zh: 「第三章」解释了外婆为什么要给茄子撒两次盐。

examples.en: I read one chapter of the mystery each night, like medicine.
examples.zh: 每晚读「一章」那本悬疑小说，像吃药一样定时。

words.enDefinition: pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives

examples.en: Grandma lets me choose the fruit; I always pick loquats.
examples.zh: 外婆让我来「挑」水果，我总选枇杷。

examples.en: We chose the slower boat because it allowed deck picnics.
examples.zh: 我们「选」了慢船，因为甲板上可以野餐。

words.enDefinition: something owned; any tangible or intangible possession that is owned by someone;

examples.en: Grandma's most treasured piece of property is a keyring, oddly.
examples.zh: 说来奇怪，外婆最珍视的「财产」是一个钥匙圈。

examples.en: The rental property on the corner changes tenants every May.
examples.zh: 街角那处出租「房产」每年五月都换租客。

words.enDefinition: document (or organization) from which information is obtained

examples.en: The recipe's true source was Grandma's church cookbook from 1978.
examples.zh: 这道菜的「出处」是外婆 1978 年的教会食谱。

examples.en: Cite the source under every photo, the teacher reminded us.
examples.zh: 老师提醒我们，每张照片下面都要标「来源」。

words.enDefinition: (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but

examples.en: The dumplings were nearly gone by the time I reached the table.
examples.zh: 等我走到桌边，饺子「几乎」没了。

examples.en: Grandpa nearly won the chess match until his phone rang.
examples.zh: 外公的棋「差点」就赢了，这时他的手机响了。

words.enDefinition: the direction where the sun sets; the southern part of a place

examples.en: We drove south until the smell of the sea replaced the market's.
examples.zh: 我们一路向「南」开，直到海风替代了市场的气味。

examples.en: The south side of the house catches the afternoon sun.
examples.zh: 房子「朝南」的一面晒得到午后阳光。

words.enDefinition: hear with intention

examples.en: Grandpa listens to the opera channel while shelling beans outside.
examples.zh: 外公一边剥豆子一边「听」戏曲频道。

examples.en: Listen to the kettle carefully; it sings before it boils.
examples.zh: 「听」水壶的声音，它会在烧开前先唱歌。

words.enDefinition: particular society at a particular time and place

examples.en: Our lane's dumpling culture has survived three generations of change.
examples.zh: 我们这条巷子的饺子「文化」传了三代人。

examples.en: The exchange student taught us tea culture from her province.
examples.zh: 交换生给我们讲了她家乡的茶「文化」。

words.enDefinition: committee having supervisory powers

examples.en: The school board approved the new library extension last week.
examples.zh: 学校「董事会」上周批准了新图书馆的扩建。

examples.en: The village board meets monthly above the old teahouse, Thursdays.
examples.zh: 村「委员会」每月在老茶馆楼上周会。

words.enDefinition: make real or concrete; give reality or substance to

examples.en: Grandma finally realized her old dream of a jasmine-covered balcony.
examples.zh: 外婆终于「实现」了茉莉花爬满阳台的梦想。
