words.enDefinition: an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members

examples.en: Our small village side finally topped the weekend football league.
examples.zh: 我们村队终于在周末足球「联赛」登顶。

examples.en: The village chess league meets above the old teahouse, Wednesdays.
examples.zh: 象棋「联盟」每周三在茶馆楼上赛。

words.enDefinition: the state of being unsure of something

examples.en: I have no doubt the cat ate the order slip.
examples.zh: 我毫不「怀疑」是猫吃了点单小票。

examples.en: Grandpa doubts the weather app more than the sparrows do.
examples.zh: 外公对天气应用的「怀疑」比麻雀还多。

words.enDefinition: public transport provided by a line of railway cars coupled together and drawn by a locomotive

examples.en: The slow train leaves at six and takes every hilly view.
examples.zh: 慢「车」六点发车，沿途山景一个不落。

examples.en: Grandpa waves at the freight train like an old friend.
examples.zh: 外公对着货运「火车」挥手，像见老朋友。

words.enDefinition: that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord

examples.en: Grandpa claims his brain works best two dumplings after lunch.
examples.zh: 外公声称自己的「脑子」在午饭后两个饺子时最灵光。

examples.en: The chess brain of our lane lives above the fruit stall.
examples.zh: 本巷的象棋「大脑」住在水果摊楼上。

words.enDefinition: workplace for the teaching or practice of an art

examples.en: The pottery studio above the bakery smells of clay and sugar.
examples.zh: 面包店楼上的陶艺「工作室」弥漫着陶土和糖香。

examples.en: Grandpa's radio studio is one stool and a cupped hand.
examples.zh: 外公的广播「工作室」就是一条凳加一只拢起的手。

words.enDefinition: time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday

examples.en: The weekend market spills into the car park by eight.
examples.zh: 一到「周末」，市场八点就漫到停车场去了。

examples.en: Grandpa guards his precious weekend nap like a bank vault.
examples.zh: 外公守卫「周末」午睡如守银行金库。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one

examples.en: Grandma buys eggs by the dozen and never counts the last one.
examples.zh: 外婆按「打」买鸡蛋，从来不数最后一枚。

examples.en: A dozen hungry cousins claimed the loquat tree before breakfast.
examples.zh: 早饭前，十二个「一打」表亲占领了枇杷树。

words.enDefinition: close interaction

examples.en: Grandpa keeps contact with every ferry captain by whistle code.
examples.zh: 外公靠口哨暗号与每位渡轮船长保持「联系」。

examples.en: Avoid eye contact with the queue-jumper; the aunties handle it.
examples.zh: 别与插队者有「目光接触」；阿姨们会处理的。

words.enDefinition: hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war

examples.en: Grandpa re-fights the battle of the flooded stall every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，外公都要重新「复盘」摊位被淹那场「战役」。

examples.en: The great snowball battle across the lane lasted until dinner.
examples.zh: 横跨巷子的雪球「大战」一直打到晚饭。

words.enDefinition: any spatial attributes (especially as defined by outline)

examples.en: Each dumpling's final shape depends on which cousin folded it.
examples.zh: 饺子的「形状」取决于哪个表亲包的。

examples.en: Grandpa trims the hedge into a shape resembling a sleeping dog.
examples.zh: 外公把树篱修成一只睡狗的「造型」。

words.enDefinition: a system or means of carrying people or goods from place to place

examples.en: Public transport here means one old bus and many opinions.
examples.zh: 这里的公共「交通」就是一辆公交加众人议论。

examples.en: Grandma trusts the river transport more than the ring road.
examples.zh: 外婆信河上的「运输」，胜过信环城路。

words.enDefinition: depository for collecting and displaying objects having scientific or historical or artistic value

examples.en: The county museum proudly displays Grandma's very first market scale.
examples.zh: 县「博物馆」展出了外婆的第一杆市场秤。

examples.en: We visited the museum during the rain and stayed for the model ships.
examples.zh: 下雨天我们逛了「博物馆」，还看了船模展。

words.enDefinition: a book or magazine published once a year; also an annual report in business contexts

examples.en: Her graduation photo made the college annual on page seven.
examples.zh: 她的毕业照登上了大学「年刊」第七页。

examples.en: The society's annual collects every lantern design made since 1990.
examples.zh: 协会的「年刊」收录了 1990 年以来所有的灯彩设计。

words.enDefinition: take in marriage

examples.en: They plan to marry in the courtyard, lanterns strictly optional.
examples.zh: 他们「打算」在院子里成婚，灯笼自选。

examples.en: Grandpa married his childhood neighbour from two stalls further down.
examples.zh: 外公「娶了」隔着两个摊位长大的邻家姑娘。

words.enDefinition: the state of being present; current existence

examples.en: The mayor's surprise presence instantly doubled the loquat festival crowd.
examples.zh: 镇长的「出席」让枇杷节人流翻倍。

examples.en: The cat insists on its presence at every inventory count.
examples.zh: 每次盘点，那只猫都坚持要「在场」。

words.enDefinition: the activity of protecting someone or something

examples.en: The new awning offers real protection from the April hail.
examples.zh: 雨棚在四月冰雹天里提供了实实在在的「保护」。

examples.en: Grandpa's sunscreen is the only sun protection he truly trusts.
examples.zh: 防晒霜是外公唯一信得过的「防护」。

words.enDefinition: to bring things together, or to pick someone or something up

examples.en: Grandpa collects fresh market gossip the way bees collect pollen.
examples.zh: 外公「收集」市场八卦，像蜜蜂采蜜一样勤快。

examples.en: I collect the younger cousins from the station every Friday.
examples.zh: 每周五我都去车站「接」表亲们。

words.enDefinition: the only fertile female in a colony of social insects such as bees and ants and termites; its function is to lay eggs

examples.en: The beekeeper showed us the queen through the glass frame.
examples.zh: 养蜂人隔着玻璃框给我们看了「蜂后」。

examples.en: A queen ant founded a colony under the market scale.
examples.zh: 一只蚁「后」在市场秤底下建立了一个王国。

words.enDefinition: directs the work of others

examples.en: The old dog obeys its master before the whistle finishes.
examples.zh: 口哨还没吹完，狗就听「主人」的了。

examples.en: As master of the workshop, Grandpa assigns the noisy jobs to himself.
examples.zh: 作为作坊的「主人」，外公把吵闹的活都派给了自己。

words.enDefinition: single serving of a beverage

examples.en: The only drink Grandpa truly trusts is tea, twice boiled.
examples.zh: 外公唯一信得过的「饮品」是煮过两遍的茶。

examples.en: One cold drink later, everyone in the queue forgave it.
examples.zh: 一杯冰「饮料」下肚，大家原谅了排队。

words.enDefinition: the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit

examples.en: Grandpa cheerfully calls hauling heavy market crates his morning exercise.
examples.zh: 外公把赶集运货称为晨间「锻炼」。

examples.en: The doctor only prescribes exercise: stairs, not lifts, he says.
examples.zh: 医生的「运动」处方是：爬楼梯，别坐电梯。

words.enDefinition: the property created by the space between two objects or points

examples.en: The distance between our stalls is exactly one gossip exchange.
examples.zh: 我们两个摊位的「距离」正好是一次八卦的长度。

examples.en: Grandpa judges any walking distance by counting dumpling shops passed.
examples.zh: 外公以路过的饺子店数量来衡量「路程远近」。

words.enDefinition: the appendage to an object that is designed to be held in order to use or move it

examples.en: The wok's old wooden handle somehow survives Grandpa's daily enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 炒锅的木「柄」扛得住外公的猛劲。

examples.en: Grandma grips the market cart's handle with two fingers, imperiously.
examples.zh: 外婆用两根手指威严地扣住推车「把手」。

words.enDefinition: the month following July and preceding September

examples.en: August in our lane means one fan and many opinions.
examples.zh: 我们巷子的「八月」意味着一台风扇加众人议论。

examples.en: The sweet loquats sold out twice in this August alone.
examples.zh: 光是「八月」，枇杷就两度售罄。

words.enDefinition: land mass that projects well above its surroundings; higher than a hill

examples.en: The eastern mountain hides the sunrise until half past six.
examples.zh: 「山」挡着日出，六点半才露头。

examples.en: Grandpa claims the mountain's cold spring water beats any filter.
examples.zh: 外公说山里的泉「水」胜过任何滤芯。

words.enDefinition: distance travelled per unit time

examples.en: Grandpa checks the fan's speed before trusting it with dumplings.
examples.zh: 外公先确认风扇「转速」，才放心让它吹饺子。

examples.en: The dragon boat's speed dropped instantly once Grandma came aboard.
examples.zh: 外婆一上船，龙舟「速度」立刻下降。

words.enDefinition: white or silvered surface where pictures can be projected for viewing

examples.en: The cinema's new screen swallowed our whole field of view.
examples.zh: 影院的新「银幕」吞下了我们整个视野。

examples.en: Grandpa projects the opera onto a bedsheet screen every Saturday.
examples.zh: 外公每周六把戏曲投影在床单「幕布」上。

words.enDefinition: come out into view, as from concealment

examples.en: The moon emerged from behind the laundry lines at nine.
examples.zh: 九点，「月亮」从晾衣绳后「浮现」。

examples.en: Grandpa finally emerged from the chess marathon undefeated and hungry.
examples.zh: 外公从象棋马拉松中「脱颖而出」，没输但饿了。

words.enDefinition: someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there

examples.en: Every resident of the lane got a festival dumpling allocation.
examples.zh: 巷里每位「居民」都分到了节日饺子配额。

examples.en: The newest resident is the cat; the paperwork is pending.
examples.zh: 最新的「住户」是那只猫；手续还在办。

words.zhGloss: （可单独购买搭配的）单件服装
words.enDefinition: garment that can be purchased separately and worn in combinations with other garments
acceptedZhAnswers: （可单独购买搭配的）单件服装

examples.en: This knit top sells as a separate that pairs with any skirt.
examples.zh: 这件针织上衣作为「单件服装」出售，可与任何裙子搭配。

examples.en: The tailor splits the suit into separates for summer wear.
examples.zh: 裁缝把套装拆成「单件」方便夏天穿。

words.enDefinition: the inherent capacity for coming into being

examples.en: The pup shows real potential as a sheepdog, chaos included.
examples.zh: 这只小狗当牧羊犬很有「潜力」，包括制造混乱的天赋。

examples.en: Grandpa sees real dumpling-folding potential in the most hopeless cousin.
examples.zh: 外公能在最没指望的表亲身上看出包饺子的「潜质」。

words.enDefinition: the condition of being susceptible to harm or injury

examples.en: Grandpa warns of the danger of trusting scales at dusk.
examples.zh: 外公警告说，傍晚轻信秤上的数字有「危险」。

examples.en: The wet tiles are a danger the cat ignores daily.
examples.zh: 湿地砖的「危险」，那只猫每天都无视。

words.enDefinition: the act of moving forward (as toward a goal)

examples.en: The reading corner shows real progress since the bookshelf arrived.
examples.zh: 书架到货后，阅读角「进步」明显。

examples.en: Grandpa tracks his fishing progress in a small drowned notebook.
examples.zh: 外公在一个泡过水的小本子里记录钓鱼「进展」。

words.enDefinition: large number of things or people considered together

examples.en: A crowd gathered the moment the noodle master flipped the wok.
examples.zh: 面师傅一颠勺，「人群」立刻围拢过来。

examples.en: Grandpa parts a crowd like a ferry parts the river.
examples.zh: 外公分开「人群」，如渡轮分开河水。

words.enDefinition: plant cultivated for its blooms or blossoms

examples.en: The flower on the stall table changes with every season.
examples.zh: 摊桌上的「花」随季节更换。

examples.en: Grandma trades slightly bruised vegetable seconds for the florist's unsold flowers.
examples.zh: 外婆用卖相次的蔬菜换花店剩下的「鲜花」。

words.enDefinition: disposed or inclined toward

examples.en: Grandpa is always willing to taste every pickle, for science.
examples.zh: 为了科学，外公「乐意」尝遍每一种腌菜。

examples.en: The cat is willing to negotiate, but at sardine rates.
examples.zh: 那只猫「愿意」谈判，条件按沙丁鱼计价。

words.enDefinition: happening at even intervals; following the same pattern

examples.en: A strictly regular sleep schedule finally fixed my morning mood.
examples.zh: 「规律的」作息终于治好了我早上的起床气。

examples.en: Grandpa takes his regular evening walk at exactly seven sharp.
examples.zh: 外公每晚七点准时进行「例行」散步。

words.enDefinition: written explanation or criticism or illustration that is added to a book or other textual material

examples.en: My teacher's comment on the essay was one word: finally.
examples.zh: 老师对作文的「评语」只有一个词：总算。

examples.en: Grandpa leaves a kind comment under every noodle review video.
examples.zh: 外公在每条面条视频下都留下善意的「评论」。

words.enDefinition: correctional institution where persons are confined while on trial or for punishment

examples.en: The old prison by the river is now a very honest museum.
examples.zh: 河边的老「监狱」如今是一座非常诚实的博物馆。

examples.en: Grandpa jokes the market queue is worse than prison food.
examples.zh: 外公打趣说市场的队比「监狱」伙食还磨人。

words.enDefinition: person who keeps watch over something or someone

examples.en: The night guard knows every cat by name and habit.
examples.zh: 夜班「警卫」叫得出每只猫的名字和习惯。

examples.en: Grandpa guards the lantern poles like an unpaid, happy guard.
examples.zh: 外公守着灯杆，像个不领薪却快乐的「看守」。

words.enDefinition: the speech act of continuing a conversational exchange

examples.en: Grandma's reply to the price rise was a longer shopping list.
examples.zh: 面对涨价，外婆的「回应」是一张更长的购物单。

examples.en: The stall's reply to bad weather is hot ginger tea.
examples.zh: 摊位对坏天气的「答复」是一壶热姜茶。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being just or fair

examples.en: Grandpa says a fair price is simply everyday market justice.
examples.zh: 外公说，公道的价格就是最朴素的市场「正义」。

examples.en: The lane's unofficial court settles disputes with tea and justice.
examples.zh: 巷子里的非官方法庭用茶和「公道」解决纠纷。

words.enDefinition: long wooden bench with a back

examples.en: Grandpa dozes on the oak settle by the bakery window.
examples.zh: 外公在面包店窗边的橡木「长椅」上打盹。

examples.en: The old kitchen settle seats six cousins and one cat.
examples.zh: 厨房的「高背长凳」坐得下六个表亲和一只猫。

words.enDefinition: formation of aircraft in flight

examples.en: Three loud training jets flew past in tight flight formation.
examples.zh: 三架教练机以密集的「编队飞行」掠过。

examples.en: Grandpa identifies planes by their flight patterns, not their noise.
examples.zh: 外公靠「飞行编队」认飞机，不靠轰鸣声。

words.enDefinition: refuse to acknowledge

examples.en: The cat ignores the new cushion in favour of the scale.
examples.zh: 猫「无视」新坐垫，偏爱那杆秤。

examples.en: Grandpa ignores the weather app and reads the sky instead.
examples.zh: 外公「不理会」天气应用，改看天色。

words.enDefinition: an instance of visual perception

examples.en: The fog ruined our first sight of the harbour bridge.
examples.zh: 大雾毁了我们与海港大桥的初次「相见」。

examples.en: At first sight, the stall looks closed; the cat disagrees.
examples.zh: 乍一「看」，摊位像是关了；猫表示反对。

words.enDefinition: statistic describing the location of a distribution

examples.en: On average, the ferry is four minutes late and entirely forgiven.
examples.zh: 「平均」而言，渡轮晚四分钟，而且完全被原谅。

examples.en: Grandpa averages his chess wins and never mentions the losses.
examples.zh: 外公只算棋局的「平均」胜率，从不提败绩。

words.enDefinition: emitting or reflecting light readily or in large amounts

examples.en: The market is bright at dawn, all tarpaulin and steam.
examples.zh: 清晨的市场一片「明亮」，满是篷布与蒸汽。

examples.en: Grandpa's bright yellow kettle is the noisiest object in the lane.
examples.zh: 外公「亮黄色」的水壶是巷子里最扎眼的东西。

words.enDefinition: make a proposal, declare a plan for something

examples.en: Mum proposed a riverside picnic instead of the crowded mall.
examples.zh: 妈妈「提议」去野餐，不去拥挤的商场。

examples.en: Grandpa seriously proposed extending the festival by one dumpling day.
examples.zh: 外公「提议」把节庆再延长一个饺子日。

words.enDefinition: solid piece of something (usually having flat rectangular sides)

examples.en: The kid patiently stacked wooden blocks into a lopsided tower.
examples.zh: 孩子把木头「积木块」堆成了歪塔。

examples.en: Grandpa splits the whole ice block with one confident tap.
examples.zh: 外公自信一敲，把大「冰块」劈成两半。

words.enDefinition: clothing in general

examples.en: Grandma irons all the children's festival clothes the night before.
examples.zh: 外婆节前一夜熨好节日「衣裳」。

examples.en: Hang the wet clothes upstairs; the cat claims the drying rack.
examples.zh: 湿「衣服」晾到楼上——晾衣架已被猫宣布主权。

words.enDefinition: busy and always doing things; taking an active part

examples.en: Grandpa stays active in the garden until the rain wins.
examples.zh: 外公在园子里忙个不停，直到雨「赢了」为止。

examples.en: The most active stallholder at dawn is always Grandma herself.
examples.zh: 清晨最「勤快」的摊主永远是我外婆。

words.enDefinition: in large part; mainly or chiefly

examples.en: The long delay was largely the fog's fault, said everyone.
examples.zh: 大家都说，延误「主要」是雾的锅。

examples.en: Grandpa reads the market largely through the price of noodles.
examples.zh: 外公主要靠面条价格来「读懂」市场行情。

words.enDefinition: put into a proper or systematic order

examples.en: Grandma arranged the pickle jars by colour before anyone arrived.
examples.zh: 趁没人来，外婆先按颜色把腌菜「摆」好了。

examples.en: We arranged the grand chess rematch for after the rain.
examples.zh: 我们把象棋复赛「安排」在雨停之后。

words.enDefinition: continue to live through hardship or adversity

examples.en: The old awning survived the typhoon with three new holes.
examples.zh: 旧雨棚「挺过」了台风，多了三个新洞。

examples.en: Only the sealed pickle jars survived the market flood intact.
examples.zh: 市场被淹后，只有腌菜罐完好「幸存」。

words.enDefinition: electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds

examples.en: The lane's last red telephone booth now stores borrowed umbrellas.
examples.zh: 巷里最后一座「电话亭」如今用来存伞。

examples.en: Grandpa answers the hallway telephone on the third ring, formally.
examples.zh: 外公在第三声铃响时「接电话」，仪态端正。

words.enDefinition: person who operates a farm

examples.en: The peach farmer sells his peaches before the market opens.
examples.zh: 「农民」赶在市场开门前就把桃子卖完了。

examples.en: Grandpa trades weather rhymes with the old bean farmer weekly.
examples.zh: 外公每周都和种豆的「农人」交换天气谚语。

words.enDefinition: collection of things wrapped or boxed together

examples.en: The battered package arrived, and the noodles survived quite intact.
examples.zh: 「包裹」到时压扁了，好在里面的面条无恙。

examples.en: Grandpa ties every outgoing package with the same red string.
examples.zh: 外公给每个「包裹」都系同一种红绳。

words.enDefinition: an associate that one works with

examples.en: My colleague covers the stall when the ferry is late.
examples.zh: 渡轮晚点时，「同事」会替我看摊。

examples.en: Grandpa refers to the market cat as his oldest colleague.
examples.zh: 外公把市场那只猫称作资历最老的「同事」。

words.enDefinition: conceptual whole made up of complicated and related parts

examples.en: The sports complex hides a pool behind the old grandstand.
examples.zh: 「综合运动场」的老看台后面藏着一个泳池。

examples.en: Grandpa navigates the vast shopping complex by dumpling stalls alone.
examples.zh: 外公光凭饺子摊就能在购物中心「建筑群」里认路。

words.enDefinition: something that cannot be done

examples.en: It seems impossible that the cat opened the jar alone.
examples.zh: 那只猫独自拧开罐子，看似「不可能」。

examples.en: Grandpa proved the impossible twice: pickles before breakfast, both times happily.
examples.zh: 外公证明了「不可能」：早饭前吃腌菜，还是两次。

words.enDefinition: feeling of trust (in someone or something)

examples.en: Grandpa's huge confidence survives every chess loss and one flood.
examples.zh: 外公的「自信」经受住了所有棋局败绩和一场水患。

examples.en: The rookie's confidence collapsed when the parrot mocked the recipe.
examples.zh: 鹦鹉嘲笑配方后，新手的「信心」塌了。

words.enDefinition: for the most part

examples.en: The corner stall sells mainly pickles and, unofficially, fresh gossip.
examples.zh: 摊位「主要」卖腌菜，非正式业务是八卦。

examples.en: Grandpa drinks mainly strong tea, with ceremonial exceptions for soup.
examples.zh: 外公「主要」喝茶，喝汤属于仪式性例外。

words.enDefinition: strip forming the outer edge of something

examples.en: Grandma sewed lace along the border of the festival tablecloth.
examples.zh: 外婆沿节日桌布的「边缘」缝了一圈蕾丝。

examples.en: The garden border by the wall grows mint and one stubborn rose.
examples.zh: 墙边花园「边界」种着薄荷和一朵倔强的玫瑰。

words.enDefinition: sewing consisting of small folds or puckers made by pulling tight a thread in a line of stitching

examples.en: The blue dress's soft gathers hide a very practical pocket.
examples.zh: 连衣裙柔软的「抽褶」藏着一个非常实用的口袋。

examples.en: Grandma adds neat gathers at the waist for festival dresses.
examples.zh: 外婆给节日裙的腰部加上「碎褶」。

words.enDefinition: the greatest possible degree of something

examples.en: The lane's official limit for queue debates is three minutes.
examples.zh: 本巷排队争论的「上限」是三分钟。

examples.en: Grandpa firmly believes good dumplings have no reasonable daily limit.
examples.zh: 外公认为饺子的「数量」没有合理的上限。

words.enDefinition: the amount of 3-dimensional space occupied by an object

examples.en: Measure the box's exact volume before quoting the shipping fee.
examples.zh: 报价运费前，先量箱子的「体积」。

examples.en: The melon's sheer volume outranks its weight in Grandpa's maths.
examples.zh: 在外公的算法里，甜瓜的「体积」比重量更重要。

words.enDefinition: be emphatic or resolute and refuse to budge

examples.en: Grandpa insists that the kettle sings better with fresh water.
examples.zh: 外公「坚持」认为新换的水能让水壶唱得更动听。

examples.en: Grandma always insists on tasting the soup before serving guests.
examples.zh: 招待客人前，外婆「坚决要求」先尝汤。

words.enDefinition: process or result of distributing or extending over a wide expanse of space

examples.en: The gossip's spread outran the actual news by two streets.
examples.zh: 八卦的「传播」比消息本身快了两条街。

examples.en: Grandpa measured the red paint spread on his trousers unhappily.
examples.zh: 外公不高兴地估算裤子上油漆「蔓延」的面积。

words.enDefinition: an item inserted in a written record

examples.en: Her diary entry about the concert made the whole lane laugh.
examples.zh: 她那篇关于演唱会的日记「记录」逗笑了整条巷子。

examples.en: Grandpa adds one entry to the price book every Saturday.
examples.zh: 外公每周六都在价格本上「记」一笔。

words.enDefinition: motor that converts thermal energy to mechanical work

examples.en: The ferry's engine starts before the captain finishes his tea.
examples.zh: 船长茶还没喝完，渡轮「引擎」就启动了。

examples.en: Grandpa listens to the engine the way doctors listen to hearts.
examples.zh: 外公听「发动机」像医生听心跳一样认真。

words.enDefinition: piece of furniture resembling a cupboard with doors and shelves and drawers; for storage or display

examples.en: The corner kitchen cabinet stores pickles and one suspicious teapot.
examples.zh: 街角的「橱柜」存着腌菜和一把可疑的茶壶。

examples.en: Grandpa built this whole kitchen cabinet long before marrying Grandma.
examples.zh: 厨房的「碗柜」是外公娶外婆前打的。

words.enDefinition: person responsible for the editorial aspects of publication; the person who determines the final content of a text (especially of a newspaper or magazine)

examples.en: The editor cut Grandpa's weather rhyme to one perfect line.
examples.zh: 「编辑」把外公的天气谚语精简成了绝妙的一行。

examples.en: As editor of the lane newsletter, Grandma accepts dumplings as payment.
examples.zh: 身为巷子通讯刊的「主编」，外婆收饺子当稿费。

words.enDefinition: like better; value more highly

examples.en: Grandpa prefers the aisle seat for legroom and escape routes.
examples.zh: 外公「偏好」靠过道的座位，理由是腿脚空间和逃生路线。

examples.en: The cat prefers the scale to any cushion we buy.
examples.zh: 无论我们买什么垫子，猫都「更喜欢」那杆秤。

words.enDefinition: to an extreme degree

examples.en: The soup cooled extremely fast once Grandma finally stopped stirring.
examples.zh: 外婆一停搅动，汤「极快」地凉了下去。

examples.en: Grandpa finds the biweekly chess rematch extremely important, as expected.
examples.zh: 外公觉得两周一次的象棋复赛「极其」重要。

words.enDefinition: relatively low in price or charging low prices

examples.en: The cheap umbrella folded at the first really strong gust.
examples.zh: 那把「便宜」雨伞在第一阵真正的狂风里报销了。

examples.en: Grandpa's cheap handmade noodles beat the mall food court easily.
examples.zh: 外公的「廉价」面轻轻松松胜过商场美食广场。

words.enDefinition: to utter intentions of injury or punishment against:"He threatened me when I tried to call the police"

examples.en: Grandpa threatens to audit every queue, and the queue behaves.
examples.zh: 外公「扬言」要整顿所有队伍，队伍果然乖了。

examples.en: The cat threatens the goldfish daily; the glass holds firm.
examples.zh: 猫每天「恐吓」金鱼；玻璃坚守阵地。

words.zhGloss: 把…送进（医院、监狱等机构）
words.enDefinition: cause to be admitted; of persons to an institution
acceptedZhAnswers: 把…送进（医院、监狱等机构）

examples.en: The magistrate committed him to a treatment programme, not a cell.
examples.zh: 法官把他「送进」的是治疗项目，不是牢房。

examples.en: They committed their uncle to the seaside clinic for a month.
examples.zh: 他们把叔叔「送进」海滨疗养院，为期一个月。

words.enDefinition: any monetary aid

examples.en: The research grant paid for one microscope and forty kilos of rice.
examples.zh: 那笔研究「拨款」买了一台显微镜和四十公斤大米。

examples.en: Grandpa's garden grant arrived with too many forms and one smile.
examples.zh: 外公的花园「补助金」到账时表格繁多，笑容只有一个。

words.enDefinition: an animal that produces gametes (ova) that can be fertilized by male gametes (spermatozoa)

examples.en: The vet gently confirmed the new kitten is a female.
examples.zh: 兽医确认新来的小猫是「雌性」。

examples.en: The henhouse's only female duck runs the entire farmyard, strictly.
examples.zh: 鸡舍里唯一的「母」鸭掌管整个院子。

words.enDefinition: the time of life between childhood and maturity

examples.en: In his youth, Grandpa cycled across two counties for noodles.
examples.zh: 「年轻时」，外公为了一碗面骑车穿过两个县。

examples.en: The youth of this lane invented three games and one soup.
examples.zh: 这条巷子的「年轻人」发明了三种游戏和一种汤。

words.enDefinition: being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird

examples.en: A strange van circled the market until the cat followed it home.
examples.zh: 一辆「陌生的」面包车绕着市场打转，直到猫跟回了家。

examples.en: Grandpa finds the new dumpling filling strange but eats three.
examples.zh: 外公觉得新饺子馅「怪怪的」，但吃了三个。

words.enDefinition: an event that repeats

examples.en: The comedy was a repeat, but we laughed at the same lines.
examples.zh: 那是「重播」，我们却在同样的台词处笑出声。

examples.en: Grandpa's stories repeat nightly, with a slightly bigger fish added each time.
examples.zh: 外公的故事每晚都「重复」，只是鱼会变大。

words.enDefinition: having a large distance from side to side; wide

examples.en: The river is broad enough to hide four bridges and one ferry.
examples.zh: 这条河「宽」得能藏下四座桥和一艘渡轮。

examples.en: Grandpa makes sweeping broad claims about noodles and narrow exceptions.
examples.zh: 外公对面条下的「宽泛」论断总带着狭窄的例外。

words.enDefinition: extraordinarily good or great; used especially as intensifiers

examples.en: The little community garden turned out wonderful, despite the nettles.
examples.zh: 社区花园弄出来「棒极了」，荨麻除外。

examples.en: Grandpa called the new dumpling skin wonderful, twice, out loud.
examples.zh: 外公大声说了两遍新饺子皮「妙极了」。

words.enDefinition: very good; of the highest quality

examples.en: The stall's spicy tofu won an excellent mention from the council.
examples.zh: 摊位的辣豆腐赢得了委员会「极佳」的评价。

examples.en: Grandpa grades noodles excellent only when the queue is quiet.
examples.zh: 只有在队伍安静时，外公才给面条打「优」。

words.enDefinition: do away with, cause the destruction or undoing of

examples.en: The termites nearly destroyed the bench before the cat confessed.
examples.zh: 白蚁差点「毁掉」长凳，直到猫招供。

examples.en: Grandpa destroyed the puzzle record and his only afternoon off.
examples.zh: 外公「粉碎」了拼图纪录，也搭上了唯一的假日午后。

words.enDefinition: any of various games played with a ball (round or oval) in which two teams try to kick or carry or propel the ball into each other's goal

examples.en: The lane's weekend football match ends when the streetlights win.
examples.zh: 巷里的「足球赛」打到路灯获胜为止。

examples.en: Grandpa coaches lane football strictly from the bench, with tea.
examples.zh: 外公执教「足球」严格限于板凳席，外加一杯茶。

words.enDefinition: wrong action attributable to bad judgment or ignorance or inattention

examples.en: One small mistake gave the chess game to the parrot.
examples.zh: 一个小「失误」把棋局送给了鹦鹉。

examples.en: Grandpa calls his famous wrong turn a scenic mistake, officially.
examples.zh: 外公把走错的路官方定义为「美丽的错误」。

words.enDefinition: structure that allows people or vehicles to cross an obstacle such as a river or canal or railway etc.

examples.en: The old stone bridge holds two generations of carved initials.
examples.zh: 石「桥」上刻着两代人的名字缩写。

examples.en: Grandpa fishes under the bridge when the sun gets rude.
examples.zh: 太阳太晒时，外公就转移到「桥」下钓鱼。

words.enDefinition: characterized by an absence or near absence of agitation or activity

examples.en: The quiet of the lane ends the moment the market opens.
examples.zh: 市场一开门，巷子的「安静」就到头了。

examples.en: Grandpa enjoys the quiet of dawn with one kettle and no phone.
examples.zh: 外公享受清晨的「宁静」，一壶水，不接电话。

words.enDefinition: outward or visible aspect of a person or thing

examples.en: Don't judge the café by its appearance; the noodles argue otherwise.
examples.zh: 别以「外表」评判这家咖啡馆；面条会提出异议。

examples.en: The whole stall's appearance changed completely after Grandma's banner arrived.
examples.zh: 外婆的横幅挂上后，摊位的「门面」变了样。

words.enDefinition: one-piece garment for a woman; has skirt and bodice

examples.en: She wore a blue linen dress to the lantern judging.
examples.zh: 她穿了条蓝色亚麻「连衣裙」去参加灯会评审。

examples.en: Grandma sewed a whole summer dress from two good curtains.
examples.zh: 外婆用两块好窗帘布缝了条夏「裙」。

words.enDefinition: verbal commitment by one person to another agreeing to do (or not to do) something in the future

examples.en: Grandpa made a promise to the cat about sardine Fridays.
examples.zh: 外公向猫许下了周五沙丁鱼的「诺言」。

examples.en: The stall's written promise is simple: cold noodles, warm welcome.
examples.zh: 摊位的「承诺」很简单：面凉，人情热。

words.enDefinition: meeting for execution of a group's functions

examples.en: The gym offers a free trial session for new members.
examples.zh: 健身房为新会员提供一次免费「体验课」。

examples.en: Grandpa attended every single session of the three-day pickle masterclass.
examples.zh: 腌菜大师课的每一「讲」，外公都出席了。

words.enDefinition: advancing in amount or intensity

examples.en: The whole lane is increasingly fond of Friday dumpling nights.
examples.zh: 巷子里的人「越来越」喜欢周五饺子夜。

examples.en: Grandpa's late chess style is increasingly defensive and entirely undefeated.
examples.zh: 外公的棋风「日益」保守，且保持不败。

words.enDefinition: involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm

examples.en: The wet stairs are dangerous after the fish truck passes.
examples.zh: 运鱼车过后，湿楼梯很「危险」。

examples.en: Grandpa calls the cat's pyjama hour dangerous to afternoon naps.
examples.zh: 外公说猫的睡衣时段对午后补觉构成「威胁」。

words.enDefinition: marked by suitability or rightness or appropriateness

examples.en: There's a proper way to fold dumplings, and the cat knows it.
examples.zh: 包饺子有「正经的」手法，猫都懂。

examples.en: Grandpa insists on proper hot tea before any serious chess.
examples.zh: 外公坚持正事之前先喝「像样的」茶。

words.enDefinition: widely known and esteemed

examples.en: The noodle master is famous at least two counties over.
examples.zh: 这位面师傅的「名气」传到了邻县。

examples.en: Grandpa is famous in the lane for arguing with weather apps.
examples.zh: 外公因与天气应用「抬杠」而在巷内「出名」。

words.enDefinition: successful ending of a struggle or contest

examples.en: Victory tasted exactly like cold noodles after the chess marathon.
examples.zh: 棋赛马拉松后，「胜利」的滋味是凉面味的。

examples.en: Grandpa claims victory in every argument by simply outlasting it.
examples.zh: 外公赢下每场争论的「秘诀」只是熬得久。

words.enDefinition: building where theatrical performances or motion-picture shows can be presented

examples.en: The old theatre shows teahouse operas every second Saturday evening.
examples.zh: 老「戏院」每隔一个周六演一场戏。

examples.en: Grandpa regards the theatre bench as his personal box seat.
examples.zh: 外公把「戏院」长凳当成自己的专属包厢。

words.enDefinition: male member of a royal family other than the sovereign (especially the son of a sovereign)

examples.en: The storybook prince rescues the stolen dumplings, not the princess.
examples.zh: 故事书里的「王子」救的是饺子，不是公主。

examples.en: Grandpa played the prince in the lane's lantern play, once.
examples.zh: 外公在巷子的灯会小戏里演过一次「王子」。

words.enDefinition: person who represents others

examples.en: Our stall's representative at the council is the cat, technically.
examples.zh: 严格来说，代表我们摊位出席委员会的「代表」是那只猫。

examples.en: Grandpa has acted as unofficial representative for every queue-related complaint.
examples.zh: 所有排队相关的投诉都由外公当「代表」去交涉。

words.enDefinition: occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure

examples.en: The usual breakfast queue starts forming by half past seven.
examples.zh: 「惯常的」队伍七点半就开始排了。

examples.en: Grandpa always orders the usual: two dumplings, one long argument.
examples.zh: 外公照「老规矩」点单：两个饺子，外加一场漫长的争论。

words.enDefinition: (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point

examples.en: In one respect, renting beats owning: the roof is not your problem.
examples.zh: 在一个「方面」，租房胜过买房：屋顶漏水不归你管。

examples.en: The plan fails in every single respect except the dumplings.
examples.zh: 这计划除了饺子一环，在每个「方面」都失败了。

words.enDefinition: direct toward itself or oneself by means of some psychological power or physical attributes

examples.en: The lantern festival attracts curious visitors from three surrounding counties.
examples.zh: 灯会「吸引」了三个县的游客。

examples.en: Grandpa attracts unwanted advice the way spilled honey attracts bees.
examples.zh: 外公「招来」建议的架势，像蜂蜜招蜜蜂。

words.enDefinition: representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material

examples.en: The old faded photograph shows the market before the awnings.
examples.zh: 老「照片」里是还没搭雨棚的市场。

examples.en: Grandpa carries one photograph of the ferry in his wallet, laminated.
examples.zh: 外公钱包里护膜层压着一张渡轮的「照片」。

words.enDefinition: being in accord with established forms and conventions and requirements (as e.g. of formal dress)

examples.en: The dress code is formal only for the lantern judges.
examples.zh: 只有灯会评委需要着「正式」装。

examples.en: Grandpa owns one formal shirt, reserved for weddings and audits.
examples.zh: 外公只有一件「正式」衬衫，婚礼和查账专用。

words.enDefinition: happening or done every day

examples.en: A daily walk to the market keeps my knees honest.
examples.zh: 「每天」步行去市场让我的膝盖保持诚实。

examples.en: Grandpa's sacred daily routine is market, chess, nap, no exceptions.
examples.zh: 外公的「每日」流程：赶集、下棋、午睡，概不例外。

words.enDefinition: a person or thing rejected as below standard

examples.en: Quality control set aside every reject from the morning batch.
examples.zh: 质检把早上那批里的所有「不合格品」挑了出来。

examples.en: Grandpa rescues the bakery's rejects; they taste identical to him.
examples.zh: 外公专门收面包房的「落选品」；在他嘴里味道一样。

words.enDefinition: (anatomy) the point of connection between two bones or elements of a skeleton (especially if it allows motion)

examples.en: Grandpa's creaky knee joint forecasts rain better than the app.
examples.zh: 外公的膝「关节」预报下雨比应用还准。

examples.en: The joint between the two stalls is the gossip border.
examples.zh: 两个摊位的「交界处」是八卦分界线。

words.enDefinition: the activity of looking thoroughly in order to find something or someone

examples.en: The search for the lost cat ended at the fish stall.
examples.zh: 寻找走失那只猫的「搜寻」行动，在鱼摊收尾。

examples.en: Grandpa joined the search for the missing umbrella, and won.
examples.zh: 外公加入了寻找失踪雨伞的「搜寻」，并获胜。

words.enDefinition: colloquial expression for invitation

examples.en: We invite the whole lane to the dumpling tasting, twice.
examples.zh: 我们「邀请」全巷的人来品鉴饺子，办两场。

examples.en: Grandpa politely declines to invite the weather to any picnic.
examples.zh: 外公拒绝「邀请」天气参加任何野餐。

words.enDefinition: a person from the eastern part of a country or region

examples.en: Grandma, a lifelong eastern, still rises with the harbour sun.
examples.zh: 外婆是土生土长的「东方人」，仍随海港的日出而起。

examples.en: The stall's only eastern makes pickles the way his mother did.
examples.zh: 摊位上唯一的「东部人」腌菜仍按他母亲的老法子。

words.enDefinition: ellipse in which the two axes are of equal length; a plane curve generated by one point moving at a constant distance from a fixed point

examples.en: The kids drew a circle around the puddle and defended it.
examples.zh: 孩子们在水洼周围画了个「圆圈」并誓死捍卫。

examples.en: Grandpa plants the herbs in one perfect circle by the door.
examples.zh: 外公把香草沿着门口种成一个完美的「圆」。

words.enDefinition: the lower side of anything

examples.en: Grandpa taped the receipt to the bottom of the scale drawer.
examples.zh: 外公把收据贴在了秤柜的「底部」。

examples.en: The boat's hull bottom needed paint after the shallow detour.
examples.zh: 绕浅滩之后，船「底」需要补漆了。

words.enDefinition: free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances

examples.en: The whole kitchen sparkled, clean before the health inspector's flashlight.
examples.zh: 厨房锃亮，「干干净净」地迎接卫生检查员的手电筒。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps the stall spotlessly clean by judging himself first.
examples.zh: 外公保持摊位「整洁」的方法是先检讨自己。

words.enDefinition: the commercial activity of providing funds and capital

examples.en: She studies finance and dreams of fixing the market's accounts.
examples.zh: 她学的是「金融」，梦想理清市场的账目。

examples.en: Grandpa handles the lane's festival finance with one tin box.
examples.zh: 外公用一个铁盒管着巷子节庆的「财务」。

words.enDefinition: compel to behave in a certain way

examples.en: Grandpa always refuses to impose his noodle opinions on guests.
examples.zh: 外公拒绝把自己的面条观点「强加」给客人。

examples.en: The landlord tried to impose strict new parking rules overnight.
examples.zh: 房东试图一夜之间「强推」新的停车规定。

words.enDefinition: state emphatically and authoritatively

examples.en: The mayor declared the rainy market festival open, umbrellas raised.
examples.zh: 镇长「宣布」市场节开幕，雨伞齐刷刷举起。

examples.en: Grandpa declared the soup finished before tasting it, as tradition demands.
examples.zh: 按惯例，外公先「宣告」汤成，再开始品尝。

words.enDefinition: cruel or violent treatment; also the wrongful use of something

examples.en: The report flagged rising drug abuse among the harbour youth.
examples.zh: 报告指出港口青少年中存在「吸毒」问题。

examples.en: Grandpa calls the overtime scales a clear abuse of power.
examples.zh: 外公称加班使用的秤是对权力的明显「滥用」。

words.enDefinition: to separate into parts, groups, or shares

examples.en: Divide the steamed dumplings evenly or face the aunties' tribunal.
examples.zh: 把饺子「分」均匀，否则要面对姨妈法庭。

examples.en: Grandpa divides the profits in chalk, on the stall door.
examples.zh: 外公在摊位门上用粉笔「分账」。

words.enDefinition: the state of being welcome

examples.en: The lane gave us a warm welcome and warmer dumplings.
examples.zh: 巷子给了我们热情的「欢迎」，和更热乎的饺子。

examples.en: The kind ferry crew warmly welcomed the stranded cyclist aboard.
examples.zh: 渡轮船员「欢迎」被困的骑行者上船。

words.enDefinition: a person or thing with the same ability, status, or value as another

examples.en: At the chess table, Grandpa insists his cat has no equal.
examples.zh: 外公坚称他的猫在下棋上没有「对手」。

examples.en: Grandma treats every customer as an equal, especially the loud ones.
examples.zh: 外婆把每位顾客当「平等的人」对待，尤其是嗓门大的。

words.enDefinition: the feeling that accompanies an unsatisfied state

examples.en: Grandpa's one desire is a stool by the river at dawn.
examples.zh: 外公唯一的「心愿」是清晨河边的一条凳。

examples.en: The cat's burning desire for sardines borders on public policy.
examples.zh: 猫对沙丁鱼的「渴望」近乎一项基本国策。

words.enDefinition: substance used as a coating to protect or decorate a surface (especially a mixture of pigment suspended in a liquid); dries to form a hard coating

examples.en: Grandpa mixed the paint to match the door's memory, not its colour.
examples.zh: 外公调的「油漆」匹配的是门的记忆，不是门的颜色。

examples.en: One coat of paint hid forty years of weather reports.
examples.zh: 一层「漆」遮住了四十年的风霜记录。

words.enDefinition: covering or including everything

examples.en: The overall cost of the trip came to two umbrellas and a fish.
examples.zh: 这趟旅行的「总」开销是两把伞外加一条鱼。

examples.en: Grandpa's overall impression of the mall: cold air, warm prices.
examples.zh: 外公对商场的「总体」印象：冷气足，价格更热。

words.enDefinition: commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)

examples.en: Always check the ticket before the ferry leaves, not after.
examples.zh: 渡轮开走前，先核对「船票」。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps every old cinema ticket in a noodle tin.
examples.zh: 外公把每张电影「票」都收在一只面罐里。

words.enDefinition: right; free from mistakes

examples.en: Three answers were somehow correct on my first driving attempt.
examples.zh: 我第一次考驾照就「答对」了三题。

examples.en: Grandpa insists the correct dumpling count is always one more.
examples.zh: 外公坚称「正确」的饺子数量永远是再加一个。

words.enDefinition: glass or plastic vessel used for storing drinks or other liquids; typically cylindrical without handles and with a narrow neck that can be plugged or capped

examples.en: The bottle of plum syrup survived three moves and one cat.
examples.zh: 那瓶酸梅「糖浆」挺过了三次搬家和一只猫。

examples.en: Return the empty bottle to the stall for two cents back.
examples.zh: 把空「瓶」还给摊位能退两分钱。

words.enDefinition: disapproval expressed by pointing out faults or shortcomings

examples.en: Grandpa accepted the criticism of his chess opening with tea.
examples.zh: 外公就着茶接受了对自己开局「批评」。

examples.en: The lane's harshest food critic gives criticism only between mouthfuls.
examples.zh: 巷里最严的评论家只在进食间隙发表「批评」。

words.enDefinition: poker hand with 5 consecutive cards (regardless of suit)

examples.en: With five cards in sequence, Dad laid down a straight and swept the chips.
examples.zh: 五张连牌，爸爸亮出「顺子」，扫走了全部筹码。

examples.en: Grandpa folds a winning straight too early, every single game.
examples.zh: 外公每局都过早弃掉一手「顺子」。

words.enDefinition: extend on all sides of simultaneously; encircle

examples.en: The stall's rich smells surround the entire lane by nine.
examples.zh: 九点前，摊位的香气已「包围」整条巷子。

examples.en: Grandpa ceremonially surrounds his soup bowl with exactly three pickles.
examples.zh: 外公的汤「四周」精确环绕三碟腌菜。

words.enDefinition: the atmospheric conditions that comprise the state of the atmosphere in terms of temperature and wind and clouds and precipitation

examples.en: The weather turned unexpectedly kind the moment the ferry docked.
examples.zh: 渡轮靠岸那一刻，「天气」转好了。

examples.en: Grandpa predicts the evening weather from the cat's nap angle.
examples.zh: 外公凭猫打盹的角度预测「天气」。

words.enDefinition: path over which electrical signals can pass

examples.en: Switch the router to a less crowded channel before the film.
examples.zh: 放电影前，把路由器调到不那么拥挤的「信道」。

examples.en: Grandpa's favourite channel is the opera one, always channel three.
examples.zh: 外公最爱的「频道」永远是三台的戏曲。

words.enDefinition: any materials unused and rejected as worthless or unwanted

examples.en: Sort the garden waste into the green bin, not the lane.
examples.zh: 园子的「废弃物」要丢进绿桶，不许丢巷子里。

examples.en: Grandpa turns all kitchen waste into compost for the balcony.
examples.zh: 外公把厨余「垃圾」做成阳台花肥。

words.enDefinition: an association organized to promote art or science or education

examples.en: She joined a local science institute that funds research by young students.
examples.zh: 她加入了一家资助年轻学生做研究的科学「学会」。

examples.en: The city's history institute will open its archives to the public next month.
examples.zh: 这家历史「学会」下个月将向公众开放馆藏档案。

words.enDefinition: group of people who differ racially or politically from a larger group of which it is a part

examples.en: The city offers free evening classes to support minority families downtown.
examples.zh: 该市为市中心的「少数群体」家庭提供免费夜校课程。

examples.en: As a minority in the committee, our ideas rarely win enough votes.
examples.zh: 作为委员会里的「少数派」，我们的想法很少能拿到足够的票数。

words.enDefinition: has little chance of being the case or coming about

examples.en: The bakery rarely has croissants left by noon, and today is unlikely to be different.
examples.zh: 面包店到中午很少剩下牛角包，今天也「不太可能」例外。

examples.en: Heavy rain makes a picnic in the park unlikely this weekend.
examples.zh: 大雨让这周末在公园野餐变得「不太可能」。

words.enDefinition: an amount that is twice as great as another; a drink or portion made twice the usual size

examples.en: My rent this year is almost double what I paid three years ago.
examples.zh: 我今年的房租几乎是三年前的「两倍」。

examples.en: He ordered a double at the cafe because he had to study all night.
examples.zh: 他在咖啡店点了杯「双份」，因为要熬夜复习。

words.enDefinition: cause to be structured or ordered or operating according to some principle or idea

examples.en: The students organized a car wash to raise money for their team trip.
examples.zh: 学生们「组织」了一场洗车义卖，为团队旅行筹钱。

examples.en: She spent the whole Sunday afternoon organizing her closet into labeled boxes.
examples.zh: 她花了整个周日下午把衣柜「整理」成贴好标签的几个箱子。

words.enDefinition: someone who shows the way by leading or advising

examples.en: Our guide in Kyoto knew every hidden alley near the old temples.
examples.zh: 我们在京都的「导游」熟知古寺附近每一条隐秘小巷。

examples.en: An experienced mountain guide checked our ropes twice before the climb.
examples.zh: 一位经验丰富的登山「向导」在攀登前把我们的绳索检查了两遍。

words.enDefinition: an extended fictional work in prose; usually in the form of a story

examples.en: She finished the mystery novel in two late nights last week.
examples.zh: 上周她熬了两个深夜，读完了那本悬疑「小说」。

examples.en: My grandfather wrote a short novel about his childhood on a farm.
examples.zh: 祖父写了一部关于农场童年的中篇「小说」。

words.enDefinition: feeling safe and confident, without fear or worry

examples.en: A steady paycheck made him feel secure enough to rent his own flat.
examples.zh: 稳定的收入让他足够「安心」，敢于租下自己的公寓。

examples.en: The baby sleeps more soundly when she feels secure in her mother's arms.
examples.zh: 宝宝在妈妈怀里感到「安心」时，睡得格外沉。

words.enDefinition: an energetic attempt to achieve something

examples.en: Her long struggle with the illness taught the whole family patience.
examples.zh: 她与疾病的长期「抗争」教会了全家人耐心。

examples.en: The rescue team's struggle through the snowstorm lasted nearly six hours.
examples.zh: 救援队在暴风雪中「苦苦挣扎」，走了近六个小时。

words.enDefinition: an artistic form of nonverbal communication

examples.en: The wedding ended with everyone joining a traditional folk dance.
examples.zh: 婚礼最后，大家一同跳起了一段民族「舞蹈」。

examples.en: Her modern dance piece brought the whole audience to its feet.
examples.zh: 她的现代「舞」让全场观众都起立鼓掌。

words.enDefinition: the person in command of a ship or aircraft

examples.en: The captain announced that we would reach the harbor before sunset.
examples.zh: 「船长」广播说我们能在日落前抵达港口。

examples.en: Our boat captain slowed the engine whenever dolphins appeared beside us.
examples.zh: 每当海豚出现在船边，我们的「船长」都会放慢引擎。

words.enDefinition: something intended to communicate a particular impression

examples.en: The library's holiday display of paper lanterns drew a large crowd.
examples.zh: 图书馆的节日纸灯「陈列」吸引了大批读者。

examples.en: The harbor's New Year firework display lasted nearly twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 港口的新年烟花「表演」持续了将近二十分钟。

words.enDefinition: the act of escaping physically

examples.en: The rabbit made a quick escape the moment the gate swung open.
examples.zh: 栅栏门一晃开，兔子就趁机「逃脱」了。

examples.en: Firefighters showed every hotel guest the escape route to the stairwell.
examples.zh: 消防员向酒店每位住客展示了通往楼梯间的「逃生」路线。

words.enDefinition: investigate scientifically

examples.en: The police investigated the strange noises reported behind the supermarket.
examples.zh: 警方「调查」了有人报警称超市后巷传出的怪声。

examples.en: Mom investigated the burnt smell drifting out of the kitchen.
examples.zh: 妈妈进厨房「查」了查那股焦糊味是从哪儿来的。

words.enDefinition: not either; not one or the other

examples.en: My brother doesn't like spicy food, and neither do I.
examples.zh: 我哥哥不吃辣，我「也」不吃。

examples.en: The first bus didn't stop, and neither did the second.
examples.zh: 第一班车没停，第二班「也」没停。

words.enDefinition: narrow strait connecting two bodies of water

examples.en: The kayak barely squeezed through the narrow between the two islands.
examples.zh: 皮划艇勉强挤过两座岛屿之间的「狭窄水道」。

examples.en: In the old wall there is a narrow where only one cart fits.
examples.zh: 老城墙上有一处「狭窄通道」，仅容一辆马车通过。

words.enDefinition: mental or emotional strain caused by difficult or demanding circumstances

examples.en: Final exams put a lot of stress on students living in the dorms.
examples.zh: 期末考试给住在宿舍的学生带来了很大「压力」。

examples.en: Soft piano music helps me release stress after a long shift.
examples.zh: 漫长班次结束后，轻柔的钢琴曲帮我「释放压力」。

words.enDefinition: attain success or reach a desired goal

examples.en: After three failed attempts, she finally succeeded in fixing the bicycle chain.
examples.zh: 失败三次之后，她终于「成功」修好了自行车链条。

examples.en: If you keep practicing every evening, you will succeed eventually.
examples.zh: 只要你每晚坚持练习，总有一天会「成功」。

words.enDefinition: to protect someone or something from attack, criticism, or harm

examples.en: Mom defended my little brother when the neighbors blamed him for the broken window.
examples.zh: 邻居们把打碎窗户的事怪到弟弟头上时，妈妈站出来「维护」了他。

examples.en: The old seawall defended the fishing village from the autumn storm.
examples.zh: 这道老海堤在秋天的风暴中「保护」了渔村。

words.enDefinition: another possibility or choice that can be used instead

examples.en: Since the highway was blocked, we took the coast road as an alternative.
examples.zh: 高速公路被封后，我们改走沿海公路作为「替代路线」。

examples.en: If the medicine doesn't work, surgery may be the only alternative.
examples.zh: 如果药物不起作用，手术也许是唯一的「替代方案」。

words.enDefinition: give sanction to

examples.en: My parents approved of my decision to study art abroad.
examples.zh: 父母「赞同」我出国学艺术的决定。

examples.en: The manager approved my leave request within just an hour this morning.
examples.zh: 经理今天上午不到一小时就「批准」了我的请假申请。

words.enDefinition: exercising caution or showing care or attention

examples.en: Be careful with that hot pan, because the handle doesn't stay cool.
examples.zh: 端那口热锅时要「小心」，把手可不隔热。

examples.en: She is a careful driver who always checks her mirrors twice.
examples.zh: 她开车很「小心」，总会把后视镜看两遍。

words.enDefinition: leader engaged in civil administration

examples.en: The local politician visited our school to talk about recycling programs.
examples.zh: 那位本地「政治人物」来我们学校谈垃圾分类回收。

examples.en: My cousin wants to become a politician and improve the city's buses.
examples.zh: 我表哥想成为「政治家」，改善市里的公交车服务。

words.enDefinition: single distinct event

examples.en: The waiter handled the spilled soup incident with a smile and free dessert.
examples.zh: 对于打翻汤的「小插曲」，服务员微笑着送上了免费甜点。

examples.en: Police reviewed camera footage after last night's incident in the parking lot.
examples.zh: 昨晚停车场「事件」发生后，警方调取了监控录像。

words.enDefinition: the contestant who wins the contest

examples.en: Everyone cheered loudly when the winner crossed the finish line.
examples.zh: 「获胜者」冲过终点线时，大家都大声欢呼。

examples.en: The raffle winner chose the beach trip over the new laptop.
examples.zh: 抽奖「得主」选了海边旅行，放弃了新笔记本电脑。

words.enDefinition: a person elected to an office who has not yet taken it (used after a title, as in president-elect)

examples.en: The mayor-elect promised to repair every pothole downtown before summer.
examples.zh: 「当选市长」承诺入夏前把市中心的坑洼路都修好。

examples.en: Reporters kept calling the governor-elect's office for interviews all morning.
examples.zh: 记者们一上午都在给「州长当选人」的办公室打电话约采访。

words.enDefinition: reproach for some lapse or misdeed

examples.en: The dog knocked over the vase, but our cat took the blame.
examples.zh: 花瓶其实是狗碰倒的，却让猫「背了黑锅」。

examples.en: The manager accepted the blame for the missing dinner reservation.
examples.zh: 经理为弄丢的晚餐预订「承担了责任」。

words.enDefinition: an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth

examples.en: The mechanic gave us a rough estimate for the engine repair.
examples.zh: 修理工给了我们一份发动机维修的粗略「估价」。

examples.en: By my estimate, moving all these boxes will take three days.
examples.zh: 据我「估计」，搬完这些箱子要花三天。

words.enDefinition: (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon

examples.en: The patchwork quilt has a bright red square in every corner.
examples.zh: 拼布被子的每个角上都有一块鲜红的「正方形」。

examples.en: Draw a perfect square first, then divide it into four smaller ones.
examples.zh: 先画一个标准的「正方形」，再把它分成四个小的。

words.enDefinition: formal message requesting something that is submitted to an authority

examples.en: The library approved my request to extend the loan by two weeks.
examples.zh: 图书馆「同意」了我延长借期两周的请求。

examples.en: Song requests poured in as soon as the radio host came on air.
examples.zh: 电台主持人一开播，「点歌请求」就源源不断地涌进来。

words.enDefinition: to leave someone or something out of a group or statement

examples.en: The hotel may except small pets from its usual animal ban.
examples.zh: 这家酒店也许会把小型宠物「排除」在通常的禁宠令之外。

examples.en: The airline will except travelers with medical needs from the new baggage fee.
examples.zh: 航空公司会把有医疗需求的旅客「除外」，不收新增的行李费。

words.enDefinition: at the same time but in another place

examples.en: The pasta needs ten minutes; meanwhile, I will chop the garlic.
examples.zh: 意面要煮十分钟；「与此同时」，我来切蒜。

examples.en: Dad was still parking the car; meanwhile, we queued for ferry tickets.
examples.zh: 爸爸还在停车；「与此同时」，我们排着队买船票。

words.enDefinition: large and impressive in physical size or extent

examples.en: The wedding took place in a grand ballroom with crystal chandeliers.
examples.zh: 婚礼在一间挂着水晶吊灯的「华丽」宴会厅里举行。

examples.en: We stood amazed in front of the palace's grand entrance.
examples.zh: 我们站在宫殿「宏伟」的入口前，惊叹不已。

words.enDefinition: a popular style of clothing, hair, or behavior at a given time

examples.en: Wide-leg jeans have come back into fashion among college students.
examples.zh: 阔腿牛仔裤今年又在大学生中间「流行」起来。

examples.en: My sister follows every new fashion, from colors to hairstyles.
examples.zh: 从配色到发型，我妹妹追逐每一种新「时尚」。

words.enDefinition: the land along the edge of the sea or ocean

examples.en: We drove along the coast and stopped at every quiet beach.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「海岸」开车，每处安静的海滩都停下来看看。

examples.en: The whole coast was foggy this morning, so the ferry moved slowly.
examples.zh: 今早整段「海岸」都雾蒙蒙的，渡轮开得很慢。

words.enDefinition: express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness

examples.en: Guests complained about the noise from the construction site next door.
examples.zh: 客人们「抱怨」隔壁工地传来的噪音。

examples.en: He always complains about the weather but never carries an umbrella.
examples.zh: 他总是「抱怨」天气，却从不带伞。

words.enDefinition: a short written summary or set of instructions for a task or case

examples.en: The designer read the brief twice before sketching the new logo.
examples.zh: 动笔画新标志之前，设计师把那份「简报」读了两遍。

examples.en: Each student prepared a one-page brief on climate change for the debate.
examples.zh: 每个学生都为辩论准备了一页关于气候变化的「摘要」。

words.enDefinition: something that should remain hidden from others (especially information that is not to be passed on)

examples.en: The kids kept the surprise party a secret from Mom all week.
examples.zh: 整整一周，孩子们都把惊喜派对当作「秘密」瞒着妈妈。

examples.en: Grandma finally shared her secret for making the fluffiest pancakes.
examples.zh: 奶奶终于把做出最松软煎饼的「秘诀」告诉了我们。

words.enDefinition: forward movement or progress; also money paid before it is due

examples.en: She received an advance from the publisher for her first cookbook.
examples.zh: 她拿到了出版社为首本食谱书支付的「预付款」。

examples.en: Despite the storm, the rescue team made a steady advance up the slope.
examples.zh: 尽管风暴肆虐，救援队仍沿着山坡稳步「推进」。

words.enDefinition: bring an accusation against; level a charge against

examples.en: My sister accused me of eating the last slice of cake.
examples.zh: 妹妹「指责」我吃了最后一块蛋糕。

examples.en: Neighbors accused the old factory of polluting the small river nearby.
examples.zh: 邻居们「指控」那家老工厂污染了附近的小河。

words.enDefinition: machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion

examples.en: The old fan's motor hums loudly whenever it runs for an hour.
examples.zh: 旧风扇的「马达」一转满一小时就嗡嗡作响。

examples.en: Dad replaced the washing machine motor himself and saved a repair fee.
examples.zh: 爸爸自己换了洗衣机的「马达」，省下一笔修理费。

words.enDefinition: quantity that does not vary

examples.en: In physics class, gravity is treated as a fixed constant in every formula.
examples.zh: 物理课上，重力在所有公式里都被当作固定的「常数」。

examples.en: Our teacher said pi is the most famous constant in mathematics.
examples.zh: 老师说圆周率是数学里最著名的「常数」。

words.enDefinition: the idea of something that is perfect; something that one hopes to attain

examples.en: Moving to the countryside and keeping bees has always been her ideal.
examples.zh: 搬到乡下养蜜蜂一直是她的「理想」。

examples.en: He gave up a high salary to pursue his ideal of teaching.
examples.zh: 他放弃了高薪，去追求当老师的「理想」。

words.enDefinition: pull back or move away or backward

examples.en: Grandpa walked to the bank to withdraw cash for the weekend trip.
examples.zh: 爷爷步行去银行「提取」周末旅行要用的现金。

examples.en: The company withdrew its controversial ad after customers complained online.
examples.zh: 顾客在网上投诉后，公司「撤回」了那条有争议的广告。

words.enDefinition: intensely or extremely bad or unpleasant in degree or quality

examples.en: The severe storm knocked down trees across the whole neighborhood.
examples.zh: 这场「猛烈」的暴风雨刮倒了整个街区的许多树木。

examples.en: Grandpa felt severe chest pain, so we called the doctor at once.
examples.zh: 爷爷胸口「剧烈」疼痛，我们立刻请了医生。

words.enDefinition: causing fear or dread or terror

examples.en: The traffic was terrible this morning, so I missed my first class.
examples.zh: 今天早上交通「糟透了」，所以我误了第一节课。

examples.en: The horror movie had one terrible scene that made everyone scream.
examples.zh: 那部恐怖片里有个「可怕」的场景，把所有人都吓得尖叫。

words.enDefinition: person who is confined; especially a prisoner of war

examples.en: In the story, the prisoner dug a tunnel over three long years.
examples.zh: 故事里，那名「囚犯」花了整整三年挖出一条地道。

examples.en: Guards counted the prisoners twice before locking the yard for the night.
examples.zh: 狱警在夜里锁院子前把「囚犯」们清点了两遍。

words.enDefinition: someone who has committed a crime or has been legally convicted of a crime

examples.en: The detective studied the blurry photo carefully to identify the criminal.
examples.zh: 侦探仔细研究那张模糊的照片，来确认「罪犯」的身份。

examples.en: My cousin watches crime shows and always guesses the criminal first.
examples.zh: 我表哥看罪案剧时总是最先猜出「罪犯」。

words.enDefinition: live (in a certain place)

examples.en: The new bakery occupies the corner shop where the post office used to be.
examples.zh: 新面包店「占据」了原来邮局所在的街角小店。

examples.en: Homework and piano lessons occupy most of my weekday evenings.
examples.zh: 作业和钢琴课「占」去了我工作日晚上大部分时间。

words.enDefinition: a violent collision or impact; also a sudden unpleasant surprise or an electric discharge

examples.en: The shock of the explosion shattered windows three streets away.
examples.zh: 爆炸的「冲击」震碎了三条街外的玻璃窗。

examples.en: Grandma got a small shock when she touched the old heater.
examples.zh: 奶奶碰到旧取暖器时被轻微「电」了一下。

words.enDefinition: change toward something smaller or lower

examples.en: The village has seen a steady decline in young residents since the mill closed.
examples.zh: 磨坊关闭后，村里的年轻居民持续「减少」。

examples.en: Doctors noticed a slow decline in his hearing after the concert.
examples.zh: 音乐会后，医生发现他的听力慢慢「衰退」。

words.enDefinition: the sensation that results when taste buds in the tongue and throat convey information about the chemical composition of a soluble stimulus

examples.en: One sip of grandma's soup brought back the taste of childhood.
examples.zh: 一口奶奶做的汤，唤回了童年的「味道」。

examples.en: This lemon cake has a sharp taste that wakes up your mouth.
examples.zh: 这款柠檬蛋糕有种尖锐的「味道」，一下子唤醒了味蕾。

words.enDefinition: musical notation indicating one half step higher than the note named

examples.en: The pianist mistakenly played every F as a sharp in the second verse.
examples.zh: 弹到第二段时，钢琴家误把每个 F 都弹成了「升音」。

examples.en: Our music teacher drew a sharp in front of the note on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 音乐老师在白板上那个音符前面画了一个「升记号」。

words.enDefinition: be in control

examples.en: The older boys dominate the basketball court every lunch break.
examples.zh: 每天午休，高年级男生总是「称霸」篮球场。

examples.en: One strong swimmer dominated the relay from the very first lap.
examples.zh: 从第一圈起，接力赛就被那位健将「主导」了。

words.enDefinition: something added; the process of adding numbers or items

examples.en: The new balcony is a lovely addition to our small flat.
examples.zh: 新阳台是我们这套小公寓里讨人喜欢的「新增部分」。

examples.en: In addition to the fruit, the gift box also holds a jar of honey.
examples.zh: 「除」水果「外」，礼盒里还装着一罐蜂蜜。

words.enDefinition: writer for newspapers and magazines

examples.en: The young journalist interviewed vendors at the night market for her column.
examples.zh: 那位年轻「记者」为专栏采访了夜市的小贩。

examples.en: A sports journalist waited outside the stadium for the coach's comments.
examples.zh: 一位体育「记者」在体育场外等着教练发表评论。

words.enDefinition: someone who is under suspicion

examples.en: The police questioned one suspect for hours about the missing bicycle.
examples.zh: 警方就失踪的自行车盘问了那名「嫌疑人」好几个小时。

examples.en: In the mystery novel, the quiet neighbor was the least likely suspect.
examples.zh: 在推理小说里，安静的邻居是最不可能的「嫌疑人」。

words.enDefinition: bar from attention or consideration

examples.en: The doctor quickly dismissed my fear that the cough was serious.
examples.zh: 医生很快「否定」了我担心咳嗽很严重的想法。

examples.en: The judge dismissed the case because the evidence was clearly incomplete.
examples.zh: 由于证据明显不足，法官「驳回」了这起案件。

words.enDefinition: suitable to or characteristic of drama

examples.en: The sky turned a dramatic orange just before the storm hit.
examples.zh: 暴风雨来临前，天空呈现出「戏剧性」的橙色。

examples.en: The final episode had a dramatic twist nobody in the family expected.
examples.zh: 大结局的「戏剧性」转折出乎全家人的意料。

words.enDefinition: something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery

examples.en: The spelling bee's first prize is a full set of encyclopedias.
examples.zh: 拼字比赛的头「奖」是一整套百科全书。

examples.en: Grandma won a small prize in the village lottery for the third time.
examples.zh: 奶奶第三次在村里的抽奖中得了个小「奖品」。

words.enDefinition: the act of taking someone into legal custody; the state of being detained by police

examples.en: The thief's arrest surprised neighbors who thought he was just a handyman.
examples.zh: 那名窃贼被「逮捕」时，邻居们很吃惊，本以为他只是个修理工。

examples.en: Reporters crowded the courthouse as soon as news of the arrest spread.
examples.zh: 「逮捕」的消息一传开，记者们就挤满了法院门口。

words.enDefinition: an ordered list of times at which things are planned to occur

examples.en: The train schedule on the wall helped us plan the whole day trip.
examples.zh: 墙上的火车「时刻表」帮我们计划了一整天的行程。

examples.en: Mom stuck the family schedule on the fridge so nobody misses practice.
examples.zh: 妈妈把全家的「日程表」贴在冰箱上，谁也不会错过训练。

words.enDefinition: the acquisition of something for payment

examples.en: Keep the receipt for every purchase so returns stay easy.
examples.zh: 每次「购买」都保留收据，退货就会很方便。

examples.en: My first big purchase after payday was a warm winter coat.
examples.zh: 发工资后，我的第一笔大「购物」是一件暖和的冬衣。

words.enDefinition: the text appearing in a book, newspaper, or other printed publication

examples.en: The small print at the bottom of the contract mentions a yearly fee.
examples.zh: 合同底部密密的「小字印刷」里提到一笔年费。

examples.en: Grandma prefers books with large print because reading glasses strain her eyes.
examples.zh: 奶奶偏爱「大字印刷」的书，因为戴老花镜看字很费眼。

words.enDefinition: formal and solemn declaration of objection

examples.en: Students held a peaceful protest against cutting the school sports budget.
examples.zh: 学生们举行和平「抗议」，反对削减学校的体育预算。

examples.en: Despite our protest, the landlord raised the parking fee again.
examples.zh: 尽管我们「抗议」，房东还是又上调了停车费。

words.enDefinition: commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country

examples.en: Tea is this island's most famous export to markets across Europe.
examples.zh: 茶叶是这座岛销往欧洲市场的最著名「出口商品」。

examples.en: Farmers packed the season's oranges, ready for export to neighboring countries.
examples.zh: 果农把本季的橙子装箱，准备「出口」到邻国。

words.enDefinition: day or period of time set aside for feasting and celebration

examples.en: Red lanterns gave the whole street a festival look before New Year.
examples.zh: 新年前，红灯笼让整条街都透着「节日」的气氛。

examples.en: Everyone wore festival clothes for the harvest celebration in the village.
examples.zh: 村里的丰收庆典上，大家都穿上了「节日的」盛装。

words.enDefinition: happening or moving very quickly; fast

examples.en: The city's rapid growth turned farmland into apartment blocks within a decade.
examples.zh: 城市的「迅速」扩张让农田在十年间变成了公寓楼。

examples.en: Her rapid recovery surprised the doctors after such a serious fall.
examples.zh: 摔得那么重，她却「迅速」康复，医生们都感到惊讶。

words.enDefinition: cloud of fine particles suspended in a gas

examples.en: Thin smoke drifted from the neighbor's chimney into our yard.
examples.zh: 淡淡的「烟」从邻居家的烟囱飘进了我们的院子。

examples.en: We saw smoke rising from the kitchen and rushed to check the pan.
examples.zh: 看见厨房冒「烟」，我们赶紧跑去查看锅子。

words.enDefinition: an informal word for a man or boy; an associate or companion

examples.en: That friendly fellow at the bus stop shares his umbrella every rainy day.
examples.zh: 公交站那个友善的「家伙」，一到雨天就与人共用雨伞。

examples.en: My grandfather still writes to an old fellow from his army days.
examples.zh: 祖父还和一位当兵时的老「伙伴」保持着书信往来。

words.enDefinition: an example or occurrence of something

examples.en: This delay is one more instance of the ferry running late in fog.
examples.zh: 这次延误又是渡轮在雾中晚点的又一个「例子」。

examples.en: In some instances, the bakery sells day-old bread at half price.
examples.zh: 在有些「情况」下，面包店会把隔天的面包半价出售。

words.enDefinition: something kept back or saved for future use or a special purpose

examples.en: Grandma keeps a reserve of canned food in case of heavy snow.
examples.zh: 奶奶储存了一批罐头「储备」，以防大雪封门。

examples.en: The camp's water reserve nearly ran dry during the hot week.
examples.zh: 炎热的那一周，营地的「储水」几乎见了底。

words.enDefinition: written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications

examples.en: The washing machine still has a two-year guarantee from the store.
examples.zh: 这台洗衣机还有商店提供的两年「保修」。

examples.en: The seller gave a written guarantee that the puppy had all its shots.
examples.zh: 卖家书面「保证」这只小狗已经打齐了疫苗。

words.enDefinition: a person or thing that one likes best or favors above all others

examples.en: Strawberry ice cream has been my favourite since primary school.
examples.zh: 草莓冰淇淋从小学起就是我的「最爱」。

examples.en: This old song remains the family's favourite at every birthday dinner.
examples.zh: 每逢生日聚餐，这首老歌仍是全家的「最爱」。

words.enDefinition: time during which some action is awaited

examples.en: A short delay at the station made us miss the first ferry.
examples.zh: 车站的小「延误」让我们错过了第一班渡轮。

examples.en: After a long delay, the repairman finally arrived with the right part.
examples.zh: 「耽搁」了很久之后，修理工终于带着合适的零件来了。

words.enDefinition: the form in which a text (especially a printed book) is published

examples.en: The library keeps every edition of the town newspaper since 1950.
examples.zh: 图书馆收藏着这家镇报自 1950 年以来的每一「版」。

examples.en: My pocket dictionary is a newer edition with clearer examples.
examples.zh: 我的袖珍词典是例句更清晰的新「版本」。

words.enDefinition: material produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules

examples.en: The lab class showed how a simple chemical turns purple cabbage juice red.
examples.zh: 实验课上我们看到一种简单的「化学药品」把紫甘蓝汁变红了。

examples.en: Farmers now use fewer chemicals to keep the stream water clean.
examples.zh: 为了保持溪水清洁，农民现在少用「化学品」了。

words.enDefinition: an unsuccessful ending to a struggle or contest

examples.en: The chess club's first defeat in two years surprised everyone at school.
examples.zh: 棋社两年来的首次「失利」让全校都感到意外。

examples.en: Even after the defeat, the team kept training every rainy evening.
examples.zh: 即便遭遇「失败」，球队仍坚持在雨天的傍晚训练。

words.enDefinition: extending the legs at right angles to the trunk (one in front and the other in back)

examples.en: The gymnast held a perfect split during her floor routine.
examples.zh: 体操选手在自由体操中完成了一个标准的「劈叉」。

examples.en: After months of stretching, Mia finally touched the floor in a full split.
examples.zh: 拉伸了几个月后，米娅终于能完全「劈叉」触地了。

words.enDefinition: creation of the highest excellence

examples.en: Sherlock Holmes is a classic that my whole family rereads every winter.
examples.zh: 《福尔摩斯》是全家每年冬天都会重读的「经典」。

examples.en: That old film is a real classic, still funny after fifty years.
examples.zh: 那部老电影是真正的「经典」，五十年后依然好笑。

words.enDefinition: farm building for housing horses or other livestock

examples.en: Every morning before school, Mia helps groom horses in the stable.
examples.zh: 上学前，米娅每天早上都会帮着在「马厩」里给马梳洗。

examples.en: The old wooden stable smells of hay and warm leather in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天，老木「马厩」里满是干草和暖皮革的味道。

words.enDefinition: female member of a royal family other than the queen (especially the daughter of a sovereign)

examples.en: At the school play, my little sister played a lost princess.
examples.zh: 校园剧里，我妹妹扮演了一位迷路的「公主」。

examples.en: The storybook tells how a brave princess rescued the village from the dragon.
examples.zh: 故事书讲述勇敢的「公主」如何从恶龙手中救下村庄。

words.enDefinition: the child of your aunt or uncle

examples.en: My cousin from Toronto is visiting us during the summer holidays.
examples.zh: 多伦多的「表哥」暑假会来我们家住。

examples.en: At the reunion, my cousins taught me a card game from their hometown.
examples.zh: 家庭聚会上，「表兄妹们」教了我一种他们家乡的纸牌游戏。

words.enDefinition: commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country

examples.en: The shop's best-selling import is the dark chocolate made in Belgium.
examples.zh: 这家店最畅销的「进口商品」是比利时产的黑巧克力。

examples.en: Rice is a major import for countries with little farmland.
examples.zh: 对耕地稀少的国家来说，大米是重要的「进口货」。

words.enDefinition: feeling of favorable regard

examples.en: Her kindness to new students earned her the favour of every teacher.
examples.zh: 她对新同学的友善让她赢得了每位老师的「好感」。

examples.en: The cafe's quiet corners are in favour with students before exams.
examples.zh: 考试前，咖啡馆安静的角落很受学生「青睐」。

words.enDefinition: serious accident (usually involving one or more vehicles)

examples.en: Nobody was hurt in the car crash at the snowy crossing last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚雪天路口的「车祸」中没有人受伤。

examples.en: The news showed photos of the plane crash near the mountain village.
examples.zh: 新闻展示了山村附近「坠机」事故的照片。

words.enDefinition: the contestant you hope to defeat

examples.en: Our school's biggest rival in the football league is Riverside High.
examples.zh: 足球联赛中我们学校最大的「对手」是河滨高中。

examples.en: The chess champion greeted her old rival with a warm handshake.
examples.zh: 国际象棋冠军与老「对手」热情握手致意。

words.enDefinition: an abrupt failure of function or complete physical exhaustion

examples.en: The bridge's collapse cut off the only road into the valley.
examples.zh: 大桥的「坍塌」切断了进入山谷的唯一公路。

examples.en: After the marathon, his collapse at the finish line worried the medics.
examples.zh: 马拉松结束后，他在终点的「虚脱倒地」让医护人员很担心。

words.enDefinition: occurring or done often at short intervals; happening repeatedly

examples.en: Our frequent visits to grandma's house always end with her dumplings.
examples.zh: 我们对奶奶家的「频繁」拜访，总以她包的饺子收场。

examples.en: The frequent bus service means you never wait long at this stop.
examples.zh: 公交班次「频繁」，在这个站等车从不用太久。

words.enDefinition: marked by strict and particular and complete accordance with fact

examples.en: Do you know the exact time the night market opens on Fridays?
examples.zh: 你知道夜市周五「确切」的开放时间吗？

examples.en: The map shows the exact spot where the old lighthouse stood.
examples.zh: 地图上标出了旧灯塔所在「确切」的位置。

words.enDefinition: an investigation of the component parts of a whole and their relations in making up the whole

examples.en: After a careful analysis of her diet, the coach suggested more protein.
examples.zh: 仔细「分析」了她的饮食后，教练建议多补充蛋白质。

examples.en: Grandma's analysis of the neighbors' quarrel turned out to be right.
examples.zh: 奶奶对邻居吵架原因的「分析」结果证明是对的。

words.enDefinition: give an account of

examples.en: Grandpa loves to relate stories of his voyage around the cape.
examples.zh: 祖父喜欢「讲」他绕过好望角航行的故事。

examples.en: The witness agreed to relate the events of that rainy evening.
examples.zh: 证人同意「讲述」那个雨夜发生的事情。

words.enDefinition: indicating exactness or preciseness

examples.en: Please arrive at eight exactly, because the ferry leaves without waiting.
examples.zh: 请「正好」八点到，渡轮可不等人。

examples.en: That's exactly what Mom said when I broke the old vase.
examples.zh: 我打碎旧花瓶时，妈妈「正是」这么说的。

words.enDefinition: examine and note the similarities or differences of

examples.en: Before buying a phone, compare prices at three different shops.
examples.zh: 买手机前，先在三家店「比较」一下价格。

examples.en: My little brother loves to compare his toy cars by speed.
examples.zh: 弟弟喜欢按速度「比较」他的玩具小车。

words.enDefinition: come into possession of

examples.en: You must obtain permission before hanging posters in the hallway.
examples.zh: 在走廊贴海报之前，你必须先「获得」许可。

examples.en: Students can obtain a free copy of the guide from the front desk.
examples.zh: 学生可以在前台「取得」免费的指南副本。

words.enDefinition: characterized by unity; being or joined into a single entity

examples.en: The united efforts of the neighbors cleaned the beach in one morning.
examples.zh: 邻居们「齐心协力」，一个上午就把海滩清理干净了。

examples.en: A united class presentation impressed everyone at the science fair.
examples.zh: 全班「齐心」完成的展示在科学展上让所有人赞叹。

words.enDefinition: particular course of action intended to achieve a result

examples.en: The nurse explained the check-in procedure to every new patient.
examples.zh: 护士向每位新病人解释了「登记流程」。

examples.en: Follow the safety procedure before turning on the welding machine.
examples.zh: 打开焊机之前，请遵守「安全操作规程」。

words.enDefinition: condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity

examples.en: In no circumstance should you swim in this river after dark.
examples.zh: 天黑之后，任何「情况」下都不许在这条河里游泳。

examples.en: Each team's circumstances differ, so practice times will vary this season.
examples.zh: 每支队伍的「情况」不同，所以本赛季的训练时间会有变化。

words.enDefinition: person who seeks the advice of a lawyer

examples.en: The barber knows each client's preferred cut after twenty years downtown.
examples.zh: 在市中心干了二十年，理发师记得每位「顾客」爱好的发型。

examples.en: The lawyer explained the contract to her client in plain words.
examples.zh: 律师用平实的语言向「委托人」解释了合同。

words.enDefinition: means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information

examples.en: Radio remains a trusted medium for farmers waiting on weather news.
examples.zh: 对等着天气消息的农民来说，广播仍是可信的「媒介」。

examples.en: Clay is a popular medium in our Thursday pottery workshop.
examples.zh: 陶土是我们周四陶艺工作坊常用的一种「材料」。

words.enDefinition: the point or degree to which something extends

examples.en: To some extent, the delay was caused by the heavy fog.
examples.zh: 这次延误在「一定程度上」是由大雾造成的。

examples.en: The extent of the fire damage shocked the whole neighborhood.
examples.zh: 火灾损毁的「范围」震惊了整个街区。

words.enDefinition: render capable or able for some task

examples.en: The new ramp enables wheelchair users to enter the library alone.
examples.zh: 新坡道使轮椅使用者「能够」独自进出图书馆。

examples.en: Saving money this year will enable us to visit grandmother in spring.
examples.zh: 今年攒下的钱将使我们「能够」在春天去看望祖母。

words.enDefinition: someone who expresses in language; someone who talks (especially someone who delivers a public speech or someone especially garrulous)

examples.en: The main speaker at the book fair signed copies after her talk.
examples.zh: 书展的「主讲人」演讲结束后为读者签名。

examples.en: At the debate, each speaker had exactly three minutes to argue.
examples.zh: 辩论会上，每位「发言者」恰好有三分钟陈述时间。

words.enDefinition: the right or opportunity to use or reach something

examples.en: Members get early access to the gym before it opens to the public.
examples.zh: 健身房对公众开放前，会员可「优先使用」。

examples.en: The side ramp gives wheelchair users easy access to the stage.
examples.zh: 侧边的坡道让轮椅使用者可以轻松「进入」舞台区。

words.enDefinition: with ease (`easy' is sometimes used informally for `easily')

examples.en: Grandpa climbs the stairs easily now after his knee surgery.
examples.zh: 膝盖手术后，爷爷现在上下楼梯很「轻松」。

examples.en: These new shoes slip on easily, even without untying the laces.
examples.zh: 这双新鞋「很容易」穿，甚至不用解鞋带。

words.enDefinition: a note or source used to find information; the act of referring to something

examples.en: Keep the page number as a reference when you cite the article.
examples.zh: 引用这篇文章时，把页码留作「参考」。

examples.en: The map in the guide is a handy reference for hikers.
examples.zh: 指南里的地图是徒步者随手可查的「参考资料」。

words.enDefinition: discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation

examples.en: Guess the meaning of the new word from its context in the story.
examples.zh: 从故事的「上下文」里猜猜这个生词的意思。

examples.en: Out of context, his joke sounded ruder than he intended.
examples.zh: 脱离「语境」来看，他的玩笑听起来比本意生硬。

words.enDefinition: arousing or holding the attention

examples.en: The museum's new dinosaur exhibit is interesting for both kids and adults.
examples.zh: 博物馆新开的恐龙展对大人和孩子都「有趣」。

examples.en: She told us an interesting story about her grandmother's sea voyage.
examples.zh: 她给我们讲了一个关于祖母海上旅行的「有趣」故事。

words.enDefinition: the activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information

examples.en: Good communication between roommates prevents most of the small arguments.
examples.zh: 室友间良好的「沟通」能避免大多数小争执。

examples.en: Video calls have become our main communication with cousins overseas.
examples.zh: 视频通话成了我们与海外表亲主要的「交流」方式。

words.enDefinition: originate or come into being

examples.en: New problems often arise when the whole family travels together.
examples.zh: 全家一起旅行时，常会「出现」新的问题。

examples.en: If any confusion arises during checkout, ask the receptionist for help.
examples.zh: 退房时若「出现」疑问，可以请前台帮忙。

words.enDefinition: give a definition for the meaning of a word

examples.en: Can you define courage without using the word brave at all?
examples.zh: 你能完全不用 brave 这个词来「定义」courage 吗？

examples.en: House rules clearly define which chores each child handles every week.
examples.zh: 家规明确「规定」了每个孩子每周负责哪些家务。

words.enDefinition: (computer science) written programs or procedures or rules and associated documentation pertaining to the operation of a computer system and that are stored in read/write memory

examples.en: This free software lets students edit audio for their podcasts.
examples.zh: 这款免费「软件」让学生可以编辑播客音频。

examples.en: The laptop came with drawing software preinstalled for my art class.
examples.zh: 这台笔记本电脑预装了绘画「软件」，供我上美术课用。

words.enDefinition: an orderly grouping (of things or persons) considered as a unit; the result of arranging

examples.en: The flower arrangement on the dining table uses only garden roses.
examples.zh: 餐桌上的「插花」只用了花园里种的玫瑰。

examples.en: The librarian approved our new seating arrangement for story hour.
examples.zh: 图书管理员同意了我们为故事时间做的「座位安排」。

words.enDefinition: the trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area

examples.en: The hiking trail winds through a forest of tall cedar trees.
examples.zh: 这条徒步小径蜿蜒穿过一片高大的雪松「森林」。

examples.en: Birds wake the whole forest every morning just before sunrise.
examples.zh: 每天日出前，鸟儿唤醒整片「森林」。

words.enDefinition: involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope

examples.en: Global sea levels rise a little every year, coastal towns report.
examples.zh: 沿海城镇报告说，「全球」海平面每年都在缓慢上升。

examples.en: The band's global tour includes stops in twelve countries this summer.
examples.zh: 乐队今夏的「全球」巡演将在十二个国家停留。

words.enDefinition: fixed look with eyes open wide

examples.en: Don't stare at the sun during the eclipse without special glasses.
examples.zh: 日食期间，不戴专用眼镜不要「直视」太阳。

examples.en: The whole cafe seemed to stare when the musician dropped his trumpet.
examples.zh: 乐手的小号掉落时，整个咖啡馆的人似乎都在「盯着看」。

words.enDefinition: the feelings expressed on a person's face

examples.en: Grandma's proud expression showed the moment I recited the poem perfectly.
examples.zh: 我完美背出那首诗的那一刻，奶奶脸上满是骄傲的「表情」。

examples.en: That old saying is a common expression in southern villages.
examples.zh: 那句老话是南方村庄里常用的「说法」。

words.enDefinition: an informal talk between two or more people

examples.en: An easy conversation with the taxi driver made the long ride shorter.
examples.zh: 与出租车司机轻松的「闲聊」让漫长的车程变短了。

examples.en: Grandma started a conversation with every neighbor at the market.
examples.zh: 在市场里，奶奶跟每位邻居都「聊」了起来。

words.enDefinition: preliminary election where delegates or nominees are chosen

examples.en: Voters in our town choose the mayoral candidates in the primary.
examples.zh: 我们镇的选民在「初选」中挑选市长候选人。

examples.en: Campaign volunteers knocked on doors across town before the April primary.
examples.zh: 四月「初选」前，竞选志愿者在镇上挨家挨户敲门拉票。

words.enDefinition: division of some larger or more complex organization

examples.en: The new library branch opened two blocks from the train station.
examples.zh: 新的图书馆「分馆」开在距火车站两个街区的地方。

examples.en: Our bank's branch on Main Street closes early on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 我们银行在大街上的「分行」周六关门较早。

words.enDefinition: under normal conditions

examples.en: The bakery normally opens at seven, but today it stayed shut.
examples.zh: 面包店「通常」七点开门，但今天一直没开。

examples.en: Grandpa normally walks the dog after dinner, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 爷爷「通常」晚饭后遛狗，风雨无阻。

words.enDefinition: an implement consisting of a length of wood

examples.en: The retriever dove into the lake to fetch the wooden stick.
examples.zh: 那只寻回犬跳进湖里去捡木「棍」。

examples.en: Grandpa taught us to roast marshmallows on a long stick.
examples.zh: 爷爷教我们把棉花糖串在长「棍」上烤。

words.enDefinition: person who joins with others in some activity or endeavor

examples.en: Uncle Ray and his associates run the fishing charter business together.
examples.zh: 雷叔叔和他的生意「伙伴」一起经营包船钓鱼生意。

examples.en: He met his old associates from the band at the reunion.
examples.zh: 在重聚会上，他见到了乐队当年的老「伙伴」。

words.enDefinition: vivid mental image

examples.en: Opening a small bakery by the sea has been her clear vision.
examples.zh: 在海边开一家小面包店是她心中清晰的「愿景」。

examples.en: In his vision, the garden was full of white roses again.
examples.zh: 在他的「想象」中，花园里又开满了白玫瑰。
