words.enDefinition: lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter

examples.en: The kids climbed carefully over the rocks at the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子们在海滩的「岩石」间小心攀爬。

examples.en: A fallen rock blocked the narrow mountain path for hours.
examples.zh: 一块落下的「岩石」把山路堵了好几个小时。

words.enDefinition: mild viral infection involving the nose and respiratory passages (but not the lungs)

examples.en: I caught a heavy cold at the start of winter.
examples.zh: 入冬时我得了重「感冒」。

examples.en: Hot lemon tea always helps when you have a cold.
examples.zh: 「感冒」时喝热柠檬茶总是有用。

words.enDefinition: one of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes

examples.en: Send Granny a birthday card this year by real post.
examples.zh: 今年用真正的邮寄给奶奶寄一张生日「贺卡」。

examples.en: He paid quickly by card at the multistorey car park.
examples.zh: 他在多层停车场用「银行卡」付款。

words.enDefinition: space reserved for sitting (as in a theater or on a train or airplane)

examples.en: Is this seat taken, or may I sit down here?
examples.zh: 这个「座位」有人吗，我可以坐这里吗？

examples.en: Please return to your seat before the plane takes off.
examples.zh: 飞机起飞前请回到「座位」上。

words.enDefinition: unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope

examples.en: The huge waves kept all the small boats in harbour.
examples.zh: 「极大的」海浪把所有小船都留在了港里。

examples.en: Cleaning the huge stadium after the concert took two days.
examples.zh: 清理「巨大的」体育场花了两天时间。

words.enDefinition: round object that is hit or thrown or kicked in games

examples.en: The dog chased the ball right into the neighbour's yard.
examples.zh: 狗追着「球」一直跑进邻居的院子。

examples.en: We kicked the ball around in the yard after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我们在院子里踢「球」。

words.enDefinition: symptom of some physical hurt or disorder

examples.en: A sharp pain in his shoulder sent him to the doctor.
examples.zh: 肩膀的剧「痛」让他去看了医生。

examples.en: The medicine eased the pain in her knee within an hour.
examples.zh: 一小时内，药物就缓解了她膝盖的「疼痛」。

words.enDefinition: any of various mostly cold-blooded aquatic vertebrates usually having scales and breathing through gills

examples.en: He luckily caught three fat fish before breakfast this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早饭前他钓到了三条肥「鱼」。

examples.en: The village pond is stocked with young fish every spring.
examples.zh: 池塘每年春天都会投放「鱼苗」。

words.enDefinition: distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list

examples.en: Add this item to the list before we forget it.
examples.zh: 趁还没忘，把这一「项」加到清单上。

examples.en: Every single item on the menu costs under ten dollars.
examples.zh: 菜单上每一「样」都不超过十美元。

words.enDefinition: journey for some purpose (usually including the return)

examples.en: Our trip to the mountains was cancelled because of snow.
examples.zh: 因为下雪，我们去山里的「旅行」取消了。

examples.en: The little ferry trip across the bay takes forty minutes.
examples.zh: 乘渡轮横渡海湾的「行程」要四十分钟。

words.enDefinition: extending far down or far in; very intense or strong

examples.en: The old well is surprisingly deep, so cover it properly.
examples.zh: 那口老井「深」得出奇，务必盖好。

examples.en: She took a deep breath before walking onto the stage.
examples.zh: 上台之前，她「深」吸了一口气。

words.enDefinition: the boundary of a surface

examples.en: Do not lean over the edge of the station platform.
examples.zh: 不要探身到站台的「边缘」外。

examples.en: The cat sat at the edge of the sofa, watching the fish tank.
examples.zh: 猫坐在沙发「边」上盯着鱼缸。

words.enDefinition: form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature

examples.en: The fierce midday heat drove everyone indoors before eleven o'clock.
examples.zh: 正午的「暑热」让所有人十一点前就躲进了屋内。

examples.en: You can feel the heat rising from the city pavement.
examples.zh: 你能感觉到城市路面蒸腾的「热气」。

words.enDefinition: deliver by singing

examples.en: She loves to sing loudly in the shower before school.
examples.zh: 她喜欢上学前在淋浴时「唱歌」。

examples.en: The choir will sing at the town festival on Saturday.
examples.zh: 合唱团周六将在镇艺术节上「演唱」。

words.enDefinition: the outer covering of the body of a person or animal

examples.en: After a week at the beach, my skin went brown.
examples.zh: 在海边待了一周，我的「皮肤」晒成了棕色。

examples.en: The green lizard sheds its skin several times a year.
examples.zh: 蜥蜴每年会「蜕皮」好几次。

words.enDefinition: strongbox where valuables can be safely kept

examples.en: Keep the passports and tickets in the hotel safe overnight.
examples.zh: 把护照和票放在酒店的「保险箱」里过夜。

examples.en: The old iron safe in the basement still locks perfectly.
examples.zh: 地下室那台旧「保险柜」仍然锁得牢牢的。

words.enDefinition: warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrates characterized by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings

examples.en: A brightly coloured little bird visited our feeder this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上一只色彩鲜艳的「鸟」光顾了我们的喂食器。

examples.en: Tired migrating birds rest in the reeds beside the lake.
examples.zh: 迁徙的「鸟」在湖边的芦苇丛里歇脚。

words.enDefinition: possessing material wealth

examples.en: He grew up very rich but chose to live simply.
examples.zh: 他从小生活「富裕」，却选择了简朴的生活。

examples.en: The region is rich in history and old timber houses.
examples.zh: 这个地区历史底蕴「深厚」，还有很多老木屋。

words.enDefinition: not at all; in no degree (used to strengthen a negative, as in 'none too pleased')

examples.en: The written reply was none too polite, to be honest.
examples.zh: 说实话，那份答复「一点也不」客气。

examples.en: The water in the village well is none too clean.
examples.zh: 村里井水的水质「并不」干净。

words.enDefinition: air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure

examples.en: Close the window; the cold wind is picking up quickly.
examples.zh: 关上窗户，「风」正迅速变大。

examples.en: The strong wind blew the washing clean off the line.
examples.zh: 「风」把晾的衣物全从绳上吹落了。

words.enDefinition: moving or able to move quickly; happening without delay

examples.en: The fast train reaches the coast in under two hours.
examples.zh: 「快」车不到两小时就到海边。

examples.en: That mountain river runs really fast after the spring thaw.
examples.zh: 春融之后，那条河流「湍急」。

words.enDefinition: the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable

examples.en: The plants died from a lack of water in July.
examples.zh: 七月「缺水」，植物都枯死了。

examples.en: A simple lack of sleep made the whole team cranky.
examples.zh: 「睡眠不足」让全队都烦躁不安。

words.enDefinition: the amount by which the revenue of a business exceeds its cost of operating

examples.en: The doctor noted his weight gain after months of late-night snacks.
examples.zh: 医生记下了他几个月吃宵夜带来的体重「增加」。

examples.en: There has been a real gain in her confidence this term.
examples.zh: 这学期她的自信心有了实实在在的「增长」。

words.enDefinition: an animal that produces gametes (spermatozoa) that can fertilize female gametes (ova)

examples.en: In many bird species, the male bird has brighter feathers.
examples.zh: 在许多鸟类中，「雄性」的羽毛更鲜艳。

examples.en: The young vet said the kitten is a healthy male.
examples.zh: 兽医说这只小猫是只健康的「公猫」。

words.enDefinition: physical pain or emotional distress

examples.en: Her kind words eased the hurt left by the argument.
examples.zh: 暖心的话语减轻了争吵留下的「伤害」。

examples.en: Time slowly softened the hurt of losing the old house.
examples.zh: 时间冲淡了失去老房子的「伤痛」。

words.enDefinition: instrumentalists not including string players

examples.en: The school band practises in the big hall every Thursday.
examples.zh: 学校「乐队」每周四在大厅排练。

examples.en: A lively jazz band played at the wedding until midnight.
examples.zh: 一支爵士「乐队」在婚礼上一直演奏到午夜。

words.enDefinition: gathering of producers to promote business

examples.en: We bought lovely handmade soap at the spring craft fair.
examples.zh: 我们在春季手工艺「博览会」上买了手工皂。

examples.en: The book fair fills the whole town hall each October.
examples.zh: 每年十月，图书「交易会」占满了整个市政厅。

words.enDefinition: workplace consisting of farm buildings and cultivated land as a unit

examples.en: We bought fresh eggs from the farm down the road.
examples.zh: 我们从路那头的「农场」买了新鲜鸡蛋。

examples.en: Grandpa worked on a big dairy farm in his youth.
examples.zh: 爷爷年轻时在「奶牛场」干活。

words.enDefinition: set of related records (either written or electronic) kept together

examples.en: The young lawyer pulled the client's file from the cabinet.
examples.zh: 律师从柜子里抽出客户的「档案」。

examples.en: Every written complaint is kept on file for five years.
examples.zh: 每份投诉都会「存档」五年。

words.enDefinition: thing made to be similar or identical to another thing

examples.en: Keep a copy of the contract in your desk drawer.
examples.zh: 在书桌抽屉里留一份合同「副本」。

examples.en: This painting is a copy; the original hangs in Madrid.
examples.zh: 这幅画是「复制品」，真迹挂在马德里。

words.enDefinition: temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers

examples.en: The young scouts pitched their camp beside the river bend.
examples.zh: 童子军们在河湾边扎起了「营地」。

examples.en: The mountain camp sits at two thousand metres beside a stream.
examples.zh: 山上的「营地」设在海拔两千米的一条小溪旁。

words.enDefinition: money in the form of bills or coins

examples.en: The busy Saturday market stall takes cash only, no cards.
examples.zh: 周六市场摊位只收「现金」，不刷卡。

examples.en: I always keep some cash aside for the bus fare.
examples.zh: 我总是备一些「现金」付车费。

words.enDefinition: an opening into or through something

examples.en: The mouse vanished into a hole behind the skirting board.
examples.zh: 老鼠钻进踢脚板后面的一个「洞」里不见了。

examples.en: There is a hole in the toe of my left sock.
examples.zh: 我左脚袜子的脚尖处有个「洞」。

words.enDefinition: set of two similar things considered as a unit

examples.en: I bought a new pair of running shoes on sale.
examples.zh: 打折时我买了一「双」新跑鞋。

examples.en: This warm new pair of gloves matches the scarf perfectly.
examples.zh: 这「一副」暖和的手套和围巾非常相配。

words.enDefinition: vessel that carries passengers or freight

examples.en: The huge cargo ship left port with the morning tide.
examples.zh: 货「船」趁着早潮离开了港口。

examples.en: A century ago, emigrants crossed the ocean on crowded ships.
examples.zh: 一个世纪前，移民们乘坐拥挤的「轮船」横渡大洋。

words.enDefinition: a small round mark or dirty patch on a surface

examples.en: A dark spot of gravy landed on the clean tablecloth.
examples.zh: 一滴深色「污渍」落在了干净的桌布上。

examples.en: Dark grease spots from the bicycle chain stained his trousers.
examples.zh: 自行车链条的油「渍」弄脏了他的裤子。

words.enDefinition: small vessel for travel on water

examples.en: We rented a small boat and rowed across the lake.
examples.zh: 我们租了一条小「船」，划到湖对岸。

examples.en: The little fishing boat returns to the harbour at dusk.
examples.zh: 渔「船」黄昏时分回到港口。

words.enDefinition: the hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees

examples.en: The heavy old table is made of solid oak wood.
examples.zh: 这张旧桌子由坚实的橡「木」制成。

examples.en: Stack the split wood by the shed so it stays dry.
examples.zh: 把劈好的「木柴」堆在小屋旁，保持干燥。

words.enDefinition: list of names

examples.en: The teacher called the roll at the start of class.
examples.zh: 上课开始时老师照「名册」点了名。

examples.en: His name now stands first on the club's membership roll.
examples.zh: 他的名字现在排在俱乐部「名册」的第一位。

words.enDefinition: number or letter indicating quality (especially of a student's performance)

examples.en: She lost two marks just for spelling the title wrong.
examples.zh: 她因把标题拼错被「扣了两分」。

examples.en: He earned the highest mark in the class this term.
examples.zh: 这学期他拿了全班最高的「分数」。

words.enDefinition: coins made of gold

examples.en: The early miners panned for gold in this mountain river.
examples.zh: 早期矿工在这条山间河里淘「金」。

examples.en: The champion's medal is only gold-plated rather than solid gold.
examples.zh: 冠军奖牌是镀「金」的，并非纯金。

words.enDefinition: declare untrue; contradict

examples.en: He denied breaking the window, but his muddy shoes said otherwise.
examples.zh: 他「否认」打碎了窗户，但满是泥的鞋子出卖了他。

examples.en: The company denies any safety problems at the old plant.
examples.zh: 公司「否认」老工厂存在任何安全问题。

words.enDefinition: the means of connection between things linked in series

examples.en: Doctors found a clear link between diet and sleep quality.
examples.zh: 医生发现饮食和睡眠质量之间有明确的「联系」。

examples.en: Click the link at the bottom of the email to register.
examples.zh: 点击邮件底部的「链接」即可报名。

words.enDefinition: mechanical device that you ride for amusement or excitement

examples.en: The roller coaster is the most popular ride in the park.
examples.zh: 过山车是乐园里最受欢迎的「游乐设施」。

examples.en: The little ones loved the miniature train ride at the zoo.
examples.zh: 小朋友们喜欢动物园里环绕全园的小火车「游乐项目」。

words.enDefinition: wild primitive state untouched by civilization

examples.en: Grey wolves still live in the wild in these mountains.
examples.zh: 这些山里仍有狼生活在「荒野」中。

examples.en: The garden was left to grow wild behind the shed.
examples.zh: 小屋后面的花园任其「荒芜」。

words.enDefinition: fermented juice (of grapes especially)

examples.en: Uncle brought a bottle of red wine for Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 叔叔带了一瓶红「葡萄酒」来吃周日晚餐。

examples.en: This sunny valley is famous for its crisp white wine.
examples.zh: 这个山谷以清爽的白「葡萄酒」闻名。

words.enDefinition: acquire or deserve by one's efforts or actions

examples.en: She earns some extra money by tutoring maths at weekends.
examples.zh: 她周末辅导数学「赚」外快。

examples.en: He earned the team's respect by never missing a practice.
examples.zh: 他从不缺训，因而「赢得」了全队的尊重。

words.enDefinition: food for domestic livestock

examples.en: The farmer stored the winter feed in the tall barn.
examples.zh: 农民把过冬的「饲料」存进高高的谷仓。

examples.en: The price of chicken feed rose sharply again this spring.
examples.zh: 今年春天鸡「饲料」价格又涨了。

words.enDefinition: an act of raising something to a higher position

examples.en: The movers gave the piano one heavy lift up the stairs.
examples.zh: 搬运工们用力一「抬」，把钢琴搬上了楼。

examples.en: The crane completed the delicate lift in under a minute.
examples.zh: 吊车不到一分钟就完成了这次精细的「起吊」。

words.enDefinition: the act of pushing off the ground and rising into the air; a leap

examples.en: The young horse cleared the highest jump of the course.
examples.zh: 马儿越过了全程最高的「跳跃障碍」。

examples.en: With one running jump, he cleared the narrow garden stream.
examples.zh: 他助跑一「跳」，跃过了花园的小溪。

words.enDefinition: having or giving out heat to a moderate degree; friendly

examples.en: The bread came out of the oven warm and golden.
examples.zh: 面包出炉时又「暖」又金黄。

examples.en: Our new neighbours gave us a genuinely warm welcome here.
examples.zh: 新邻居给了我们真心实意的「热情」欢迎。

words.enDefinition: on the positive side or higher end of a scale

examples.en: Two plus two makes four, as every child learns early.
examples.zh: 二「加」二等于四，每个孩子早早就会学。

examples.en: The rent is six hundred a month, plus the utility bills.
examples.zh: 房租每月六百，「外加」水电账单。

words.enDefinition: yielding readily to pressure or weight

examples.en: The white cat's fur is incredibly soft after her bath.
examples.zh: 猫咪洗完澡后，毛摸起来「软」极了。

examples.en: He speaks in a soft voice that calms the toddlers.
examples.zh: 他说话声音「轻柔」，能安抚学步的孩子。

words.enDefinition: one of a series of ridges that moves across the surface of a liquid (especially across a large body of water)

examples.en: A big wave knocked over the whole sandcastle in seconds.
examples.zh: 一个大「浪」几秒钟就把沙堡打翻了。

examples.en: Waves lapped gently against the side of the rowing boat.
examples.zh: 「海浪」轻轻拍打着划艇的船舷。

words.enDefinition: set of garments (usually including a jacket and trousers or skirt) for outerwear all of the same fabric and color

examples.en: He wears a smart grey suit to every client meeting.
examples.zh: 他每次见客户都穿灰色「西装」。

examples.en: This suit needs dry cleaning before the interview on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五面试前，这套「西装」需要干洗。

words.enDefinition: someone who cooks food

examples.en: The cook at our canteen makes the best dumplings in town.
examples.zh: 我们食堂的「厨师」做的饺子全镇最好。

examples.en: Grandma was the family cook for more than fifty years.
examples.zh: 奶奶当了五十多年的家庭「厨师」。

words.enDefinition: journey or route all the way around a particular place or area

examples.en: The free city tour ends at the old harbour market.
examples.zh: 城市「观光」行程在老港口市场结束。

examples.en: We joined a guided tour of the castle's hidden rooms.
examples.zh: 我们参加了城堡隐藏房间的导览「游览」。

words.enDefinition: pain that feels hot as if it were on fire

examples.en: Cool the fresh burn under running water for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 把「烧伤」处放在流动水下冲十分钟降温。

examples.en: The cook got a painful burn from the oven tray.
examples.zh: 厨师被烤箱烤盘烫出了一种「灼痛」。

words.enDefinition: level tract of land

examples.en: The route home is flat, so the ride is easy.
examples.zh: 回家的路线很「平坦」，骑车很轻松。

examples.en: Lay the map flat on the table to see the whole region.
examples.zh: 把地图「平铺」在桌上，才能看到整个区域。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being at a refreshingly low temperature

examples.en: We enjoyed the cool of the evening on the porch.
examples.zh: 我们在门廊上享受夜晚的「凉爽」。

examples.en: The stone basement keeps its cool even in hot August.
examples.zh: 即使在八月，石头地下室也保持着「凉意」。

words.enDefinition: long thin piece of cloth or paper as used for binding or fastening

examples.en: Use strong brown tape to seal the moving boxes properly.
examples.zh: 用结实的「胶带」把搬家纸箱封好。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps a box of old cassette tapes in the attic.
examples.zh: 爷爷的阁楼里有一箱旧盒式「磁带」。

words.enDefinition: water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere

examples.en: The first real rain finally arrived after six dry weeks.
examples.zh: 干早六周之后，第一场像样的「雨」终于来了。

examples.en: Heavy overnight rain flooded the lane outside the school gates.
examples.zh: 大「雨」淹了校门外的巷道。

words.enDefinition: notify of danger, potential harm, or risk

examples.en: The red signs warn swimmers about the strong underwater current.
examples.zh: 标牌「警告」游泳者水下水流湍急。

examples.en: Doctors always warn their patients about this medicine's side effects.
examples.zh: 医生总会「提醒」病人注意这种药的副作用。

words.enDefinition: substance that can be consumed to produce energy

examples.en: Check the fuel gauge before starting the long drive home.
examples.zh: 出发长途回家前先检查「燃料」。

examples.en: Rising fuel prices affect every small delivery company in town.
examples.zh: 「燃油」涨价影响着镇上每一家货运公司。

words.enDefinition: piece of furniture with a writing surface and usually drawers or other compartments

examples.en: My desk faces the window, so I watch the birds while working.
examples.zh: 我的「书桌」朝着窗户，工作时能看到鸟。

examples.en: Please clear your desk completely before the cleaning staff arrive.
examples.zh: 保洁人员来之前请清理好你的「书桌」。

words.enDefinition: become slow or slower

examples.en: Traffic is slow near the school at half past three.
examples.zh: 下午三点半学校附近车流「缓慢」。

examples.en: She took a slow walk around the garden after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后她在花园里「缓缓地」散步。

words.enDefinition: movable organ for flying (one of a pair)

examples.en: The bird hurt its wing and cannot fly for now.
examples.zh: 这只鸟伤了「翅膀」，暂时不能飞。

examples.en: A butterfly's wing is covered with thousands of tiny scales.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的「翅膀」上覆盖着成千上万片细小的鳞片。

words.enDefinition: the motion characteristic of fluids (liquids or gases)

examples.en: The flow of the river slows near the old bridge.
examples.zh: 河水在老桥附近的「流动」变缓。

examples.en: Traffic flow improved greatly after the new lane opened downtown.
examples.zh: 市中心新车道开通后，交通「流量」顺畅了。

words.enDefinition: minor inadvertent mistake usually observed in speech or writing or in small accidents or memory lapses etc.

examples.en: She had a nasty slip on the icy garden path.
examples.zh: 她在结冰的花园小径上重重「滑了一跤」。

examples.en: A slip of the tongue caused the whole class to laugh.
examples.zh: 一次「口误」惹得全班大笑。

words.enDefinition: the act of delivering a blow with the foot

examples.en: He gave the ball a powerful kick toward the top corner.
examples.zh: 他用力一「踢」，把球踢向球门上角。

examples.en: The startled horse's kick knocked the water bucket right over.
examples.zh: 马「踢」了一脚，把水桶踢翻了。

words.enDefinition: a shapeless lump or collection of matter; a large quantity

examples.en: A dark mass of storm clouds gathered on the horizon.
examples.zh: 地平线上聚起一大「团」乌云。

examples.en: Masses of slimy seaweed washed up after the weekend storm.
examples.zh: 周末风暴后，大「团」大「团」的海藻被冲上岸。

words.enDefinition: small hard fruit

examples.en: Plant the tomato seeds two centimetres deep in small pots.
examples.zh: 把番茄「种子」种进小花盆两厘米深。

examples.en: This apple has dark seeds, so it is fully ripe.
examples.zh: 这个苹果的「籽」是深色的，说明完全熟了。

words.enDefinition: prescribed selection of foods

examples.en: A balanced daily diet matters more than any single superfood.
examples.zh: 均衡的「日常饮食」比任何单一超级食物都重要。

examples.en: The doctor suggested a low-salt diet for Grandpa's blood pressure.
examples.zh: 医生建议爷爷为控制血压采用低盐「饮食」。

words.enDefinition: an explosive device fused to explode under specific conditions

examples.en: Workers found an old wartime bomb during the subway dig.
examples.zh: 工人在地铁施工时发现了一枚战争年代的旧「炸弹」。

examples.en: Bomb experts safely removed the defused bomb from the site.
examples.zh: 专家安全地移走了已拆除引信的「炸弹」。

words.enDefinition: the actors in a play

examples.en: The whole cast bowed together at the end of the play.
examples.zh: 剧终时，「全体演员」一起鞠躬谢幕。

examples.en: The cast celebrated opening night backstage with pizza and music.
examples.zh: 「剧组」全体成员在后台用披萨和音乐庆祝首演之夜。

words.enDefinition: person responsible for hiring workers

examples.en: My kind boss finally approved the holiday request this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上「老板」终于批准了我的休假申请。

examples.en: The friendly boss of the bakery knows every regular's order.
examples.zh: 面包店的「老板」记得每位熟客的订单。

words.enDefinition: an instinctive motive

examples.en: I resisted the urge to check my phone during dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭时我忍住了看手机的「冲动」。

examples.en: He felt a sudden urge to laugh during the solemn speech.
examples.zh: 严肃的演讲途中，他突然「很想」笑。

words.enDefinition: complete collection of similar things

examples.en: She grabbed a pack of biscuits on her way out.
examples.zh: 出门时她顺手抓了一「包」饼干。

examples.en: The whole pack of playing cards is missing two aces.
examples.zh: 这「一副」牌少了两张A。

words.enDefinition: friendly nation

examples.en: In the group project, my cousin was my strongest ally.
examples.zh: 小组作业里，表哥是我最坚定的「盟友」。

examples.en: The two small shops became allies against the supermarket chain.
examples.zh: 两家小店联合起来，成了对抗连锁超市的「盟友」。

words.enDefinition: the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle

examples.en: My aunt sends us a jar of homemade jam every autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，我「姑姑」都会寄来一罐自制果酱。

examples.en: Aunt Rosa patiently taught me to make pasta by hand.
examples.zh: 「罗莎姨妈」教我手工做意大利面。

words.enDefinition: large room for gatherings or entertainment

examples.en: The wedding reception will be held in the village hall.
examples.zh: 婚宴在村里的「礼堂」举行。

examples.en: The brand new concert hall seats five hundred people comfortably.
examples.zh: 新音乐「厅」能舒适地容纳五百人。

words.enDefinition: person who makes use of a thing; someone who uses or employs something

examples.en: The gym asks every user to wipe down the equipment.
examples.zh: 健身房要求每位「使用者」擦拭器材。

examples.en: This free design software now has a million registered users.
examples.zh: 这款免费软件如今有一百万注册「用户」。

words.enDefinition: On the top of; upon; on. See On to, under On, prep.

examples.en: The naughty cat jumped onto the warm laptop keyboard again.
examples.zh: 猫又跳「到」了温热的笔记本电脑键盘上。

examples.en: He stepped nervously onto the stage to collect his prize.
examples.zh: 他走「上」舞台去领奖。

words.enDefinition: the words of something written

examples.en: Read the short text on the museum plaque out loud.
examples.zh: 把博物馆铭牌上的「文字」大声读出来。

examples.en: I highlighted one very important line in the history text.
examples.zh: 我在历史「课文」里高亮了一句重要的话。

words.enDefinition: local and well-defined elevation of the land

examples.en: Our house sits on the hill, so the view is wonderful.
examples.zh: 我们家坐落在小「山」上，视野绝佳。

examples.en: Cycling up the steep hill behind the village takes real effort.
examples.zh: 骑车上村后的陡「坡」确实费劲。

words.enDefinition: the dressed skin of an animal (especially a large animal)

examples.en: The old tannery prepared each hide for the leather workshop.
examples.zh: 制革厂为皮革作坊处理每一张「兽皮」。

examples.en: The old family sofa is upholstered in thick cow hide.
examples.zh: 这张旧沙发用厚实的牛「皮」包面。

words.enDefinition: way especially designed for a particular use

examples.en: The old stone path leads straight down to the beach.
examples.zh: 这条石「路」一直通到海滩。

examples.en: Keep to the marked path while walking in the reserve.
examples.zh: 在保护区内请沿标记的「小路」行走。

words.enDefinition: and nothing more

examples.en: The app is merely a tool; your practice does the work.
examples.zh: 这个应用「只是」工具，真正的功夫在于你的练习。

examples.en: He merely shrugged when we asked about the broken vase.
examples.zh: 我们问起打碎的花瓶时，他「只是」耸了耸肩。

words.enDefinition: an implement used in the practice of a vocation

examples.en: The right tool makes every home repair twice as easy.
examples.zh: 合适的「工具」能让每次修理事半功倍。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps each small tool in a labelled wooden box.
examples.zh: 爷爷把每件「工具」都放在贴了标签的木盒里。

words.enDefinition: characteristic sound

examples.en: Grandma's gold ring has a tiny ruby in the centre.
examples.zh: 奶奶的金「戒指」中央镶着一颗小红宝石。

examples.en: He slipped the engagement ring onto her finger at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时分，他把订婚「戒指」戴上了她的手指。

words.enDefinition: something acquired without compensation

examples.en: The handmade wool scarf was a gift from my aunt.
examples.zh: 这条手工围巾是「姑姑」送的「礼物」。

examples.en: The best gift you can give a new parent is sleep.
examples.zh: 你能送给新手父母最好的「礼物」是睡眠。

words.enDefinition: something that remunerates

examples.en: The bakery raised its hourly wage at the start of the month.
examples.zh: 面包店月初上调了每小时的「工资」。

examples.en: He saves part of every wage for his evening classes.
examples.zh: 他从每份「工资」里存一部分付夜校学费。

words.enDefinition: powerful stroke with the fist or a weapon

examples.en: The boxer took a heavy blow to the shoulder in round two.
examples.zh: 第二回合，拳击手肩膀上重重挨了一「击」。

examples.en: Losing the grant came as a cruel blow to the team.
examples.zh: 补助金落空对团队是残酷的「打击」。

words.enDefinition: the food served and eaten at one time

examples.en: Breakfast is still the most important meal of the day.
examples.zh: 早餐是一天中最重要的一「餐」。

examples.en: They shared a quiet birthday meal at the corner cafe.
examples.zh: 他们在街角咖啡馆安静地吃了一顿「饭」。

words.enDefinition: footwear shaped to fit the foot (below the ankle) with a flexible upper of leather or plastic and a sole and heel of heavier material

examples.en: There is a deep scuff on my new shoe already.
examples.zh: 我的新「鞋」上已经有了一道磨痕。

examples.en: Please take off your shoes and leave them by the door.
examples.zh: 请脱「鞋」放在门边。

words.enDefinition: rigid connective tissue that makes up the skeleton of vertebrates

examples.en: The dog buried a large bone in the garden yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天狗在花园里埋了一根「骨头」。

examples.en: Grandma's rich broth simmers with a marrow bone all morning.
examples.zh: 奶奶的汤用一根髓「骨」炖了一上午。

words.enDefinition: any place of pain and turmoil;

examples.en: The rescuers described the flooded mine as a living hell.
examples.zh: 救援者形容被淹的矿井如同「地狱」。

examples.en: Grandpa always said the war memories were his private hell.
examples.zh: 爷爷常说战争记忆是他的私人「地狱」。

words.enDefinition: set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones)

examples.en: The school has a strict dress code for the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典礼上学校有严格的着装「规定」。

examples.en: The medieval knights lived by a strict code of honour.
examples.zh: 中世纪骑士遵循严格的「荣誉准则」。

words.enDefinition: a sudden attempt to take hold of something

examples.en: She made a grab for the last biscuit and missed.
examples.zh: 她伸手一「抓」最后一块饼干，没抓到。

examples.en: His sudden grab for the falling cup saved the tablecloth.
examples.zh: 他猛地一「抓」，接住了掉落的杯子，保住了桌布。

words.enDefinition: hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella

examples.en: She scraped her knee when she fell off the scooter.
examples.zh: 她从滑板车上摔下来擦伤了「膝盖」。

examples.en: Always bend your knees properly before lifting the heavy box.
examples.zh: 搬重箱子前要先正确地「屈膝」。

words.enDefinition: the act of paying to use something for a limited time

examples.en: Car hire is cheaper if you book online in advance.
examples.zh: 提前网上预订，汽车「租赁」更便宜。

examples.en: The rowing boat is available for hire at the jetty.
examples.zh: 那条划艇可以在码头「租用」。

words.enDefinition: be subject to change in accordance with a variable

examples.en: Prices vary a lot from one market stall to the next.
examples.zh: 各市场摊位的价格「各不相同」。

examples.en: The daily menu varies with whatever the fishermen bring in.
examples.zh: 菜单随渔民每次的渔获而「变化」。

words.enDefinition: the part of a piece of meat that contains little fat

examples.en: Ask the butcher for a piece of lean beef for the stew.
examples.zh: 让肉铺师傅为炖菜挑一块「瘦肉」。

examples.en: This cut of pork has far more lean than fat.
examples.zh: 这块猪肉「瘦」的部分远多于肥的。

words.enDefinition: the part of an organism (human or animal) that connects the head to the rest of the body

examples.en: Wear a scarf to keep your neck warm on the bike.
examples.zh: 骑车时戴条围巾给「脖子」保暖。

examples.en: The itchy label scratched the back of his neck all day.
examples.zh: 扎人的标签蹭得他后「颈」发痒。

words.enDefinition: garment size for a tall person

examples.en: The very tall boy in the back row plays centre.
examples.zh: 后排那个「高个子」男孩打中锋。

examples.en: Our sunflowers grow surprisingly tall in the light sandy soil.
examples.zh: 在我们松软的沙土里，向日葵长得出奇地「高」。

words.enDefinition: the emotion of intense dislike; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action

examples.en: There was no hate in her honest criticism, only concern.
examples.zh: 她的批评里没有「憎恨」，只有关心。

examples.en: The old song describes how hate slowly turns into forgiveness.
examples.zh: 这首歌讲述「恨」如何慢慢化为原谅。

words.enDefinition: the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants

examples.en: Every single leaf on the maple turned red in October.
examples.zh: 十月里，枫树的每片「叶子」都红了。

examples.en: A dry brown leaf drifted down onto her open notebook.
examples.zh: 一片枯黄的「落叶」飘到她摊开的笔记本上。

words.enDefinition: an excavation that is (usually) filled with water

examples.en: The heated hotel swimming pool opens at seven every morning.
examples.zh: 酒店「泳池」每天早上七点开放。

examples.en: Children splashed happily in the shallow pool near the fountain.
examples.zh: 孩子们在喷泉边的浅「水池」里开心地戏水。

words.enDefinition: compound formed by replacing hydrogen in an acid by a metal (or a radical that acts like a metal)

examples.en: Add a good pinch of salt to the pasta water.
examples.zh: 往煮意面的水里加一撮「盐」。

examples.en: Sea salt tastes much stronger than table salt in dressings.
examples.zh: 在调料汁里，海「盐」比精盐味道更浓。

words.enDefinition: any of various water-soluble compounds having a sour taste and capable of turning litmus red and reacting with a base to form a salt

examples.en: Fresh lemon juice contains a weak but useful natural acid.
examples.zh: 柠檬汁含有一种弱但实用的天然「酸」。

examples.en: The chemistry teacher showed the class how acid reacts with chalk.
examples.zh: 化学老师演示了「酸」如何与粉笔反应。

words.enDefinition: the immaterial part of a person; the actuating cause of an individual life

examples.en: Grandma always says that truly good music feeds the soul.
examples.zh: 奶奶总说，好的音乐滋养「灵魂」。

examples.en: She put her whole soul into that huge landscape painting.
examples.zh: 她把整个「灵魂」都投入了这幅风景画。

words.enDefinition: lose thickness; become thin or thinner

examples.en: The early ice on the pond is still dangerously thin.
examples.zh: 池塘的冰还很「薄」，非常危险。

examples.en: Cut the cucumber into very thin slices for the salad.
examples.zh: 把黄瓜切成「薄」片做沙拉。

words.enDefinition: movable barrier in a fence or wall

examples.en: Please close the garden gate so the dog stays inside.
examples.zh: 关上花园「大门」，别让狗跑出去。

examples.en: Passengers for the noon flight board today at gate twelve.
examples.zh: 中午航班今天在十二「号登机口」登机。

words.enDefinition: (botany) the usually underground organ that lacks buds or leaves or nodes; absorbs water and mineral salts; usually it anchors the plant to the ground

examples.en: The old tree's roots lift the garden path each winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，老树的「根」都会把花园小径拱起。

examples.en: A knob of ginger root adds warmth to the winter soup.
examples.zh: 加一小块姜「根」能给冬季的汤增加暖意。

words.enDefinition: the organ of smell and entrance to the respiratory tract; the prominent part of the face of man or other mammals

examples.en: The friendly dog pushed its wet nose against my hand.
examples.zh: 狗用湿湿的「鼻子」蹭我的手。

examples.en: Please blow your runny nose properly before the concert begins.
examples.zh: 音乐会开始前请把「鼻涕」擤干净。

words.enDefinition: people who are sick

examples.en: The local charity sends volunteers to care for the sick.
examples.zh: 慈善机构派出志愿者照料「病人」。

examples.en: Sea air was once thought to help the sick recover.
examples.zh: 从前人们认为海边的空气能帮助「病人」康复。

words.enDefinition: occupied with work or another activity, with little time available

examples.en: Mum is busy preparing dinner, so set the table yourself.
examples.zh: 妈妈正「忙着」准备晚饭，你自己摆餐具吧。

examples.en: He is too busy to join us this weekend, sadly.
examples.zh: 可惜他这周末太「忙」，没法和我们一起。

words.enDefinition: narrow way or road

examples.en: The delivery van only barely fits down our narrow lane.
examples.zh: 送货面包车勉强能开进我们那条窄「巷」。

examples.en: A new painted cycle lane runs along the canal path.
examples.zh: 运河步道旁新辟了一条自行车「道」。

words.enDefinition: fossil fuel consisting of carbonized vegetable matter deposited in the Carboniferous period

examples.en: The old black steam locomotive still burns coal for power.
examples.zh: 老式蒸汽机车仍靠烧「煤」获得动力。

examples.en: Grandpa once worked in a coal mine near the valley.
examples.zh: 爷爷曾在山谷附近的「煤矿」工作。

words.enDefinition: locally circumscribed place characterized by some distinctive features

examples.en: Parking is completely free in this zone after six o'clock.
examples.zh: 六点以后在这个「区域」停车免费。

examples.en: The map clearly marks a quiet zone around the library.
examples.zh: 地图上标出了图书馆周围的安静「地带」。

words.enDefinition: to stop sleeping, or to cause someone to stop sleeping

examples.en: Please wake me at six so I do not miss the train.
examples.zh: 请六点「叫醒」我，免得我错过火车。

examples.en: I usually wake naturally before the alarm on working days.
examples.zh: 工作日我通常在闹钟响之前就「醒」了。

words.enDefinition: to deal successfully with a difficult situation or problem

examples.en: She copes with exam stress by running along the river.
examples.zh: 她靠沿河跑步来「应付」压力。

examples.en: How do you cope with three deadlines in one week?
examples.zh: 一周三个截止日期，你是怎么「应对」的？

words.enDefinition: precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals

examples.en: The first proper snow of this winter season arrived overnight.
examples.zh: 入冬后第一场像样的「雪」一夜之间来了。

examples.en: Heavy snow closed the mountain road for two whole days.
examples.zh: 大「雪」把山路整整封了两天。

words.enDefinition: the part of the earth's surface consisting of humus and disintegrated rock

examples.en: This heavy clay soil holds water for days after rain.
examples.zh: 这种黏「土」雨后能保水好几天。

examples.en: Turn the garden soil over before planting the spring tulips.
examples.zh: 种春季郁金香前先「翻土」。

words.enDefinition: body of (usually fresh) water surrounded by land

examples.en: We swam across the lake early on a calm morning.
examples.zh: 一个无风的清晨，我们游过了「湖」。

examples.en: The mountain lake freezes over most years in late January.
examples.zh: 这个「湖」大多数年份在一月下旬结冰。

words.enDefinition: the quality of a person's voice

examples.en: Her gentle tone softened the moment she saw the baby.
examples.zh: 一看到婴儿，她的「语气」就柔和了下来。

examples.en: The cello's rich deep tone filled the small stone hall.
examples.zh: 大提琴低沉的「音调」充满了小石厅。

words.enDefinition: round vessel that is open at the top; used chiefly for holding food or liquids;

examples.en: Fill the big bowl with warm water for the cat.
examples.zh: 给猫的「碗」里倒满温水。

examples.en: Grandma always mixed the pancake batter in her biggest bowl.
examples.zh: 奶奶在她最大的「碗」里调煎饼糊。

words.enDefinition: not widely known; especially valued for its uncommonness

examples.en: It is rare to see snow in this southern city.
examples.zh: 在这座南方城市，「很少」见到下雪。

examples.en: Grandma's recipe uses a rare local herb for the marinade.
examples.zh: 奶奶的配方用了一种「稀有的」本地香草做腌汁。

words.enDefinition: an act of cleaning something, especially with water

examples.en: Give the dusty car a good wash before Sunday's trip.
examples.zh: 周日出行前把车好好「洗」一洗。

examples.en: That muddy white rugby jacket needs a hot wash tonight.
examples.zh: 那件沾满泥的橄榄球服今晚需要热水「洗」。

words.enDefinition: drop of the clear salty saline solution secreted by the lacrimal glands

examples.en: A tear rolled down her cheek during the last scene.
examples.zh: 最后一幕时，一滴「泪」顺着她的脸颊滑落。

examples.en: He quickly wiped away the tears and smiled at us.
examples.zh: 他擦掉「眼泪」，朝我们笑了笑。

words.enDefinition: an enclosed armored military vehicle; has a cannon and moves on caterpillar treads

examples.en: The old war film showed tanks crossing the muddy field.
examples.zh: 那部老战争片里，「坦克」驶过泥泞的田野。

examples.en: A single military tank rumbled through the small town square.
examples.zh: 一辆军用「坦克」隆隆驶过小镇广场。

words.enDefinition: heavy ductile magnetic metallic element; is silver-white in pure form but readily rusts; used in construction and tools and armament; plays a role in the transport of oxygen by the blood

examples.en: The fence around the park is made of wrought iron.
examples.zh: 公园周围的栅栏由熟「铁」制成。

examples.en: Spinach and red meat are good sources of dietary iron.
examples.zh: 菠菜和红肉是膳食「铁」的良好来源。

words.enDefinition: protective covering that covers or forms the top of a building

examples.en: Rain water leaked through the kitchen roof during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中，雨水从厨房「屋顶」渗了进来。

examples.en: Local workers replaced the church roof before the winter rains.
examples.zh: 工人们在冬雨来临前换掉了教堂「屋顶」。

words.enDefinition: white nutritious liquid secreted by mammals and used as food by human beings

examples.en: The milk expired yesterday, so I will buy more today.
examples.zh: 「牛奶」昨天过期了，我今天再多买些。

examples.en: A glass of warm milk before bed helps some people fall asleep.
examples.zh: 睡前喝温「牛奶」对有些人有助眠作用。

words.enDefinition: to make a liquid flow from a container into somewhere else

examples.en: Pour the pancake batter slowly into the hot frying pan.
examples.zh: 把煎饼糊慢慢「倒」进热锅里。

examples.en: The heavy rain poured down the classroom windows all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整个下午，雨「倾泻」在教室的窗上。

words.enDefinition: prominent or sensational but short-lived news event

examples.en: Stir the vegetable soup gently so the pieces stay whole.
examples.zh: 轻轻「搅动」汤，别把蔬菜搅散。

examples.en: One single quick glance at the painting stirred old memories.
examples.zh: 看一眼这幅画就「激起」了旧日回忆。

words.enDefinition: man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength

examples.en: The retired firefighter is a hero to the whole street.
examples.zh: 那位退役消防员是整条街的「英雄」。

examples.en: In the story, the hero rescues the village from the flood.
examples.zh: 故事里，「英雄」把村庄从洪水中救了出来。

words.enDefinition: unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope

examples.en: The vast ocean stretched to the horizon without a sail.
examples.zh: 「浩瀚的」大海上没有一片帆，一直延伸到天际。

examples.en: She has a vast collection of postcards from her travels.
examples.zh: 她收藏了「大量」旅行时寄来的明信片。

words.enDefinition: small group of indispensable persons or things

examples.en: The CORE of the business is its loyal morning customers.
examples.zh: 这门生意的「核心」是那些忠实的晨间老顾客。

examples.en: Trust is truly the CORE of every good neighbourhood shop.
examples.zh: 「信任」是每个好的街坊小店的核心。

words.enDefinition: sudden forceful flow

examples.en: There is no rush; finish the report whenever it is ready.
examples.zh: 不用「赶」，报告什么时候好就什么时候交。

examples.en: He felt a rush of cold air when the door opened.
examples.zh: 门一开，一股冷气「涌」了进来。

words.enDefinition: short for railway

examples.en: Engineering crews are welding new rails along the mountain route.
examples.zh: 工人们正沿山区线路焊接新「铁轨」。

examples.en: Steel rails carry the night train safely over the viaduct.
examples.zh: 钢「轨」载着夜行列车安全驶过高架桥。

words.enDefinition: cloak that is folded or wrapped around a person

examples.en: She wore a warm wool wrap over her evening dress.
examples.zh: 她在晚礼服外披了条保暖的羊毛「披肩」。

examples.en: Grandma's old silk wrap still looks lovely after forty years.
examples.zh: 四十年过去了，奶奶的丝「披巾」依旧好看。

words.enDefinition: the act of pulling something heavy along; something that makes progress slow or boring

examples.en: The heavy drag of the suitcase up the stairs exhausted him.
examples.zh: 把行李箱在楼梯上「拖」上楼让他筋疲力尽。

examples.en: Sitting through three hours of paperwork is a real drag.
examples.zh: 枯坐三个小时填表格真是件「烦人的苦差」。

words.enDefinition: an outer garment that has sleeves and covers the body from shoulder down; worn outdoors

examples.en: Hang your wet rain coat by the door to dry.
examples.zh: 把湿「外套」挂在门边晾干。

examples.en: This wool coat keeps me warm through the whole winter.
examples.zh: 这件「大衣」让我整个冬天都暖和。

words.enDefinition: unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot

examples.en: The garden rain gauge collected more than three inches overnight.
examples.zh: 雨量计一夜之间收集了三「英寸」多的雨水。

examples.en: He measured the wooden shelf carefully to the nearest inch.
examples.zh: 他仔细地把书架量到精确到「英寸」。

words.enDefinition: a small piece that has broken off from something hard; a small thin piece of food

examples.en: Fresh wood chips covered the workshop floor after the sawing.
examples.zh: 锯完木头后，车间地板上满是「木屑」。

examples.en: Sprinkle the dark chocolate chips evenly over the cake batter.
examples.zh: 把「巧克力碎粒」均匀撒在蛋糕糊上。

words.enDefinition: your consciousness of your own identity

examples.en: He looked at his reflection and questioned his whole self.
examples.zh: 他望着镜中的自己，质疑起整个「自我」。

examples.en: Writing a private diary helped her understand her inner self.
examples.zh: 写日记帮她理解了「内在的自我」。

words.enDefinition: place (seaport or airport) where people and merchandise can enter or leave a country

examples.en: The huge cruise ship finally left port just after sunrise.
examples.zh: 游轮终于在日出后离开了「港口」。

examples.en: Most of the town's income comes from the fishing port.
examples.zh: 小镇大部分收入来自「渔港」。

words.enDefinition: with or in a close or intimate relationship

examples.en: You are such a dear for helping with the move.
examples.zh: 你帮忙搬家，真是个「亲爱的好孩子」。

examples.en: Come in, my dear, and warm yourself by the fire.
examples.zh: 进来吧，「亲爱的」，到炉火边暖暖身子。

words.enDefinition: footwear that covers the whole foot and lower leg

examples.en: Lace up your old hiking boots before the muddy trail.
examples.zh: 走泥泞步道前系好登山「靴」。

examples.en: Snow slipped into my boot while I cleared the path.
examples.zh: 铲雪时，「雪」灌进了我的「靴子」。

words.enDefinition: composition written in metrical feet forming rhythmical lines

examples.en: She wrote a short funny poem for the school magazine.
examples.zh: 她为校刊写了一首短「诗」。

examples.en: This very ancient poem is still recited at every festival.
examples.zh: 这首古诗至今仍在每个节日被「传诵」。

words.enDefinition: showing or causing joy and pleasure; especially made happy

examples.en: I am so very glad you could join us tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚你能来，我非常「高兴」。

examples.en: She was really glad the storm passed before the fair.
examples.zh: 集市开张前风暴就过去了，她很「庆幸」。

words.enDefinition: to move an object or part of your body so that it is no longer straight

examples.en: Bend the wire gently into a circle for the wreath.
examples.zh: 把铁丝轻轻「弯」成圆圈做花环。

examples.en: Bend down very slowly to pick up the dropped coins.
examples.zh: 捡起掉落的硬币时要慢慢「弯腰」。

words.enDefinition: loose material consisting of grains of rock or coral

examples.en: The children built a big castle out of wet sand.
examples.zh: 孩子们用湿「沙」堆了一座城堡。

examples.en: Strong wind blew sand across the coastal road all morning.
examples.zh: 整个上午，「风沙」一直吹过沿海公路。

words.enDefinition: weight to be borne or conveyed

examples.en: The van carried a heavy load of bricks to the site.
examples.zh: 面包车载着沉重的砖块「负荷」开往工地。

examples.en: Ease the heavy load carefully off your back before climbing.
examples.zh: 爬坡前先卸下背上的重「负」。

words.enDefinition: fastener fitted to a door or drawer to keep it firmly closed

examples.en: The old brass key snapped right inside the rusty lock.
examples.zh: 旧钥匙正好折断在生锈的「锁」里。

examples.en: Always check the door lock twice before leaving the workshop.
examples.zh: 离开车间前务必检查两遍「门锁」。

words.enDefinition: posture assumed by models for photographic or artistic purposes

examples.en: The wedding photographer asked her to change her pose slightly.
examples.zh: 摄影师请她稍稍换个「姿势」。

examples.en: He deliberately struck a funny pose for the family photo.
examples.zh: 拍全家福时他摆了个滑稽的「造型」。

words.enDefinition: humorous anecdote or remark intended to provoke laughter

examples.en: His joke about the weather broke the ice at dinner.
examples.zh: 他拿天气开的「玩笑」打破了晚餐的拘谨。

examples.en: Nobody really understood the joke, but everyone still laughed politely.
examples.zh: 没人真听懂那个「笑话」，但大家都礼貌地笑了。

words.enDefinition: fine powdery material such as dry earth or pollen that can be blown about in the air

examples.en: Grey dust gathered on the bookshelf over the long winter.
examples.zh: 漫长的冬天里，书架上积了「灰尘」。

examples.en: Wipe the dust off the plants with a damp cloth.
examples.zh: 用湿布擦掉植物上的「灰尘」。

words.enDefinition: very interested in and enthusiastic about something; eager

examples.en: She is keen on photography and joins every photo walk.
examples.zh: 她「热衷于」摄影，每次外拍都参加。

examples.en: He is a keen young swimmer, training before school daily.
examples.zh: 他是个「热心的」游泳爱好者，每天上学前训练。

words.enDefinition: the act of caressing with the lips (or an instance thereof)

examples.en: She gave her sleepy son a kiss on the forehead.
examples.zh: 她在睡眼惺忪的儿子额头上印下一个「吻」。

examples.en: The bride blew a kiss to her grandparents in the front row.
examples.zh: 新娘向前排的祖父母「飞吻」。

words.enDefinition: a sweet baked food made from flour, sugar, eggs and fat

examples.en: Mum baked a lovely lemon cake for the neighbours' party.
examples.zh: 妈妈为邻居聚会「烤」了一个柠檬「蛋糕」。

examples.en: The whole chocolate cake disappeared before the candles were lit.
examples.zh: 蜡烛还没点，巧克力「蛋糕」就被吃光了。

words.enDefinition: the top or extreme point of something (usually a mountain or hill)

examples.en: We reached the windy peak before the clouds rolled in.
examples.zh: 云层涌来之前，我们登上了「山顶」。

examples.en: The little hotel sits just below the mountain's snowy peak.
examples.zh: 酒店坐落在「山峰」雪线之下不远处。

words.enDefinition: (of skin or light) whitish and lacking colour

examples.en: He looked pale and shaky after the long ferry crossing.
examples.zh: 长时间乘船之后，他脸色「苍白」，身子发虚。

examples.en: The pale weak winter sun barely warmed the frozen garden.
examples.zh: 「苍白」的冬日阳光几乎暖不了冰冻的花园。

words.enDefinition: ligament made of metal and used to fasten things or make cages or fences etc

examples.en: The young electrician stripped the wire before joining the cables.
examples.zh: 电工剥开「电线」再接线。

examples.en: A loose blue wire sparked quietly behind the old television.
examples.zh: 旧电视机后面一根松动的「电线」悄悄打着火花。

words.enDefinition: belonging to or derived from or associated with a divine power

examples.en: The ancient holy festival fills the temple streets with music.
examples.zh: 「神圣的」节日让寺庙街道充满音乐。

examples.en: The pilgrims walked for days to reach the holy mountain.
examples.zh: 朝圣者们走了好几天才到达「圣山」。

words.enDefinition: either of two offspring born at the same time from the same pregnancy

examples.en: One twin is very quiet; the other never stops talking.
examples.zh: 这对「双胞胎」一个安静，另一个说个不停。

examples.en: As a twin, she shares birthdays, jokes, and even jumpers.
examples.zh: 作为「双胞胎」之一，她连生日、玩笑甚至毛衣都和妹妹共享。

words.enDefinition: an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that causes an event to result one way rather than another

examples.en: Finding that parking space by the market was pure luck.
examples.zh: 在市场旁找到那个车位纯属「运气」。

examples.en: Good luck with the interview tomorrow; you will be great.
examples.zh: 祝你明天面试「好运」，你一定行的。

words.enDefinition: payment or series of payments made by the lessee to an owner for use of some property, facility, equipment, or service

examples.en: The rent for the small flat includes all water charges.
examples.zh: 这套小公寓的「房租」包含全部水费。

examples.en: They split the monthly rent three ways to save money.
examples.zh: 为了省钱，他们三人平摊「租金」。

words.enDefinition: cover from sight

examples.en: The dog quickly buried its bone somewhere in the flowerbed.
examples.zh: 狗把「骨头」埋在了花坛的某个地方。

examples.en: The villagers buried the time capsule beneath the old oak.
examples.zh: 村民们在老橡树下「埋」下了时间胶囊。

words.enDefinition: a tube that carries water or gas from one place to another

examples.en: A burst water pipe flooded the kitchen on Sunday night.
examples.zh: 周日晚上，一根爆裂的「水管」淹了厨房。

examples.en: The local plumber replaced the rusty pipe under the sink.
examples.zh: 水管工更换了水槽下生锈的「管子」。

words.enDefinition: small pond of standing water

examples.en: The sheep grazed quietly beside the shallow mere at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分，羊群在浅「湖」边安静地吃草。

examples.en: A thin grey mist floated over the mere before sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出前，薄雾漂浮在小「湖」上。

words.enDefinition: emblem usually consisting of a rectangular piece of cloth of distinctive design

examples.en: The national flag flies above the town hall every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上，「国旗」都在市政厅上空飘扬。

examples.en: A red warning flag tells swimmers to stay away from the rocks.
examples.zh: 一面红旗「警示」游泳者远离礁石。

words.enDefinition: the natural satellite of the Earth

examples.en: The full moon rose over the lake just after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后不久，「月亮」从湖面升起。

examples.en: A bright full moon lit the whole valley that night.
examples.zh: 那晚，一轮「满月」照亮了整个山谷。

words.enDefinition: the yield from plants in a single growing season

examples.en: Wheat has been the main crop in this region for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来，小麦一直是这个地区的主要「农作物」。

examples.en: The farmers covered the young crop against the late frost.
examples.zh: 农民们盖住幼小的「庄稼」以防晚霜。

words.enDefinition: the rate of moving (especially walking or running)

examples.en: She set a slow steady pace for the long climb.
examples.zh: 长途攀登中她保持着平稳的「步速」。

examples.en: The whole town moves at a slower pace in August.
examples.zh: 八月里，这座小镇的节奏「慢」了下来。

words.enDefinition: a position in a scale of status or importance

examples.en: He joined the police and rose to the rank of inspector.
examples.zh: 他加入警队，一路升到了「警衔」中的督察级。

examples.en: In the army, his high rank earned him quiet respect.
examples.zh: 在军队里，他的「军衔」为他赢得了默默的敬重。

words.enDefinition: the bags of letters and packages that are transported by the postal service

examples.en: The mail reaches our small office around ten each morning.
examples.zh: 「邮件」每天早上十点左右送到我们办公室。

examples.en: There is a small parcel in today's mail for you.
examples.zh: 今天的「邮件」里有个给你的小包裹。

words.enDefinition: light shade of red

examples.en: The walls of the new nursery are painted soft pink.
examples.zh: 育婴室的墙刷成了柔和的「粉红色」。

examples.en: Pale pink cherry blossom covered the orchard in early April.
examples.zh: 四月初，「粉红色的」花覆盖了果园。

words.enDefinition: conduit consisting of a long hollow object (usually cylindrical) used to hold and conduct objects or liquids or gases

examples.en: Squeeze the very last of the toothpaste from the tube.
examples.zh: 把「牙膏管」里最后一点牙膏挤出来。

examples.en: The water travels through a clear plastic tube into the tank.
examples.zh: 水通过塑料「管」流进水箱。

words.enDefinition: plumbing fixture consisting of a water basin fixed to a wall or floor and having a drainpipe

examples.en: The dirty dishes piled up in the kitchen sink overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之间，脏盘子在厨房「水槽」里堆了起来。

examples.en: She rinsed the fresh lettuce leaves under the sink tap.
examples.zh: 她在「洗碗池」的水龙头下冲洗生菜叶。

words.enDefinition: the posterior part of the body of a vertebrate especially when elongated and extending beyond the trunk or main part of the body

examples.en: The dog wagged its tail the moment I came home.
examples.zh: 我一到家，狗就摇起了「尾巴」。

examples.en: The comet's glowing tail brightens as it nears the sun.
examples.zh: 彗星接近太阳时，「彗尾」会发光。

words.enDefinition: toothed wheel that engages another toothed mechanism in order to change the speed or direction of transmitted motion

examples.en: Shift down a gear before you reach the steep hill.
examples.zh: 到陡坡前先「换」低一「挡」。

examples.en: The bicycle's rear gear needs oil after the wet ride.
examples.zh: 雨骑之后，自行车的后「变速齿轮」需要上油。

words.enDefinition: swift whirling motion (usually of a missile)

examples.en: The skater finished her final spin with one arm raised.
examples.zh: 滑冰选手完成最后一个「旋转」时单臂上扬。

examples.en: The old washing machine's spin cycle is surprisingly quiet now.
examples.zh: 洗衣机的「甩干」转动现在安静得出奇。

words.enDefinition: hollow device made of metal that makes a ringing sound when struck

examples.en: The old bronze church bell rang eight times at noon.
examples.zh: 中午，古老的教堂「钟」敲了八下。

examples.en: A tiny brass bell hangs cheerfully above the shop door.
examples.zh: 店门上方挂着一只小铜「铃」。

words.enDefinition: grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished

examples.en: Rinse the rice very well twice before you cook it.
examples.zh: 煮之前把「米」淘洗两遍。

examples.en: Fried rice with fried egg is our Friday night tradition.
examples.zh: 蛋炒「饭」是我们周五夜晚的传统。

words.enDefinition: cook and make edible by putting in a hot oven

examples.en: We bake bread every Sunday morning in the stone oven.
examples.zh: 每周日早上我们都在石炉里「烤」面包。

examples.en: Mum likes to bake a cake for every family birthday.
examples.zh: 妈妈喜欢为每个家人生日「烘焙」一个蛋糕。

words.enDefinition: up to a particular time; until

examples.en: The little local museum stays open till eight on Fridays.
examples.zh: 周五这家小博物馆一直开放「到」八点。

examples.en: Wait right here till I fetch the tickets from the office.
examples.zh: 就在这里等着，「直到」我从办公室取来票。

words.enDefinition: an act or period of swimming

examples.en: Let us all go for a quick swim before lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭前我们去「游泳」一会儿吧。

examples.en: A short swim in the sea woke us all up.
examples.zh: 在海里「游」了一小会儿，大家都精神了。

words.enDefinition: large piece of fabric (usually canvas fabric) by means of which wind is used to propel a sailing vessel

examples.en: They raised the sail as soon as the boat left the dock.
examples.zh: 船一离开码头他们就「扬帆」了。

examples.en: A badly torn sail means a very slow trip home.
examples.zh: 「帆」破了，回家的航程就会很慢。

words.enDefinition: a small piece of land used for a particular purpose, such as growing vegetables

examples.en: Grandpa grows tomatoes on a small plot behind the sheds.
examples.zh: 爷爷在小屋后的一小块「地里」种番茄。

examples.en: They finally bought a building plot near the new school.
examples.zh: 他们买下了新学校附近的一块建筑「用地」。

words.enDefinition: collection of objects laid on top of each other

examples.en: There is a pile of unread letters on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌上堆着一「摞」没读的信。

examples.en: The happy kids jumped into the pile of raked leaves.
examples.zh: 孩子们跳进了耙成的一「堆堆」落叶里。

words.enDefinition: a friend or companion; someone who shares an activity with you

examples.en: He has been my best mate since we started primary school.
examples.zh: 从小学起他就是我最好的「伙伴」。

examples.en: My old mates from the football team meet every Saturday.
examples.zh: 足球队的「老伙伴们」每周六聚一次。

words.enDefinition: able to make good decisions using knowledge and experience

examples.en: It was a wise decision to insure the van early.
examples.zh: 早早给货车投保是个「明智的」决定。

examples.en: Grandma's wise advice saved us from a really bad contract.
examples.zh: 奶奶「明智的」建议让我们避开了一份糟糕的合同。

words.enDefinition: freedom from difficulty or hardship or effort

examples.en: He lifted the heavy box with surprising ease and speed.
examples.zh: 他「轻松」而敏捷地抬起了重箱子。

examples.en: The painkillers gave her enough ease to sleep at last.
examples.zh: 止痛药让她终于「轻松」得可以入睡。

words.enDefinition: characterized by or producing sound of great volume or intensity

examples.en: The very loud music from next door kept us awake.
examples.zh: 隔壁「大声的」音乐让我们睡不着。

examples.en: She gave a loud laugh that filled the whole cafe.
examples.zh: 她「响亮的」笑声充满了整间咖啡馆。

words.enDefinition: physical or mental damage or injury

examples.en: Smoking does real lasting harm to your lungs over time.
examples.zh: 吸烟日久对肺有实实在在的「伤害」。

examples.en: The weekend storm caused little harm to the harbour boats.
examples.zh: 风暴对港口船只几乎没有造成「损害」。

words.enDefinition: challenge to do something dangerous or foolhardy

examples.en: She accepted the dare and climbed to the top of the wall.
examples.zh: 她接受了这个「挑战」，爬到了墙顶。

examples.en: It started as a dare and ended with everyone in the fountain.
examples.zh: 这原本只是个「打赌式的挑衅」，结果人人都跳进了喷泉。

words.enDefinition: device in which something (usually an animal) can be caught and penned

examples.en: The patient hunter checked his traps at sunrise every day.
examples.zh: 猎人每天日出时查看他的「陷阱」。

examples.en: The final trick question was a trap for careless readers.
examples.zh: 这道刁钻的题是个抓粗心读者的「圈套」。

words.enDefinition: an organization of military vessels belonging to a country and available for sea warfare

examples.en: Her older brother serves in the navy on a destroyer.
examples.zh: 她哥哥在「海军」的一艘驱逐舰上服役。

examples.en: The navy helicopter rescued the fishermen during the night storm.
examples.zh: 夜间的风暴中，「海军」救起了渔民。

words.enDefinition: state of confusion and disorderliness

examples.en: What a terrible mess the puppies made of the newspaper!
examples.zh: 小狗把报纸弄得一团「糟」！

examples.en: His desk is always a mess of tools and sketches.
examples.zh: 他的书桌总是「乱七八糟」，堆满工具和草图。

words.enDefinition: to pursue and kill or catch wild animals; to search for something

examples.en: Barn owls hunt small animals across the fields at night.
examples.zh: 猫头鹰夜里在田野间「捕猎」小动物。

examples.en: Wolves hunt in packs at the edge of the forest.
examples.zh: 狼群在森林边缘结群「狩猎」。

words.enDefinition: something that resembles a tablet of medicine in shape or size

examples.en: Take one small white pill after each meal with water.
examples.zh: 每餐后用水服下一粒白色「药丸」。

examples.en: Grandma always keeps her morning pills in a labelled box.
examples.zh: 奶奶把早晨的「药丸」放在贴了标签的盒子里。

words.enDefinition: morally objectionable behavior

examples.en: In the old legend, the knight confronts an ancient evil.
examples.zh: 传说中，骑士直面一股古老的「邪恶」。

examples.en: Grandma always says gossip carries a little evil inside it.
examples.zh: 奶奶说闲话里藏着几分「恶意」。

words.enDefinition: an angular or rounded shape made by folding

examples.en: Make one sharp, clean fold along the dotted pencil line.
examples.zh: 沿虚线折出一道整齐的「折痕」。

examples.en: The linen dress falls in soft folds when she walks.
examples.zh: 她走路时，亚麻裙垂下柔软的「褶」。

words.enDefinition: piece of land where waste materials are dumped

examples.en: The old dump behind the farm takes garden waste only.
examples.zh: 农场后面那个旧「垃圾场」只收园林垃圾。

examples.en: Council lorries carry the town's rubbish to the dump at dawn.
examples.zh: 市政卡车清晨把全镇的垃圾运往「垃圾场」。

words.enDefinition: succession of notes forming a distinctive sequence

examples.en: He hummed the theme tune of the cartoon all day.
examples.zh: 他一整天都哼着那部动画片主题曲的「曲调」。

examples.en: She played a simple folk tune on her new flute.
examples.zh: 她用新长笛吹了一支简单的民歌「小调」。

words.enDefinition: catch for locking a door

examples.en: Hang your wet towel on the brass hook by the shower.
examples.zh: 把湿毛巾挂在淋浴间旁边的铜「挂钩」上。

examples.en: The rusty gate hook rattles whenever the wind picks up.
examples.zh: 一起风，院门的「挂钩」就叮当作响。

words.enDefinition: clean or organized

examples.en: Her handwriting is neat enough to read at a glance.
examples.zh: 她的字迹很「工整」，一眼就能看清。

examples.en: Keep the whole tool bench neat after every single repair.
examples.zh: 每次修理完都要把工具台收拾「整齐」。

words.enDefinition: a thick slice of meat with a bone in it, such as a pork or lamb chop

examples.en: Grill the lamb chops about six minutes on each side.
examples.zh: 羊「排」每面大约烤六分钟。

examples.en: Dad seasoned the thick pork chop with rosemary and thyme.
examples.zh: 爸爸用迷迭香和百里香给猪「排」调味。

words.enDefinition: the back of a military formation or procession

examples.en: The garden at the rear of the cottage gets evening sun.
examples.zh: 小屋「后面」的花园照得到夕阳。

examples.en: Load the bikes through the rear door of the van.
examples.zh: 把自行车从面包车的「后门」装进去。

words.enDefinition: musical percussion instrument; usually consists of a hollow cylinder with a membrane stretched across each end

examples.en: The festival drum could be heard across the whole field.
examples.zh: 整个田野都能听到节庆的「鼓」声。

examples.en: He practises the drum in the garage to spare the neighbours.
examples.zh: 他在车库里练「鼓」，免得吵到邻居。

words.enDefinition: a state of peace and quiet; stillness of wind or water

examples.en: A strange calm settled over the harbour before the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴来临前，海港上空笼罩着一种奇特的「平静」。

examples.en: The early morning mountain lake lay in perfect, windless calm.
examples.zh: 清晨的湖面一片完美的「平静」，没有风。

words.enDefinition: an irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction

examples.en: The overnight fire left the old barn in complete ruin.
examples.zh: 大火让旧谷仓彻底「毁灭」。

examples.en: The misty abbey ruins attract photographers every year in autumn.
examples.zh: 每年秋天，修道院「废墟」都会吸引摄影师。

words.enDefinition: the point at which a liquid bubbles and turns to steam

examples.en: Bring the water to a fast boil before adding pasta.
examples.zh: 下意面前先把水烧到大「沸」。

examples.en: Watch the pot; the boil comes quickly on high heat.
examples.zh: 看好锅，大火时很快就「煮沸」。

words.enDefinition: get healthy again

examples.en: Clean the small cut well so it can heal quickly.
examples.zh: 把伤口洗净，好让它快点「愈合」。

examples.en: Her scraped knee healed quickly without any scar at all.
examples.zh: 她擦伤的膝盖「痊愈」了，一点疤都没留。

words.enDefinition: bag made of paper or plastic for holding customer's purchases

examples.en: Carry all the potatoes home in this strong paper sack.
examples.zh: 用这个结实的纸「袋」把土豆带回家。

examples.en: A whole sack of rice arrived for the food bank.
examples.zh: 一整「袋」大米送到了食物银行。

words.enDefinition: a medicine or treatment that makes an illness go away completely

examples.en: The researchers hope this new drug will truly cure patients.
examples.zh: 研究人员希望这种新药能真正「治愈」病人。

examples.en: There is still no real cure for the common cold.
examples.zh: 目前仍然没有「治愈」普通感冒的办法。

words.enDefinition: an informal conversation

examples.en: We had a long chat on the bench after the walk.
examples.zh: 散步之后，我们在长椅上「闲聊」了很久。

examples.en: A friendly morning chat with the baker starts every Saturday.
examples.zh: 每个周六都是从和面包师的友好「闲谈」开始的。

words.enDefinition: excavation in the earth from which ores and minerals are extracted

examples.en: Grandpa once worked in the coal mine beside the river.
examples.zh: 爷爷在河边那座「煤矿」工作过。

examples.en: The abandoned old silver mine opens for tours each summer.
examples.zh: 那座老「银矿」每年夏天开放参观。

words.enDefinition: put an end to a state or an activity

examples.en: He finally quit smoking completely after his daughter was born.
examples.zh: 女儿出生后，他终于「戒」了烟。

examples.en: She quit the accounting job last year to teach sailing.
examples.zh: 她「辞掉」了会计工作，去教帆船。

words.enDefinition: liquid food especially of meat or fish or vegetable stock often containing pieces of solid food

examples.en: Grandma's chicken soup warms the whole family on cold evenings.
examples.zh: 冷夜里，奶奶的鸡「汤」温暖着全家。

examples.en: Ladle the hot vegetable soup into bowls before it cools.
examples.zh: 趁热把「汤」舀进碗里，别让它凉了。

words.enDefinition: the bottom of a shoe or boot; the back part of a shoe or boot that touches the ground and provides elevation

examples.en: The heel of my new boot rubs on long walks.
examples.zh: 走远路时，我新「靴子」的「后跟」磨脚。

examples.en: She carefully fixed the broken heel with glue and patience.
examples.zh: 她用胶水和耐心修好了断掉的「鞋跟」。

words.enDefinition: belonging to or associated with a female person or animal previously mentioned

examples.en: That red umbrella by the door is hers, not mine.
examples.zh: 门边那把红伞是「她的」，不是我的。

examples.en: The whole garden idea was hers from the very beginning.
examples.zh: 整个主意从一开始就是「她的」。

words.enDefinition: portable shelter (usually of canvas stretched over supporting poles and fastened to the ground with ropes and pegs)

examples.en: Pitch the tent on flat ground away from the stream.
examples.zh: 把「帐篷」搭在离溪流远的平地上。

examples.en: A gust of wind flattened the old tent at midnight.
examples.zh: 半夜一阵风把旧「帐篷」吹塌了。

words.enDefinition: fine soft fibre produced by silkworms; cloth made from it

examples.en: The soft scarf is pure silk, a gift from Suzhou.
examples.zh: 这条围巾是真「丝」的，苏州带来的礼物。

examples.en: Real silk feels cool in summer and warm in winter.
examples.zh: 「丝」夏天摸着凉，冬天摸着暖。

words.enDefinition: sound recording consisting of a disk with a continuous groove; used to reproduce music by rotating while a phonograph needle tracks in the groove

examples.en: Grandpa still plays his jazz discs on the old gramophone.
examples.zh: 爷爷用老式留声机放他的爵士「唱片」。

examples.en: The installation disc sits in the drawer with the manuals.
examples.zh: 安装「光盘」和说明书一起放在抽屉里。

words.enDefinition: displeasing to the senses

examples.en: The ugly fence finally got a coat of green paint.
examples.zh: 那道「丑陋的」栅栏终于刷上了绿漆。

examples.en: An ugly public dispute split the club into two groups.
examples.zh: 一场「难堪的」争执让俱乐部分裂成两派。

words.enDefinition: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere

examples.en: Hail a passing taxi at the rank outside the station.
examples.zh: 在站外的候车点招一辆「出租车」。

examples.en: The chatty taxi driver knew a shortcut past the traffic.
examples.zh: 「出租车」司机知道一条避开拥堵的近路。

words.enDefinition: an artificial source of visible illumination

examples.en: The small desk lamp casts just enough light for reading.
examples.zh: 「台灯」的光正好够读书用。

examples.en: A hurricane lamp lit the porch during the power cut.
examples.zh: 停电时，一盏防风「灯」照亮了门廊。

words.enDefinition: to make fabric or clothes with long needles and wool

examples.en: Grandma will knit a scarf for each grandchild this winter.
examples.zh: 今年冬天奶奶要给每个孙辈「织」一条围巾。

examples.en: Learn to knit first with thick needles and chunky wool.
examples.zh: 用粗针和粗毛线学「编织」。

words.enDefinition: reduce or cause to be reduced from a solid to a liquid state, usually by heating

examples.en: The spring melt fills the streams with cold clear water.
examples.zh: 春季「融雪」让溪流灌满冰冷清澈的水。

examples.en: The summer melt of the glacier feeds the valley farms.
examples.zh: 「冰川融水」滋养着山谷的农田。

words.enDefinition: the meat of a cow, eaten as food

examples.en: The Sunday family stew needs two pounds of lean beef.
examples.zh: 周日炖菜需要两磅「牛肉」。

examples.en: He ordered sliced roast beef with vegetables at the carvery.
examples.zh: 他在烤肉店点了烤「牛肉」配蔬菜。

words.enDefinition: a thin sharp piece of metal hammered into wood to fix things together

examples.en: Hammer each nail firmly into the fence panel before painting.
examples.zh: 刷漆前把每颗「钉子」牢牢钉进围栏板。

examples.en: A loose nail caught his sleeve on the shed door.
examples.zh: 小屋门上一颗松动的「钉子」挂住了他的袖子。

words.enDefinition: draw into the mouth by creating a practical vacuum in the mouth

examples.en: The hungry newborn calf sucked milk eagerly from the bucket.
examples.zh: 新生小牛急切地从桶里「吸」奶。

examples.en: The vacuum sucks dust from every corner of the rug.
examples.zh: 吸尘器把地毯每个角落的灰尘都「吸」走。

words.enDefinition: a hard pointed growth on the heads of cattle, goats, and similar animals

examples.en: The wild mountain goat's horn is ridged along its length.
examples.zh: 山羊的「角」上有一道道棱纹。

examples.en: The bull lowered its horns and pawed the dusty ground.
examples.zh: 公牛低下「角」，用蹄刨着尘土。

words.enDefinition: cutlery used for serving and eating food

examples.en: Use a large fork to fluff the rice before serving.
examples.zh: 上桌前用「叉子」把米饭拨松。

examples.en: The best fork for the cake is the silver one.
examples.zh: 吃蛋糕最好用的「叉子」是那把银的。

words.enDefinition: an opening that permits escape or release

examples.en: Follow the glowing green signs to reach the nearest exit.
examples.zh: 跟着发亮的绿色标志走到最近的「出口」。

examples.en: The old cinema's side exit opens onto a quiet lane.
examples.zh: 电影院的侧面「出口」通向一条安静的小巷。

words.enDefinition: not sharp; unable to cut well

examples.en: This bread knife is too dull to slice the loaf.
examples.zh: 这把面包「刀」太「钝」，切不动整条面包。

examples.en: The kitchen scissors went dull after years of cutting cardboard.
examples.zh: 剪了多年硬纸板后，剪刀「钝」了。

words.enDefinition: an unfortunate development

examples.en: What a pity our picnic clashed with the town parade.
examples.zh: 野餐和游行撞期，真「可惜」。

examples.en: She took pity on the shivering stray and fed it.
examples.zh: 她「可怜」那只发抖的流浪猫，喂了它。

words.enDefinition: slight wetness

examples.en: The cold cellar walls stay damp all through the summer.
examples.zh: 整个夏天，地窖的墙都「潮湿」。

examples.en: Wipe the damp off the windows before the mould spreads.
examples.zh: 趁发霉前把窗上的「潮气」擦掉。

words.enDefinition: structure in which animals lay eggs or give birth to their young

examples.en: A thrush built its nest in the hedge beside the gate.
examples.zh: 一只画眉在门旁的树篱里筑了「巢」。

examples.en: The mother blackbird guarded her nest from the noisy jays.
examples.zh: 鸟妈妈守护着自己的「巢」，防着吵闹的松鸦。

words.enDefinition: set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge

examples.en: The final history exam starts at nine sharp on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一九点整开始历史「考试」。

examples.en: She finally passed the driving exam on her third try.
examples.zh: 她第三次尝试才通过驾驶「考试」。

words.enDefinition: (physics and chemistry) the smallest component of an element having the chemical properties of the element

examples.en: The science teacher showed us a model of an atom.
examples.zh: 科学老师给我们看了「原子」模型。

examples.en: Tiny atoms join together to form every substance around us.
examples.zh: 「原子」结合在一起，构成了我们身边的所有物质。

words.enDefinition: hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot; worn inside the shoe; reaches to between the ankle and the knee

examples.en: There is a hole in the heel of my sock.
examples.zh: 我的「袜子」脚跟处破了个洞。

examples.en: Woollen socks keep the hikers warm through the wet night.
examples.zh: 羊毛「袜」让徒步者在湿冷的夜里保持温暖。

words.enDefinition: cleansing agent made from the salts of vegetable or animal fats

examples.en: This simple glycerine soap is gentle enough for sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 这种甘油「皂」对敏感肌足够温和。

examples.en: Lather the soap up really well before rinsing the paintbrushes.
examples.zh: 洗画笔前先把「肥皂」充分打出泡沫。

words.enDefinition: mathematical element that when added to another number yields the same number

examples.en: The old garden thermometer hit zero just before dawn today.
examples.zh: 今天黎明前，花园温度计降到了「零度」。

examples.en: The new recruits started from zero, with no field experience.
examples.zh: 新队员们从「零」开始，没有任何实地经验。

words.enDefinition: a small hard swelling, or a shapeless piece of something

examples.en: She added a lump of butter to the hot vegetables.
examples.zh: 她往热蔬菜里加了一小「块」黄油。

examples.en: The doctor checked the small lump on his neck at once.
examples.zh: 医生立刻检查了他脖子上的小「肿块」。

words.enDefinition: the thick rubber ring fitted around a wheel, especially of a car or bicycle

examples.en: A flat tyre stranded us two miles from the campsite.
examples.zh: 一只「轮胎」瘪了，把我们困在离营地两英里的地方。

examples.en: Check the tyre pressure carefully before the long motorway drive.
examples.zh: 上高速长途前检查「轮胎」气压。

words.enDefinition: the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed

examples.en: The little bakery's fame spread quickly after the television visit.
examples.zh: 电视节目来过之后，小面包店的「名气」迅速传开。

examples.en: She sought neither money nor lasting fame from the research.
examples.zh: 她做这项研究既不图钱也不图「名」。

words.enDefinition: to bite food several times before swallowing it

examples.en: Chew each small mouthful slowly and carefully to help digestion.
examples.zh: 每一口都慢慢「咀嚼」，有助消化。

examples.en: The new puppy chewed the old slipper beyond recognition overnight.
examples.zh: 小狗一夜之间把拖鞋「嚼」得面目全非。

words.enDefinition: be obedient to

examples.en: Well-trained family dogs obey these simple voice commands almost immediately.
examples.zh: 训练有素的家犬几乎立刻就「服从」这些简单指令。

examples.en: Everyone must obey the safety rules on the building site.
examples.zh: 在工地上人人都要「遵守」安全规则。

words.enDefinition: tight cluster of people or things

examples.en: Tie a tight double knot so the parcel stays shut.
examples.zh: 打个双「结」，包裹就不会松开。

examples.en: A small knot of neighbours gathered at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 一小「群」邻居聚在公交站。

words.enDefinition: having a sharp acid taste like a lemon; (of milk) gone off

examples.en: The homemade lemonade is too sour without plenty of extra sugar.
examples.zh: 不多加糖的话，自制柠檬水太「酸」。

examples.en: The milk has gone completely sour in this summer heat.
examples.zh: 这么热的天，牛奶「馊」出酸味了。

words.enDefinition: blockage consisting of an object designed to fill a hole tightly

examples.en: Pull the rubber bath plug out before the water overflows.
examples.zh: 水要溢出前把浴缸「塞子」拔掉。

examples.en: Fit the rubber plug tightly into the basin's drain hole.
examples.zh: 把橡胶「塞子」紧紧塞进水池的排水孔。

words.enDefinition: socially incorrect in behavior

examples.en: It is rude to check your phone at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 吃饭时看手机很「无礼」。

examples.en: The clerk was never rude, even to the impatient customers.
examples.zh: 那位店员从不「粗鲁」，即使对不耐烦的顾客也是。

words.enDefinition: person with fair skin and hair

examples.en: Her blonde hair caught the warm late afternoon sunlight perfectly.
examples.zh: 她的「金发」映着午后暖阳。

examples.en: The blonde toddler waved cheerfully at every passer-by in the park.
examples.zh: 那个「金发的」小娃娃在公园里欢快地向每个路人挥手。

words.enDefinition: firm and making a pleasant sharp sound when bitten or crushed

examples.en: The orchard's fresh early apples are wonderfully crisp this season.
examples.zh: 这个季节果园的新鲜苹果「脆」得妙极了。

examples.en: She likes her toast crisp, almost golden at the edges.
examples.zh: 她喜欢吐司烤得「酥脆」，边缘接近金黄。

words.enDefinition: not willing to work or be active

examples.en: The lazy old cat sleeps on the radiator all afternoon.
examples.zh: 「懒猫」整个下午都睡在暖气片上。

examples.en: We spent a lazy summer Sunday reading on the porch.
examples.zh: 我们在门廊上看书，过了个「懒洋洋的」周日。

words.enDefinition: capable or worthy of being perceived

examples.en: There is a clearly noticeable difference between the two photos.
examples.zh: 两张照片之间有「明显的」差别。

examples.en: His big improvement in maths was noticeable within one term.
examples.zh: 一学期之内，他数学的进步就「看得出来」。

words.enDefinition: (of a body part) painful and sensitive; aching

examples.en: My throat is really sore after cheering at the match.
examples.zh: 在赛场上呐喊助威之后，我的「嗓子疼」。

examples.en: Heavy weekend gym sessions always leave her arms pleasantly sore.
examples.zh: 大重量训练日过后，她的手臂总会有些「酸痛」。

words.enDefinition: neat and arranged in good order

examples.en: Your desk looks wonderfully tidy after the big weekend sort-out.
examples.zh: 大扫除之后，你的书桌看起来格外「整洁」。

examples.en: Keep the tool shed tidy so everything is easy to find.
examples.zh: 把工具棚收拾「整齐」，这样找东西就方便了。

words.enDefinition: the sound made by something moving rapidly or by steam coming out of a small aperture

examples.en: The referee's sharp whistle stopped the match for a foul.
examples.zh: 裁判的「哨声」因一次犯规中止了比赛。

examples.en: He taught the young boys to whistle with two fingers.
examples.zh: 他教男孩子们用两根手指「吹口哨」。

words.enDefinition: deliberately offensive act or something producing the effect of deliberate disrespect

examples.en: Calling the stew watery was an insult to the chef.
examples.zh: 说炖菜太稀是对厨师的「侮辱」。

examples.en: He simply shrugged off the insult and kept serving customers.
examples.zh: 他对「羞辱」一笑置之，继续招呼客人。

words.enDefinition: an edge between a sidewalk and a roadway consisting of a line of curbstones (usually forming part of a gutter)

examples.en: Park parallel to the curb and leave the ramp clear.
examples.zh: 与「路缘」平行停车，把坡道口留出来。

examples.en: The kids sat on the curb sharing a bag of chips.
examples.zh: 孩子们坐在「马路牙子」上分吃一包薯条。

words.enDefinition: open and genuine; not deceitful

examples.en: Please accept our sincere thanks for the very prompt repairs.
examples.zh: 请接受我们对及时维修的「诚挚」感谢。

examples.en: Her sincere apology finally ended the week-long silence between them.
examples.zh: 她「真诚的」道歉终于结束了长达一周的冷战。

words.enDefinition: happening by chance; not planned or intended

examples.en: The stained tablecloth was accidental, so nobody blamed the child.
examples.zh: 桌布上的污渍是「意外」弄的，没人怪孩子。

examples.en: Their accidental meeting at the ferry turned into a friendship.
examples.zh: 他们在渡口的「偶然」相遇发展成了一段友谊。

words.enDefinition: not causing or capable of causing harm

examples.en: The garden spiders here are completely harmless, despite their size.
examples.zh: 尽管个头大，这里的花园蜘蛛是「无害的」。

examples.en: One harmless little joke at the party made everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 聚会上一个「无伤大雅的」玩笑逗笑了所有人。

words.enDefinition: cavity or space in something

examples.en: An owl sleeps in the hollow of the old beech tree.
examples.zh: 一只猫头鹰睡在老山毛榉的「树洞」里。

examples.en: The stone path crosses a hollow where mist always gathers.
examples.zh: 小路穿过一个总是积雾的「洼地」。

words.enDefinition: restless or short-tempered under delay or opposition

examples.en: The toddler grew impatient waiting for the kettle to boil.
examples.zh: 等水烧开时，幼儿变得「不耐烦」。

examples.en: Try not to be too impatient with the first-time skaters.
examples.zh: 对第一次滑冰的人尽量别「急躁」。

words.enDefinition: cause to be embarrassed; cause to feel self-conscious

examples.en: Please do not embarrass the new waiter in front of guests.
examples.zh: 请不要在客人面前让新「服务员难堪」。

examples.en: Old baby photos always embarrass my brother at family gatherings.
examples.zh: 家庭聚会上，老照片总让我哥哥「尴尬」。

words.enDefinition: cement consisting of a sticky substance that is used as an adhesive

examples.en: Spread the wood glue thinly on both edges before pressing.
examples.zh: 按压前在两个边缘薄薄涂一层「胶」。

examples.en: The special glue dried clear, so the repair is invisible.
examples.zh: 「胶水」干后是透明的，修补处看不出来。

words.enDefinition: strong feelings of dislike

examples.en: She wiped the counter with clear disgust at the spilt milk.
examples.zh: 她带着明显的「厌恶」擦掉洒出的牛奶。

examples.en: The state of the changing rooms filled the coach with disgust.
examples.zh: 更衣室的状态让教练满心「反感」。

words.enDefinition: piece of clothing covering the body from the waist to the ankles, with a separate part for each leg

examples.en: Fold the clean pants before they wrinkle in the basket.
examples.zh: 趁干净「裤子」还没在篮子里起皱就叠好。

examples.en: He bought tough waterproof pants for the muddy trail race.
examples.zh: 他为泥泞的越野赛买了防水「长裤」。

words.enDefinition: person who drinks alcohol to excess habitually

examples.en: The outreach team helps every alcoholic who asks for support.
examples.zh: 帮扶团队帮助每一位寻求支持的「酒鬼」。

examples.en: Uncle Ted stopped drinking years ago and now helps other alcoholics.
examples.zh: 泰德叔叔多年前戒了酒，如今帮助其他「酗酒者」。

words.enDefinition: excite to an abnormal condition, or chafe or inflame

examples.en: His constant drumming on the table irritates everyone at study group.
examples.zh: 他不停敲桌子，「惹恼」了学习小组的所有人。

examples.en: Rough cheap woollen scarves tend to irritate really sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 粗糙的羊毛围巾容易「刺激」特别敏感的皮肤。

words.enDefinition: kind of pain; something as sudden and painful as being stung

examples.en: A single bee sting swelled his wrist for two days.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂「蜇伤」让他的手腕肿了两天。

examples.en: Salt in a fresh open cut carries a sharp sting.
examples.zh: 盐撒进伤口会有尖锐的「刺痛」。

words.enDefinition: affect with wonder

examples.en: The magician's card tricks never fail to amaze the kids.
examples.zh: 魔术师的纸牌戏法总能「惊艳」孩子们。

examples.en: It will truly amaze you how fast the seedlings grow.
examples.zh: 幼苗长得有多快会令你「吃惊」。

words.enDefinition: almost exact but not completely accurate

examples.en: Give me the approximate total cost before we order materials.
examples.zh: 订材料前先给我「大约的」费用。

examples.en: The approximate arrival time is six fifteen, road traffic allowing.
examples.zh: 在不堵车的情况下，「大概」六点一刻到。

words.enDefinition: massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws

examples.en: A hungry black bear wandered through the campsite last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一只黑「熊」在营地附近游荡。

examples.en: Never feed a wild black bear, however harmless it seems.
examples.zh: 无论野「熊」看起来多无害，都不要喂它。

words.enDefinition: a person who is older, or higher in rank or standing

examples.en: The senior club players lead the warm-up before each match.
examples.zh: 「资历深」的队员在每场比赛前带热身。

examples.en: Respect your seniors at the club, even the quiet ones.
examples.zh: 在俱乐部要尊重「前辈」，连沉默寡言的也要尊重。

words.enDefinition: without deviation

examples.en: The morning bus goes directly to the museum without changes.
examples.zh: 这班公交「直达」博物馆，不用换乘。

examples.en: She looked directly at the jury while giving her answer.
examples.zh: 回答时她「直视着」陪审团。

words.enDefinition: to find the total number of things or people; to include something when calculating

examples.en: Count the change carefully before you leave the market stall.
examples.zh: 离开摊位前仔细「数清」找零。

examples.en: Every single vote counts in this very close club election.
examples.zh: 在这次势均力敌的俱乐部选举中，每一票都「算数」。
