words.enDefinition: in an anxiously nervous manner

examples.en: The puppy waited nervously by the door during its first thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 第一次遇上雷暴，小狗「紧张地」守在门边。

examples.en: She checked the oven nervously every five minutes before the judges arrived.
examples.zh: 评委到来前，她每五分钟就「不安地」查看一次烤箱。

words.enDefinition: annoy continually or chronically

examples.en: Residents asked the council to stop the calls that harass elderly people at dinner.
examples.zh: 居民们请求市政制止那些在晚餐时间「骚扰」老人的电话。

examples.en: The boss was fined for trying to harass workers into unpaid weekend shifts.
examples.zh: 老板因不断「骚扰」员工、强要周末无偿加班而被罚款。

words.enDefinition: using aggressive methods to support a cause

examples.en: The militant faction refused any compromise with the ferry company.
examples.zh: 那一「好战的」派系拒绝与轮渡公司作任何妥协。

examples.en: His militant defence of the harbour wall won over the younger fishermen.
examples.zh: 他「强硬激进的」防波堤保卫主张赢得了年轻渔民的拥护。

words.enDefinition: specific form of evildoing

examples.en: Gambling was the vice that emptied the eldest brother's farm savings.
examples.zh: 赌博这个「恶习」掏空了大哥的农场积蓄。

examples.en: The village had few vices beyond gossip and the occasional card game.
examples.zh: 村里除了闲言碎语和偶尔打牌，几乎没有别的「恶习」。

words.enDefinition: with anxiety or apprehension

examples.en: Parents waited anxiously outside the exam hall until the last bell.
examples.zh: 家长们「焦急地」在考场外守到最后一遍铃响。

examples.en: The fisherman watched anxiously as the storm clouds gathered over the bay.
examples.zh: 乌云在港湾上空聚拢，渔民「忧心忡忡地」注视着。

words.enDefinition: to a faint degree or weakly perceived

examples.en: Music played faintly from the harbour cafe as the boats came in.
examples.zh: 渔船归港时，港口咖啡馆的音乐「隐隐约约地」传来。

examples.en: The old photograph showed the church tower only faintly through the fog.
examples.zh: 雾气里，老照片上的教堂钟楼只「隐约可辨」。

words.enDefinition: roll of photographic film holding a series of frames to be projected by a movie projector

examples.en: Grandfather threads the film reel onto the projector with steady hands.
examples.zh: 爷爷手法平稳，把电影「胶片盘」装上放映机。

examples.en: The fishing reel squeaks when the mackerel pull hard on the line.
examples.zh: 鲭鱼猛拽钓线时，渔线「卷线轮」会吱吱作响。

words.enDefinition: without justice or fairness

examples.en: The letter was wrongly delivered to the bakery instead of the school.
examples.zh: 那封信被「误投」到了面包房，而不是学校。

examples.en: He was wrongly blamed for the broken gate until the neighbours spoke up.
examples.zh: 邻居开口澄清前，损坏的大门一直被「错怪」到他头上。

words.enDefinition: in a cheerful manner

examples.en: The baker greets every customer cheerfully, even at five in the morning.
examples.zh: 哪怕清晨五点，面包师傅也「乐呵呵地」招呼每位顾客。

examples.en: She cheerfully admits that her first loaf was hard as a brick.
examples.zh: 她「爽快地」承认，自己烤的第一条面包硬得像砖头。

words.enDefinition: in a cold unemotional manner

examples.en: The clerk answered coldly, so we took our complaint to the manager.
examples.zh: 职员回话「冷冰冰的」，我们便向经理投诉。

examples.en: The wind blew coldly across the pier all through the fishing season.
examples.zh: 整个捕鱼季，海风都在码头上「冷冷地」吹着。

words.enDefinition: the official currency of the euro area, used by eurozone members of the European Union

examples.en: The ferry tickets cost forty euro for two bicycles included.
examples.zh: 连两辆自行车在内，轮渡票一共四十「欧元」。

examples.en: The stall accepts euro cash but prefers the local card payment.
examples.zh: 摊位收「欧元」现金，但更希望刷本地银行卡。

words.enDefinition: with impatience; in an impatient manner

examples.en: The children waited impatiently for the ice-cream van to turn the corner.
examples.zh: 孩子们「不耐烦地」等着冰淇淋车拐过街角。

examples.en: He tapped his fingers impatiently while the printer slowly warmed up.
examples.zh: 打印机慢慢预热时，他不「耐烦地」敲着手指。

words.enDefinition: with confidence; in a confident manner

examples.en: She confidently ordered dinner in Portuguese on the first evening abroad.
examples.zh: 出国头一晚，她就「自信地」用葡萄牙语点了菜。

examples.en: The young skipper confidently steered the ferry into the narrow harbour mouth.
examples.zh: 年轻的船长「沉着地」把轮渡驶进狭窄的港口入口。

words.enDefinition: in a generous manner

examples.en: The farmer generously gave the choir a crate of apples for the concert.
examples.zh: 农场主「慷慨地」送给合唱团一箱苹果，供音乐会用。

examples.en: They generously opened their garden to the neighbours every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天他们都「大方地」向邻居们开放自家花园。

words.enDefinition: in a cheap manner

examples.en: You can eat cheaply at the workers' canteen near the station.
examples.zh: 在车站附近的工人食堂吃饭很「便宜」。

examples.en: The shed was built cheaply from leftover pallets and old corrugated iron.
examples.zh: 这个棚子用剩余托盘和旧瓦楞铁皮「低成本地」搭了起来。

words.enDefinition: in a cheerful manner

examples.en: The guests chatted pleasantly on the terrace until the candles burned low.
examples.zh: 客人们在露台上「愉快地」闲谈，直到蜡烛烧短。

examples.en: The innkeeper pleasantly waived the extra charge for the late arrival.
examples.zh: 客栈老板「和气地」免掉了晚到的加收费用。

words.enDefinition: in a stiff manner

examples.en: The new boots made him walk stiffly for the first week.
examples.zh: 新靴子让他头一周走路都「僵硬」。

examples.en: The old major bowed stiffly to the memorial and laid his wreath.
examples.zh: 年迈的少校「僵硬地」向纪念碑鞠躬，献上了花圈。

words.enDefinition: in an unfair manner

examples.en: The referee unfairly booked our keeper for something he never did.
examples.zh: 裁判「不公平地」给我们门将出牌，他根本没做那事。

examples.en: Rents rise unfairly fast in villages near the new ferry terminal.
examples.zh: 轮渡码头附近的村庄，房租涨得「不合理地」快。

words.enDefinition: spoken with poor articulation as if with a thick tongue

examples.en: Grandmother spread the butter thickly on the warm crusty loaf.
examples.zh: 奶奶在温热的脆皮面包上「厚厚地」抹了一层黄油。

examples.en: The fog lay thickly over the harbour until nearly noon.
examples.zh: 浓雾「厚厚地」笼罩港口，快到中午才散。

words.enDefinition: hand-held mobile radiotelephone for use in an area divided into small sections, each with its own short-range transmitter/receiver

examples.en: Leave your cellphone in the locker before entering the pool area.
examples.zh: 进泳池区前，把「手机」存在储物柜里。

examples.en: Her old cellphone still works, though the screen has a crack.
examples.zh: 她那部旧「手机」还能用，只是屏幕裂了道缝。

words.enDefinition: to treat someone unfairly or make them suffer

examples.en: The law protects workers so employers cannot victimize those who report dangers.
examples.zh: 法律保护劳动者，雇主不得「迫害」上报安全隐患的员工。

examples.en: Referees promise that no player will be victimized for reporting abuse.
examples.zh: 裁判们承诺，任何举报侵扰行为的球员都不会被「刁难」。

words.enDefinition: not according to nature; not by natural means

examples.en: The pond is artificially stocked with trout every spring for the children.
examples.zh: 池塘每年春天都「人工投放」鳟鱼，供孩子们垂钓。

examples.en: The flowers looked artificially bright under the strong exhibition lights.
examples.zh: 展灯强光下，那些花的颜色显得「人工雕琢般」鲜艳。

words.enDefinition: in a steep manner

examples.en: The path rises steeply for the first mile, then flattens out.
examples.zh: 小路头一英里「陡峭地」爬升，之后就变平了。

examples.en: Ferry prices rose steeply after the harbour was privatised last year.
examples.zh: 去年港口私营化后，轮渡票价「急剧」上涨。

words.enDefinition: strike with disgust or revulsion

examples.en: The condition of the abandoned orphanage will appal any visitor.
examples.zh: 那座废弃孤儿院的惨状会让任何来访者「震惊」。

examples.en: The waste dumped beside the stream appalled the morning anglers.
examples.zh: 倒在小溪旁的垃圾让清晨的垂钓者「大为骇然」。

words.enDefinition: state characterized by emotions ranging from mild discontentment to deep grief

examples.en: There was quiet unhappiness in the village after the ferry line closed.
examples.zh: 轮渡航线停开后，村子里弥漫着一种无声的「不快」。

examples.en: Her letter home hid the unhappiness of the first winter abroad.
examples.zh: 她写给家里的信，藏起了出国头一个冬天的「苦闷」。

words.enDefinition: without expression; in a blank manner

examples.en: The new waiter stared blankly at our order in dialect.
examples.zh: 新来的侍者「茫然地」盯着我们用方言报的菜名。

examples.en: When asked about the missing oars, the boys just shrugged blankly.
examples.zh: 问起丢失的船桨，男孩们只是「一脸茫然地」耸耸肩。

words.enDefinition: subject to change or variation

examples.en: The old ladder felt unsteady against the wet barn wall.
examples.zh: 那架旧梯子靠在湿漉漉的谷仓墙上，「晃晃悠悠」的。

examples.en: Her unsteady first steps after the surgery delighted the whole ward.
examples.zh: 手术后她「踉跄的」头几步，让整个病房都高兴起来。

words.enDefinition: in an unwilling manner

examples.en: The cat left the warm windowsill unwillingly when the supper bowl rang.
examples.zh: 晚饭碗一响，猫才「不情愿地」离开温暖的窗台。

examples.en: He unwillingly admitted that the new ferry timetable suited nobody.
examples.zh: 他「勉强地」承认，新的轮渡时刻表谁都不合适。

words.enDefinition: in an impolite manner

examples.en: The tourist rudely pushed past the queue for the harbour ferry.
examples.zh: 那名游客「粗鲁地」插队挤上了港口轮渡。

examples.en: Stop rudely interrupting your grandmother when she tells the story properly.
examples.zh: 奶奶好好讲故事时，别「无礼地」打断她。

words.enDefinition: someone who takes part in an activity

examples.en: Each participant in the bread course takes home two loaves.
examples.zh: 面包课的每位「学员」都可以带两条面包回家。

examples.en: Every participant receives a printed map of the coastal walk.
examples.zh: 每位「参加者」都会拿到一张海岸步道的印刷地图。

words.enDefinition: a socket-shaped device for making an electrical connection; also a device for lifting a car

examples.en: The car jack slides neatly into the compartment beside the spare tyre.
examples.zh: 汽车「千斤顶」正好能收进备胎旁边的隔层。

examples.en: Plug the microphone into the audio jack on the back panel.
examples.zh: 把麦克风插进后面板上的音频「插孔」。

words.enDefinition: serial arrangement in which things follow in logical order or a recurrent pattern

examples.en: Follow the numbered sequence of locks as you walk the canal towpath.
examples.zh: 沿运河纤道走时，按编号「顺序」经过各道船闸。

examples.en: The dance teacher teaches the steps in a simple sequence first.
examples.zh: 舞蹈老师先把舞步按简单的「先后顺序」教给大家。

words.enDefinition: game played on a court by two opposing teams of 5 players; points are scored by throwing the ball through an elevated horizontal hoop

examples.en: The new basketball hoop was installed beside the village school fence.
examples.zh: 新的「篮球」框装在了村校围栏旁。

examples.en: Evening basketball on the outdoor court keeps the teenagers out of trouble.
examples.zh: 傍晚在露天球场打「篮球」，让少年们远离是非。

words.enDefinition: the state of being male or female; a grammatical category

examples.en: The application form asks for name, age, and gender.
examples.zh: 申请表要求填写姓名、年龄和「性别」。

examples.en: The club welcomes members of any gender to its chess nights.
examples.zh: 俱乐部的象棋之夜欢迎任何「性别」的成员参加。

words.enDefinition: the act of speaking or acting for someone; a way of showing or depicting something

examples.en: Each village sends two representatives, so the council gives fair representation to all.
examples.zh: 每村出两名代表，这样议会就能给所有村庄「公平的代表性」。

examples.en: The painting is a striking representation of the storm over the bay.
examples.zh: 这幅画生动「再现」了海湾上空的风暴。

words.enDefinition: something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation

examples.en: The main variable in ferry times is the weather, not the schedule.
examples.zh: 轮渡时间最大的「变数」是天气，而不是班次表。

examples.en: Keep the oven temperature variable in mind when baking at altitude.
examples.zh: 在高海拔烘焙时，要记住烤箱温度是个「可变因素」。

words.enDefinition: distinguishing quality

examples.en: The village makes a clear distinction between market days and feast days.
examples.zh: 村里对赶集日和节庆日有明确的「区分」。

examples.en: She earned the distinction of being the first woman skipper on the route.
examples.zh: 她赢得「殊荣」，成为该航线首位女性船长。

words.enDefinition: outward features

examples.en: The external walls need repainting before the winter storms return.
examples.zh: 冬季风暴来临前，房屋「外部」墙面需要重新粉刷。

examples.en: Judge the house by its external condition only after checking the roof.
examples.zh: 查看屋顶之后，再从「外观」状况来评判这座房子。

words.enDefinition: (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence

examples.en: The lease contains a clause about keeping the yard tidy.
examples.zh: 租约里有一条规定保持院子整洁的「条款」。

examples.en: Our teacher explained that a clause needs both a subject and a verb.
examples.zh: 老师讲解说，「从句」必须同时具备主语和动词。

words.enDefinition: to tie or fasten something tightly; to constrain

examples.en: Bind the bean stalks to the canes with soft garden twine.
examples.zh: 用柔软的园艺细绳把豆藤「绑」到支柱上。

examples.en: The contract will bind both families to the harvest-sharing deal.
examples.zh: 这份合同将「约束」两家共同遵守收成分配的约定。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being significant

examples.en: The mayor explained the significance of the old bell to the visitors.
examples.zh: 市长向游客们讲解了那口老钟的「意义」。

examples.en: Nobody realised the significance of the empty bench by the war memorial.
examples.zh: 当时没人意识到战争纪念碑旁那张空长椅的「重要含义」。

words.enDefinition: the product of a quantity by an integer

examples.en: The storm tore multiple branches off the old chestnut tree.
examples.zh: 风暴把老栗树的「好几根」树枝都刮断了。

examples.en: She checked the ferry timetable multiple times before leaving home.
examples.zh: 出门前，她把轮渡时刻表「反复查了多遍」。

words.enDefinition: Mixed or mingled; surrounded by.

examples.en: The old letters were hidden amongst the hymn books at the chapel.
examples.zh: 旧信件就藏在礼拜堂的赞美诗堆「当中」。

examples.en: Amongst the market stalls, the honey stand is always the busiest.
examples.zh: 「在」集市各摊位「之中」，蜂蜜摊总是最热闹的。

words.enDefinition: the line or plane indicating the limit or extent of something

examples.en: The old stone wall marks the boundary between the two farms.
examples.zh: 那堵老石墙标出两家农场的「分界」。

examples.en: Disputes over the field boundary ended once the surveyor marked it.
examples.zh: 测量员标定后，那块田的「边界」之争便告平息。

words.enDefinition: included or united as part of a whole

examples.en: The guidebook has incorporated maps at the back for the coastal walks.
examples.zh: 指南书末尾「附入的」地图，方便你走海岸步道。

examples.en: These incorporated suggestions made the final plan acceptable to both villages.
examples.zh: 这些「吸收采纳的」建议让最终方案为两村共同接受。

words.enDefinition: learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines

examples.en: The visiting scholar from the university studies old coastal dialects.
examples.zh: 大学来的访问「学者」研究古老的沿海方言。

examples.en: As a young scholar, he copied every inscription in the churchyard.
examples.zh: 年轻时做「学者」，他抄录了墓园里的每一处碑文。

words.enDefinition: government official who conducts criminal prosecutions on behalf of the state

examples.en: The prosecutor showed the court the receipts found in the warehouse.
examples.zh: 「检察官」向法庭出示了仓库里查获的收据。

examples.en: The young prosecutor questioned the harbourmaster for three hours straight.
examples.zh: 年轻的「公诉人」连续盘问了港务长三个小时。

words.enDefinition: statement that is assumed to be true and from which a conclusion can be drawn

examples.en: The plan rests on the premise that the ferry will run daily.
examples.zh: 这项计划的「前提」是轮渡每天都能开航。

examples.en: She questioned the premise of the report before reading the details.
examples.zh: 读完细节之前，她就先质疑了报告的「前提假设」。

words.enDefinition: to become aware of through the senses

examples.en: Dogs can perceive high sounds that our ears simply miss.
examples.zh: 狗能「感知」到我们耳朵听不见的高频声音。

examples.en: Villagers perceive the new road as progress, though some mourn the quiet.
examples.zh: 村民们「认为」新路是进步，尽管有人惋惜失去了宁静。

words.enDefinition: particular functioning condition or arrangement

examples.en: The bus runs in silent electric mode through the old quarter.
examples.zh: 公交以电力「模式」静音驶过老城区。

examples.en: Set the camera to night mode before shooting the harbour fireworks.
examples.zh: 拍港口焰火前，先把相机调到夜间「模式」。

words.enDefinition: decide upon or fix definitely

examples.en: The invitation does not specify whether children are welcome at the harvest meal.
examples.zh: 请柬没有「明确说明」丰收宴是否欢迎孩子。

examples.en: Please specify which dates suit you for the cottage booking.
examples.zh: 订小屋时，请「具体注明」哪些日期合适。

words.enDefinition: form or compose

examples.en: Twelve elected farmers constitute the drainage board for the valley.
examples.zh: 十二位民选农户「组成」山谷排水委员会。

examples.en: These old ledgers constitute the earliest record of the market prices.
examples.zh: 这些旧账簿「构成了」集市价格最早的记录。

words.enDefinition: component of production; something that goes into the production of output

examples.en: Before the vote, the council invited input from every household.
examples.zh: 投票前，市政邀请每个家庭提出「意见」。

examples.en: Add your input to the suggestion box by Friday, please.
examples.zh: 请在周五前把你的「想法」投进意见箱。

words.enDefinition: open, honest, and direct in speech

examples.en: To be frank, the soup at the inn tastes better than mine.
examples.zh: 「说实话」，客栈的汤比我做得好喝。

examples.en: She gave a frank answer about why the stall had closed.
examples.zh: 对于摊位歇业的原因，她给出了「坦率的」回答。

words.enDefinition: form a critical opinion of

examples.en: The committee will evaluate the market proposals again next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 委员会下周二将再次「评估」各项集市方案。

examples.en: Take a day to evaluate whether the cottage really suits you.
examples.zh: 花一天时间「评估」一下这处小屋是否真的合适。

words.enDefinition: put in effect

examples.en: What did the volunteers accomplish during the two-day beach cleanup?
examples.zh: 两天的海滩清理，志愿者们「完成」了哪些事？

examples.en: She managed to accomplish the whole ledger transcription before winter.
examples.zh: 入冬之前，她「完成了」整本账簿的誊录。

words.enDefinition: displaying numbers rather than scale positions

examples.en: The station clock is digital now, with big red numbers.
examples.zh: 车站的钟现在是「数字式」的，红色数字很大。

examples.en: Grandfather finally switched from film to a small digital camera.
examples.zh: 爷爷终于告别胶卷，换了一台小型「数码」相机。

words.enDefinition: physical condition in which there is a disturbance of normal functioning

examples.en: The doctor explained the sleep disorder to the worried night-shift worker.
examples.zh: 医生向忧心的夜班工人解释了这种睡眠「失调」。

examples.en: The kitchen was in complete disorder after the retirement party.
examples.zh: 退休欢送会过后，厨房里一片「杂乱」。

words.enDefinition: an abrupt movement

examples.en: The umpire calls the teams together for the toss at noon.
examples.zh: 正午时分，裁判召集两队进行「掷币」。

examples.en: Give the salad a quick toss before serving it to the guests.
examples.zh: 上桌前，把沙拉快速「翻拌」一下。

words.enDefinition: address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship; say a prayer

examples.en: The fishermen pray for calm seas before the season opens.
examples.zh: 捕鱼季开始前，渔民们会「祈祷」海上风平浪静。

examples.en: Grandmother prays quietly in the chapel every evening at six.
examples.zh: 奶奶每晚六点都在小礼拜堂「默默祷告」。

words.enDefinition: the number of occurrences within a given time period

examples.en: The doctor checks the frequency of the baby's heartbeat at each visit.
examples.zh: 每次产检，医生都会查胎儿心跳的「频率」。

examples.en: The radio frequency changed after the new transmitter was installed.
examples.zh: 新发射塔装好后，电台「频率」改了。

words.enDefinition: the magnitude of something in a particular direction (especially length or width or height)

examples.en: Check the exact dimension of the window before ordering the curtains.
examples.zh: 订窗帘之前，先量好窗户的准确「尺寸」。

examples.en: The garden adds a new dimension to the little cottage's charm.
examples.zh: 这座花园为小屋的魅力增添了新的「维度」。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to or responsible for administration

examples.en: The village hall handles most administrative tasks for the parish council.
examples.zh: 村政厅承办教区议会的大部分「行政」事务。

examples.en: Filling in the administrative forms took longer than the ferry crossing.
examples.zh: 填这些「行政」表格，比坐轮渡过海还费时间。

words.enDefinition: tall annual cereal grass bearing kernels on large ears: widely cultivated in America in many varieties; the principal cereal in Mexico and Central and South America since pre-Columbian times

examples.en: Farmers dry the corn in the yard before storing it.
examples.zh: 农民入库前会先在院子里晾晒「玉米」。

examples.en: Golden fields of corn wave above the lane in late August.
examples.zh: 八月末，「玉米」的金色田野在小路上方起伏。

words.enDefinition: failure to perform some promised act or obligation

examples.en: The company faces court action for a serious breach of the safety rules.
examples.zh: 该公司严重「违反」安全规定，将面临起诉。

examples.en: Repairing the breach in the sea wall took the whole winter.
examples.zh: 修补海堤的「缺口」花了整整一个冬天。

words.enDefinition: in a literal sense

examples.en: The recipe says to fold the dough literally, not stir it.
examples.zh: 菜谱说要「逐字照做」地翻折面团，而不是搅拌。

examples.en: The queue at the ferry office stretched literally around the block.
examples.zh: 轮渡售票处的队伍「实实在在地」绕过了整个街区。

words.enDefinition: the act of clasping another person in the arms (as in greeting or affection)

examples.en: The sisters shared a long embrace on the station platform.
examples.zh: 姐妹俩在站台上久久地「拥抱」。

examples.en: He opened his arms in a warm embrace for the returning sailors.
examples.zh: 他张开双臂，给了归来的水手们一个温暖的「拥抱」。

words.enDefinition: an amount allowed or granted (as during a given period)

examples.en: The children save their weekly allowance for the summer ferry trips.
examples.zh: 孩子们把每周的「零用钱」存起来，夏天好去坐轮渡。

examples.en: The company pays a travel allowance for deliveries beyond the bridge.
examples.zh: 对桥外的配送，公司支付交通「补贴」。

words.enDefinition: an area in which something acts or operates or has power or control: "the range of a supersonic jet"

examples.en: The report examines the full scope of pollution in the estuary.
examples.zh: 报告全面考察了河口的污染「范围」。

examples.en: Repainting the hall is beyond the scope of our small budget.
examples.zh: 重新粉刷礼堂超出了我们这点预算的「范围」。

words.enDefinition: informal word for a dollar; a male deer

examples.en: The old trick is to pass the buck instead of fixing the fence.
examples.zh: 老套路就是把责任「推来推去」，而不是把栅栏修好。

examples.en: He flipped a buck to decide who would climb the mast.
examples.zh: 他抛起一枚「美元」，决定谁去爬桅杆。

words.enDefinition: one of several distinct subdivisions of a text intended to separate ideas; the beginning is usually marked by a new indented line

examples.en: The teacher asked us to summarise the first paragraph in one line.
examples.zh: 老师要我们把第一「段」用一句话概括。

examples.en: Skip to the last paragraph for the ferry timetable changes.
examples.zh: 轮渡时刻表的改动，直接看最后一段「段落」就行。

words.enDefinition: discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of

examples.en: The smoke alarm detects even a whisper of burning toast.
examples.zh: 烟雾报警器连烤焦面包的一丝烟味都能「探测到」。

examples.en: The vet quickly detected an infection in the old dog's paw.
examples.zh: 兽医很快「发现」老狗的爪子有感染。

words.enDefinition: permission to do something

examples.en: The landlord signed his consent for the loft conversion last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚房东签字「同意」了阁楼改造。

examples.en: Photographers need written consent before publishing pictures of the children.
examples.zh: 摄影师发布孩子照片前，需要取得书面「许可」。

words.enDefinition: be composed of

examples.en: The new harbour committee will comprise seven elected villagers and two officers.
examples.zh: 新的港务委员会将「由」七位民选村民和两名职员「组成」。

examples.en: The festival programme will comprise concerts, a market, and boat races.
examples.zh: 节庆活动将「包括」音乐会、集市和赛船。

words.enDefinition: person who is an authority on history and who studies it and writes about it

examples.en: The local historian traced the bridge's builders through parish records.
examples.zh: 本地「历史学家」借助教区档案查出了大桥的建造者。

examples.en: As village historian, she keeps every carnival photograph since 1950.
examples.zh: 作为村里的「史料记录者」，她保存着 1950 年以来所有的狂欢节照片。

words.enDefinition: position 19 in a countable series of things

examples.en: She finished nineteenth in her very first long-distance swim.
examples.zh: 她第一次参加长距离游泳就拿到了「第十九名」。

examples.en: The lighthouse keeper's cottage dates from the nineteenth century or earlier.
examples.zh: 灯塔看守人的小屋建于「十九世纪」或更早。

words.enDefinition: country person

examples.en: The museum shows how a peasant family lived through the hard winters.
examples.zh: 博物馆展示了「农民」一家如何熬过严冬。

examples.en: His grandfather worked as a peasant farmer on the terraced hills.
examples.zh: 他的祖父曾在梯田山坡上当「农民」种地。

words.zhGloss: 公用事业；公用事业公司
words.enDefinition: company that performs a public service; subject to government regulation
acceptedZhAnswers: 公用事业；公用事业公司

examples.en: The power utility restored the lines to the outlying farms within a day.
examples.zh: 电力「公司」一天之内就恢复了偏远农场的供电。

examples.en: Residents complained to the water utility about the rusty supply pipes.
examples.zh: 居民就生锈的供水管道向水务「公司」投诉。

words.enDefinition: small workplace where handcrafts or manufacturing are done

examples.en: The old wheelwright's workshop still smells of oak and iron.
examples.zh: 老车轮匠的「工坊」里仍弥漫着橡木和铁的气味。

examples.en: Dad turned the garage into a small workshop for mending bicycles.
examples.zh: 爸爸把车库改成了修自行车的小「工场」。

words.enDefinition: (often followed by `from') not alike; different in nature or quality

examples.en: There are two distinct accents on either side of the bay.
examples.zh: 海湾两岸的口音「截然不同」。

examples.en: The recipe needs a distinct chilli flavour, not a mild one.
examples.zh: 这道菜谱要「明显的」辣椒味，不能太淡。

words.enDefinition: in the order given

examples.en: The silver and bronze medals went to Anna and Pietro respectively.
examples.zh: 银牌和铜牌「分别」归属于安娜和彼得罗。

examples.en: The baker and the butcher open at seven and eight respectively.
examples.zh: 面包房和肉铺「分别」在七点和八点开门。

words.enDefinition: utter or declare in a very loud voice

examples.en: Don't yell across the yard; the fence carries sound to the neighbours.
examples.zh: 别隔着院子「大喊」，声音会顺着围栏传到邻居家。

examples.en: You could hear the coach yell instructions from the far goal line.
examples.zh: 从球门那头都能听到教练「吼」着指令。

words.enDefinition: true or available everywhere; applying to everyone

examples.en: The longing for home is a universal feeling among sailors.
examples.zh: 思乡之情是水手们「普遍」共有的感受。

examples.en: They designed a universal spanner that fits almost every nut on the boat.
examples.zh: 他们设计了一种「通用的」扳手，几乎能拧船上所有螺母。

words.enDefinition: comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy

examples.en: The neighbours filed a lawsuit over the fallen tree on the shared wall.
examples.zh: 因倒在共用墙上的那棵树，邻居们提起了「诉讼」。

examples.en: The lawsuit against the ferry company lasted nearly three years.
examples.zh: 针对轮渡公司的「官司」打了将近三年。

words.enDefinition: the act of storing something

examples.en: The loft provides storage for the carnival decorations and old flags.
examples.zh: 阁楼用来「存放」狂欢节装饰和旧旗帜。

examples.en: The harbour office rents dry storage space for fishing nets.
examples.zh: 港务处出租干燥的「仓储」空间，供渔网存放。

words.enDefinition: a complete list of items, often with descriptions

examples.en: The seed catalogue arrives every January, full of tempting pictures.
examples.zh: 种子「目录」每年一月寄到，图片引人垂涎。

examples.en: She ordered the peach trees from the nursery's autumn catalogue.
examples.zh: 她从苗圃的秋季「目录」上订购了桃树。

words.enDefinition: the art and style of designing buildings

examples.en: The town is famous for the red-brick architecture of its market hall.
examples.zh: 这座城镇以集市的红砖「建筑风格」闻名。

examples.en: She studies architecture and sketches the harbour warehouses every weekend.
examples.zh: 她学「建筑」，每个周末都去画港口仓库的速写。

words.enDefinition: be greater in scope or size than some standard

examples.en: Let the dough rise until it exceeds the rim of the tin.
examples.zh: 让面团发到「超出」模具边缘为止。

examples.en: The fine will exceed a thousand dollars if the noise continues.
examples.zh: 若噪音持续，罚款将「超过」一千美元。

words.enDefinition: positive motivational influence

examples.en: The free ferry pass is an incentive for villagers to shop locally.
examples.zh: 免费轮渡通行证是鼓励村民本地消费的一种「激励」。

examples.en: Offering the best parking spot gave the staff a real incentive.
examples.zh: 把最好的停车位当奖励，给了员工实实在在的「动力」。

words.enDefinition: person who is owned by someone

examples.en: The old sugar mill museum remembers the slaves who built its walls.
examples.zh: 老糖厂博物馆铭记着修筑厂墙的「奴隶」们。

examples.en: Generations of slaves were bought and sold in that harbour square.
examples.zh: 那座港口广场上曾世代买卖「奴隶」。

words.enDefinition: concerned primarily with theories or hypotheses rather than practical considerations

examples.en: The plan looks brilliant in theoretical terms but struggles in practice.
examples.zh: 这个方案「理论上」漂亮，实践起来却困难重重。

examples.en: Our instructor covers the theoretical side in the mornings and practice after lunch.
examples.zh: 教员上午讲「理论」，午饭后进行实操。

words.enDefinition: group or class of persons enjoying superior intellectual or social or economic status

examples.en: The village team beat the elite riders from the national circuit.
examples.zh: 村队击败了全国巡回赛的「精英」骑手们。

examples.en: Only the elite of the fishing fleet dare cross in February.
examples.zh: 只有渔船队中的「尖子」才敢在二月出海。

words.enDefinition: the sacred writings of the Christian religions

examples.en: The family bible records every birth since the farm began.
examples.zh: 家族的《圣经》记载着农场开创以来的每一次添丁。

examples.en: She keeps her grandmother's bible on the shelf beside the hymn book.
examples.zh: 她把祖母的《圣经》和赞美诗集并排放在一起。

words.enDefinition: time available for ease and relaxation

examples.en: The harbour promenade fills with leisure walkers after Sunday lunch.
examples.zh: 周日午餐后，海滨步道上满是「悠闲」散步的人。

examples.en: Retirement gave him leisure to finish the boat he began decades ago.
examples.zh: 退休让他有「闲暇」完成几十年前动手造的那条船。

words.enDefinition: a description of a possible situation or sequence of events

examples.en: In the worst-case scenario, the storm delays the ferry by a full day.
examples.zh: 最坏的「情形」是，风暴让轮渡整整延误一天。

examples.en: The council rehearsed an evacuation scenario for the coastal flood season.
examples.zh: 市政为沿海汛期演练了一套疏散「预案」。

words.enDefinition: the phenomenon of a propagating wave (light or sound) being thrown back from a surface

examples.en: The full moon's reflection doubled the beauty of the still bay.
examples.zh: 平静海湾里满月的「倒影」让夜色加倍动人。

examples.en: She caught her reflection in the polished brass of the ship's bell.
examples.zh: 她在擦得锃亮的船钟铜面上看到了自己的「映像」。

words.enDefinition: magnifier of images of distant objects

examples.en: Grandfather watches the ferry traffic through an old brass telescope.
examples.zh: 爷爷用一架老铜「望远镜」观看轮渡的往来。

examples.en: The observatory opens its big telescope to visitors on clear Fridays.
examples.zh: 晴朗的周五，天文台向访客开放那台大型「望远镜」。

words.enDefinition: literary work based on the imagination and not necessarily on fact

examples.en: She reads historical fiction about fishing villages all winter long.
examples.zh: 整个冬天她都在读以渔村为背景的历史「小说」。

examples.en: The distinction between fact and fiction blurs in most sea stories.
examples.zh: 大多数海员故事里，事实与「虚构」的界限都很模糊。

words.enDefinition: the period during which something is functional (as between birth and death)

examples.en: In a lifetime of fishing, he had never seen the bay freeze.
examples.zh: 打了一「辈子」鱼，他从未见海湾封冻。

examples.en: The old engine has a lifetime guarantee, according to the dealer.
examples.zh: 据经销商说，这台老发动机有「终身」保修。

words.enDefinition: in the second place

examples.en: First we check the moorings; secondly, we test the radio.
examples.zh: 先检查缆绳；「其次」测试电台。

examples.en: Secondly, the council must approve the plan before any digging begins.
examples.zh: 「第二」，动土之前市政必须批准方案。

words.enDefinition: give testimony in a court of law

examples.en: The ferry captain agreed to testify about the night of the collision.
examples.zh: 轮渡船长同意就相撞当晚出庭「作证」。

examples.en: Two neighbours testified that the dog had never bitten anyone before.
examples.zh: 两位邻居「作证」说，那条狗此前从未咬过人。

words.enDefinition: used or designed for residence or limited to residences

examples.en: The old cannery is being turned into quiet residential apartments.
examples.zh: 旧罐头厂正被改造成安静的「住宅」公寓。

examples.en: New residents complain that the street is too busy for a residential zone.
examples.zh: 新住户抱怨，这条街车流太大，不像「住宅区」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of business done; the rate at which stock or staff is replaced

examples.en: The bakery's turnover doubled after the ferry route reopened in spring.
examples.zh: 春天轮渡航线重开后，面包房的「营业额」翻了一番。

examples.en: High staff turnover hurts the small hotel every single summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天，员工「流动率」过高都让这家小旅馆头疼。

words.enDefinition: a small cut or notch in something

examples.en: Careful, there's a nick in the blade from last year's oyster knife.
examples.zh: 小心，刀刃上有个去年开生蚝留下的「小缺口」。

examples.en: He polished the nick out of the propeller before the regatta.
examples.zh: 帆船赛前，他把螺旋桨上的「刻痕」打磨掉了。

words.enDefinition: in addition; furthermore, their quality is improving"; moreover, mice nested there"

examples.en: The engine is reliable; furthermore, it uses far less fuel.
examples.zh: 这台发动机很可靠；「而且」，油耗也低得多。

examples.en: The cottage has no parking; furthermore, the stairs are steep.
examples.zh: 小屋没有停车位；「此外」楼梯还很陡。

words.enDefinition: distinctly dissimilar or unlike

examples.en: The market draws a diverse crowd of farmers, tourists, and students.
examples.zh: 集市吸引了农民、游客和学生等「形形色色的」人群。

examples.en: The island offers a diverse mix of woodland, dunes, and rocky shore.
examples.zh: 这座岛把林地、沙丘与岩岸「多样地」融为一炉。

words.enDefinition: an enclosed passageway; rooms usually open onto it

examples.en: The hospital corridor smells of floor polish and fresh lilies.
examples.zh: 医院的「走廊」里飘着地板蜡和新鲜百合的气味。

examples.en: A long corridor connects the harbour master's office to the customs shed.
examples.zh: 一条长长的「走廊」连接着港务长办公室和海关棚屋。

words.enDefinition: make stronger

examples.en: The builders reinforced the sea wall with fresh concrete blocks.
examples.zh: 建筑工人用新的混凝土块「加固」了海堤。

examples.en: A hot supper will reinforce you after a day of moving crates.
examples.zh: 搬了一天货箱后，一顿热腾腾的晚饭能让你「恢复元气」。

words.enDefinition: lay judge or civil authority who administers the law (especially one who conducts a court dealing with minor offenses)

examples.en: The magistrate fined the captain and suspended his licence for a month.
examples.zh: 「地方法官」对船长处以罚款，并吊销执照一个月。

examples.en: Minor offences in the parish are heard by the local magistrate.
examples.zh: 教区内的轻罪案件由本地「治安官」审理。

words.enDefinition: without much difficulty

examples.en: Information about the tide tables is readily available at the harbour office.
examples.zh: 在港务处「随时可以」轻松拿到潮汐表。

examples.en: She readily agreed to water the greenhouse while we were away.
examples.zh: 我们外出期间，她「爽快地」答应照看温室。

words.enDefinition: to describe the distinctive nature of; to be typical of

examples.en: Tall chimneys and tight lanes characterize the older quarter of the town.
examples.zh: 高高的烟囱和狭窄的巷道是老城区的「特征」。

examples.en: Locals characterize the harbour master as strict but always fair.
examples.zh: 当地人形容港务长「严格却一贯公正」。

words.enDefinition: gesture involving the shoulders

examples.en: When I asked about the missing oars, he gave a simple shrug.
examples.zh: 问起丢失的船桨，他只是「耸了耸肩」。

examples.en: She answered every hard question with a smile and a shrug.
examples.zh: 每逢刁钻问题，她都以微笑加「耸肩」回应。

words.enDefinition: used or intended to defend; protecting against attack

examples.en: The troops dug a defensive line along the ridge before dawn.
examples.zh: 天亮前，部队在山脊沿线挖出了「防御」阵地。

examples.en: He grew defensive whenever anyone mentioned the missing ledger.
examples.zh: 谁一提那本丢失的账簿，他就变得「戒备起来」。

words.enDefinition: someone who creates plans to be used in making something (such as buildings)

examples.en: The architect drew the village hall with a wide porch for rainy days.
examples.zh: 「建筑师」把村政厅设计成带宽门廊的样式，方便雨天使用。

examples.en: Our neighbour is the architect who restored the lighthouse keeper's cottage.
examples.zh: 我们邻居就是修复灯塔看守人小屋的那位「建筑师」。

words.enDefinition: any large and important church

examples.en: The cathedral bells can be heard across the whole harbour town.
examples.zh: 「大教堂」的钟声传遍整座海港小镇。

examples.en: Tourists photograph the twin spires of the cathedral from the ferry.
examples.zh: 游客们从轮渡上拍摄「大教堂」的双塔尖。

words.enDefinition: without being affected by something; in spite of the circumstances

examples.en: The market goes ahead regardless of the early morning frost.
examples.zh: 无论清晨霜冻与否，集市都照常开张。

examples.en: She walks the coastal path daily regardless of the weather.
examples.zh: 无论天气如何，她每天都走一遍海滨步道。

words.enDefinition: by that means or because of that

examples.en: The council drained the marsh, thereby ending the summer mosquito problem.
examples.zh: 市政排干了沼泽，「从而」解决了夏日蚊虫问题。

examples.en: He fixed the pump himself, thereby saving the village a repair bill.
examples.zh: 他自己修好了水泵，「就这样」为村里省下了一笔修理费。

words.enDefinition: distinguished from Bovidae by the male's having solid deciduous antlers

examples.en: A family of deer crossed the lane just before the school bus.
examples.zh: 校车开过前，一小群「鹿」横穿了小路。

examples.en: Early risers often spot deer grazing near the orchard fence.
examples.zh: 早起的人常能看到「鹿」在果园栅栏边吃草。

words.enDefinition: the speech act of objecting

examples.en: Nobody raised an objection when the market moved to the square.
examples.zh: 集市迁到广场时，没有人提出「异议」。

examples.en: The lawyer's objection stopped the question before the witness answered.
examples.zh: 律师的「反对」让证人免于回答那个问题。

words.enDefinition: sweet yellow liquid produced by bees

examples.en: The stall sells comb honey from hives above the lavender field.
examples.zh: 摊位上卖的是薰衣草田上方蜂巢产的「蜂蜜」。

examples.en: Grandmother sweetens the cough remedy with a spoon of local honey.
examples.zh: 奶奶在止咳糖浆里加一勺本地「蜂蜜」调味。

words.enDefinition: very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk

examples.en: The infant slept through the whole christening in her grandmother's arms.
examples.zh: 「婴儿」在外婆怀里睡完了整个洗礼仪式。

examples.en: The clinic weighs each infant and plots the numbers on a chart.
examples.zh: 诊所给每个「婴儿」称重，并把数据记到图表上。

words.enDefinition: a room in a hospital with beds for patients

examples.en: The children's ward was decorated with paper boats for the storm season.
examples.zh: 汛期到来前，儿科「病房」挂满了纸船装饰。

examples.en: Grandfather moved from the emergency ward to a room with a window.
examples.zh: 爷爷从急诊「病区」转进了带窗的病房。

words.enDefinition: person who cares for persons or property

examples.en: Her aunt became her legal guardian after both parents were lost at sea.
examples.zh: 父母双双海上罹难后，姨妈成了她的法定「监护人」。

examples.en: The old sheepdog acts as guardian of the henhouse every night.
examples.zh: 那只老牧羊犬每晚都当鸡舍的「守护者」。

words.enDefinition: accumulated knowledge or erudition or enlightenment

examples.en: Villagers seek the old postman's wisdom before buying their first boat.
examples.zh: 买第一条船之前，村民们都要来讨教老邮差的「智慧」。

examples.en: There's hard-earned wisdom in Grandmother's rule about never sailing on a red sky.
examples.zh: 奶奶那条「晚霞不出海」的规矩，是来之不易的生活「智慧」。

words.enDefinition: the quality of doing what is right and avoiding what is wrong

examples.en: Patience is a virtue that the tide teaches every young fisherman.
examples.zh: 「耐心」是潮汐教给每个年轻渔夫的美德。

examples.en: She praised the virtue of repairing things instead of replacing them.
examples.zh: 她称赞了修旧利废而非一扔了之的「美德」。

words.enDefinition: widely known person

examples.en: The retired jockey is the biggest celebrity in our little town.
examples.zh: 那位退役赛马骑师是我们小镇最大的「名人」。

examples.en: A television celebrity opened the new lifeboat station last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，一位电视「名流」为新的救生艇站揭幕。

words.enDefinition: a man-made waterway for boats or irrigation

examples.en: Barges still carry hay along the canal between the two towns.
examples.zh: 驳船仍沿「运河」在两镇之间运送干草。

examples.en: The canal was dug in 1848 to move coal to the harbour.
examples.zh: 这条「运河」开凿于 1848 年，用来把煤运往港口。

words.enDefinition: currently happening

examples.en: The search for the missing dinghy is ongoing, with boats out at first light.
examples.zh: 对失踪小艇的搜寻仍在「进行中」，天一亮各船就出发了。

examples.en: The bridge repair is an ongoing project that will last until autumn.
examples.zh: 大桥维修是一项将「持续」到秋天的「进行中」工程。

words.enDefinition: beam made of wood

examples.en: The builder stacks seasoned timber under the lean-to until spring.
examples.zh: 建筑工人把风干的「木料」码在披屋下，等开春再用。

examples.en: Old ships' timbers wash up on the beach after every big storm.
examples.zh: 每场大风过后，海滩上都会冲来旧船的「木材」。

words.enDefinition: domesticated bovine animals as a group regardless of sex or age

examples.en: The farmer moves his cattle to the upper pasture in June.
examples.zh: 六月，农场主把「牛群」赶到高处的牧场。

examples.en: Cattle grid crossings save the sheep from wandering onto the main road.
examples.zh: 牛栏格栅拦住了羊群，免得它们游荡上大路。

words.enDefinition: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment

examples.en: It was evident from the long queue that the ferry had been cancelled.
examples.zh: 从长长的队伍就能「明显看出」，轮渡取消了。

examples.en: Her talent for knots was evident even in the scouts.
examples.zh: 还在童子军时，她打绳结的才能就已「显露无遗」。

words.enDefinition: relating to or befitting athletics or athletes

examples.en: The athletic field behind the school hosts the summer sports days.
examples.zh: 学校后面的「运动场」承办夏季运动会。

examples.en: Their athletic daughter swims the harbour crossing twice every summer.
examples.zh: 他们「擅长运动的」女儿每年夏天都横渡海港两次。

words.enDefinition: expert skill or knowledge in a particular field

examples.en: The boatbuilder's expertise saved the old sloop from the scrapyard.
examples.zh: 造船师傅的「专业造诣」让那条老单桅船免于报废。

examples.en: We needed someone with electrical expertise to rewire the village hall.
examples.zh: 重新给村政厅布线，需要懂电的「专业人才」。

words.enDefinition: a limit or restriction on what you can do

examples.en: The main constraint on the new marina is the height of the bridge.
examples.zh: 新游艇码头的主要「制约因素」是大桥的高度。

examples.en: Budget constraints forced the council to postpone the harbour mural.
examples.zh: 预算「限制」迫使市政推迟了港口壁画的计划。

words.enDefinition: the inner surface of the hand from the wrist to the base of the fingers

examples.en: The fortune teller read the lines on my palm for a coin.
examples.zh: 算命师收了一枚硬币，替我看「手掌」上的纹路。

examples.en: She cooled the feverish child with a damp cloth on each palm.
examples.zh: 她用湿布敷在孩子每只「手掌」上，为高热降温。

words.enDefinition: serve oneself to, or consume regularly

examples.en: The old ferry consumes nearly twice the fuel of the new one.
examples.zh: 旧轮渡的燃料「消耗」几乎是新船的两倍。

examples.en: The family of six can consume a whole batch of pies in minutes.
examples.zh: 一家六口几分钟能「吃掉」整整一炉馅饼。

words.enDefinition: having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value

examples.en: The wealthy shipowner restored the row of cottages by the quay.
examples.zh: 那位富有的船主把码头边的一排村舍修葺一新。

examples.en: The town grew wealthy on herring, then quieter when the shoals moved.
examples.zh: 小镇靠鲱鱼「致富」，鱼群游走后便归于安静。

words.enDefinition: one of the huge systems of stars that make up the universe

examples.en: On clear nights, the galaxy arches over the dark harbour water.
examples.zh: 晴朗的夜晚，「银河」横跨黑沉沉的海港上空。

examples.en: The observatory volunteer pointed out our own galaxy, the Milky Way.
examples.zh: 天文台志愿者指给我们看我们所在的「星系」——银河。

words.enDefinition: special advantage or immunity or benefit not enjoyed by all

examples.en: Meeting the queen was a privilege the old coastguard never forgot.
examples.zh: 见到女王是那位老海岸警卫员毕生难忘的「殊荣」。

examples.en: Club membership is a privilege that comes with mooring duties.
examples.zh: 俱乐部会员是一项「特权」，也意味着要承担系泊值班。

words.enDefinition: (sentence connectors) because of the reason given

examples.en: The storm broke the slipway; consequently, the lifeboat launched from the sand.
examples.zh: 风暴毁坏了滑道，「因此」救生艇只能从沙滩下水。

examples.en: He skipped the lifejacket check and consequently missed the early crossing.
examples.zh: 他没做救生衣检查，「结果」错过了早班轮渡。

words.enDefinition: friend who is frequently in the company of another

examples.en: Her sheepdog is her constant companion on the long coastal rounds.
examples.zh: 那只牧羊犬是她漫长海岸巡线上形影不离的「伙伴」。

examples.en: He found a congenial companion in the man who shared his ferry seat.
examples.zh: 他在轮渡上的邻座找到了一位投缘的「同伴」。

words.enDefinition: distribute according to a plan or set apart for a special purpose

examples.en: The tutor allocates twenty minutes of each lesson to free conversation.
examples.zh: 老师给每节课「分配」二十分钟自由对话时间。

examples.en: Council funds are allocated to the library, the pool, and the youth club.
examples.zh: 市政经费被「分配」给图书馆、游泳池和青少年俱乐部。

words.enDefinition: any of various burrowing animals of the family Leporidae having long ears and short tails; some domesticated and raised for pets or food

examples.en: Our neighbours' rabbit escaped again and turned up in our vegetable patch.
examples.zh: 邻居家的「兔子」又逃出来了，结果出现在我们的菜地里。

examples.en: The children fed the rabbit carrot tops through the hutch wire.
examples.zh: 孩子们隔着笼子喂「兔子」胡萝卜缨。

words.enDefinition: piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole

examples.en: Grandmother sewed a bright patch over the hole in my school trousers.
examples.zh: 奶奶在我校裤的破洞上缝了一块鲜艳的「补丁」。

examples.en: He ironed a patch onto the elbow of his favourite jacket.
examples.zh: 他在心爱夹克的肘部熨上一块「补片」。

words.enDefinition: relating to or belonging to the Middle Ages

examples.en: The medieval castle wall still stands above the market square.
examples.zh: 那段「中世纪的」城堡城墙仍然矗立在集市广场上方。

examples.en: They lit the hall with candles for the medieval-themed feast.
examples.zh: 为「中世纪」主题的宴会，他们用蜡烛点亮了大厅。

words.enDefinition: appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to

examples.en: Everyone says the baby resembles her grandfather around the eyes.
examples.zh: 大家都说这孩子的眼睛「长得像」外公。

examples.en: The new library resembles a ship moored at the end of the street.
examples.zh: 新图书馆「形似」一艘停泊在街尾的轮船。

words.enDefinition: pass through

examples.en: The old bridge must undergo a full inspection before spring traffic.
examples.zh: 春季通车前，老桥必须「经受」一次全面检查。

examples.en: She underwent minor surgery on her wrist and recovered quickly.
examples.zh: 她的手腕做了小手术，恢复得很快。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others

examples.en: The thick hedge shields us from the road and gives us privacy.
examples.zh: 浓密的树篱挡住马路视线，保住了我们的「隐私」。

examples.en: Respect their privacy and knock before entering the office.
examples.zh: 尊重他人的「隐私」，进办公室前先敲门。

words.enDefinition: shoulder firearm with a long barrel and a rifled bore

examples.en: The old rifle hangs above the fireplace as a family keepsake.
examples.zh: 那支老「步枪」作为传家物挂在壁炉上方。

examples.en: Soldiers clean and oil their rifles every Sunday morning in camp.
examples.zh: 驻营期间，士兵们每周日早上都会保养「步枪」。

words.enDefinition: the act of closing something; the state of being closed

examples.en: The sudden closure of the bridge added twenty minutes to every journey.
examples.zh: 大桥突然「关闭」，每次出行都多了二十分钟。

examples.en: Residents petitioned against the closure of the village's last shop.
examples.zh: 居民们请愿，反对关闭村里最后一家商店。

words.enDefinition: the organization of information according to preset specifications (usually for computer processing)

examples.en: Please send the minutes in the same format as last month's.
examples.zh: 会议记录请按上个月的「格式」发送。

examples.en: The novel was reissued in a pocket-sized format for travellers.
examples.zh: 小说重印时改成了便于携带的口袋「版式」。

words.enDefinition: decreed by or proceeding from a court of justice

examples.en: The judicial review delayed the harbour project by a full year.
examples.zh: 一次「司法」审查使港口工程整整推迟了一年。

examples.en: Judges must keep their judicial decisions free from outside pressure.
examples.zh: 法官必须让「司法」裁决免受外界压力影响。

words.enDefinition: manner of living that reflects the person's values and attitudes

examples.en: Cycling to work became part of her lifestyle after the move.
examples.zh: 搬家之后，骑车上班成了她「生活方式」的一部分。

examples.en: The island lifestyle suits my parents better than the city ever did.
examples.zh: 相比城市，「岛上生活方式」更适合我父母。

words.enDefinition: message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program

examples.en: Grandfather tells the flood narrative differently every time we ask.
examples.zh: 每次问起，爷爷对那场洪水的「讲述」都略有不同。

examples.en: The film's narrative jumps between the two sisters' childhoods.
examples.zh: 影片的「叙事」在两姐妹的童年之间来回切换。

words.enDefinition: small number or amount

examples.en: Only a handful of students signed up for the early Latin class.
examples.zh: 只有「少数几个」学生报了清晨的拉丁语课。

examples.en: She grabbed a handful of raisins before the training run.
examples.zh: 训练开跑前，她抓了「一把」葡萄干。

words.enDefinition: the line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet

examples.en: We watched the storm build along the horizon all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整个下午，我们看着风暴在「地平线」上酝酿。

examples.en: Learning to sail opened a new horizon for the retired teacher.
examples.zh: 学帆船为退休教师打开了新的「视野」。

words.enDefinition: of or located in the lower part of a town, or in the business center

examples.en: The bus drops us downtown right beside the farmers' market.
examples.zh: 公交车把我们直接送到「市中心」的农贸市场旁。

examples.en: They moved downtown to be closer to the theatre district.
examples.zh: 他们搬到「市中心」住，离剧院区更近。

words.enDefinition: an event that results in a transformation

examples.en: The conversion of the barn into a studio took eight months.
examples.zh: 把谷仓改建为工作室的「改造」工程花了八个月。

examples.en: The kitchen's conversion to gas heating cut our bills in half.
examples.zh: 厨房改为燃气供暖后，账单省了一半。

words.enDefinition: relating to an empire or its ruler

examples.en: The imperial palace opens its gardens to the public each spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，「皇室」宫殿向公众开放花园。

examples.en: Imperial coins from that era turn up at every flea market.
examples.zh: 每个跳蚤市场都能翻出那个年代的「帝国」铸币。

words.enDefinition: the act of enrolling

examples.en: Bring two photos and your passport to the registration desk.
examples.zh: 请带两张照片和护照到「登记」处。

examples.en: Registration for the swimming course closes on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 游泳课程的「报名」周五下午截止。

words.enDefinition: a flat outdoor paved area next to a house or restaurant

examples.en: We eat breakfast on the terrace when the summer mornings are warm.
examples.zh: 夏日清晨暖和时，我们就在「露台」上吃早餐。

examples.en: The restaurant's terrace overlooks the river and the old bridge.
examples.zh: 餐厅的「露台」正对着河流和古桥。

words.enDefinition: to have a view over something from above; to fail to notice

examples.en: The castle tower overlooks the whole valley and the river bend.
examples.zh: 城堡塔楼「俯瞰」整个山谷和河湾。

examples.en: Double-check the address so we don't overlook the small gate.
examples.zh: 再核对一遍地址，免得「漏看」那扇小门。

words.enDefinition: state categorically

examples.en: She calmly asserted her right to see the building plans.
examples.zh: 她沉着地「主张」自己有权查看建筑图纸。

examples.en: The coach asserted that the team's discipline had improved.
examples.zh: 教练「坚称」球队的纪律性已经提升。

words.enDefinition: creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation

examples.en: The double-decker bread oven was the bakery's greatest innovation.
examples.zh: 双层烤炉是这家面包店最了不起的「创新」。

examples.en: Every innovation in the workshop began as a doodle on the bench.
examples.zh: 车间里的每一项「革新」都始于工作台上的涂鸦。

words.enDefinition: small room on a ship or boat where people sleep

examples.en: We rented a log cabin by the lake for the half-term week.
examples.zh: 假期那一周，我们租了湖边的原木「小木屋」。

examples.en: The ship's cabin was cosy, with two bunks and a tiny window.
examples.zh: 船上的「舱室」很舒适，有两张铺位和一扇小窗。

words.enDefinition: especially; in particular

examples.en: The seminar was useful, notably the session on local archives.
examples.zh: 研讨会很有用，「尤其是」地方档案那一场。

examples.en: Prices rose across the market, notably for butter and cheese.
examples.zh: 集市物价普遍上涨，「尤其」黄油和奶酪涨得明显。

words.enDefinition: medicine or therapy that cures disease or relieve pain

examples.en: Honey and lemon is the remedy my mother swears by for coughs.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜柠檬水是妈妈治咳嗽最信的「偏方」。

examples.en: The chemist recommended a gentle herbal remedy for the baby's rash.
examples.zh: 药剂师推荐了一种温和的草本「药物」，对付婴儿湿疹。

words.enDefinition: coniferous tree

examples.en: A row of tall pines shelters the garden from the north wind.
examples.zh: 一排高大的「松树」为花园挡住了北风。

examples.en: The little cabin smelled of pine needles and yesterday's woodsmoke.
examples.zh: 小木屋里弥漫着「松针」和昨日柴烟的味道。

words.enDefinition: Against; as, John Doe versus Richard Roe; -- chiefly

examples.en: Saturday's final pits the reigning champions versus the youngest squad.
examples.zh: 周六决赛是卫冕冠军「对阵」最年轻的队伍。

examples.en: The debate framed tradition versus progress, and both sides argued well.
examples.zh: 辩题是传统「对」进步，双方都辩得精彩。

words.enDefinition: the male ruler of an empire

examples.en: The emperor's summer residence sits on the hill above the vineyards.
examples.zh: 「皇帝」的夏宫坐落在葡萄园上方的山坡上。

examples.en: Museum guides tell how the last emperor abdicated in that very hall.
examples.zh: 博物馆讲解员说，末代「皇帝」正是在那座大殿里退位的。

words.enDefinition: professional cook

examples.en: The head chef greets every supplier at the market at dawn.
examples.zh: 清晨集市上，主「厨」会亲自招呼每位供货商。

examples.en: Our local chef won a medal for her rosemary lamb stew.
examples.zh: 本地的这位「厨师」凭迷迭香炖羊肉赢得了一枚奖章。

words.enDefinition: a broad smile in which the teeth are visible

examples.en: A wide grin spread across his face when the parcel arrived.
examples.zh: 包裹一到，他脸上就绽开了大大的「露齿笑」。

examples.en: She hid a grin behind her hand as the puppy stole the sock.
examples.zh: 小狗叼走袜子时，她用手掩着「咧嘴笑」。

words.enDefinition: show or affirm to be just and legitimate

examples.en: The clinic checks that every charity caller is legitimate before opening the door.
examples.zh: 开门前，诊所会先核实来电募捐者是否「正当合法」。

examples.en: He made a legitimate claim to the family's old orchard tools.
examples.zh: 对家中旧果园工具，他提出了「正当的」所有权主张。

words.enDefinition: in a way that is appropriate to the situation or information available

examples.en: The forecast changed, so we packed the tent accordingly.
examples.zh: 天气预报变了，我们据此「相应地」收拾了帐篷。

examples.en: Sort the letters by district and label the boxes accordingly.
examples.zh: 按街区把信件分好，并「相应地」给箱子贴上标签。

words.enDefinition: a group of similar things or people gathered closely together

examples.en: A cluster of mushrooms appeared under the oak after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后橡树下冒出一「簇」蘑菇。

examples.en: Tourists quickly formed a cluster around the street violinist.
examples.zh: 游客们很快在街头小提琴手周围聚成一「团」。

words.enDefinition: show in, or as in, a picture

examples.en: The mural depicts the harbour as it looked a century ago.
examples.zh: 这幅壁画「描绘」了港口一个世纪前的样子。

examples.en: Old tapestries depict farmers bringing the harvest to the abbey gates.
examples.zh: 古代挂毯「描绘」农民把收成送到修道院门口的情景。

words.enDefinition: person whose occupation is teaching

examples.en: The swimming instructor counts every stroke aloud from the poolside.
examples.zh: 游泳「教练」在池边大声数着每一个划水动作。

examples.en: Our driving instructor insists on checking the mirrors before starting.
examples.zh: 我们的驾「教练」坚持起步前先看后视镜。

words.enDefinition: lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task

examples.en: The inadequate lighting in the stairwell caused several stumbles.
examples.zh: 楼梯间「不足的」照明让人摔了好几跤。

examples.en: Her inadequate notes made the revision week far harder.
examples.zh: 笔记「不充分」，让复习那一周难上加难。

words.enDefinition: to invent or plan something cleverly

examples.en: The neighbours devised a fair rota for walking the shared dog.
examples.zh: 邻居们「设计」了一张公平的遛狗轮值表。

examples.en: She devised a simple code so the children could share secrets.
examples.zh: 她「设计」了一套简单暗号，让孩子们能分享秘密。

words.enDefinition: to match or be in agreement with something

examples.en: The numbered keys correspond to the labelled hooks by the door.
examples.zh: 编号钥匙与门旁挂钩的标签一一「对应」。

examples.en: We correspond by letter because he loves fountain pens and stamps.
examples.zh: 我们靠写信「来往」，因为他喜欢钢笔和邮票。

words.enDefinition: the likelihood of a thing occurring rather than not occurring

examples.en: The odds of catching the last ferry improve if you cycle.
examples.zh: 骑车去的话，赶上末班轮渡的「几率」会更大。

examples.en: Against all odds, the little bookshop survived three recessions.
examples.zh: 「尽管希望渺茫」，那家小书店还是挺过了三次经济衰退。

words.enDefinition: to change something slightly, especially to improve it

examples.en: We modified the recipe slightly by using olive oil instead of butter.
examples.zh: 我们把食谱稍作「修改」，用橄榄油代替黄油。

examples.en: The plan was modified after the neighbours raised concerns about parking.
examples.zh: 邻居们提出停车顾虑后，方案作了「修改」。

words.enDefinition: place of worship that has its own altar

examples.en: The village chapel seats forty people and rings a small bell.
examples.zh: 村里的「小教堂」可容纳四十人，还挂着一口小钟。

examples.en: They were married in the stone chapel on the cliff road.
examples.zh: 他们在崖边路上的石头「礼拜堂」结的婚。

words.enDefinition: consistent with or based on or using reason

examples.en: Let's make a rational decision about the car instead of an emotional one.
examples.zh: 关于这辆车，我们做个「理性的」决定，别感情用事。

examples.en: There is a rational explanation for the lights going out at midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜熄灯其实有一种「合理的」解释。

words.enDefinition: an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of an entity

examples.en: Patience is her best attribute as a primary school teacher.
examples.zh: 「耐心」是她作为小学老师最大的「特质」。

examples.en: The advert lists every attribute of the used caravan, honestly and otherwise.
examples.zh: 广告把这款二手房车的各项「特性」都列了出来，如实得很。

words.enDefinition: measured portion of medicine taken at any one time

examples.en: The pharmacist measured the exact dose of medicine into a spoon.
examples.zh: 药剂师把精确的「剂量」量进小勺里。

examples.en: Never double the dose if you forget the morning tablet.
examples.zh: 如果忘了吃早上的药片，也「切勿」加倍「剂量」。

words.enDefinition: container that is usually woven and has handles

examples.en: She carried the shopping basket through the Saturday vegetable stalls.
examples.zh: 她提着购物「篮」穿过周六的蔬菜摊。

examples.en: The cat sleeps in the wicker basket beside the radiator.
examples.zh: 猫咪睡在暖气片旁的柳条「篮子」里。

words.enDefinition: long fixed look

examples.en: The child's steady gaze made the street mime lose his place.
examples.zh: 孩子「目不转睛的注视」，让街头哑剧演员都乱了阵脚。

examples.en: She followed his gaze to the old lighthouse on the point.
examples.zh: 她顺着他「凝视」的方向望向海角的老灯塔。

words.enDefinition: portray in words

examples.en: The actor portrays the young postman with warmth and humour.
examples.zh: 这位演员「刻画」年轻邮递员时充满温情与幽默。

examples.en: Newspapers portrayed the strike as a crisis, though locals disagreed.
examples.zh: 报纸把罢工「描绘成」危机，当地人却不以为然。

words.enDefinition: special loved one

examples.en: Come in, darling, the soup is still hot on the stove.
examples.zh: 进来吧，「亲爱的」，汤还在炉子上温着呢。

examples.en: The old lady calls every child in the street her darling.
examples.zh: 老太太把街上的每个孩子都称作「心肝宝贝」。

words.enDefinition: mental representation of some haunting experience

examples.en: The old inn claims a friendly ghost walks the top corridor.
examples.zh: 那家老客栈声称有个「幽灵」常在顶层走廊游荡。

examples.en: My brother insists the cold spot in the pantry is a ghost.
examples.zh: 哥哥坚持说，食品储藏室里那块阴冷处是「鬼魂」作祟。

words.enDefinition: small island

examples.en: The little isle can only be reached at low tide.
examples.zh: 那座「小岛」只有在退潮时才能登上。

examples.en: Legends say a saint once lived alone on the isle.
examples.zh: 传说一位圣人曾独自住在那座「小岛」上。

words.enDefinition: the underside of footwear or a golf club

examples.en: The cobbler stitched a new leather sole onto my walking boots.
examples.zh: 修鞋匠给我的徒步靴换缝了新的皮革「鞋底」。

examples.en: His soles were stained yellow from cutting across the fresh field.
examples.zh: 抄近路穿过新刈的草场，他的「脚底」都染黄了。

words.enDefinition: any amazing or wonderful occurrence

examples.en: Finding her wedding ring in the compost was a small miracle.
examples.zh: 在堆肥里找到婚戒，真是个小小的「奇迹」。

examples.en: The doctors called his recovery a miracle after such a fall.
examples.zh: 摔成那样还能康复，医生们称之为「奇迹」。

words.enDefinition: giving satisfaction

examples.en: The plumber's patch was satisfactory, though we will replace the pipe in spring.
examples.zh: 水管工的修补「还过得去」，不过开春我们还是要把管子换掉。

examples.en: The manager asked if the room temperature was satisfactory for everyone.
examples.zh: 经理问室温是否让每个人都「满意」。

words.enDefinition: of a feature that helps to distinguish a person or thing

examples.en: Her distinctive laugh carries all the way across the workshop.
examples.zh: 她那「独特的」笑声能一路传到整个车间。

examples.en: The bakery's distinctive smell of cinnamon reaches the school gate.
examples.zh: 面包店「独特的」肉桂香气一直飘到校门口。

words.enDefinition: found in the ordinary course of events

examples.en: These everyday plates go in the dishwasher without any fuss.
examples.zh: 这些「日常用的」盘子直接放进洗碗机即可。

examples.en: The diary records her everyday struggles with the bus timetable.
examples.zh: 日记记录了她「每天」与公交时刻表较劲的琐碎。

words.enDefinition: spiritual being attendant upon God

examples.en: Grandmother keeps a little carved angel on the kitchen windowsill.
examples.zh: 奶奶在厨房窗台上摆着一尊小木雕「天使」。

examples.en: The nurse who stayed past her shift was our angel that night.
examples.zh: 那晚多留了班的护士就像我们的「天使」。

words.enDefinition: despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)

examples.en: The hike was exhausting; nonetheless, everyone signed up for next month.
examples.zh: 这次远足累坏了人；「尽管如此」，大家还是报了下个月的。

examples.en: The evidence was thin; the judge nonetheless granted the extension.
examples.zh: 证据虽薄，法官「仍然」批准了延期。

words.enDefinition: subject to legal action

examples.en: Drivers are liable for any damage caused while the car is borrowed.
examples.zh: 车子借出期间，司机须对一切损坏「承担法律责任」。

examples.en: The old river wall is liable to flood after two days of rain.
examples.zh: 连下两天雨后，老河堤「容易」漫水。

words.enDefinition: express greetings upon meeting someone

examples.en: The doorman greets every guest by name at the winter fair.
examples.zh: 冬季集市上，门童「问候」每位客人时都能叫出名字。

examples.en: Neighbours greet each other with a nod and the weather.
examples.zh: 邻居们碰面时「打个招呼」，聊聊天气。

words.enDefinition: bedding that keeps a person warm in bed

examples.en: Grandmother knitted a thick blanket for the baby's cot.
examples.zh: 奶奶为婴儿床织了一条厚厚的「毯子」。

examples.en: Frost covered the fields like a white blanket before sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出前，霜像白色的「毯子」一样盖住了田野。

words.enDefinition: to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')

examples.en: The recipe is wholly vegetarian, without any fish stock.
examples.zh: 这道菜谱「完全」是素的，一点鱼汤都不放。

examples.en: I am not wholly convinced the shortcut saves any time.
examples.zh: 我并「不完全」相信抄近路真能省时间。

words.enDefinition: to cause to become; to give or provide

examples.en: The witness rendered great help by describing the van's number plate.
examples.zh: 目击者描述了面包车的车牌，提供了很大「帮助」。

examples.en: The storm rendered the cliff path impassable for a week.
examples.zh: 风暴使崖边小路一周都「无法通行」。

words.enDefinition: agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole

examples.en: After two meetings, the residents reached a consensus on the roof colour.
examples.zh: 开了两次会后，居民们就屋顶颜色达成了「共识」。

examples.en: There is a general consensus that the market should start earlier.
examples.zh: 大家「一致认为」，集市应该提早开张。

words.enDefinition: relating to a colony or the period when a country had colonies

examples.en: The colonial courthouse now houses the town's little history museum.
examples.zh: 那座「殖民时期的」法院大楼如今是镇上的小型历史博物馆。

examples.en: Colonial administrators mapped the coast, though they never settled here.
examples.zh: 「殖民」官员曾绘制过海岸地图，却从未在此定居。

words.enDefinition: evidence that helps to solve a problem

examples.en: The muddy boot prints were the first clue in the missing cat case.
examples.zh: 泥泞的靴印是寻猫案的第一条「线索」。

examples.en: The last clue of the treasure hunt led to the old bicycle shed.
examples.zh: 寻宝游戏的最后一条「线索」指向旧自行车棚。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being intricate and compounded

examples.en: The tax form's complexity puts off most first-time applicants.
examples.zh: 税表的「复杂」让多数初次申报的人望而却步。

examples.en: He explained the complexity of the family feud in three sentences.
examples.zh: 他用三句话讲清了这场家族恩怨的「复杂」所在。

words.enDefinition: concerned with religion or religious purposes

examples.en: The oak by the spring is sacred to the older villagers.
examples.zh: 泉眼旁的橡树在年长村民心中是「神圣的」。

examples.en: They consider the first catch of the season a sacred offering.
examples.zh: 他们把本季第一网渔获视作「神圣的」供奉。

words.enDefinition: piece broken off or cut off of something else

examples.en: She taped the fragment of the old map into her notebook.
examples.zh: 她把那张古地图的「碎片」贴进了笔记本。

examples.en: Archaeologists found a pottery fragment beneath the chapel floor.
examples.zh: 考古学家在礼拜堂地板下发现了一块陶器「残片」。

words.enDefinition: a soft, low, continuous sound or speech

examples.en: A murmur of agreement went quietly round the long table.
examples.zh: 长桌旁响起一片低声「附和」。

examples.en: She heard the murmur of the stream all night from the tent.
examples.zh: 帐篷里整夜都能听到溪水的「潺潺低语」。

words.enDefinition: complete and total; also very steep

examples.en: It was sheer luck that the ladder leaned against the solid wall.
examples.zh: 梯子恰好靠在结实的墙上，纯属「十足的」运气。

examples.en: The path climbs the sheer face of the rock by iron rungs.
examples.zh: 小路靠铁蹬沿「陡峭的」岩壁攀上崖顶。

words.enDefinition: the property of something that is great in magnitude

examples.en: Move the fridge carefully; its bulk makes narrow doorways tricky.
examples.zh: 搬冰箱要小心，它「体积大」，窄门不好过。

examples.en: The bulk of the team arrives by the early bus.
examples.zh: 队里的「大多数人」都搭早班车到。

words.enDefinition: the condition of being essential or indispensable

examples.en: A good torch is a necessity when the power line fails.
examples.zh: 停电时，一把好手电是「必需品」。

examples.en: There is no necessity to buy the expensive brand; the basic one works.
examples.zh: 没有「必要」买贵的那款，基础款就够用了。

words.enDefinition: a long, low seat for two or more people

examples.en: The cat has claimed the sunny end of the couch.
examples.zh: 猫咪已经霸占了「沙发」向阳的那一头。

examples.en: We squeezed the new couch through the doorway by turning it sideways.
examples.zh: 我们把新「沙发」侧着才挤进门。

words.enDefinition: limited to a particular person, group, or organisation

examples.en: The bakery keeps an exclusive recipe that even the apprentices never see.
examples.zh: 那份「独家」配方连学徒都从未见过。

examples.en: The bay is exclusive to members on summer weekends.
examples.zh: 夏季周末，这片海湾「专供」会员使用。

words.enDefinition: story about mythical or supernatural beings or events

examples.en: Local legend says the well never runs dry, even in drought.
examples.zh: 当地「传说」这口井大旱之年也不干涸。

examples.en: My grandfather is a legend at the bowls club for his lucky throw.
examples.zh: 爷爷在草地滚球俱乐部是位「传奇人物」，全凭他那一手幸运投掷。

words.enDefinition: in the stage between childhood and adulthood; typical of teenagers

examples.en: The adolescent years are easier with a shared family dinner table.
examples.zh: 一家人同桌吃晚饭，孩子能更平稳地度过「青春期」。

examples.en: The clinic runs a free evening for adolescent footballers each month.
examples.zh: 诊所每月为「青少年」球员开设一次免费门诊夜。

words.enDefinition: large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India having a tawny coat with a shaggy mane in the male

examples.en: The stone lion by the library steps has a polished nose from luck.
examples.zh: 图书馆台阶旁的石「狮子」鼻子被摸得发亮，都说沾好运。

examples.en: The children's book shows a lion who is afraid of mice.
examples.zh: 那本童书画的是一头怕老鼠的「狮子」。

words.enDefinition: person or device that receives something; in insolvency, an official who takes control of assets

examples.en: The cordless receiver on the kitchen wall has gone quiet again.
examples.zh: 厨房墙上的无绳「听筒」又没声了。

examples.en: Lift the receiver gently; the hook is loose on this old phone.
examples.zh: 轻一点拿「听筒」，这部老电话的挂钩松了。

words.enDefinition: any customary observance or practice

examples.en: Sunday pancakes remain a small ritual in our busy kitchen.
examples.zh: 周日煎饼是我们忙碌厨房里一项小小的「仪式」。

examples.en: The nightly dog walk has become a ritual the whole street recognises.
examples.zh: 每晚遛狗已成「惯例」，整条街都认得这一幕。

words.enDefinition: provide with something desired or needed

examples.en: The guest room can accommodate four cousins during the reunion.
examples.zh: 团聚时，客房能「容纳」四位表亲住下。

examples.en: The restaurant accommodates wheelchair users with a ramp by the side door.
examples.zh: 餐厅侧门设有坡道，方便「接待」轮椅使用者。

words.enDefinition: causing or able to cause motion

examples.en: The police asked what motive the gardener had for removing the gate.
examples.zh: 警方询问园丁拆门的「动机」是什么。

examples.en: Love of the old building was her motive for buying the ruined mill.
examples.zh: 出于对老建筑的热爱，她买下了那座废磨坊，这正是她的「动机」。

words.enDefinition: worth having or seeking or achieving

examples.en: A south-facing kitchen is the most desirable feature of the little house.
examples.zh: 朝南的厨房是这栋小屋最「抢手的」亮点。

examples.en: It is desirable to book the ferry early in the holiday season.
examples.zh: 假期旺季最好「尽早」预订轮渡。

words.enDefinition: someone who has been admitted to membership in a scholarly field

examples.en: As the newest initiate, he fetches the chalk and rings the bell.
examples.zh: 作为最新的「新入会者」，他负责拿粉笔和摇铃。

examples.en: Each initiate swears to keep the society's recipes secret.
examples.zh: 每位「新会员」都要发誓保守社团的配方。

words.enDefinition: three-dimensional work of plastic art

examples.en: The park's bronze sculpture of two dancers attracts every wedding party.
examples.zh: 公园里那尊双人舞者的青铜「雕塑」是婚礼拍照必到之处。

examples.en: She studies sculpture and works mostly with driftwood and wire.
examples.zh: 她学「雕塑」，材料多用浮木和铁丝。

words.enDefinition: whole formed by a union of two or more elements or parts

examples.en: Common salt is a chemical compound of sodium and chlorine.
examples.zh: 食盐是一种由钠和氯组成的化学「化合物」。

examples.en: The medicine is a compound of four herbal extracts.
examples.zh: 这种药是四种草本成分合成的「复合制剂」。

words.enDefinition: the physical parts of a computer, and tools or equipment generally

examples.en: The shop sells garden hardware: trowels, hose fittings, and padlocks.
examples.zh: 这家店卖园艺「五金器具」：小铲、水管接头和挂锁。

examples.en: The laptop's hardware is fine; only the operating system needs updating.
examples.zh: 笔记本的「硬件」没问题，只是系统需要更新。

words.enDefinition: act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes

examples.en: The hostel failed to comply with the new fire regulations.
examples.zh: 这家旅舍没有「遵守」新的消防规定。

examples.en: All riders must comply with the helmet rule, coaches included.
examples.zh: 所有骑手都必须「遵守」戴头盔的规定，教练也不例外。

words.enDefinition: a loud, heavy blow or the noise made by shutting something hard

examples.en: The slam of the shed door startles the cat every time.
examples.zh: 每次棚门「砰的一声」，都会把猫吓一跳。

examples.en: Listen for the slam of the metal gate before the school bell.
examples.zh: 铁栅栏「砰然」一响，学校铃声随后就到。

words.enDefinition: society in an advanced state of social development (e.g., with complex legal and political and religious organizations)

examples.en: The museum traces how civilization reached these islands by sea.
examples.zh: 博物馆追溯了「文明」如何经海路传到这些岛屿。

examples.en: Ancient civilization flourished along the river for a thousand years.
examples.zh: 古代「文明」在这条河流域繁盛了一千年。

words.enDefinition: large and comfortable country house

examples.en: They rented a hillside villa with a lemon grove for August.
examples.zh: 八月他们租了山坡上一栋带柠檬园的「别墅」。

examples.en: The old villa by the gate has shutters painted sea-green.
examples.zh: 大门旁那座老「别墅」的百叶窗漆成了海绿色。

words.enDefinition: an undivided or unbroken completeness or totality with nothing wanting

examples.en: The judge's integrity was never questioned, even by losing parties.
examples.zh: 就连败诉方也从未质疑过法官的「正直」。

examples.en: Check the integrity of the hull before every long voyage.
examples.zh: 每次远航前都要检查船体的「完好性」。

words.enDefinition: an assembly (including one or more judges) to conduct judicial business

examples.en: The employment tribunal heard the cleaner's case on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 就业「仲裁庭」周二审理了这位清洁工的案子。

examples.en: A special tribunal will decide the boundary dispute between the farms.
examples.zh: 一个特别「法庭」将裁决两家农场间的地界纠纷。

words.enDefinition: an examination conducted by spoken communication

examples.en: She passed the oral part of the driving test first try.
examples.zh: 她一次就通过了驾照考试的「口试」部分。

examples.en: The oral exam lasts ten minutes, mostly about your chosen novel.
examples.zh: 「口试」十分钟，主要围绕你选的那本小说。

words.enDefinition: unpleasantly stern

examples.en: The coach's harsh criticism after the match surprised the young players.
examples.zh: 赛后教练「严厉的」批评让年轻队员很意外。

examples.en: Avoid harsh scouring pads on the new non-stick pan.
examples.zh: 新的不粘锅别用「粗糙的」钢丝球刷。

words.enDefinition: low continuous indistinct sound; often accompanied by movement of the lips without the production of articulate speech

examples.en: Grandfather mutters to his roses while he prunes them.
examples.zh: 爷爷修剪玫瑰时会对着花丛「喃喃自语」。

examples.en: She muttered an apology and wiped the spilt tea from the keyboard.
examples.zh: 她「低声」道歉着，擦掉洒在键盘上的茶水。

words.enDefinition: free from ambiguity

examples.en: The assembly instructions are straightforward: two pages and eight screws.
examples.zh: 组装说明「简单明了」：两页纸、八颗螺丝。

examples.en: She gave a straightforward answer about why the club lost money.
examples.zh: 对于俱乐部亏损的原因，她给出了「坦率的」回答。

words.enDefinition: woman whose husband is dead especially one who has not remarried

examples.en: The war widow still lays flowers at the memorial every November.
examples.zh: 每年十一月，那位「遗孀」仍会到纪念碑前献花。

examples.en: As a young widow, she ran the bakery alone for twenty years.
examples.zh: 年纪轻轻守寡后，她独自经营面包房二十年。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being humane

examples.en: The volunteers' quiet kindness restored our faith in humanity.
examples.zh: 志愿者默默的善举让我们重拾对「人性」的信心。

examples.en: Great novels remind us what we share in our humanity.
examples.zh: 伟大的小说提醒我们，「人性」中有哪些相通之处。

words.enDefinition: causing or capable of causing death

examples.en: The cliff path has no railings and a deadly drop below.
examples.zh: 崖边小路没有护栏，脚下就是「致命的」深渊。

examples.en: Some wild mushrooms are deadly when eaten raw or undercooked.
examples.zh: 有些野生蘑菇生吃或未煮熟是「致命的」。

words.enDefinition: small wild or domesticated web-footed broad-billed swimming bird usually having a depressed body and short legs

examples.en: The ducks queue hopefully by the pond railings at feeding time.
examples.zh: 喂食时间一到，「鸭子」们就在池塘栏杆边排起队。

examples.en: Roast duck with plum sauce is our festival treat.
examples.zh: 「烤鸭」配酸梅酱是我们过节的美味。

words.enDefinition: appeal or request earnestly

examples.en: She pleaded with the landlord to fix the boiler before winter.
examples.zh: 她「恳求」房东在入冬前修好锅炉。

examples.en: The defendant pleaded not guilty through his court lawyer.
examples.zh: 被告通过律师「答辩」称无罪。

words.enDefinition: two (or more) slices of bread with a filling between them

examples.en: Dad makes a cheese sandwich exactly the same way every morning.
examples.zh: 爸爸每天早上都一模一样地做奶酪「三明治」。

examples.en: Share the sandwich between the two of you; it's huge.
examples.zh: 这个「三明治」太大了，你们俩分着吃吧。

words.enDefinition: a place where ships are loaded and unloaded or repaired

examples.en: The fishing boats unload at the dock before the market opens.
examples.zh: 开市前，渔船在「码头」卸货。

examples.en: The old ship sits in dry dock for its yearly paint.
examples.zh: 那艘老船进「船坞」干修，准备年度刷漆。

words.enDefinition: residential district located on the outskirts of a city

examples.en: They moved to a quiet suburb where the schools are walking distance.
examples.zh: 他们搬到了一个安静的「郊区」，学校步行即到。

examples.en: The train links the northern suburbs with the city centre every ten minutes.
examples.zh: 北部「市郊」的火车每十分钟一班直达市中心。

words.enDefinition: characterized by grandeur

examples.en: The view from the bell tower is absolutely magnificent in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天从钟楼上望去，景色「壮丽无比」。

examples.en: She wore her grandmother's magnificent emerald brooch at the wedding.
examples.zh: 婚礼上，她戴着祖母那枚「华美的」祖母绿胸针。

words.enDefinition: the main stem of a tree; usually covered with bark; the bole is usually the part that is commercially useful for lumber

examples.en: Squirrels chase each other up and down the old oak trunk.
examples.zh: 松鼠们围着老橡树「树干」上蹿下跳。

examples.en: The fallen trunk across the stream makes a natural bridge.
examples.zh: 横在小溪上的倒下「树干」成了一座天然便桥。

words.enDefinition: piece of poetry

examples.en: She learned the second verse of the folk song by heart.
examples.zh: 她把那首民歌的第二「节」背了下来。

examples.en: The wedding card included a handwritten verse from the groom's grandmother.
examples.zh: 婚礼贺卡里附有新郎祖母手写的一「节诗」。

words.enDefinition: an evil supernatural being

examples.en: According to the play, the devil tempts the farmer with a golden scythe.
examples.zh: 剧里说，「魔鬼」用一把金镰刀引诱农夫。

examples.en: Kids dare each other to touch the devil statue in the old church.
examples.zh: 孩子们互相打赌，谁敢摸老教堂里的「魔鬼」雕像。

words.enDefinition: the act of taking something from someone unlawfully

examples.en: Report the theft of the bicycle to the police within a day.
examples.zh: 自行车被「盗」后，请在一天内报警。

examples.en: Insurance covers theft from the van if the windows are shut.
examples.zh: 只要车窗关好，货车内的失「窃」保险能赔。

words.enDefinition: steep high face of rock

examples.en: The lighthouse stands on the cliff where the seabirds nest.
examples.zh: 灯塔矗立在「悬崖」上，海鸟就在那筑巢。

examples.en: They watched the sunset from the cliff path with thermoses of tea.
examples.zh: 他们提着保温瓶茶水，在「峭壁」小路上看日落。

words.enDefinition: maintain or assert

examples.en: Historians contend that the bridge is older than the abbey.
examples.zh: 历史学家「主张」这座桥比修道院还古老。

examples.en: She had to contend with a leaking roof all winter.
examples.zh: 整个冬天她都得「应付」漏雨的屋顶。

words.enDefinition: an orderly arrangement

examples.en: The spice stall displays an impressive array of colours and smells.
examples.zh: 香料摊上「陈列着」色彩与气味都令人惊叹的「一排排」货品。

examples.en: The baker's window shows an array of iced buns every Friday.
examples.zh: 每逢周五，面包店橱窗「摆满」一「排排」糖霜小圆包。

words.enDefinition: create by putting components or members together

examples.en: The scouts assemble by the flagpole at ten sharp every Saturday.
examples.zh: 每周六十点整，童子军在旗杆旁「集合」。

examples.en: Grandfather can assemble the flat-pack shed in an afternoon.
examples.zh: 爷爷一个下午就能「组装」好那套板式棚屋。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being loyal

examples.en: The postman's loyalty to his round never wavered in forty years.
examples.zh: 四十年间，老邮差对这条投递路线的「忠诚」从未动摇。

examples.en: The dog's loyalty was rewarded with a place by the fire.
examples.zh: 狗狗的「忠心」换来了一块炉边专属地盘。

words.enDefinition: position 18 in a countable series of things

examples.en: The bakery opens its eighteenth branch by the station next month.
examples.zh: 下个月，这家面包房将在车站旁开出「第十八家」分店。

examples.en: She finished eighteenth in the county cross-country run.
examples.zh: 她在郡越野赛中获得「第十八名」。

words.enDefinition: By which; -- used relatively.

examples.en: They set up a trust whereby the orchard pays for the school books.
examples.zh: 他们设立了一项信托，「凭此」果园收益可为学校买书。

examples.en: A toll was introduced whereby lorry drivers pay for road repairs.
examples.zh: 新开征的通行费「据此」让卡车司机分担道路维修费用。

words.enDefinition: something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted

examples.en: The fallen elm was the last obstacle on the flooded lane.
examples.zh: 倒下的榆树是积水小巷的最后一处「障碍」。

examples.en: Shyness was the biggest obstacle to her singing in public.
examples.zh: 「羞怯」是她当众唱歌的最大「障碍」。

words.enDefinition: person who follows next in order

examples.en: The retiring head teacher introduces her successor at the autumn assembly.
examples.zh: 秋季开学典礼上，即将退休的校长介绍了自己的「继任者」。

examples.en: The old clockmaker trained his successor for three years before retiring.
examples.zh: 老钟表匠退休前花了三年培养「接班人」。

words.enDefinition: signal for attracting attention

examples.en: The fuel indicator flickers above half on the steep hill.
examples.zh: 陡坡上，油表「指示器」在半格上方闪动。

examples.en: Early leaf fall is a reliable indicator of a hard winter.
examples.zh: 落叶早，往往「预示着」寒冬将至。

words.enDefinition: device that removes something from whatever passes through it

examples.en: Replace the paper coffee filter before the morning rush begins.
examples.zh: 早高峰来临前，先把咖啡「滤纸」换掉。

examples.en: The pond filter keeps the water clear enough to see the goldfish.
examples.zh: 池塘「过滤器」让水清得能看清金鱼。

words.enDefinition: one who supervises or has charge and direction of

examples.en: The night supervisor checks the ovens one last time before locking up.
examples.zh: 打烊前，夜班「主管」会最后检查一遍烤炉。

examples.en: Ask the floor supervisor before moving the ladder, for safety.
examples.zh: 为安全起见，挪梯子前先问一下当班「主管」。

words.enDefinition: series of ordered groupings of people or things within a system

examples.en: In the kitchen, the hierarchy is clear: head chef, sous chefs, apprentices.
examples.zh: 后厨「等级分明」：主厨、副厨、学徒。

examples.en: The emails climbed the company hierarchy before reaching a decision.
examples.zh: 邮件在公司「层级」里层层上报，才等到决定。

words.enDefinition: identifying the nature or cause of some phenomenon

examples.en: The vet's diagnosis was a mild allergy to the new soap.
examples.zh: 兽医「诊断」是对新肥皂轻度过敏。

examples.en: A second doctor confirmed the diagnosis of the old fracture.
examples.zh: 第二位医生证实了那处旧骨折的「诊断」。

words.enDefinition: the head of the Roman Catholic Church

examples.en: The portrait of the young pope hangs beside the cathedral door.
examples.zh: 年轻「教皇」的画像就挂在主教座堂门口旁。

examples.en: History class covers how the medieval pope settled that dispute.
examples.zh: 历史课讲到中世纪「教皇」如何化解了那场争端。
