examples.en: The clerk flagged the prematurity payment before releasing any funds.
examples.zh: 出纳在放款前拦下了这笔「未到期付款」。

words.enDefinition: ownership interest related to preferred stockholders'

examples.en: Preferred stockholders' equity sits above common equity in the stack.
examples.zh: 「优先股股东权益」在权益结构中排在普通股之前。

examples.en: Convertible terms have completely reshaped the preferred stockholders' equity section.
examples.zh: 可转换条款重塑了「优先股股东权益」部分。

words.enDefinition: an operation involving business

examples.en: Licensing rules cover every single business operation on the premises.
examples.zh: 许可规定覆盖场所内的每一项「企业经营活动」。

examples.en: The tour showed how a modern business operation actually runs.
examples.zh: 这次参观展示了现代「企业经营活动」的真实运转。

words.enDefinition: indicators that track business conditions

examples.en: Weekly business indicators flash green, amber, or red per store.
examples.zh: 每周的「经营指标」按门店以绿、黄、红三色显示。

examples.en: Falling business indicators pushed the board to cancel the expansion.
examples.zh: 「经营指标」回落促使董事会取消了扩张计划。

words.enDefinition: law governing business

examples.en: A Contracts 101 module sits inside the first-year business law course.
examples.zh: 合同起草是第一年「商业法」课程的核心内容。

examples.en: A grounding in business law saves founders from nasty surprises.
examples.zh: 「商业法」的基础知识能让创始人免于踩坑。

words.enDefinition: the cost of real

examples.en: Rising inflation doubles the real cost of that quoted fee.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀使这笔报价的「实际成本」翻倍。

examples.en: Compare the real cost of each offer, not just the sticker.
examples.zh: 比较每份方案的「实际成本」，别只看标价。

words.enDefinition: the cost of re-order

examples.en: Frequent small deliveries raise the re-order cost per ordered unit.
examples.zh: 频繁的小批量送货抬高了单位「再订购成本」。

examples.en: The system balances re-order cost against holding cost fully automatically.
examples.zh: 系统会自动在「再订购成本」与持有成本之间取得平衡。

words.enDefinition: amounts billed for re-shipping

examples.en: The carrier waived all the re-shipping charges after the mix-up.
examples.zh: 弄错货物后，承运商免除了「重新装运的费用」。

examples.en: Re-shipping charges for the wrong sizes hit our margin hard.
examples.zh: 错码商品的「重新装运费用」重挫了我们的毛利。

words.enDefinition: the cost of rearrangement

examples.en: Moving the packing station carried a rearrangement cost of two weeks.
examples.zh: 搬移包装站产生了两周工时的「重布置成本」。

examples.en: Any rearrangement cost above five working days needs a sign-off.
examples.zh: 「重布置成本」超过五天的须报批。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for reasonable in

examples.en: The starter kits are quite reasonable in price for schools.
examples.zh: 对学校来说，这套入门工具的「价格」是合理的。

examples.en: Buyers found the extended warranty reasonable in price given the coverage.
examples.zh: 考虑到保障范围，买家认为延保「价格合理」。

words.zhGloss: 追认代理人所订的合同
words.enDefinition: approval that confirms contracts made by an agent
acceptedZhAnswers: 追认代理人所订的合同

examples.en: Board minutes recorded the ratification of agents' contracts signed abroad.
examples.zh: 董事会纪要记录了对代理人在海外所签合同的「追认」。

examples.en: Without the ratification of agents' contracts, the deposit deal collapses.
examples.zh: 没有对「代理人所订合同」的追认，定金交易就会告吹。

collocations: draft the ratification of agents' contracts
sign the ratification of agents' contracts
enforce the ratification of agents' contracts

words.enDefinition: enterprises engaged in government business

examples.en: All government business enterprises must publish audited results each year.
examples.zh: 「公营企业」每年必须公布经审计的业绩。

examples.en: The reform forced government business enterprises to compete for contracts.
examples.zh: 改革迫使「公营企业」通过竞标获取合同。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from recurring

examples.en: Subscription renewals alone give the studio a reliable recurring profit.
examples.zh: 订阅续费为工作室带来了稳定的「经常性利润」。

examples.en: Investors value steady recurring profit far above any one-off gains.
examples.zh: 投资者对「经常性利润」的估值远高于一次性收益。

words.enDefinition: the cost of recurring

examples.en: Ground rent is a recurring cost, whatever the season brings.
examples.zh: 无论淡旺季，地租都是一笔「经常性成本」。

examples.en: Carefully model every recurring cost before quoting the annual fee.
examples.zh: 报年度费用之前，先测算好每项「经常成本」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in redemption transactions

examples.en: The fund's redemption price is published at four each afternoon.
examples.zh: 该基金每天下午四点公布「赎回价格」。

examples.en: Early exit costs the investor the full redemption price spread.
examples.zh: 提前退出会让投资者承担全部「赎回价差」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for reference world market

examples.en: Our royalties track the reference world market price for copper.
examples.zh: 特许权使用费与铜的「世界市场参考价格」挂钩。

examples.en: Tax officials benchmark transfer prices against the reference world market price.
examples.zh: 税务官员以「世界市场参考价格」为基准检验转让定价。

collocations: calculate the reference world market price
compare the reference world market price
reduce the reference world market price

words.enDefinition: a reformation of contract used in professional practice

examples.en: Both parties signed a reformation of contract correcting the dates.
examples.zh: 双方签署了更正日期的「重订合同」。

examples.en: The court allowed reformation of contract to fix the clerical error.
examples.zh: 法院允许通过「重订合同」来纠正笔误。

words.enDefinition: the cost of bond issue

examples.en: Legal review trimmed the bond issue cost by a point.
examples.zh: 法律审查使「公司债发行成本」降低了一个百分点。

examples.en: Bond issue cost always runs visibly higher for unrated issuers.
examples.zh: 未评级发行人的「债券发行成本」更高。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for bond issue

examples.en: Amortise the whole bond issue expense across the five-year term.
examples.zh: 把「公司债发行费用」在五年期限内摊销。

examples.en: The bond issue expense hit the first-quarter results quite hard.
examples.zh: 「公司债发行费用」重创了第一季度的业绩。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for bond-issuing

examples.en: Printing and registration fees form most of the bond-issuing expense.
examples.zh: 印制和登记费用构成「发行公司债费用」的大头。

examples.en: Auditors questioned why the bond-issuing expense has doubled this year.
examples.zh: 审计人员质询「公司债发行费用」为何翻倍。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning reciprocal

examples.en: The twin shipments settle through reciprocal credit between both banks.
examples.zh: 两批互运货物通过双方银行间的「对开信用」结算。

examples.en: Reciprocal credit lets each side finance the other's consignment smoothly.
examples.zh: 「对开信用」让双方互相为对方的货载融资。

words.enDefinition: management of record

examples.en: Good record management easily survives any surprise inspection by authorities.
examples.zh: 良好的「记录管理」经得起任何突击检查。

examples.en: She thoroughly reorganised our record management before the ISO audit.
examples.zh: 在ISO审核之前，她重新梳理了「记录管理」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in published transactions

examples.en: Refiners sell against the published price minus a small discount.
examples.zh: 炼厂按「公布的价格」扣减少量折扣出售。

examples.en: All deviations from the published price require proper written reasons.
examples.zh: 偏离「公布价格」必须书面说明理由。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of brokerage

examples.en: The brokerage commission is one percent, capped at five thousand.
examples.zh: 「经纪人佣金」为百分之一，上限五千元。

examples.en: Try to negotiate the brokerage commission down for repeat high-volume orders.
examples.zh: 对持续放量的大客户，要把「经纪佣金」谈下来。

words.enDefinition: an office handling purchases from head

examples.en: Branches log purchases from head office in a separate ledger.
examples.zh: 分店把「向总公司购货」记入单独的账簿。

examples.en: Purchases from head office carry no extra profit margin at all.
examples.zh: 「向总公司购货」不加收利润。

collocations: secure the purchases from head office
visit the purchases from head office
lease the purchases from head office

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for purchase

examples.en: The purchase budget caps fabric spend at eight hundred thousand.
examples.zh: 「采购预算」把面料支出上限设为八十万元。

examples.en: Review the purchase budget before the autumn trade fair season.
examples.zh: 展会季开始前，先复核「采购预算」。

words.enDefinition: an office handling purchase from head

examples.en: Each purchase from head office carries a transfer price memo.
examples.zh: 每笔「总公司来货」都附有一份调拨价格备忘录。

examples.en: The latest purchase from head office arrived without the invoice.
examples.zh: 这批「总公司来货」到货时没有随附发票。

collocations: scope the purchase from head office
own the purchase from head office
handover the purchase from head office

words.enDefinition: the cost of budget

examples.en: Our budget cost per hire doubled after we switched agencies.
examples.zh: 更换中介后，每名员工的「预算成本」翻倍。

examples.en: Track budget cost against actuals weekly on the shared dashboard.
examples.zh: 在共享看板上跟踪「预算成本」与实际数。

words.enDefinition: documents used for budget

examples.en: Council members received all the budget documents three days early.
examples.zh: 议员们提前三天收到了「预算文件」。

examples.en: File every one of the budget documents before the audit visit.
examples.zh: 审计进场之前，把所有「预算文件」归档。

words.enDefinition: an enforcement for budget

examples.en: Budget enforcement tightened up considerably once department heads signed pledges.
examples.zh: 各部门主管签署承诺后，「预算执行」明显收紧。

examples.en: Software now enforces the budget enforcement rules in real time.
examples.zh: 软件如今实时执行「预算管控」规则。

words.enDefinition: a message concerning budget

examples.en: The mayor's annual budget message again pledges no new levies.
examples.zh: 市长的「预算咨文」承诺不加征新税费。

examples.en: The written budget message carefully explains every proposed cut line.
examples.zh: 「预算申请书」逐项解释了拟削减的科目。

words.enDefinition: a presentation for budget

examples.en: A much cleaner budget presentation won over the sceptical board.
examples.zh: 更清晰的「预算呈现」打动了持怀疑态度的董事会。

examples.en: Always follow the standard budget presentation format for grant applications.
examples.zh: 申请补助请采用标准的「预算格式」。

words.enDefinition: a process used for budget

examples.en: Our annual budget process starts with frontline input, not spreadsheets.
examples.zh: 「预算程序」从一线意见开始，而非电子表格。

examples.en: We shortened the budget process from ten weeks to six.
examples.zh: 我们把「预算流程」从十周压缩到六周。

words.enDefinition: a proposed budget submitted for approval

examples.en: The committee returns any budget proposal that lacks contingency lines.
examples.zh: 委员会会退回任何缺少应急科目的「预算提案」。

examples.en: Her revised budget proposal finally funded all the workshop upgrades.
examples.zh: 她的「预算提案」终于为车间升级争取到了资金。

words.enDefinition: a liability recognised for budget

examples.en: A separate budget provision covers flood repairs at the depot.
examples.zh: 「预算条款」为仓库的洪水修复预留了资金。

examples.en: The budget provision for staff training has doubled this year.
examples.zh: 今年的培训「预算拨备」翻了一番。

words.enDefinition: receipts from budget

examples.en: Budget receipts from licence fees have beaten the official forecast.
examples.zh: 牌照费带来的「预算收入」超出了预测。

examples.en: Track all the budget receipts weekly against the phased plan.
examples.zh: 按周对照分阶段计划跟踪「预算收入」。

words.enDefinition: an established practice in budget

examples.en: Rolling forecasts became standard budget practice after the currency shock.
examples.zh: 冲击之后，滚动预测成为标准的「预算做法」。

examples.en: Good budget practice keeps a full month of cash unbudgeted.
examples.zh: 良好的「预算习惯」会留出一个月的现金不作安排。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning group annuity

examples.en: The employer funds a group annuity contract for all retirees.
examples.zh: 雇主为退休员工购买了一份「团体年金合同」。

examples.en: The group annuity contract starts paying out from age sixty-five.
examples.zh: 这份「团体年金合同」自六十五岁起给付。

words.enDefinition: to force or push the market price up

examples.en: Speculators hoarded beans to raise the market upon the frost news.
examples.zh: 投机商囤积豆子，想借霜冻消息「抬高市场价格」。

examples.en: Bullish traders tried to raise the market upon the strike rumours.
examples.zh: 看涨的交易商试图借罢工传闻「拉升市价」。

collocations: need to raise the market upon
how to raise the market upon
fail to raise the market upon

words.enDefinition: a deposit lodged as security for a guarantee or obligation

examples.en: Tenants pay a guarantee deposit equal to two months' rent.
examples.zh: 租户须缴纳相当于两个月租金的「押金」。

examples.en: The full guarantee deposit returns within thirty days of checkout.
examples.zh: 「保证金」在退租后三十天内退还。

words.enDefinition: a guarantee covering export credit risk

examples.en: The state guarantee of export credits unlocked the Chilean order.
examples.zh: 国家的「出口信用担保」促成了智利订单。

examples.en: A guarantee of export credits covers both default and transfer risk.
examples.zh: 「出口信用担保」同时覆盖违约风险和转移风险。

collocations: arrange the guarantee of export credits
monitor the guarantee of export credits
repay the guarantee of export credits

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for breaking-up

examples.en: Shipbreakers quote a breaking-up price per lightweight ton delivered ashore.
examples.zh: 拆船商按轻载吨位报出「拆解价格」。

examples.en: Rising steel scrap lifted the breaking-up price for old tankers.
examples.zh: 废钢涨价抬高了旧油轮的「废料价格」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in breakeven transactions

examples.en: Always calculate the breakeven price before agreeing any volume discount.
examples.zh: 同意任何批量折扣之前，先算清「保本价格」。

examples.en: Their breakeven price sits fully twelve percent below our own.
examples.zh: 他们的「保本价」比我们低百分之十二。

words.enDefinition: quality control together with product reliability

examples.en: Joint quality control and reliability audits now run every quarter.
examples.zh: 「质量管理和可靠性」审核如今每季度进行一次。

examples.en: Aerospace clients demand documented proof of quality control and reliability.
examples.zh: 航空航天客户要求提供「质量管理与可靠性」的证明。

collocations: prioritise the quality control and reliability
standardise the quality control and reliability
monitor the quality control and reliability

words.enDefinition: activity related to quality control circle

examples.en: Quality control circle activity cut defects on line two by half.
examples.zh: 「质量控制圈活动」使二号线的缺陷减少了一半。

examples.en: Management credits quality control circle activity for the smoother runs.
examples.zh: 管理层把生产的顺畅归功于「质量控制圈活动」。

collocations: prioritise the quality control circle activity
standardise the quality control circle activity
monitor the quality control circle activity

words.enDefinition: a group formed for quality control

examples.en: Each shift elects two members to the quality control group.
examples.zh: 每个班次选出两名成员加入「质量管理小组」。

examples.en: The plant's quality control group meets every Thursday after lunch.
examples.zh: 「质量管理小组」每周四午饭后开会。

words.enDefinition: manufacturing overhead absorbed into production above the amount actually incurred

examples.en: A busy season produced over absorbed cost in the overhead account.
examples.zh: 旺季生产使间接费用账户出现了「多分配的成本」。

examples.en: Over absorbed cost means the predetermined rate ran too high.
examples.zh: 出现「多分配成本」说明预定分配率定高了。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred in circulating commodities through trade

examples.en: Warehousing and haulage together dominate the costs of commodity circulation.
examples.zh: 仓储和运输占「商品流通成本」的大头。

examples.en: E-commerce trimmed the costs of commodity circulation for farm goods.
examples.zh: 电商降低了农产品的「商品流通成本」。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning cost-plus fixed incentive

examples.en: The shipyard has always worked under a cost-plus fixed incentive contract.
examples.zh: 船厂按「成本加固定奖合同」承接工程。

examples.en: Under the cost-plus fixed incentive contract, all savings split equally.
examples.zh: 按「成本加固定奖励合同」，节约部分双方平分。

collocations: draft the cost-plus fixed incentive contract
sign the cost-plus fixed incentive contract
enforce the cost-plus fixed incentive contract

words.zhGloss: 成本加保证最大酬金合同
words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning cost-plus guaranteed maximum
acceptedZhAnswers: 成本加保证最大酬金合同

examples.en: Owners chose a cost-plus guaranteed maximum contract for the tunnel.
examples.zh: 业主为隧道工程选择了「成本加保证最大酬金合同」。

examples.en: A cost-plus guaranteed maximum contract strictly caps the builder's fee.
examples.zh: 「成本加保证最大酬金合同」为承建商酬金设定了上限。

collocations: draft the cost-plus guaranteed maximum contract
sign the cost-plus guaranteed maximum contract
enforce the cost-plus guaranteed maximum contract

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning cost-plus incentive fee

examples.en: Early delivery earned the builder a bonus under the cost-plus incentive fee contract.
examples.zh: 按「成本加奖金合同」，提前交付为承建商赢得了奖金。

examples.en: A cost-plus incentive fee contract rewards both speed and quality.
examples.zh: 「成本加激励酬金合同」同时奖励速度与质量。

collocations: draft the cost-plus incentive fee contract
sign the cost-plus incentive fee contract
enforce the cost-plus incentive fee contract

words.zhGloss: 成本加固定最大酬金合同
words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning cost-plus upset maximum
acceptedZhAnswers: 成本加固定最大酬金合同

examples.en: The whole refit runs under a cost-plus upset maximum contract.
examples.zh: 这次改装按「成本加固定最大酬金合同」执行。

examples.en: Under a cost-plus upset maximum contract, overruns hurt the builder.
examples.zh: 按「成本加固定最大酬金合同」，超支由承建方承担。

collocations: draft the cost-plus upset maximum contract
sign the cost-plus upset maximum contract
enforce the cost-plus upset maximum contract

words.enDefinition: the relationship between parties regarding cost-volume-profit

examples.en: The seminar mapped our cost-volume-profit relationship across three pricing scenarios.
examples.zh: 研讨班在三种情景下梳理了我们的「成本-数量-利润关系」。

examples.en: Understanding the cost-volume-profit relationship guided the whole discounting decision carefully.
examples.zh: 理解「成本-数量-利润关系」为折扣决策提供了依据。

words.enDefinition: a detailed examination of cost-revenue

examples.en: A quick cost-revenue analysis quietly killed the vending machine idea.
examples.zh: 一份「成本收入分析」否决了自动售货机的方案。

examples.en: Finance runs a full cost-revenue analysis before every branch opening.
examples.zh: 每开设一家分行之前，财务都要做「成本收入分析」。

words.zhGloss: 成本-数量-利润分析-量-本-利分析
words.enDefinition: a detailed examination of cost-volume-profit
acceptedZhAnswers: 成本-数量-利润分析-量-本-利分析

examples.en: Cost-volume-profit analysis showed the break-even point at nine thousand units.
examples.zh: 「本量利分析」显示盈亏平衡点在九千件。

examples.en: Run a completely fresh cost-volume-profit analysis after the price rise.
examples.zh: 提价之后，重新做一次「本量利分析」。

words.enDefinition: a detailed examination of cost-profit-volume

examples.en: The controller presented a cost-profit-volume analysis for the new line.
examples.zh: 财务控制人为新产线做了「成本-利润-产销量分析」。

examples.en: Careful cost-profit-volume analysis exposes how thin the mid-tier really is.
examples.zh: 「成本利润产销量分析」暴露了中档产品的微利程度。

words.enDefinition: indirect costs related to overapplied manufacturing

examples.en: Overapplied manufacturing overhead flows back to cost of goods sold.
examples.zh: 「过多分配制造费用」要转回销货成本。

examples.en: Auditors traced the overapplied manufacturing overhead to optimistic hour estimates.
examples.zh: 审计人员把「过多分配制造费用」追溯到了过于乐观的工时估计。

words.enDefinition: the cost of overhead activities

examples.en: Rent and insurance payments dominate our entire overhead cost structure.
examples.zh: 租金和保险占我们「间接费用成本」的大头。

examples.en: Sharing the warehouse ultimately halved each individual brand's overhead cost.
examples.zh: 共用仓库使各品牌的「间接费用」减半。

words.enDefinition: accepted requirements for overhead cost

examples.en: Overhead cost standards reset every July from the audited actuals.
examples.zh: 「间接费用成本标准」每年七月按经审计的实际数重订。

examples.en: Every department reports against the overhead cost standards once monthly.
examples.zh: 各部门每月对照「间接费用标准」进行报告。

words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual overhead cost

examples.en: An adverse overhead cost variance traced directly to unplanned maintenance.
examples.zh: 不利的「间接费用成本差异」源于计划外的检修。

examples.en: The overhead cost variance report reaches the plant manager weekly.
examples.zh: 「间接费用差异」报告每周送达厂长。

words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual overhead budget

examples.en: A favourable overhead budget variance quietly funded the training week.
examples.zh: 有利的「间接费用预算差异」为培训周提供了资金。

examples.en: Explain the overhead budget variance before the board pack goes out.
examples.zh: 董事会材料发出之前，先说明「间接费用预算差异」。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage overall cost

examples.en: Overall cost control rests firmly with the monthly operations review.
examples.zh: 「全面成本管理」依托于每月的运营评审会。

examples.en: The turnaround plan credits its survival to overall cost control.
examples.zh: 扭亏计划把生存归功于「全面成本控制」。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for overall

examples.en: The overall budget absorbs both the plant upgrades and hiring.
examples.zh: 「综合预算」同时涵盖了工厂升级和招聘。

examples.en: The directors approved the overall budget with only two abstentions.
examples.zh: 董事会在两票弃权下通过了「总预算」。

words.zhGloss: 买卖双方直接交易市场
words.enDefinition: a market for over-the-counter
acceptedZhAnswers: 买卖双方直接交易市场

examples.en: Unlisted bonds trade on the over-the-counter market entirely by phone.
examples.zh: 未上市债券通过电话在「场外交易市场」成交。

examples.en: Liquidity on the over-the-counter market always thins at month end.
examples.zh: 月末「场外市场」的流动性会变薄。

collocations: clear goods through the over-the-counter market

words.enDefinition: an approach that weighs costs against benefits

examples.en: A strict cost-benefit philosophy drives every single fixture decision here.
examples.zh: 这里每一项设施决策都遵循「成本-收益哲学」。

examples.en: The mayor's cost-benefit philosophy ultimately spared the much-loved old library.
examples.zh: 市长的「成本效益理念」保住了老图书馆。

words.enDefinition: studies of cost-benefit

examples.en: Formal cost-benefit studies preceded every bridge project in the decade.
examples.zh: 这十年间，每个桥梁项目之前都做过「成本-收益研究」。

examples.en: Critics say the official cost-benefit studies simply ignored heritage value.
examples.zh: 批评者认为这些「成本效益研究」忽视了遗产价值。

words.enDefinition: an evaluation for cost-benefit

examples.en: A detailed cost-benefit evaluation saved the popular night bus route.
examples.zh: 一次「成本-收益评估」保住了夜班公交线。

examples.en: Council rules require a cost-benefit evaluation for projects above two million.
examples.zh: 超过二百万元的项目须做「成本效益评估」。

words.zhGloss: 原始保证金；初始保证金
words.enDefinition: initial margin deposit required when a position is opened
acceptedZhAnswers: 原始保证金；初始保证金

examples.en: Post the original margin before the very first trade clears.
examples.zh: 第一笔交易结算前须缴纳「原始保证金」。

examples.en: The exchange lifted the original margin on rubber futures again.
examples.zh: 交易所再次上调了橡胶期货的「初始保证金」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of out-of-pocket manufacturing

examples.en: Only out-of-pocket manufacturing cost counts toward the emergency replacement quote.
examples.zh: 紧急报价只计算「付现制造成本」。

examples.en: By design, out-of-pocket manufacturing cost excludes every depreciation charge booked.
examples.zh: 「付现制造成本」在设计上不含折旧。

words.enDefinition: the cost of out-of-pocket

examples.en: Accept the claim only for documented out-of-pocket cost, with receipts.
examples.zh: 仅凭票据按「付现成本」受理索赔。

examples.en: Volunteering locally keeps the whole out-of-pocket cost very near zero.
examples.zh: 志愿参与可以把「自付成本」降到几乎为零。

words.enDefinition: the cost of outlay

examples.zh: 窑炉改造的「支出成本」合计九十万元。

examples.en: Compare the outlay cost with lifetime savings before approving anything.
examples.zh: 批准之前，比较「支出成本」与全周期节约。

words.enDefinition: the cost of output

examples.en: Output cost per tonne fell sharply after the preheater retrofit.
examples.zh: 预热器改造后，每吨「产出成本」下降了。

examples.en: The tender asks for our output cost, not list prices.
examples.zh: 标书要求报「产出成本」，而非目录价。

words.enDefinition: indirect costs related to other manufacturing

examples.en: Small tools and consumables sit within the other manufacturing overhead.
examples.zh: 小型工具和耗材归入「其他制造费用」。

examples.en: Auditors tested other manufacturing overhead entries for any missing invoices.
examples.zh: 审计人员抽查「其他制造费用」，寻找缺失发票。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for other income

examples.en: The other income budget counts hall hire and stall fees.
examples.zh: 「其他收益预算」计入了礼堂出租和摊位费。

examples.en: Other income budget shortfalls mostly come from empty market stalls.
examples.zh: 摊位空置使「其他收益预算」出现缺口。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for other

examples.en: Minor works sit inside the other budget, not capital projects.
examples.zh: 小型工程列入「其他预算」，而非资本项。

examples.en: The other budget also covers all the paid traineeship allowances.
examples.zh: 「其他预算」用于支付实习生津贴。

words.enDefinition: the cost incurred to manufacture a product

examples.en: The cost to manufacture one chair fell below forty dollars.
examples.zh: 一把椅子的「制造成本」降到了四十美元以下。

examples.en: Compare the cost to manufacture across both of our factories.
examples.zh: 比较两家工厂各自的「制造成本」。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit opened by an importer’s bank to pay for imported goods

examples.en: Our bank issued the import letter of credit at sight.
examples.zh: 我方银行开立了即期「进口信用证」。

examples.en: The import letter of credit explicitly lists three inspection certificates.
examples.zh: 这份「进口信用证」要求三种检验证书。

collocations: arrange the import letter of credit
monitor the import letter of credit
repay the import letter of credit

words.enDefinition: a factor affecting import

examples.en: An import factor in Milan collects the receivables for us.
examples.zh: 米兰的「进口保理商」替我们收取应收账款。

examples.en: The import factor advances a full eighty percent against each invoice.
examples.zh: 「进口代理商」按发票金额预付八成。

words.enDefinition: a firm dealing in import commission

examples.en: An import commission house in Lagos handles all our clearances.
examples.zh: 拉各斯的一家「进口代理商」负责我们的清关。

examples.en: The import commission house takes five percent on each lot.
examples.zh: 这家「进口佣金行」每批货抽五个点。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage import

examples.en: Import control tightened considerably on used electronics imports last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天，二手电子产品的「进口管制」收紧了。

examples.en: Our compliance team tracks every single import control policy change.
examples.zh: 合规团队跟踪每一项「进口管制」的变动。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit opened by an importer’s bank to pay for imported goods

examples.en: The import credit fully covers the whole shipment of machinery.
examples.zh: 这份「进口信用状」覆盖整批机械设备。

examples.en: Please ask the bank to confirm the import credit today.
examples.zh: 今天就让银行保兑这份「进口信用证」。

words.enDefinition: a curtailment for import

examples.en: Import curtailment on grain began immediately after the poor harvest.
examples.zh: 歉收之后，谷物「缩减进口」政策启动。

examples.en: The trade ministry announced an import curtailment on luxury goods.
examples.zh: 部委宣布对奢侈品「缩减进口」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in import transactions

examples.en: The import price of steel fell below domestic mill quotes.
examples.zh: 钢材「进口价格」跌到了国内钢厂报价之下。

examples.en: Customs value the goods at the import price plus freight.
examples.zh: 海关按「进口价格」加运费对货物估值。

words.enDefinition: a wholesaler of import

examples.en: An import wholesaler in Hamburg stocks all our spare parts.
examples.zh: 汉堡的一家「进口批发商」备有我们的配件库存。

examples.en: The import wholesaler breaks down full containers into smaller lots.
examples.zh: 这家「进口批发商」把整柜货拆分成小批。

words.enDefinition: a substitution for import

examples.en: Import substitution policies originally built up the local valve industry.
examples.zh: 「代替进口」政策催生了本地阀门产业。

examples.en: Import substitution works quite well until local component quality lags.
examples.zh: 「进口替代」在零部件质量掉队之前都是有效的。

words.enDefinition: a tender for import

examples.en: The port authority floated an import tender for new cranes.
examples.zh: 港务局为起重机发布了「进口招标」。

examples.en: Our import tender submission needs two solid local bank references.
examples.zh: 我们的「进口投标」需要两家本地客户的资历证明。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning import

examples.en: The import trade in timber revived after the tariffs eased.
examples.zh: 关税放宽后，木材「进口贸易」复苏了。

examples.en: Family-run firms have always dominated the import trade at this port.
examples.zh: 在这个港口，「进口贸易」由家族企业主导。

words.enDefinition: a bill of exchange arising from an import trade transaction

examples.zh: 银行在提示即日贴现了「进口贸易票据」。

examples.en: Each import trade bill references its own underlying purchase contract.
examples.zh: 每张「进口贸易票据」都注明对应的购货合同。

words.enDefinition: a market for parallel

examples.en: Fresh sanctions pushed more currency dealing onto the parallel market.
examples.zh: 制裁把货币交易挤到了「平行市场」。

examples.en: Goods reach shelves through the parallel market at premium prices.
examples.zh: 商品经由「平行市场」以溢价上架。

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in import and export

examples.en: The provincial import and export corporation handles all our filings.
examples.zh: 省「进出口公司」负责办理我们的申报。

examples.en: As an import and export corporation, we hold both licences.
examples.zh: 作为「进出口公司」，我们同时持有两类许可证。

collocations: calculate the import and export corporation
compare the import and export corporation
interpret the import and export corporation

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for import

examples.en: Our import agent in Durban clears shipments within two days.
examples.zh: 德班的「进口代理商」两天内即可完成清关。

examples.en: A truly reliable import agent knows every single tariff pitfall.
examples.zh: 可靠的「进口代理」熟知关税上的各种坑。

words.enDefinition: a market for paper

examples.en: Traders hedge their physical cargo against the liquid paper market.
examples.zh: 交易商以「纸货市场」对冲实货。

examples.en: Prices on the paper market lead the physical barrels by days.
examples.zh: 「纸(合同)市场」的价格领先实体油槽数天。

words.enDefinition: an improvement trade for import used in professional practice

examples.en: Fabric arrives completely duty-free under the improvement trade for import.
examples.zh: 面料按「加工进口贸易」免税入境。

examples.en: The improvement trade for import requires re-export within a year.
examples.zh: 「加工进口贸易」要求一年内复出口。

collocations: prioritise the improvement trade for import
standardise the improvement trade for import
monitor the improvement trade for import

words.enDefinition: an improvement trade for export used in professional practice

examples.en: Our coastal factory thrives on the improvement trade for export.
examples.zh: 我们的工厂靠「加工出口贸易」兴旺起来。

examples.en: Under the improvement trade for export, imported parts stay bonded.
examples.zh: 在「加工出口贸易」下，进口部件存于保税库。

collocations: prioritise the improvement trade for export
standardise the improvement trade for export
monitor the improvement trade for export

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for overhead standard

examples.en: Set overhead standard costs each July from audited departmental actuals.
examples.zh: 每年七月，根据经审计的部门实际数设定「间接费用标准成本」。

examples.en: Variances against overhead standard costs feed the monthly plant report.
examples.zh: 与「间接费用标准成本」的差异按月汇入工厂报表。

words.enDefinition: a wholesaler of importing

examples.en: An importing wholesaler in Sydney carries our whole spare range.
examples.zh: 悉尼的一家「进口批发商」备有我们全系列的配件。

examples.en: The importing wholesaler handles customs so retailers never touch forms.
examples.zh: 「进口批发商」包办清关，零售商完全不必碰单证。

words.enDefinition: ownership interest related to owner's

examples.en: Drawings above ten percent of owner's equity need a resolution.
examples.zh: 提款超过「业主权益」的百分之十，须通过决议。

examples.en: The balance sheet shows owner's equity built from retained profits.
examples.zh: 资产负债表显示「业主权益」由留存利润累积而成。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for imposed

examples.en: Head office handed each region an imposed budget without consultation.
examples.zh: 总部未经协商，就给各大区下达了「派定预算」。

examples.en: Staff quietly ignored an imposed budget they never helped shape.
examples.zh: 员工对这份从未参与制定的「派定预算」置之不理。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in package transactions

examples.en: The travel agent quoted a package price covering flights and hotels.
examples.zh: 旅行社报出的「组合价格」涵盖了机票和酒店。

examples.en: Buyers prefer one package price over ten separate line items.
examples.zh: 比起十项分列报价，买方更喜欢一个「打包价格」。

words.enDefinition: a market for improved

examples.en: Rate cuts quickly created an improved market for first-time buyers.
examples.zh: 降息为首次购房者带来了「好转的市场」。

examples.en: Sell the remaining plots now while we have an improved market.
examples.zh: 趁「行情好转」，把剩余地块卖掉。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning counter

examples.en: The whole deal closed as counter trade: turbines for timber.
examples.zh: 这笔交易以「补偿贸易」成交：用木材换涡轮机。

examples.en: Counter trade helped both firms dodge the hard-currency shortages entirely.
examples.zh: 「对销贸易」帮助双方避开了硬通货短缺。

words.enDefinition: a formal presentation of information about cost

examples.en: Always attach the cost statement before circulating the contract file.
examples.zh: 传阅合同档案前，先附上「成本明细表」。

examples.en: Every cost statement shows labour, materials, and overhead fully separately.
examples.zh: 每张「成本明细表」都把人工、材料和间接费用分列。

words.enDefinition: the path through which goods move to the end buyer

examples.en: Farm co-ops shortened the channel of distribution to two steps.
examples.zh: 农业合作社把「分销渠道」缩短到两个环节。

examples.en: Online stores became our fastest-growing channel of distribution last year.
examples.zh: 网店成了我们增长最快的「分销渠道」。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning cost reimbursement

examples.en: Public works projects often run under a cost reimbursement contract.
examples.zh: 公共工程常按「成本补偿合同」执行。

examples.en: Under the cost reimbursement contract, every single claim needs receipts.
examples.zh: 按「成本补偿合同」，每笔申领都要有凭证支持。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for oil-and-gas

examples.en: The concession agreement grants an oil-and-gas payment of twelve percent.
examples.zh: 特许协议规定了百分之十二的「油气权益支付」。

examples.en: Oil-and-gas payment obligations legally rank ahead of all general creditors.
examples.zh: 「油气权益支付」义务优先于普通债权人受偿。

words.enDefinition: a document presenting information about cost of production

examples.en: The cost of production report lands on my desk each Monday.
examples.zh: 「生产成本汇总表」每周一送到我的桌上。

examples.en: Line managers personally sign the cost of production report monthly.
examples.zh: 各产线经理每月在「生产成本汇总表」上签字。

collocations: draft the cost of production report
circulate the cost of production report
amend the cost of production report

words.enDefinition: the price charged in charm transactions

examples.en: Retailers deliberately set a charm price of just nineteen ninety-five.
examples.zh: 零售商把「有吸引力的价格」定在十九点九五。

examples.en: A charm price just under ten dollars lifted impulse purchases.
examples.zh: 略低于十元的「魅力价格」带动了冲动消费。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in official transactions

examples.en: Fuel sells at the official price posted at each station.
examples.zh: 燃油按各加油站公示的「官方价格」出售。

examples.en: Selling above the official price risks losing the fuel licence.
examples.zh: 高于「官方价格」销售会有吊销执照的风险。

words.enDefinition: an offer to sell shares or other assets by inviting potential buyers to submit bids

examples.en: The state sold its stake through an offer by tender.
examples.zh: 国家通过「投标报价」出售了所持股份。

examples.en: Bids for the government offer by tender closed at noon.
examples.zh: 这次「招标出售」的投标于中午截止。

words.enDefinition: the cost of order

examples.en: Rush setups badly inflate the order cost for small runs.
examples.zh: 紧急换装抬高了小批量订单的「定单成本」。

examples.en: Compare the order cost per job before quoting the client.
examples.zh: 给客户报价前，先比较每张工单的「订单成本」。

words.enDefinition: a system for order cost

examples.en: Their order cost system charges every hour to a job number.
examples.zh: 他们的「分批成本制度」把每个工时都记到订单号下。

examples.en: The order cost system automatically flags jobs running past estimate.
examples.zh: 「分批成本制度」会标记超出预估的订单。

words.zhGloss: 计算少数权益前的收益
words.enDefinition: a charge or stake related to income before minority
acceptedZhAnswers: 计算少数权益前的收益

examples.en: Income before minority interest reached eleven million dollars this year.
examples.zh: 今年「计算少数权益前的收益」达到一千一百万元。

examples.en: Analysts compare income before minority interest right across the group.
examples.zh: 分析师在集团层面对比「少数股东权益前收益」。

collocations: calculate the income before minority interest
compare the income before minority interest
interpret the income before minority interest

words.enDefinition: distribution of income

examples.en: Trust deeds fix the income distribution dates twice every year.
examples.zh: 信托契约把「收益分配」日期定为每年两次。

examples.en: The co-op's annual income distribution clearly favours its most active members.
examples.zh: 合作社的「收益分配」向活跃社员倾斜。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from incidental

examples.en: Parking fees are merely incidental revenue for the exhibition hall.
examples.zh: 停车费只是展览馆的「杂项营业收入」。

examples.en: Incidental revenue from scrap sales offsets the whole utility bill.
examples.zh: 废料销售的「杂项收入」抵消了水电开支。

words.enDefinition: manufacturing to fulfil a specific customer order

examples.en: Order production suits the switchgear shop better than stock building.
examples.zh: 对开关柜车间来说，「定单生产」比备货生产更合适。

examples.en: Under order production, nothing is cut until a contract lands.
examples.zh: 在「定单生产」模式下，没有合同就不下料。

words.enDefinition: the cost of order-filling

examples.en: Pick, pack, and label charges make up the order-filling cost.
examples.zh: 拣货、包装和贴标费用构成「定货供应成本」。

examples.en: Very small orders carry a disproportionate order-filling cost per unit.
examples.zh: 小额订单的「订单履行成本」占比格外高。

words.enDefinition: a mutual arrangement concerning orderly marketing

examples.en: Exporters signed an orderly marketing agreement limiting quarterly shipment volumes.
examples.zh: 出口商签署了限制季度销量的「有秩序销售协定」。

examples.en: The orderly marketing agreement quietly expires without renewal in June.
examples.zh: 「有秩序销售协定」六月到期后不再续签。

words.enDefinition: a market open to free trading without restrictive barriers

examples.en: Vendors set up the open-air market along the canal every Sunday.
examples.zh: 每逢周日，摊贩沿河岸摆起「露天市场」。

examples.en: Rent a stall at the open-air market before buying a shop.
examples.zh: 开店之前，不妨先在「露天市场」租个摊位试试。

words.enDefinition: a paper concerning open market

examples.en: Treasury funds cash gaps by rolling open market paper monthly.
examples.zh: 财务靠按月滚动「公开市场票据」来填补资金缺口。

examples.en: Open market paper yields track the central bank rate closely.
examples.zh: 「公开市场票据」收益率紧跟央行利率。

words.enDefinition: rental rates determined in the open market

examples.en: The lease renews at open market rentals every fifth year.
examples.zh: 租约每五年按「公开市场租金水准」续订。

examples.en: Surveyors benchmark open market rentals along the whole high street.
examples.zh: 测量师对整条街的「公开市场租金」进行了对标。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for open market

examples.en: Compensation follows the open market price at the date of loss.
examples.zh: 赔偿按损失发生日的「公开市场价格」计算。

examples.en: Compare the open market price with the awarded tender price.
examples.zh: 把「公开市场价格」与中标价比较一下。

words.enDefinition: budgeting for operational

examples.en: Operational budgeting starts in September for the next calendar year.
examples.zh: 「经营预算的编制」于九月启动，为下一公历年度做准备。

examples.en: Operational budgeting links every cost line to an activity plan.
examples.zh: 「经营预算编制」把每个成本科目与作业计划挂钩。

words.enDefinition: the cost of operational standard

examples.en: Set an operational standard cost per service call each spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天为每次上门服务设定「营业标准成本」。

examples.en: Variances against operational standard cost appear in the branch pack.
examples.zh: 与「营业标准成本」的差异出现在分行材料中。

words.enDefinition: rights related to income settlement

examples.en: Pensioners choose among three income settlement options at their retirement.
examples.zh: 退休时，养老金领取者可在三种「收益结算方式」中选择。

examples.en: The brochure explains the income settlement options in plain language.
examples.zh: 宣传册用通俗语言解释了各种「收益结算选择」。

words.enDefinition: management of operating

examples.en: Solid operating management kept both plants comfortably within their budgets.
examples.zh: 稳健的「经营管理」使两家工厂都未超预算。

examples.en: She rose from line leader to operating management in five years.
examples.zh: 她五年内从产线组长升到了「经营管理」岗位。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for operating expense

examples.en: The operating expense budget caps travel at two percent of sales.
examples.zh: 「营业费用预算」把差旅费上限定为销售额的百分之二。

examples.en: Review the operating expense budget carefully before every quarter ends.
examples.zh: 每季度结束前，先复核「营业费用预算」。

words.enDefinition: a small deposit held as security

examples.en: Visitors leave a small petty deposit for the site keys.
examples.zh: 访客为工地钥匙缴纳一笔「小额押金」。

examples.en: A petty deposit covers the toolkit borrowed for the day.
examples.zh: 「小额押金」担保当天借用的工具箱。

words.enDefinition: a firm’s credit standing and commercial reputation

examples.en: The bank weighed the firm's credit standing and respectability before lending.
examples.zh: 银行在放贷前权衡了该公司的「商业信誉」。

examples.en: Years of on-time delivery built our credit standing and respectability.
examples.zh: 多年按时交货铸就了我们的「商业信誉」。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track house

examples.en: The flagship store serves as a house account we bill directly.
examples.zh: 旗舰店作为「总公司客户」，由我们直接开票。

examples.en: House account orders bypass the usual dealer margin entirely by design.
examples.zh: 「总公司客户」的订单不走常规的经销商加价。

words.enDefinition: a market for capture

examples.en: Aggressive pricing helped the young startup capture market share quickly.
examples.zh: 激进定价帮助这家初创公司迅速「夺取市场份额」。

examples.en: Free trials let the newcomer capture market attention remarkably fast.
examples.zh: 免费试用让新品牌迅速「赢得市场关注」。

collocations: clear goods through the capture market

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for perpetual

examples.en: A perpetual budget rolls forward one month as each closes.
examples.zh: 「持续预算」每月结账后向前滚动一个月。

examples.en: With a perpetual budget in place, forecasts never go stale.
examples.zh: 采用「持续预算」，预测永远不会过时。

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for hybrid direct

examples.en: The whole group applies hybrid direct costing across its divisions.
examples.zh: 集团在各事业部推行「混合直接成本计算」。

examples.en: Hybrid direct costing treats key fixed costs as product costs.
examples.zh: 「混合直接成本法」把关键固定成本视为产品成本。

words.enDefinition: a holding the market used in professional practice

examples.en: The syndicate kept holding the market by absorbing every offer.
examples.zh: 财团不断吸纳卖单，稳稳「支撑着市场」。

examples.en: Regulators closely watched traders suspected of holding the market up.
examples.zh: 监管机构盯上了涉嫌「操纵维持市价」的交易商。

collocations: clear goods through the holding the market

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning hire-purchase

examples.en: The old lathe was acquired under an affordable hire-purchase contract.
examples.zh: 这台车床是按「分期付款合同」购入的。

examples.en: Under the hire-purchase contract, ownership passes after the final instalment.
examples.zh: 按「分期付款合同」，付清最后一期后所有权转移。

words.zhGloss: 确定营业收入的实际成本规则
words.enDefinition: recognition of historical-cost rules revenue
acceptedZhAnswers: 确定营业收入的实际成本规则

examples.en: The lecture covered historical-cost rules revenue recognition with worked cases.
examples.zh: 这堂课通过案例讲解了按「历史成本规则确认营业收入」。

examples.en: Auditors tested compliance with the historical-cost rules revenue recognition policy.
examples.zh: 审计人员测试了「按实际成本规则确认收入」的遵循情况。

collocations: prioritise the historical-cost rules revenue recognition
standardise the historical-cost rules revenue recognition
monitor the historical-cost rules revenue recognition

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for planned

examples.en: The planned budget already reserves funds for the apprenticeship scheme.
examples.zh: 「事先安排的预算」为学徒计划预留了资金。

examples.en: Compare the planned budget against actual outturn each September carefully.
examples.zh: 每年九月把「计划预算」与执行结果对比。

words.enDefinition: the cost of providing capacity

examples.en: Standby generators are a capacity cost that we cannot avoid.
examples.zh: 备用发电机是不可避免的「生产能量成本」。

examples.en: Renting the extra hall adds capacity cost only for peak weeks.
examples.zh: 租用临时场馆只在高峰周产生「产能成本」。

words.enDefinition: capacity production; a manufacturing method or production measure

examples.en: The plant reached capacity production within three months of opening.
examples.zh: 工厂投产三个月内就达到了「正常生产量」。

examples.en: Full capacity production runs left no room for rush orders.
examples.zh: 满负荷「正常生产」之下，再无余力承接急单。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for past service

examples.en: The scheme amendment created past service costs of two million.
examples.zh: 计划修订产生了二百万元的「以往服务成本」。

examples.en: Actuaries will spread the past service costs over fifteen years.
examples.zh: 精算师把「以往服务成本」在十五年内摊销。

words.enDefinition: security pledged for cash deposit as

examples.en: The landlord demands a cash deposit as collateral before handover.
examples.zh: 交房前，房东要求以现金「保证金」作担保。

examples.en: A cash deposit as collateral secures the whole trading licence.
examples.zh: 一笔「现金保证金」担保了这张经营牌照。

collocations: prioritise the cash deposit as collateral
standardise the cash deposit as collateral
monitor the cash deposit as collateral

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for paying

examples.en: A Luxembourg bank acts as paying agent for the notes.
examples.zh: 卢森堡的一家银行担任票据的「付款代理人」。

examples.en: Coupons arrive through the paying agent on the due date.
examples.zh: 利息券在到期日经「付款代理」支付。

words.enDefinition: a payable at a usance used in professional practice

examples.en: The draft is payable at a usance of ninety days.
examples.zh: 这张汇票为九十天期的「远期付款」。

examples.en: Goods ship even though payment is payable at a usance.
examples.zh: 虽然货款为「远期付款」，货物仍先行发运。

words.enDefinition: a commercial case or commercial matter under review

examples.en: The court listed the commercial case for a November hearing.
examples.zh: 法院将这起「商业案件」定于十一月开庭。

examples.en: Arbitration suits a commercial case better than the slow courts.
examples.zh: 比起拖沓的法院，「商事仲裁」更适合商业纠纷。

words.enDefinition: a market for cash

examples.en: Physical cocoa trades on the cash market for immediate delivery.
examples.zh: 实物可可即时交割，在「现款交易市场」成交。

examples.en: Prices on the cash market lead the futures by a day.
examples.zh: 「现货市场」价格领先期货一天。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for cash

examples.en: Our courier insists on cash payment on every single delivery.
examples.zh: 快递员坚持「付现」交货。

examples.en: The cash payment discounts offset the card fees we avoid.
examples.zh: 「现金付款」的折扣抵消了我们省下的刷卡费。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in cash transactions

examples.en: The cash price undercuts the credit terms by four percent.
examples.zh: 「现金售价」比赊购条件便宜百分之四。

examples.en: Always ask first for the cash price before considering instalments.
examples.zh: 考虑分期之前，先问问「现款价格」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of idle time

examples.en: Machine breakdowns added five thousand of idle time cost in May.
examples.zh: 五月，设备故障带来五千元的「停工时间成本」。

examples.en: Supervisors log the idle time cost whenever materials run late.
examples.zh: 只要材料延误，主管就会记录「停工时间成本」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of pension

examples.en: Total pension cost rose again with the new salary ceilings.
examples.zh: 新的工资上限使「养老金费用」上升了。

examples.en: Actuarial gains trimmed pension cost for the first time in years.
examples.zh: 精算收益多年来首次压低了「养老金成本」。

words.enDefinition: a shortfall between credit demand and available credit

examples.en: Small suppliers face a credit gap between order and payment.
examples.zh: 小供应商在接单到回款之间面临「信用缺口」。

examples.en: Microloans aim to bridge the deep rural credit gap entirely.
examples.zh: 小额贷款旨在填补农村的「信贷缺口」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of period

examples.en: Marketing spend is a period cost, not a product cost.
examples.zh: 营销支出属于「期间成本」，而非产品成本。

examples.en: Period cost treatment changed completely once the whole division reorganised.
examples.zh: 事业部重组后，「期间成本」的核算口径变了。

words.enDefinition: payment made under the agreed credit terms of a sale rather than in cash on delivery

examples.en: Buyers qualify for payment on terms after two clean seasons.
examples.zh: 客户经历两个无争议季度后，即可获得「按约定条件付款」资格。

examples.en: We offer payment on terms of sixty days from invoice.
examples.zh: 我们提供发票日后六十天的「按条件付款」方式。

words.enDefinition: payment arranged on delivery terms

examples.en: Drivers collect payment on delivery at every single rural drop.
examples.zh: 司机在每个乡村送货点「交货后收款」。

examples.en: Payment on delivery best suits first-time buyers still testing us.
examples.zh: 「交货后付款」适合还在试单的新客户。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning carrying

examples.en: The island's carrying trade moved grain between the two ports.
examples.zh: 这座岛屿的「航运业务」在两港之间转运粮食。

examples.en: Steamships ended the long sailing era of the carrying trade.
examples.zh: 蒸汽船终结了「运输业」的帆船时代。

words.enDefinition: transactions involving payment

examples.en: The new terminal handles payment transactions in under two seconds.
examples.zh: 这台终端处理「支付业务」不到两秒。

examples.en: Regulators monitor all payment transactions closely for unusual daily patterns.
examples.zh: 监管机构监测「支付交易」中的异常模式。

words.enDefinition: payment made in successive installments

examples.en: The small workshop accepted payment in installments across six months.
examples.zh: 作坊同意分六个月「分期支付」款项。

examples.en: Payment in installments greatly eases the burden on young farmers.
examples.zh: 「分期支付」减轻了年轻农户的负担。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of payment

examples.en: The bank levies a payment commission on every single transfer.
examples.zh: 银行对每笔汇款收取「付款手续费」。

examples.en: Compare payment commission rates at three banks before wiring the deposit.
examples.zh: 汇定金之前，先比较各家银行的「付款手续费」。

words.enDefinition: a documentary credit payable against presentation of the required documents or draft

examples.en: A payment against documents credit protects both exporter and importer.
examples.zh: 「凭单付款信用状」同时保护出口商和进口商。

examples.en: Under the payment against documents credit, originals change hands at the bank.
examples.zh: 按「凭单付款信用证」，正本单据在银行柜台交割。

collocations: arrange the payment against documents credit
monitor the payment against documents credit
repay the payment against documents credit

words.enDefinition: a documentary credit payable against presentation of the required documents or draft

examples.en: The payment against draft credit requires a sight draft only.
examples.zh: 这份「凭汇票付款的信用状」只要求即期汇票。

examples.en: Banks favour a payment against draft credit for trusted buyers.
examples.zh: 对可信的买方，银行更愿意开「凭汇票付款信用证」。

collocations: arrange the payment against draft credit
monitor the payment against draft credit
repay the payment against draft credit

words.enDefinition: payment arranged or analysed by intervention

examples.en: The guarantor saved the whole deal through payment by intervention.
examples.zh: 担保人通过「参加付款」挽救了这笔交易。

examples.en: Payment by intervention transfers to the honourer all recourse rights.
examples.zh: 「参加付款」使代付方取得全部追索权。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning carriage

examples.en: The carriage contract names Rotterdam as the port of discharge.
examples.zh: 「运送契约」指定鹿特丹为卸货港。

examples.en: Liability limits sit in clause seven of the carriage contract.
examples.zh: 责任限额写在「运输合同」第七条。

words.enDefinition: a charge or stake related to carried

examples.en: Fund managers earn carried interest only above the hurdle rate.
examples.zh: 只有超过门槛收益率，基金经理才能获得「附带权益」。

examples.en: Carried interest on the property fund vests after year five.
examples.zh: 这只地产基金的「附股权益」在第五年后归属。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with associated

examples.en: We hold twenty percent in an associated company in Kuala Lumpur.
examples.zh: 我们在吉隆坡的一家「联营公司」持股百分之二十。

examples.en: All transfers with the associated company must follow market prices.
examples.zh: 与「联号」之间的交易按市场价格进行。

words.enDefinition: retirement of asset

examples.en: Full asset retirement for the old rig starts next spring.
examples.zh: 旧钻井平台的「资产退役」明年春天启动。

examples.en: Separate provisions fully cover asset retirement obligations at each site.
examples.zh: 各场址都为「资产退役义务」计提了准备。

words.enDefinition: transport of goods by road

examples.en: Road transport moves the crates from the plant to the quay.
examples.zh: 「公路运输」把板条箱从工厂运抵码头。

examples.en: Rail beats road transport on cost but not on timing.
examples.zh: 铁路比「公路运输」省钱，但时效不如。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for general

examples.en: Postage, stationery, and cleaning costs all fall under general expenses.
examples.zh: 邮资、文具和清洁费都归入「总务费用」。

examples.en: Total general expenses must stay under eight percent of turnover.
examples.zh: 「总务费用」须控制在营业额的百分之八以内。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for renewal

examples.en: The licence renewal expense hits our books every single January.
examples.zh: 每年一月，牌照「更新费用」都会入账。

examples.en: Always budget the renewal expense well before the franchise expires.
examples.zh: 特许到期之前，先把「续约费用」编入预算。

words.enDefinition: delivery terms under which goods are free when discharged overside

examples.en: The seller quoted free overside at the overseas discharge port.
examples.zh: 卖方按卸货港「输入港船上交货价格」报价。

examples.en: Under free overside terms, the buyer arranges lighters and duty.
examples.zh: 按「船上交货（输入港）」条款，驳运和关税由买方负责。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for selling

examples.en: Commissions and showroom rent form the bulk of selling expenses.
examples.zh: 佣金和展厅租金构成「销售费用」的大头。

examples.en: Selling expenses climbed much faster than revenue during this half.
examples.zh: 本半年「销售费用」的增速超过了收入。

words.enDefinition: an agency dealing with sale

examples.en: A small Sale agency downtown handles all our used-car disposals.
examples.zh: 一家「分销处」代理我们的二手车处置业务。

examples.en: The sale agency works purely on a sales commission basis.
examples.zh: 这家「代销处」纯粹收取佣金。

words.enDefinition: a sale of goods while they are still afloat in transit

examples.en: The cargo changed hands on a sale afloat near Singapore.
examples.zh: 这批货在新加坡近海以「运输中销售」方式易手。

examples.en: A sale afloat transfers all risk once documents are endorsed.
examples.zh: 「运输中销售」在单据背书后即转移风险。

words.enDefinition: money received from deductions from

examples.en: Allowable deductions from income cut the tax bill by a third.
examples.zh: 允许的「收益减除项」使税单减少了三分之一。

examples.en: Review every one of the allowable deductions from income before filing the tax returns.
examples.zh: 报税之前，逐项复核「收益减除数」。

words.enDefinition: an agency dealing with advertising

examples.en: The advertising agency carefully storyboards each campaign before filming begins.
examples.zh: 「广告公司」在开拍前为每个活动绘制分镜。

examples.en: We moved our account to an advertising agency in Osaka.
examples.zh: 我们把业务转给了大阪的一家「广告代理公司」。

words.enDefinition: authority to administer or manage an activity

examples.en: The lease grants the landlord full administration authority over common areas.
examples.zh: 租约赋予房东对公共区域的完整「管理权」。

examples.en: The ministry's administration authority covers every single licensed bonded warehouse.
examples.zh: 该部委的「管理权限」覆盖所有持牌仓库。

words.enDefinition: assets associated with active

examples.en: Auditors must separate active assets from all long-mothballed idle equipment.
examples.zh: 审计人员把「活跃资产」与封存设备分开列示。

examples.en: Only genuinely active assets still qualify for the depreciation allowance.
examples.zh: 只有「在用资产」才有资格享受折旧减免。

words.enDefinition: earnings of unconsolidated subsidiary

examples.en: The accounts disclose the earning of unconsolidated subsidiary ventures separately.
examples.zh: 报表单独披露「未合并子公司盈余」。

examples.en: Earning of unconsolidated subsidiary operations adds seven percent to group value.
examples.zh: 「未合并子公司的收益」为集团价值贡献了百分之七。

words.enDefinition: delivery under store door terms

examples.en: Store door delivery replaced the depot pickup for city clients.
examples.zh: 对市区客户，「商店门前交货」取代了仓库自提。

examples.en: Store door delivery adds roughly three dollars to each order.
examples.zh: 「送货到店」使每张订单增加三美元成本。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for store rent

examples.en: Total store rent expense rose sharply after the flagship relocation.
examples.zh: 旗舰店搬迁后，「商店租金费用」上涨了。

examples.en: Store rent expense is booked straight-line over the full lease.
examples.zh: 「店铺租金费用」按租期直线法入账。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage stores

examples.en: Tight stores control keeps the whole tool crib within budget.
examples.zh: 严格的「仓库控制」使工具室开支不超预算。

examples.en: Overall stores control improved once barcodes replaced the paper ledger.
examples.zh: 条码取代纸质台账后，「库存管理」明显改善。

words.enDefinition: a store of ex

examples.en: We quote ex store, so collection is on your account.
examples.zh: 我们按「仓库交货」报价，提货费用由贵方承担。

examples.en: Always inspect the timber ex store before you lift it.
examples.zh: 木材请在「仓库交货」时当场验看。

collocations: clear goods through the ex store

words.enDefinition: a godown for ex maker's

examples.en: All deliveries are made ex maker's godown in Kowloon Bay.
examples.zh: 交货方式为九龙湾「制造商仓库交货」。

examples.en: Buyers collect the goods ex maker's godown every Friday morning.
examples.zh: 买方每周五上午到「制造商仓库」提货。

words.enDefinition: a godown for ex seller's

examples.en: We quickly agreed on a final price ex seller's godown.
examples.zh: 双方议定了「卖方仓库交货价格」。

examples.en: Under ex seller's godown terms, insurance passes at the gate.
examples.zh: 按「卖方仓库交货」条款，保险在大门口转移。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with transport

examples.en: Our transport company double-staffs every single frost-risk overnight run in winter.
examples.zh: 这家「运输公司」为每个霜冻风险班次配备双司机。

examples.en: Switching transport company saved us a full nine percent on freight.
examples.zh: 更换「运输公司」使运费节省了百分之九。

words.enDefinition: items related to extraordinary

examples.en: Flood losses appear in the accounts as extraordinary items below the line.
examples.zh: 洪水损失作为「非常项目」列在线下。

examples.en: Careful analysts strip out all extraordinary items before comparing margins.
examples.zh: 分析师在比较毛利前会剔除「非常项目」。

words.enDefinition: a sale of obligation

examples.en: Regulators forced an obligation sale of the excess fuel quota.
examples.zh: 监管机构强制对多余的燃油配额进行「义务出售」。

examples.en: The court-ordered obligation sale fully settled the estate's tax liabilities.
examples.zh: 这次「强制销售」清偿了遗产的税务负担。

words.enDefinition: indirect costs related to normal

examples.en: Budget at normal overhead, not at last year's pandemic lows.
examples.zh: 按「正常制造费用」编制预算，别照搬去年的低谷数。

examples.en: Normal overhead here assumes a steady eighty-five percent capacity utilisation.
examples.zh: 「正常间接费用」按百分之八十五的产能利用率测算。

words.enDefinition: operations involving net income from

examples.en: Net income from operations doubled after the fuel hedge paid off.
examples.zh: 燃油对冲见效后，「营业净收益」翻了一番。

examples.en: Net income from operations deliberately excludes the one-off land sale.
examples.zh: 「营业净收益」不含一次性的土地出售收益。

collocations: calculate the net income from operations
compare the net income from operations
interpret the net income from operations

words.enDefinition: transit of item in

examples.en: Each item in transit carries marine insurance from the yard.
examples.zh: 每件「在途项目」都自出厂起投保了海运险。

examples.en: Reconcile every item in transit against the carrier's signed manifest.
examples.zh: 把每项「在途物品」与承运人舱单核对。

words.enDefinition: an operation involving line

examples.en: Line operation at the cannery runs two shifts all year-round.
examples.zh: 罐头厂的「生产经营」全年两班运转。

examples.en: Full line operation stopped only for the annual deep clean.
examples.zh: 「产线运营」只在年度深度清洁时停工。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with constituent

examples.en: Each constituent company of the group keeps its own registry.
examples.zh: 集团每家「成员公司」都保留自己的登记册。

examples.en: The constituent company list changed completely after the long demerger.
examples.zh: 分拆之后，「组成公司的成员」名单发生了变化。

collocations: open an account at the constituent company

words.enDefinition: money received from consolidated

examples.en: Our consolidated income rose eleven percent this quarter, even though the German subsidiary struggled.
examples.zh: 尽管德国子公司表现不佳，我们的「合并收益」本季度仍增长了百分之十一。

examples.en: The CFO walked me through how intercompany dividends disappear when we report consolidated income.
examples.zh: 首席财务官向我讲解了编制「合并收益」时内部股利是如何相互抵销的。

words.enDefinition: earnings from consolidated retained

examples.en: Accumulated losses from the Brazil unit dragged consolidated retained earnings into negative territory last year.
examples.zh: 巴西子公司累积的亏损使「合并未分配利润」去年转为负数。

examples.en: Before approving our dividend, the board reviewed the movement in consolidated retained earnings.
examples.zh: 在批准分红之前，董事会审查了「合并未分配利润」的变动情况。

words.enDefinition: supply that is not immediately visible in reported stocks

examples.en: Traders say invisible supply, like unreported private stocks, is keeping copper prices from spiking.
examples.zh: 交易员说，未申报私人库存这类「市场外供应」抑制了铜价飙升。

examples.en: The USDA report ignores invisible supply held on farms, so the grain estimates look too tight.
examples.zh: 美国农业部的报告没有统计农场持有的「市场外供应」，因此谷物估产显得偏紧。

words.enDefinition: a position that profits if the asset’s price rises
acceptedZhAnswers: 对市场价格持看涨观点

examples.en: He built a long position in the stock early last spring, well before the takeover rumor.
examples.zh: 早在去年春天收购传闻出现之前，他就建立了这只股票的「多头头寸」。

examples.en: The fund trimmed its long position in wheat futures once the weather forecast turned favorable.
examples.zh: 天气预报转为有利后，该基金减持了小麦期货的「多头头寸」。

words.enDefinition: brokerage that has been received

examples.en: Her agency lives on brokerage received from the shipping lines for each booking she places.
examples.zh: 她的代理行主要靠每笔订舱业务从船公司「领取手续费」维持经营。

examples.en: Brokers must disclose all brokerage received in the deal before the contract is signed.
examples.zh: 签约之前，经纪人必须披露本次交易中「已收取的全部佣金」。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for handling

examples.en: Repacking the damaged cartons added a surprising handling expense to the warehouse bill.
examples.zh: 重新包装破损纸箱，使仓储账单上多出了一笔意想不到的「搬运费用」。

examples.en: We quoted FOB precisely so the buyer would cover all handling expense at their port.
examples.zh: 我们特意按离岸价报价，好让买方承担其港口产生的全部「搬运费用」。

words.enDefinition: total proceeds before deductions

examples.en: From the gross proceeds of the auction, the gallery deducts commission before paying the artist.
examples.zh: 画廊先从拍卖「总收入」中扣除佣金，然后才向艺术家付款。

examples.en: The bond issue raised forty million in gross proceeds, before deducting underwriting fees.
examples.zh: 本次债券发行筹得「总收入」四千万美元，尚未扣除承销费用。

words.enDefinition: earnings from gross

examples.en: The bakery's gross earnings tripled after the hotel contract, yet cash still runs short.
examples.zh: 面包房拿下酒店合同后「业务总收益」翻了三倍，但现金流依然紧张。

examples.en: Before the audit, we reconciled gross earnings against the bank deposits month by month.
examples.zh: 审计之前，我们逐月核对「业务总收益」与银行进账是否一致。

words.enDefinition: a rebate granted for purchasing a larger quantity

examples.en: Order a full pallet and the wholesaler adds a five percent quantity rebate to your account.
examples.zh: 整托盘下单的话，批发商会在你的账户里计入百分之五的「批发折扣」。

examples.en: The quantity rebate only applies if all twelve containers ship within the same quarter.
examples.zh: 只有十二个货柜在同一季度内全部装运，才适用「批发折扣」。

words.enDefinition: amounts billed for overhead

examples.en: The landlord's service bill lists heating and other overhead charges separately from rent.
examples.zh: 房东的服务账单把供暖等「间接费用」与租金分开列示。

examples.en: Our tender lost out because competitors hid lower overhead charges in their pricing.
examples.zh: 我们投标失利，是因为竞争对手在报价中藏了更低的「间接费用」。

words.enDefinition: a resource controlled by an entity related to inadmitted

examples.en: The regulator made us reclassify goodwill as an inadmitted asset in the statutory return.
examples.zh: 监管机构要求我们在法定申报中把商誉重新归类为「不受保资产」。

examples.en: Because the artwork counts as an inadmitted asset, it cannot back our solvency margin.
examples.zh: 由于这批艺术品属于「不受保资产」，不能用来支撑我们的偿付能力额度。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)标准
words.enDefinition: accepted requirements for overhead expense
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)标准

examples.en: The plant finally updated its overhead expense standards after two years of rising energy prices.
examples.zh: 能源价格连涨两年之后，工厂终于更新了「制造费用标准」。

examples.en: Every quarter, cost accounting compares actual spending against the overhead expense standards.
examples.zh: 成本会计每季度都会将实际开支与「间接费用标准」进行比对。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)效率差异
words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual overhead efficiency
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)效率差异

examples.en: Most of this month's overhead efficiency variance came from the new operators learning the line.
examples.zh: 本月「制造费用效率差异」主要来自新操作工熟悉生产线的阶段。

examples.en: The supervisor questioned the overhead efficiency variance until we showed him the downtime log.
examples.zh: 直到我们出示停机记录，主管才不再质疑「制造费用效率差异」。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred for overhead

examples.en: Rent, insurance, and the audit fee all sit in overhead expenses, not in direct costs.
examples.zh: 租金、保险和审计费都归入「间接费用」，不计入直接成本。

examples.en: Trimming overhead expenses halfway through a product launch usually backfires.
examples.zh: 在产品发布进行到一半时削减「间接费用」，通常适得其反。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)分摊率
words.enDefinition: a rate used to allocate overhead costs to products or cost centres
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)分摊率

examples.en: With labor hours falling, our overhead rate per machine hour has climbed sharply.
examples.zh: 随着工时减少，我们每机器小时的「制造费用分摊率」大幅上升。

examples.en: The intern computed the overhead rate from budgeted figures, which skewed the whole quote.
examples.zh: 实习生用预算数计算「制造费用分摊率」，结果整个报价都失真了。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)开支差异
words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual overhead spending
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)开支差异

examples.en: The overhead spending variance turned unfavorable once the insurance premium was renewed.
examples.zh: 保险续费之后，「制造费用开支差异」变得不利。

examples.en: A clean overhead spending variance tells me the department controlled discretionary costs well.
examples.zh: 「制造费用开支差异」干净利落，说明该部门对可控成本管得很好。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)差异
words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual overhead
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)差异

examples.en: Please break the total overhead variance into spending, efficiency, and volume pieces for the meeting.
examples.zh: 开会前请把「制造费用差异」总额拆分为开支、效率和数量三部分。

examples.en: An unfavorable overhead variance two months running is worth an investigation on the plant floor.
examples.zh: 「制造费用差异」连续两个月不利，值得下车间查一查。

words.zhGloss: 间接费用(制造费用)数量差异
words.enDefinition: the difference between planned and actual overhead volume
acceptedZhAnswers: 间接费用(制造费用)数量差异

examples.en: Because we produced fewer units than planned, the overhead volume variance came out unfavorable.
examples.zh: 由于实际产量低于计划，「制造费用数量差异」出现了不利结果。

examples.en: Management dismissed the overhead volume variance as a scheduling problem, not a cost problem.
examples.zh: 管理层认为「制造费用数量差异」只是排产问题，而非成本问题。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage operation

examples.en: The plant manager credits tight operation control for the drop in defect rates.
examples.zh: 厂长把不良率下降归功于严格的「业务管理」。

examples.en: Our ISO review found the operation control procedures were drafted but never really followed.
examples.zh: ISO 审核发现，「业务管理」程序虽已起草，却从未真正执行。

words.enDefinition: payment for goods made when they are delivered

examples.en: The courier only accepts cash on delivery, so keep exact change ready for the driver.
examples.zh: 快递员只接受「货到付款」，请备好零钱付给司机。

examples.en: Given their credit history, we will sell to them on cash on delivery terms from now on.
examples.zh: 鉴于他们的信用记录，今后我们只按「货到付款」方式与其交易。

words.enDefinition: an official authorisation or document instructing that a payment be made

examples.en: Treasury won't release the contractor's money until the project office signs the pay warrant.
examples.zh: 项目办公室在「付款授权书」上签字之前，财务部门不会向承包商放款。

examples.en: Each month the accountant prepares a pay warrant for wages and files it with the bank.
examples.zh: 会计每月编制一份工资「支付凭证」，并送交银行存档。

words.enDefinition: the statement of cost incurred in producing goods

examples.en: The bank asked for a statement of cost of production before it would extend the seasonal loan.
examples.zh: 银行要求先提供「生产成本表」，才肯发放这笔季节性贷款。

examples.en: I pulled last year's statement of cost of production to benchmark this quarter's energy usage.
examples.zh: 我调出去年的「生产成本表」，为本季度的能耗水平找参照。

collocations: prioritise the statement of cost of production
standardise the statement of cost of production
monitor the statement of cost of production

words.enDefinition: statement of cost and production; a manufacturing method or production measure

examples.en: Attach the statement of cost and production to the monthly report so the owners see both numbers.
examples.zh: 请把「产品成本及产量表」附在月报后面，让业主们同时看到两项数据。

examples.en: The consultant rebuilt our statement of cost and production after spotting a double-counted setup charge.
examples.zh: 顾问发现一笔调机费被重复计算后，重编了我们的「产品成本及产量表」。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for asset acquisition and retirement

examples.en: The board questioned the asset acquisition and retirement budget because the disposal values looked optimistic.
examples.zh: 董事会质疑「资产购置和退役预算」，因为报废残值定得过于乐观。

examples.en: We trim the asset acquisition and retirement budget every autumn before submitting the capital plan.

renew the payment terms of commercial agreement
terminate the payment terms of commercial agreement

words.enDefinition: settlement of a trade transaction using a letter of credit as the payment instrument

examples.en: Payment with letter of credit reassured the Vietnamese supplier more than any deposit could.
examples.zh: 对越南供应商来说，「用信用证付款」比任何定金都更能让人安心。

examples.en: We insisted on payment with letter of credit for the first three orders.
examples.zh: 前三笔订单我们坚持「以信用证方式付款」。

collocations: arrange the payment with letter of credit
monitor the payment with letter of credit
repay the payment with letter of credit

words.enDefinition: collection of payment against documents through

examples.en: We agreed to payment against documents through collection instead of a costly confirmed credit.
examples.zh: 我们同意采用「托收项下的凭单付款」，省下费用高昂的保兑信用证。

examples.en: Under payment against documents through collection, the bank releases papers only when the buyer pays.
examples.zh: 在「托收凭单付款」方式下，银行只在买方付款后才交单。

collocations: prioritise the payment against documents through collection
standardise the payment against documents through collection
monitor the payment against documents through collection

words.enDefinition: gain on realization of assets used in professional practice

examples.en: The liquidator reported a modest gain on realization of assets from selling the delivery vans.
examples.zh: 清算人报告称，出售送货车获得了少量「变产收益」。

examples.en: Any gain on realization of assets goes to the secured creditors first, per the deed.
examples.zh: 按照契约约定，「变产收益」首先归属担保债权人。

collocations: classify gain on realization of assets
measure gain on realization of assets
disclose gain on realization of assets

words.enDefinition: assets associated with turnover of total operating

examples.en: Their turnover of total operating assets improved once the idle warehouse was sold.
examples.zh: 闲置仓库出售之后，他们的「总经营资产周转率」有所提高。

examples.en: Consultants benchmark our turnover of total operating assets against the industry median.
examples.zh: 顾问们以行业中位数来对标我们的「总经营资产周转率」。

collocations: classify turnover of total operating assets
measure turnover of total operating assets
disclose turnover of total operating assets

words.enDefinition: relations concerning public

examples.en: After the recall, the company hired a public relations firm that specializes in crisis work.
examples.zh: 召回事件后，公司聘请了一家专做危机处理的「公共关系」公司。

examples.en: She moved from public relations into investor relations last autumn.
examples.zh: 去年秋天，她从「公共关系」岗位转到了投资者关系部门。

words.enDefinition: the views held by the public on an issue

examples.en: Public opinion turned against the merger once the plant closures were announced.
examples.zh: 工厂关停的消息一公布，「公众舆论」便转向反对这次并购。

examples.en: The consultancy polls public opinion before any big pricing decision.
examples.zh: 在做出重大定价决策之前，咨询公司会先开展「民意」调查。

words.enDefinition: a store of department

examples.en: The downtown department store stocks our skincare line in all nine branches.
examples.zh: 市中心的「百货商店」在全部九家分店都上架了我们的护肤产品线。

examples.en: Her first job was wrapping gifts at the department store cosmetics counter.
examples.zh: 她的第一份工作是在「百货商店」化妆品柜台包装礼品。

words.enDefinition: a conference for press

examples.en: The CEO faced tough questions about layoffs at yesterday's press conference.
examples.zh: 在昨天的「记者招待会」上，首席执行官遭遇了关于裁员的尖锐提问。

examples.en: We briefed the spokesperson twice before the press conference started.
examples.zh: 「记者招待会」开始前，我们给发言人做了两次简报培训。

words.enDefinition: an up to date used in professional practice

examples.en: Please keep the delivery schedule up to date so the plant can plan shifts.
examples.zh: 请让交货时间表保持「最新状态」，方便工厂安排班次。

examples.en: The ledger is up to date through March, so the audit can start early.
examples.zh: 账簿已更新「到最近发生的业务」，审计可以提前开始了。

words.enDefinition: estate related to real

examples.en: She invests her bonus in real estate near the new metro line.
examples.zh: 她把年终奖投到了新地铁沿线的「不动产」上。

examples.en: The fund sold its real estate holdings to escape rising maintenance costs.
examples.zh: 为摆脱不断上涨的维护成本，该基金出售了旗下「不动产」。

words.zhGloss: 硬通货；强势可兑换货币
words.enDefinition: a stable, widely accepted, readily convertible currency used in international trade
acceptedZhAnswers: 硬通货；强势可兑换货币

examples.en: Suppliers in Lagos often demand hard currency instead of local bank transfers.
examples.zh: 拉各斯的供应商常常要求用「硬通货」支付，而不接受本地银行转账。

examples.en: The tourism ministry rewards hotels that earn hard currency from foreign guests.
examples.zh: 旅游部门对能从外国客人身上赚取「硬通货」的酒店给予奖励。

words.enDefinition: the main editorial article in a newspaper
acceptedZhAnswers: 吸引顾客的特别廉价商品

examples.en: Her first job out of college was writing the leading article for a regional daily.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后的第一份工作，她就是为一家地方日报撰写「社论」。

examples.en: The editor's leading article this week questions whether tariffs really protect local jobs.
examples.zh: 本周编辑的「头条评论」质疑关税是否真能保护本地就业。

words.enDefinition: a review of should-be cost

examples.en: The should-be cost review flagged a spare-parts markup nobody had questioned for years.
examples.zh: 「应有成本检查」发现，备件加价问题多年无人质疑。

examples.en: Before renewing the cleaning contract, procurement ran a quick should-be cost review.
examples.zh: 续签清洁合同之前，采购部先做了一次快速的「应有成本审查」。

words.enDefinition: a system for formula cost

examples.en: Their software enforces a formula cost system, so estimates update the moment a recipe changes.
examples.zh: 他们的软件强制采用「公式成本制度」，配方一变，估算随即更新。

examples.en: The bakery's formula cost system prices every pastry from its ingredient weights.
examples.zh: 这家面包房的「公式成本制度」按配料重量为每种糕点定价。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning footage

examples.en: The rig owner insisted on a footage contract since the sandstone drills quickly.
examples.zh: 砂岩钻进速度快，钻机老板因此坚持要签「进尺合同」。

examples.en: Under our footage contract, the operator invoices only for meters actually drilled.
examples.zh: 按「进尺合同」约定，作业方只按实际钻进的米数开票。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning footage drilling

examples.en: They signed a footage drilling contract for the exploratory well in the northern basin.
examples.zh: 他们就北部盆地的探井签订了一份「钻井进尺合同」。

examples.en: Disputes over hole deviation make every footage drilling contract specify a payment formula.
examples.zh: 井斜问题容易引发纠纷，因此每份「钻井进尺合同」都写明了计价公式。

words.enDefinition: the cost of shortage

examples.en: Our shortage cost tripled once the fastest-selling SKU began selling out weekly.
examples.zh: 最畅销的单品开始周周断货后，我们的「缺货成本」翻了三倍。

examples.en: The textbook defines shortage cost as lost margin plus goodwill you never win back.
examples.zh: 教科书把「缺货成本」定义为损失的毛利加上再也挽回不了的客户好感。

words.zhGloss: 分期付款中最后一笔特大的偿还款
words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for balloon
acceptedZhAnswers: 分期付款中最后一笔特大的偿还款

examples.en: After the balloon payment clears next spring, the delivery vans finally belong to us.
examples.zh: 明春最后一笔「大额尾款」付清后，这些送货车才真正归我们所有。

examples.en: Refinancing saved us monthly cash but left a scary balloon payment in year five.
examples.zh: 再融资减轻了每月的现金压力，却在第五年留下一笔吓人的「大额尾款」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of should

examples.en: Our engineers built a should cost model for the pump housing before opening negotiations.
examples.zh: 谈判开谈之前，工程师们为泵壳建立了「应该成本」模型。

examples.en: The supplier's quote sits thirty percent above our should cost, so we pushed back.
examples.zh: 供应商的报价高出我们的「应该成本」三成，因此我们要求重新议价。

words.enDefinition: the cost of should-be

examples.en: The should-be cost for the bracket is four dollars, based on today's steel price.
examples.zh: 按今天的钢价计算，这个支架的「应有成本」是四美元。

examples.en: Auditors compare each quote with its should-be cost before signing the recommendation.
examples.zh: 审计人员先比对每个报价与其「应有成本」，然后才签署推荐意见。

words.enDefinition: management of shop

examples.en: Good shop management keeps every bench stocked before the morning shift starts.
examples.zh: 出色的「车间管理」能保证早班开工前每个工位都备好物料。

examples.en: He studied shop management at the polytechnic before joining the family foundry.
examples.zh: 进家族铸造厂之前，他在理工学院修读过「车间管理」课程。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for sliding-scale

examples.en: With a sliding-scale budget, the marketing team gains or loses funds as sales move.
examples.zh: 在「滑动预算」机制下，市场部的经费随销售业绩浮动。

examples.en: The charity runs a sliding-scale budget that expands whenever donations beat the forecast.
examples.zh: 这家慈善机构采用「浮动预算」，捐款超出预期时支出随之扩大。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for sliding-scale

examples.en: The utility charges a sliding-scale price that falls as factories consume more power.
examples.zh: 电力公司采用「浮动价格」，工厂用电越多，单价越低。

examples.en: Their sliding-scale price tracks the nickel index, so quotes last only a day.
examples.zh: 他们的「滑动价格」随镍价指数联动，报价有效期只有一天。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money made for footage rate

examples.en: Under footage rate payment, a stuck pipe day still costs us nothing extra.
examples.zh: 按「进尺付款」方式，卡钻停工的日子我们不用多付一分钱。

examples.en: The bank prefers footage rate payment because it ties cash outflow to progress.
examples.zh: 银行倾向于「按进尺付款」，因为资金支出与工程进度直接挂钩。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of sliding scale

examples.en: The agent earns a sliding scale commission that rises once quarterly sales pass a million.
examples.zh: 代理拿的是「累进手续费」，季度销售额过了百万，费率随之上调。

examples.en: Distributors accepted the sliding scale commission happily because volume discounts are built in.
examples.zh: 经销商欣然接受了「累进计算手续费」，因为其中内置了销量优惠。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for short-term

examples.en: Our short-term budget covers twelve months, while the strategic plan looks five years ahead.
examples.zh: 我们的「短期预算」覆盖十二个月，而战略规划则着眼于五年之后。

examples.en: Cash crunches forced the startup to redo its short-term budget twice this spring.
examples.zh: 现金流吃紧迫使这家初创公司今年春天两次重编「短期预算」。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning short sea

examples.en: Short sea trade between Baltic ports keeps our feeder vessels busy all winter.
examples.zh: 波罗的海港口之间的「短航运输」让我们的支线船整个冬天都有活干。

examples.en: Regulators promote short sea trade to take freight off the crowded motorways.
examples.zh: 监管机构鼓励「沿海短途运输」，以减轻高速公路的货运压力。

words.enDefinition: the cost of short range margin

examples.en: The plant accepts the small order because its short range margin cost stays below the bid.
examples.zh: 工厂接下这笔小订单，因为「短期边际成本」仍低于投标价。

examples.en: Economists in our pricing team plot the short range margin cost against weekly output.
examples.zh: 定价团队的经济学家把「短期边际成本」与周产量放在一起作图。

collocations: estimate the short range margin cost
allocate the short range margin cost
cut the short range margin cost

words.enDefinition: the cost of short range average

examples.en: Buying the bigger oven lowered our short range average cost per hundred loaves.
examples.zh: 换购更大的烤炉后，我们每百个面包的「短期平均成本」下降了。

examples.en: The chapter compares short range average cost curves across three plant sizes.
examples.zh: 本章对比了三种工厂规模下的「短期平均成本」曲线。

collocations: estimate the short range average cost
allocate the short range average cost
cut the short range average cost

words.zhGloss: 可避免与不可避免成本
words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for avoidable and unavoidable
acceptedZhAnswers: 可避免与不可避免成本

examples.en: The wind-down plan separates avoidable and unavoidable costs before any severance is calculated.
examples.zh: 在计算遣散费之前，退出方案先区分了「可避免成本与不可避免成本」。

examples.en: Consultants split avoidable and unavoidable costs so the board sees what closing really saves.
examples.zh: 顾问把「可避免与不可避免成本」分开列示，让董事会看清关厂究竟能省多少。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning short
