examples.en: The diagram traces the flow of costs from raw wool to finished blanket.
examples.zh: 这张图追溯了从原毛到成品毯的「成本流转」。

examples.en: Auditors tested the flow of costs through all three workshops.
examples.zh: 审计人员对三个车间的「成本流转」进行了穿行测试。

words.enDefinition: flow line production; a manufacturing method or production measure

examples.en: Flow line production doubled output once the paint booth stopped bottlenecking.
examples.zh: 喷漆房不再卡壳之后，「流水线生产」的产量翻了一番。

examples.en: Textbooks contrast flow line production with job shops built for one-offs.
examples.zh: 教科书把「流水线生产」与专做单件的机群式车间进行对比。

words.enDefinition: a costing approach used for average

examples.en: Under average costing, each goods receipt re-prices the entire balance.
examples.zh: 在「平均成本计算」下，每次收货都会重新计算全部结存的单价。

examples.en: Average costing spared the team the batch-by-batch price chasing that FIFO requires.
examples.zh: 「平均成本法」省去了先进先出法逐批追价的麻烦。

words.enDefinition: a unit of average cost per

examples.en: Lunchboxes shipped in August pushed average cost per unit to a new low.
examples.zh: 八月发货的餐盒使「单位平均成本」降至新低。

examples.en: CFOs track average cost per unit weekly during ramp-up quarters.
examples.zh: 爬坡季度的「单位平均成本」，首席财务官会每周跟踪。

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling average cost

examples.en: The warehouse values fuel with the average cost method, refreshed on each delivery.
examples.zh: 仓库对燃油采用「平均成本法」计值，每次到货后更新。

examples.en: Tax authorities accepted the average cost method for the scrap-metal inventory.
examples.zh: 税务机关认可对废金属存货采用「平均成本法」。

words.enDefinition: a curve showing the relationship for average cost

examples.en: The average cost curve bottoms out at around eight thousand units a month.
examples.zh: 「平均成本曲线」在月产八千件左右触底。

examples.en: Drawing the average cost curve helped the class see where economies of scale end.
examples.zh: 画出「平均成本曲线」后，同学们看清了规模经济的尽头在哪里。

words.enDefinition: the cost of output on an average basis

examples.en: Average cost per meal fell once the kitchen standardized its prep.
examples.zh: 厨房实现备料标准化后，每餐的「平均成本」下降了。

examples.en: Pricing below average cost is sustainable only while cash reserves last.
examples.zh: 只有在现金储备允许的情况下，按低于「平均成本」的价格销售才可持续。

words.enDefinition: a curve showing the relationship for average fixed cost

examples.en: The average fixed cost curve falls forever, approaching but never touching zero.
examples.zh: 「平均固定成本曲线」不断下降，趋近却永远到不了零。

examples.en: Tutors overlay the average fixed cost curve on the variable curve to build the total.
examples.zh: 辅导老师把「平均固定成本曲线」叠加在变动成本曲线上，合成总成本。

words.enDefinition: the cost of average fixed

examples.en: Spreading rent over more tablets lowered our average fixed cost per unit.
examples.zh: 把租金摊到更多台设备上，我们每台的「平均固定成本」降低了。

examples.en: Average fixed cost never decides pricing on its own, the consultant warned.
examples.zh: 顾问提醒，「平均固定成本」本身不能单独决定定价。

words.enDefinition: retailing for small scale

examples.en: Small scale retailing survives in villages where supermarkets cannot justify a store.
examples.zh: 在超市觉得不值得设店的村庄，「小规模零售」得以生存。

examples.en: Her thesis on small scale retailing interviewed forty kiosk owners.
examples.zh: 她的「小规模零售」论文访谈了四十位报刊亭主。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in demand transactions

examples.en: At the demand price of nine dollars, only half the harvest finds buyers.
examples.zh: 在九美元的「需求价格」下，只有一半收成能找到买家。

examples.en: The auction stopped when bidding passed the demand price buyers had signaled.
examples.zh: 竞价超过买方暗示的「需求价格」后，拍卖便告中止。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in average transactions

examples.en: The dashboard reports the average price paid per tonne across all grades.
examples.zh: 看板显示所有品级每吨的「平均价格」。

examples.en: Our average price for the season sits four percent below last year's.
examples.zh: 本季的「平均价格」比去年低百分之四。

words.enDefinition: trade activity concerning floating

examples.en: Floating trade through the strait picked up once the convoy escorts arrived.
examples.zh: 护航船队到位后，经海峡的「海上贸易」逐渐恢复。

examples.en: Archives describe the floating trade that linked the islands for centuries.
examples.zh: 档案记载了几个世纪以来联结各岛屿的「海上贸易」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of social opportunity

examples.en: The dam's social opportunity cost includes the farmland the reservoir will drown.
examples.zh: 这座大坝的「社会机会成本」包括水库将淹没的农田。

examples.en: Economists price a highway project by its social opportunity cost, not just its budget.
examples.zh: 经济学家按「社会机会成本」而非仅按预算来评价公路项目。

words.enDefinition: a marketing concept focused on social objectives

examples.en: Under the social marketing concept, the firm weighs profit, wants, and public wellbeing.
examples.zh: 按照「社会营销观念」，企业要兼顾利润、需求与公众福祉。

examples.en: Her campaign for the water utility embodies the social marketing concept.
examples.zh: 她为自来水公司策划的宣传活动体现了「社会营销观念」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of auxiliary department

examples.en: The maintenance shop's auxiliary department cost is charged out by labor hour.
examples.zh: 维修车间的「辅助部门成本」按工时对外分摊。

examples.en: Recharging auxiliary department cost fairly required a fresh activity study.
examples.zh: 要公平分摊「辅助部门成本」，就得重新做一次作业研究。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from available

examples.en: Only available profit after tax distributions may fund the community hall.
examples.zh: 只有缴税分红后的「可用利润」才能用于修建社区礼堂。

examples.en: The loan covenant tests available profit rather than headline earnings each quarter.
examples.zh: 该契约条款考核的是「可用利润」，而不是报表利润。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of available from held for sale or use

examples.en: The catalog marks every valve available from stock for next-day dispatch.
examples.zh: 产品目录标明每种阀门都「仓库有现货」，可次日发运。

examples.en: Only half the ordered lengths are available from stock this week.
examples.zh: 本周订购的长度规格只有一半「仓库有现货」。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for auxiliary unit

examples.en: The training center submits its auxiliary unit budget with the group plan.
examples.zh: 培训中心把「附属单位预算」随集团计划一并上报。

examples.en: Cuts to the auxiliary unit budget delayed the canteen renovation.
examples.zh: 「附属单位预算」遭削减后，食堂翻新被迫推迟。

words.enDefinition: management of democratic

examples.en: The co-op practices democratic management, one member one vote on big spending.
examples.zh: 这家合作社实行「民主管理」，重大开支一人一票。

examples.en: Democratic management slows decisions at times but keeps the workshop fiercely loyal.
examples.zh: 「民主管理」虽然拖慢决策，却留住了车间的人心。

words.enDefinition: the cost of attributable

examples.en: Each course carries only its attributable cost, never shared overhead.
examples.zh: 每门课程只计其「可归属成本」，从不摊入公共间接费。

examples.en: Grant rules say only attributable cost is eligible for reimbursement.
examples.zh: 资助规则规定，只有「可归属成本」才能报销。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for fixed resale

examples.en: Imposing a fixed resale price on dealers breached the competition rules.
examples.zh: 对经销商强制执行「固定转售价格」违反了竞争规则。

examples.en: Suppliers may recommend prices but cannot enforce a fixed resale price.
examples.zh: 供应商可以建议零售价，但不得强制「固定转售价格」。

words.enDefinition: a fixed ratio of inputs to output in production

examples.en: The recipe assumes a fixed production coefficient of three kilos of brine per casing.
examples.zh: 配方假定每副肠衣用三公斤盐水这一「固定生产系数」。

examples.en: Input-output tables rely on a fixed production coefficient for each sector.
examples.zh: 投入产出表假定每个部门都有「固定的生产系数」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in fixed transactions

examples.en: The renovation quote is a fixed price, so surprises land on the builder.
examples.zh: 装修报价是「固定价格」，意外情况也包含在内。

examples.en: Contracts at a fixed price protect buyers when commodity markets turn wild.
examples.zh: 大宗商品市场剧烈波动时，「固定价格」合同能保护买方。

words.enDefinition: a pool of fixed cost

examples.en: The controller lumps rent, rates, and security into one fixed cost pool.
examples.zh: 主计长把租金、房产税和保安费归入同一个「固定成本库」。

examples.en: Each fixed cost pool carries its own allocation basis in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中每个「固定成本类」都有各自的分摊基础。

words.enDefinition: budgets that do not vary with activity level

examples.en: Fixed budgets ignore demand shifts, so quarterly reviews feel unfair to sales.
examples.zh: 「固定预算」无视需求变化，季度考核让销售团队觉得不公。

examples.en: The group still runs fixed budgets because investors value predictability.
examples.zh: 集团仍沿用「固定预算」，因为投资者看重可预测性。

words.enDefinition: a market for auction

examples.en: The flower auction market opens at four in the morning for wholesalers.
examples.zh: 面向批发商的「拍卖市场」凌晨四点开市。

examples.en: Fine art prices are discovered in the auction market, not in shops.
examples.zh: 艺术品的价格是在「拍卖市场」发现的，而不是在店铺里。

words.enDefinition: speculative production; a manufacturing method or production measure

examples.en: Committing to speculative production before the fair risked half the season's cash.
examples.zh: 在展会之前就「冒险投产」，押上了半个季度的现金。

examples.en: The vineyard avoids speculative production, bottling only after orders clear.
examples.zh: 这家葡萄园不做「投机性生产」，订单确认后才灌装。

words.enDefinition: a market for speculative

examples.en: Traders pulled out of the speculative market the moment the futures curve inverted.
examples.zh: 期货曲线一倒挂，交易员便撤离了这个「投机市场」。

examples.en: Fresh copper supplies calmed the speculative market within two weeks.
examples.zh: 新增的铜供应让「投机市场」在两周内平静下来。

words.enDefinition: a market for speculation

examples.en: Regulators warn that coin grading has become a speculation market.
examples.zh: 监管机构提醒，钱币评级已经变成了「投机市场」。

examples.en: The speculation market in parking spaces collapsed once the city built garages.
examples.zh: 市政府建起车库后，车位「投机市场」应声崩塌。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for specified

examples.en: The grant covers only the specified costs listed in Annex Two.
examples.zh: 资助只覆盖附件二中列明的「规定费用」。

examples.en: Invoices outside the specified costs get rejected by the program office automatically.
examples.zh: 超出「规定费用」的发票会被项目办公室自动退回。

words.enDefinition: the cost of specification

examples.en: Adding the extra coating raised the specification cost of every panel.
examples.zh: 增加额外涂层提高了每块板材的「规定成本」。

examples.en: The tender compares bids against the specification cost prepared by engineering.
examples.zh: 评标时以工程部编制的「规定成本」作为比价依据。

words.enDefinition: a system for specific-order cost

examples.en: Under the specific-order cost system, each yacht carries its own job number.
examples.zh: 在「分批成本制度」下，每艘游艇都有自己的工单号。

examples.en: The specific-order cost system traces designer changes straight into the job file.
examples.zh: 「分批（定单）成本制度」把设计变更直接计入对应工单。

words.enDefinition: fixed-term loans that are unsecured

examples.en: The bank books fixed loans unsecured to longtime customers at preferential rates.
examples.zh: 银行以优惠利率向老客户发放「定期信用放款」。

examples.en: Their portfolio mixes mortgages with fixed loans unsecured on a three-year term.
examples.zh: 他们的资产组合把按揭与三年期的「定期信用放款」搭配在一起。

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for fixed

examples.en: Fixed costs barely moved even after we closed the second showroom.
examples.zh: 关闭第二家展厅后，「固定成本」几乎没有变化。

examples.en: Airlines battle their fixed costs with every extra seat sold at the margin.
examples.zh: 航空公司靠加卖的每一个座位来对抗高昂的「固定成本」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged in spot transactions

examples.en: Buyers settled the cargo at the spot price quoted on the day of arrival.
examples.zh: 货物按到港当日报出的「现货价格」结算。

examples.en: The spot price for gas doubled within a week of the outage.
examples.zh: 断供发生后一周内，天然气的「现货价格」翻了一番。

words.enDefinition: a market for immediate delivery and payment rather than future settlement

examples.en: Refiners top up volumes on the spot market when the pipeline halts.
examples.zh: 管道停输时，炼厂会在「现货市场」补足货量。

examples.en: Producers prefer annual contracts, but the spot market keeps everyone honest.
examples.zh: 生产商偏爱年度长约，但「现货市场」让所有人不敢乱来。

words.enDefinition: the cost of departmental unit

examples.en: The print shop quotes by departmental unit cost rather than gut feel.
examples.zh: 印刷车间的报价依据「部门单位成本」，而不是拍脑袋。

examples.en: Comparing departmental unit cost across plants exposed the aging press.
examples.zh: 对比各厂的「部门单位成本」，暴露出那台老印刷机的问题。

words.enDefinition: distribution of departmental secondary

examples.en: Departmental secondary distribution pushes service costs onto the producing workshops.
examples.zh: 「服务部门费用的第一次分配」把服务成本摊入生产车间。

examples.en: The textbook example walks through departmental secondary distribution with two service pools.
examples.zh: 教材用两个服务成本库的例子演示「服务部门费用的初次分配」。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from departmental

examples.en: Afternoon tea drives a surprising share of departmental revenue at the hotel.
examples.zh: 下午茶为酒店贡献了相当可观的「分部门收入」。

examples.en: The dashboard breaks departmental revenue down by channel each morning.
examples.zh: 看板每天早上按渠道拆解「分部门收入」。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from departmental

examples.en: The board reviews departmental profit before setting next year's bonuses.
examples.zh: 董事会在设定明年奖金之前，会先审阅「部门利润」。

examples.en: Allocating head office rent changed every departmental profit line overnight.
examples.zh: 总部租金一摊入，各条「分部利润」一夜之间全变了样。

words.enDefinition: a system for departmental process cost

examples.en: Each workshop runs a departmental process cost system with its own normal loss.
examples.zh: 每个车间都执行「部门分步成本制」，各算各的正常损耗。

examples.en: Transfers between stages move at cost under the departmental process cost system.
examples.zh: 在「部门分步成本制」下，工序间转料按成本价计价。

collocations: test the departmental process cost system
refine the departmental process cost system
compare the departmental process cost system

words.enDefinition: amounts that must be paid or spent for fixed factory overhead

examples.en: Depreciation and plant security make up most of the fixed factory overhead costs.
examples.zh: 折旧和厂区安保构成「固定间接费用」的大头。

examples.en: Idle capacity keeps fixed factory overhead costs spread over fewer units.
examples.zh: 产能闲置使「固定间接费用」摊到更少的产品上。

words.enDefinition: fixed elements of costs used in professional practice

examples.en: The seminar separates the fixed elements of costs from truly variable ones.
examples.zh: 研讨课把「成本的固定部分」与真正的变动部分区分开来。

examples.en: Insurance premiums rank among the fixed elements of costs for the fleet.
examples.zh: 保费属于车队「成本中的固定部分」。

words.enDefinition: a split the cost used in professional practice

examples.en: The neighbors split the cost of the shared fence down the middle.
examples.zh: 两家人对半「分担」了共用围墙的费用。

examples.en: We agreed to split the cost of the trade fair booth three ways.
examples.zh: 我们商定三方「分摊」交易会展位费用。

words.enDefinition: accounting for transactions and balances denominated in foreign currencies

examples.en: Quarter-end foreign exchange accounting translated every euro invoice at the closing rate.
examples.zh: 季末「外汇会计」按收盘汇率折算每一张欧元发票。

examples.en: The textbook chapter on foreign exchange accounting runs through translation and transaction gains.
examples.zh: 教材里「外汇会计」那一章，把折算损益和交易损益讲了个遍。

words.enDefinition: a balance sheet presenting sinking fund

examples.en: The trustee files a sinking fund balance sheet with the city every June.
examples.zh: 受托人每年6月向市政府提交「偿债基金平衡表」。

examples.en: Check the sinking fund balance sheet to confirm the annual contribution actually landed.
examples.zh: 查一查「偿债基金平衡表」，确认年度提存真的到账了。

collocations: prioritise the sinking fund balance sheet
standardise the sinking fund balance sheet
monitor the sinking fund balance sheet

words.enDefinition: the cost of stockholding

examples.en: Insurance, storage, and spoilage all feed into the stockholding cost of brewed beer.
examples.zh: 保险、仓储和损耗都计入酿造啤酒的「库存持有成本」。

examples.en: The buyer orders weekly now, because the stockholding cost outweighs the bulk discount.
examples.zh: 采购员现在改为每周下单，因为「库存持有成本」已经超过了批量折扣。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of salaries and wages

examples.en: Salaries and wages payable at December include the holiday pay earned but untaken.
examples.zh: 十二月的「应付薪金及工资」包含已挣得但尚未休假的工资折算。

examples.en: The audit team vouched salaries and wages payable against the signed payroll register.
examples.zh: 审计小组把「应付薪金及工资」与签核的工资登记簿逐项核对。

collocations: sample the salaries and wages payable
vouch the salaries and wages payable
tie out the salaries and wages payable

words.enDefinition: a balance sheet presenting fund

examples.en: The foundation's fund balance sheet shows grants payable of nearly four million.
examples.zh: 基金会的「基金平衡表」显示应付拨款近400万。

examples.en: Every fund balance sheet must separate restricted gifts from unrestricted ones.
examples.zh: 每张「基金平衡表」都要把限定用途捐款与无限制捐款分开列示。

words.enDefinition: accounting for advanced cost

examples.en: Advanced cost accounting covered standard costing and variance analysis in the final term.
examples.zh: 「高级成本会计」课程在最后一学期讲授标准成本法和差异分析。

examples.en: Her dissertation on advanced cost accounting examined waste tracking in a Sheffield foundry.
examples.zh: 她的「高级成本会计」论文研究的是谢菲尔德一家铸造厂的废品追踪。

collocations: tie out the advanced cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage accounting cost

examples.en: Monthly variance reports are the backbone of our accounting cost control system.
examples.zh: 月度差异报告是我们「会计成本控制」体系的支柱。

examples.en: The group introduced accounting cost control after the takeaway chain quietly lost thousands on packaging.
examples.zh: 连锁外卖店在包装上悄然损失数千英镑后，集团引入了「会计成本控制」。

collocations: tie out the accounting cost control

words.enDefinition: an audit of stores

examples.en: The stores audit found nine drill bits recorded but missing from rack four.
examples.zh: 「仓库审计」发现九枚钻头账上有记录，四号货架上却找不到。

examples.en: During the stores audit, two assistants matched every bin card against the ledger.
examples.zh: 「仓库审计」期间，两名助理把每张料位卡与分类账逐一核对。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money charged or quoted for net invoice

examples.en: Trade discounts come off first, and the net invoice price is what we record.
examples.zh: 先扣除商业折扣，然后按「净发票价格」入账。

examples.en: The catalogue shows list prices, but our net invoice price runs about twelve percent lower.
examples.zh: 目录上印的是定价，而我们的「净发票价格」大约低百分之十二。

words.enDefinition: a recurring sequence related to cost accounting

examples.en: The cost accounting cycle repeats monthly: collect, allocate, report, then compare with standards.
examples.zh: 「成本会计循环」每月重复一轮：归集、分配、编报，然后与标准对比。

examples.en: Students map the cost accounting cycle from purchase order to finished goods before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前，学生们把「成本会计循环」从采购订单到产成品的流程绘制成图。

words.enDefinition: accounting that records, classifies, and analyses the costs of products or activities

examples.en: Cost accounting told us which of the three cake lines actually made money.
examples.zh: 「成本会计」告诉我们，三条蛋糕产品线中究竟哪条真正赚钱。

examples.en: Without cost accounting, the factory had priced its cheapest product below bare materials.
examples.zh: 在没有「成本会计」之前，工厂把自己最便宜的产品定到了连材料费都不够的价位。

words.enDefinition: accounting for controlling-company

examples.en: Controlling-company accounting consolidates each subsidiary's trial balance into the group figures.
examples.zh: 「总公司会计」把各子公司的试算平衡表合并成集团数据。

examples.en: Inter-company sales are stripped out under controlling-company accounting before the group statements are struck.
examples.zh: 编制集团报表之前，「总公司会计」会先剔除公司之间的销售。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of profit sharing bonuses

examples.en: Profit sharing bonuses payable appear as a current liability until the cheques clear.
examples.zh: 「应付利润分红」在支票兑付之前列作流动负债。

examples.en: The scheme sets profit sharing bonuses payable once pre-tax profit passes two hundred thousand.
examples.zh: 税前利润一旦超过二十万，方案即触发「应付利润分红」的计提。

words.enDefinition: a cost not paid in cash but assigned for decision-making, such as the owner's own unpaid labour

examples.en: The owner's unpaid labour is an imputed cost the profit statement never shows.
examples.zh: 业主自己的无薪劳动是一种「推算成本」，利润表上从来看不到。

examples.en: Economists add imputed cost of owner-occupied premises when comparing the two shop locations.
examples.zh: 比较两家店铺选址时，经济学家会把自有门店的「推算成本」也加进来。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning open

examples.en: The supplier ships on open credit, trusting payment within thirty days.
examples.zh: 供应商按「无担保信贷」发货，信任客户三十天内付款。

examples.en: Young graduates build history by starting with open credit at their first bank.
examples.zh: 年轻人先在第一家银行建立「无担保信贷」记录，慢慢养出信用史。

words.enDefinition: accounting for operational

examples.en: Operational accounting tracks daily throughput so managers see problems within the same week.
examples.zh: 「经营会计学」追踪每日产出，让经理在同一周内就能看到问题。

examples.en: She credits operational accounting with saving the bakery, because flour waste halved within months.
examples.zh: 她把面包房的起死回生归功于「经营会计学」，几个月内面粉浪费就减半了。

words.enDefinition: records of payroll amounts and deductions

examples.en: Payroll records for the past six years still sit in the locked cabinet.
examples.zh: 过去六年的「工资簿」仍锁在档案柜里。

examples.en: The inspector asked for payroll records covering every casual worker hired since March.
examples.zh: 稽查员要求提供自三月以来雇用的每位临时工的「工资簿」。

words.zhGloss: 公司间应计折旧资产的内部利润
words.enDefinition: assets associated with inter-company profit on depreciable
acceptedZhAnswers: 公司间应计折旧资产的内部利润

examples.en: Consolidation must eliminate inter-company profit on depreciable assets sold between group members.
examples.zh: 合并报表必须抵销集团成员之间出售应计折旧资产形成的「公司间应计折旧资产的内部利润」。

examples.en: The examiner asked how inter-company profit on depreciable assets unwinds as depreciation is charged.
examples.zh: 考官问的是：随着折旧的计提，「公司间应计折旧资产的内部利润」如何逐步转回。

collocations: classify inter-company profit on depreciable assets
measure inter-company profit on depreciable assets
disclose inter-company profit on depreciable assets

words.enDefinition: an audit focused on verifying balances in the statement of financial position

examples.en: A balance sheet audit concentrates on closing balances rather than the year's transactions.
examples.zh: 「资产负债表审计」重点关注期末余额，而不是全年的交易过程。

examples.en: Under a balance sheet audit, we confirmed every loan balance directly with the lender.
examples.zh: 在「资产负债表审计」中，我们逐笔直接向贷款方确认了余额。

words.enDefinition: balance sheets prepared by banks

examples.en: Regulators compare the balance sheets of banks across the region every quarter.
examples.zh: 监管机构每季度横向比较本地区各银行的「银行资产负债表」。

examples.en: Lehman's collapse put every detail of the balance sheets of banks under a microscope.
examples.zh: 雷曼倒闭后，「银行资产负债表」的每个细节都被放到显微镜下。

collocations: record the balance sheets of banks
disclose the balance sheets of banks
reconcile the balance sheets of banks

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for shipping

examples.en: The shipping invoice listed eleven cartons, but the dock only received nine.
examples.zh: 「货物装运单」上列了十一箱，码头实际只收到九箱。

examples.en: Payment terms say the shipping invoice must accompany the goods, never trail them.
examples.zh: 付款条款规定「货物装运单」必须随货同行，绝不能事后补寄。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for stock

examples.en: Her retirement account splits evenly between a stock fund and a bond fund.
examples.zh: 她的退休账户一半买「股票基金」，一半买债券基金。

examples.en: A stock fund that tracks the whole market beat two thirds of the professionals again.
examples.zh: 追踪全市场的「股票基金」又一次跑赢了三分之二的职业选手。

words.enDefinition: a stock cover used in professional practice

examples.en: We keep four weeks of stock cover on bestsellers so shelves never go bare.
examples.zh: 畅销品我们常备四周的「存货保证期」，货架绝不会空。

examples.en: Shorter stock cover means fresher groceries but more frequent delivery fees.
examples.zh: 「存货保证期」越短，生鲜越新鲜，配送费也出得越勤。

words.enDefinition: scrip representing a right to stock

examples.en: The railway once paid workers partly in stock scrip instead of wages.
examples.zh: 铁路公司当年发工资，部分用「小额股票」代替现金。

examples.en: Collectors still trade Victorian stock scrip certificates at paper fairs.
examples.zh: 收藏爱好者至今仍在纸品交易会上买卖维多利亚时代的「小额股票」凭证。

words.enDefinition: turnover arising from stock

examples.en: Convenience stores live on stock turnover; bread sits for hours, canned goods for months.
examples.zh: 便利店靠「存货周转率」吃饭：面包只放几小时，罐头能囤几个月。

examples.en: Slow stock turnover ties up cash that the shop could spend on new lines.
examples.zh: 「存货周转率」太慢，现金就压在货上，上新品的钱都没了。

words.enDefinition: receipts from revenue

examples.en: The treasury counts income tax and customs duties as its revenue receipts.
examples.zh: 财政部把所得税和关税计入本年度的「税收经常收入」。

examples.en: Privatisation proceeds are capital, not revenue receipts, so they cannot fund salaries.
examples.zh: 私有化所得属于资本性收入而非「税收经常收入」，不能用来发工资。

words.enDefinition: an audit of general

examples.en: The charity commissioned a general audit covering both donations and trading income.
examples.zh: 该慈善机构委托进行了一次「普通审计」，范围涵盖捐赠和经营收入。

examples.en: A general audit of the books revealed nothing worse than three untidy files.
examples.zh: 对账簿的「普通审计」只查出了三个乱糟糟的文件夹，没有别的问题。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of bond interest

examples.en: The ledger shows bond interest payable of ninety thousand, due on the first.
examples.zh: 账面显示「应付公司债券利息」9万，月初到期。

examples.en: Before the merger closed, bond interest payable was accrued for the stub period.
examples.zh: 并购交割前，过渡期的「应付公司债券利息」已计提。

words.zhGloss: 未摊销债券(公司债)折价
words.enDefinition: unamortized discount on bonds payable
acceptedZhAnswers: 未摊销债券(公司债)折价

examples.en: Bond discount unamortized still sits at sixty thousand on the long-term liabilities page.
examples.zh: 负债页上还挂着6万的「未摊销债券折价」。

examples.en: Each coupon entry whittles bond discount unamortized down a little further.
examples.zh: 每记一次付息，「未摊销债券折价」就再削掉一点。

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for bond discount

examples.en: Bond discount amortization adds a slice of interest expense every period until maturity.
examples.zh: 「债券折价摊销」让每个期间的利息费用都多出一块，直到到期。

examples.en: The schedule shows bond discount amortization of four thousand for the quarter.
examples.zh: 摊销表显示本季度「债券折价摊销」为4000。

words.enDefinition: an audit of repeating

examples.en: The bank ordered a repeating audit after the same teller error surfaced twice.
examples.zh: 同一出纳差错两度出现后，银行下令进行「重复审计」。

examples.en: A repeating audit wastes fee budgets unless each visit tests something new.
examples.zh: 除非每次都核查新内容，否则「重复审计」只会白白消耗审计费用。

words.enDefinition: an audit of repeat

examples.en: The regulator scheduled a repeat audit of the branch within six months.
examples.zh: 监管机构要求六个月内对该分行进行一次「重复审计」。

examples.en: We fixed the stockroom records in April, so the repeat audit passed within hours.
examples.zh: 四月份我们修正了库房记录，所以「重复审计」几小时内就顺利通过。

words.enDefinition: a voucher supporting bank receipt

examples.en: Attach the bank receipt voucher to the deposit slip before filing.
examples.zh: 归档前，把「银行存款收入凭证」附在存款单后面。

examples.en: Every bank receipt voucher carries the teller's stamp and the account number.
examples.zh: 每张「银行存款收入凭证」都盖有柜员章和账号。

collocations: bank with the bank receipt voucher
open an account at the bank receipt voucher
deal with the bank receipt voucher

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of sales contract

examples.en: The builder carries a sales contract receivable for the sixth house, signed but unsettled.
examples.zh: 建筑商账上挂着一笔第六套房的「应收销售合同款」，合同已签但款项未清。

examples.en: A sales contract receivable ages badly once the buyer's mortgage approval stalls.
examples.zh: 一旦买方的按揭审批卡壳，「应收销售合同款」的账龄就会越拖越难看。

words.enDefinition: a salesmen's salaries and commission used in professional practice

examples.en: Salesmen's salaries and commission together took nearly a fifth of turnover last year.
examples.zh: 去年「销售员薪金及佣金」合计吃掉了近五分之一的营业额。

examples.en: We split salesmen's salaries and commission so commission rises only with collected cash.
examples.zh: 我们把「销售员薪金及佣金」分列处理，佣金只随实收现金增长。

words.enDefinition: a slip documenting a sale

examples.en: Keep the sales slip; the warranty office refuses claims without it.
examples.zh: 保留好「销售单」，保修部门没有它就不受理索赔。

examples.en: Every sales slip is carbon-copied, one for the till, one for the customer.
examples.zh: 每张「销售单」都复写一式两联，一联留收银机，一联给顾客。

words.enDefinition: accounting for distribution cost

examples.en: Distribution cost accounting separated warehouse rent from delivery fuel for the first time.
examples.zh: 「销售领域成本会计」首次把仓库租金与送货油费分开核算。

examples.en: With distribution cost accounting, the northern route proved dearer than anyone had guessed.
examples.zh: 通过「销售领域成本会计」，北方线路的费用比所有人的估计都要高。

collocations: roll forward the distribution cost accounting

words.enDefinition: an audit of administrative

examples.en: The council's administrative audit questioned why office supplies were ordered from three suppliers.
examples.zh: 市政会的「行政审计」质询了办公用品为何从三家供应商分散采购。

examples.en: An administrative audit checks procedure and paperwork, not the accuracy of the accounts themselves.
examples.zh: 「行政审计」核查的是流程与文书，而非账目数字本身的准确性。

words.enDefinition: revenue arising from unearned

examples.en: Unearned revenue shrinks every month as coaching sessions are actually delivered.
examples.zh: 随着辅导课程逐月实际交付，「预收收入」不断减少。

examples.en: The airline's unearned revenue peaks in January, when everyone books summer holidays.
examples.zh: 一月人人预订暑期度假，「预收收入」在航空公司账上达到峰值。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of discount on bonds

examples.en: The balance sheet lists discount on bonds payable as a contra account under long-term debt.
examples.zh: 资产负债表把「应付债券折价」列为长期负债项下的备抵科目。

examples.en: Issuing at ninety-eight created a discount on bonds payable that amortizes over ten years.
examples.zh: 按98折发行产生了「应付债券折价」，将在十年内摊销。

collocations: sample the discount on bonds payable
vouch the discount on bonds payable
tie out the discount on bonds payable

words.enDefinition: profits arising from after-tax

examples.en: After-tax profits rose eleven percent, though the dividend stayed flat.
examples.zh: 「税后利润」上升了百分之十一，分红却保持不变。

examples.en: The co-op returns after-tax profits to members as a rebate on purchases.
examples.zh: 合作社把「税后利润」按购物金额返还给社员。

words.enDefinition: accounting for agency

examples.en: Under agency accounting, the dealer only records commission, never the goods themselves.
examples.zh: 在「代理店会计」下，经销商只记录佣金，从不记录商品本身。

examples.en: Agency accounting keeps consignment stock off our books until it actually sells.
examples.zh: 寄售存货直到实际售出前都不进我们的账，这正是「代理店会计」的用法。

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track agency

examples.en: Agency accounts record money the agent merely collects on the principal's behalf.
examples.zh: 「代理人账」只记录代理人代委托人收取的款项。

examples.en: The estate agent keeps agency accounts separate from her own business takings.
examples.zh: 房产经纪人把「代理人账」与自己收到的业务款项严格分开。

words.zhGloss: 存于海关保税仓库中的进口货物
words.enDefinition: goods held in a bonded warehouse pending customs clearance and duty payment
acceptedZhAnswers: 存于海关保税仓库中的进口货物

examples.en: The whisky sits under bond until the excise duty is finally paid.
examples.zh: 这批威士忌「存于海关保税仓库」，直到消费税最终缴清。

examples.en: Buyers can taste whisky still under bond, but taking it home costs duty.
examples.zh: 买家可以品鉴「存于海关保税仓库」的威士忌，但要带回家就得缴税。

words.enDefinition: accounting for equity

examples.en: Equity accounting shows our share of the venture's profit without consolidating it fully.
examples.zh: 「权益会计」只反映我们在合资企业利润中的份额，而不作全面合并。

examples.en: Under equity accounting, the associate's losses cut our carrying amount each quarter.
examples.zh: 在「权益会计」下，联营企业的亏损每季度都会冲减我们的账面金额。

words.enDefinition: a foundational concept used in accounting

examples.en: The matching principle is an accounting concept every first-year student learns early.
examples.zh: 配比原则是每个大一学生早早就要学的「会计观念」。

examples.en: Prudence as an accounting concept stops the board from booking hoped-for profits.
examples.zh: 谨慎性这一「会计观念」让董事会无法把憧憬中的利润提前入账。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with accounting

examples.en: Regulators measure accounting capital differently from market capitalization, and the gap matters.
examples.zh: 监管口径的「会计资本」与市值并不相同，两者的差距不容忽视。

examples.en: Dividends can only come out of accounting capital that actually exists on the books.
examples.zh: 分红只能来自账上真实存在的「会计资本」。

words.enDefinition: an office handling accounting for branch

examples.en: Accounting for branch office activities feeds daily figures to the head office ledger.
examples.zh: 「支店会计」每天把分支机构的数据传送到总店总账。

examples.en: Accounting for branch office cash used to mean a courier with two receipts books.
examples.zh: 从前「支店会计」核算现金，得靠一名信使带着两本收据簿往返。

collocations: record the accounting for branch office
disclose the accounting for branch office
reconcile the accounting for branch office

words.enDefinition: a calendar point relevant to accounting

examples.en: Our accounting date moved from March to December to match the parent.
examples.zh: 为与母公司一致，我们的「会计结算日」从三月改到了十二月。

examples.en: Cut-off testing checks every invoice against the accounting date, one day either side.
examples.zh: 截止测试会逐张核对发票与「会计结算日」前后各一天的情况。

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for accounting

examples.en: Accounting depreciation spreads the cost evenly, while tax depreciation front-loads the relief.
examples.zh: 「会计折旧」把成本均匀分摊，而税务折旧把优惠集中在前期。

examples.en: The gap between accounting depreciation and capital allowances creates our deferred tax.
examples.zh: 「会计折旧」与资本减免之间的差额，正是我们递延所得税的来源。

words.enDefinition: a division responsible for accounting

examples.en: The accounting division sits on the third floor, next to the archives.
examples.zh: 「会计部门」在三楼办公，紧挨着档案室。

examples.en: Every payment request crosses the accounting division twice: once for coding, once for release.
examples.zh: 每份付款申请都要两过「会计部门」：一次确定科目，一次批准放款。

words.zhGloss: 内部报告会计(管理会计)
words.enDefinition: accounting intended for internal reporting
acceptedZhAnswers: 内部报告会计(管理会计)

examples.en: Accounting for internal reporting can use whatever units management finds genuinely useful.
examples.zh: 「内部报告会计」可以采用管理层认为真正有用的任何计量单位。

examples.en: Unlike the statutory accounts, accounting for internal reporting arrives every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 与法定报表不同，「内部报告会计」每周一早上准时送达。

collocations: sample the accounting for internal reporting
vouch the accounting for internal reporting
tie out the accounting for internal reporting

words.enDefinition: a professional firm that provides accountancy and related services

examples.en: The accountancy firm moved us to cloud bookkeeping and cut our filing panic.
examples.zh: 那家「会计机构」把我们迁移到云端记账，申报时的手忙脚乱从此消失。

examples.en: Our accountancy firm employs two trainees who chase every missing receipt each autumn.
examples.zh: 我们委托的「会计机构」雇了两名实习生，每年秋天专门追讨缺失的票据。

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record abstract

examples.en: Job costs from each work order were posted daily into the abstract ledger.
examples.zh: 每张工单的成本每天都过入「作业费用总账」。

examples.en: At month end the abstract ledger total had to agree with the wages journal.
examples.zh: 月末时，「作业费用总账」的合计数必须与工资日记账一致。

words.enDefinition: accounting for divisional

examples.en: Divisional accounting revealed that the Leeds depot had subsidised everyone else for years.
examples.zh: 「分部门会计」显示，利兹仓库多年来一直在补贴其他部门。

examples.en: With divisional accounting, each region bids for its own vans and staff.
examples.zh: 实行「分部门会计」后，各区都要为自己的车辆和人员争预算。

words.enDefinition: a manual describing accounting policies and procedures

examples.en: The accounting manual spells out who may sign for which amount.
examples.zh: 「会计规程」明确规定什么金额该由谁签字。

examples.en: New starters receive the accounting manual plus a short quiz before touching the ledger.
examples.zh: 新员工要读完「会计规程」并通过小测验，才能碰分类账。

words.enDefinition: money received from accounting

examples.en: Accounting income follows the matching rules, so cash timing barely matters.
examples.zh: 「会计所得」遵循配比规则，现金收付的时间几乎无关紧要。

examples.en: Taxable profit diverges from accounting income whenever the two rulebooks disagree.
examples.zh: 两套规则一旦打架，应税利润就会偏离「会计所得」。

words.zhGloss: 会计收益率(或称财务报表法)
words.enDefinition: an accounting rate of return used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 会计收益率(或称财务报表法)

examples.en: The accounting rate of return uses book profit, so depreciation choices bend the answer.
examples.zh: 「会计收益率」用的是账面利润，折旧方法一变结果就跟着变。

examples.en: Managers like the accounting rate of return because the figures sit in last year's statements.
examples.zh: 经理们偏爱「会计收益率」，因为数据直接取自去年的报表。

collocations: calculate the accounting rate of return
compare the accounting rate of return
interpret the accounting rate of return

words.enDefinition: the price charged in accounting transactions

examples.en: For project appraisal, economists value the timber at its accounting price, not the subsidised one.
examples.zh: 在项目评估中，经济学家按「会计价格」对木材计价，而不是用补贴价。

examples.en: The accounting price strips out taxes and subsidies to show the real resource cost.
examples.zh: 「会计价格」剔除税负和补贴，反映出真实的资源成本。

words.enDefinition: an audit of voucher

examples.en: The voucher audit matched every payment slip to an authorised purchase order.
examples.zh: 「凭证审计」把每张付款单与经批准的采购订单一一对应。

examples.en: During the voucher audit we found thirty payments lacking any approval signature.
examples.zh: 「凭证审计」中发现三十笔付款没有任何审批签字。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from taxable

examples.en: Adjusting accounting profit for entertaining and depreciation gives the taxable profit.
examples.zh: 对会计利润调整招待费和折旧等项目，就得出「应纳税的利润」。

examples.en: Losses carried forward reduce taxable profit until the trading record turns positive again.
examples.zh: 结转亏损会继续抵减「应纳税的利润」，直到经营重新盈利为止。

words.enDefinition: money received from taxable on dividend

examples.en: Since the reform, only half the amount is taxable on dividend income for small shareholders.
examples.zh: 改革后，小股东只有一半股利收益「应纳税」。

examples.en: Nonresident investors face a flat fifteen percent on what is taxable on dividend income.
examples.zh: 非居民投资者对「应纳税的股利收益」按15%固定税率计征。

collocations: record the taxable on dividend income
disclose the taxable on dividend income
reconcile the taxable on dividend income

words.enDefinition: a clerk who records and tracks factory costs

examples.en: The factory cost clerk weighs scrap every Friday and files the variance sheet.
examples.zh: 「工厂成本管理员」每周五称量废料，并归档差异表。

examples.en: Our factory cost clerk knows every machine's output better than the supervisors do.
examples.zh: 我们的「工厂成本管理员」对每台机器的产出比主管们还清楚。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of subscription

examples.en: Subscription receivable of twelve thousand remains from the spring share issue.
examples.zh: 春季增发仍有一万二千英镑的「应收认股款」未收。

examples.en: The directors chased every subscription receivable before calling the board meeting.
examples.zh: 召开董事会之前，董事们把每笔「应收认股款」都催了一遍。

words.enDefinition: assets associated with depreciation for plant

examples.en: Depreciation for plant assets starts when the machine is ready for use, not at purchase.
examples.zh: 「固定资产折旧」从机器可投入使用时起算，而不是从购买日起。

examples.en: The schedule of depreciation for plant assets lists each press, its life, and method.
examples.zh: 「固定资产折旧」明细表逐台列示压机的使用寿命和折旧方法。

words.enDefinition: output of depreciation-service

examples.en: Under the depreciation-service output approach, the tractor's cost follows the acres it ploughs.
examples.zh: 按「生产服务折旧法」，拖拉机的成本跟着它耕作的土地面积走。

examples.en: Depreciation-service output suits quarry machinery whose wear tracks tonnes crushed, not calendar months.
examples.zh: 「生产服务折旧法」适合采石场设备——机器磨损取决于破碎吨数，而非日历月份。

words.enDefinition: a trade barrier used in professional practice

examples.en: The new licensing rule works as a trade barrier against foreign dairy imports.
examples.zh: 新的许可制度实质上是针对外国乳制品进口的一道「贸易壁垒」。

examples.en: Quotas, standards, and customs delays are all trade barriers dressed in different clothes.
examples.zh: 配额、技术标准和海关拖延，都是换了个马甲的「贸易壁垒」。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of trade accounts

examples.en: Trade accounts payable cover suppliers of goods, not the electricity or the rent.
examples.zh: 「贸易应付账款」只覆盖货品供应商，不包括电费和租金。

examples.en: Trade accounts payable turned over every forty days, which the bank considers healthy.
examples.zh: 「贸易应付账款」约四十天周转一次，银行认为这属于健康水平。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of excessive held for sale or use

examples.en: Excessive stock of tinsel after January ties up cash for eleven months.
examples.zh: 一月过后「存货超额」的金属箔条，会把现金占压十一个月。

examples.en: The stockroom floods with excessive stock whenever buyers guess the fashion wrong.
examples.zh: 采购一旦看走眼流行趋势，库房立刻被「存货超额」淹没。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for export

examples.en: Each export invoice names the vessel, the port, and the consignee in triplicate.
examples.zh: 每份出口「货物装运单」都一式三份，注明船名、港口和收货人。

examples.en: Customs will not release the cargo until the export invoice is stamped.
examples.zh: 出口「货物装运单」盖章之前，海关不会放行货物。

words.enDefinition: invoices supporting expense claims

examples.en: Collect expense invoices weekly, or the tax office disallows the whole claim.
examples.zh: 每周都要收齐「费用清单」，否则税务局会驳回整笔申报。

examples.en: Her expense invoices filled a shoebox: train tickets, coffees, and one questionable lamp.
examples.zh: 她的「费用清单」装满了一个鞋盒：火车票、咖啡，还有一盏来路可疑的台灯。

words.zhGloss: 公司间应收及应付款项
words.enDefinition: inter-company receivables and payables used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 公司间应收及应付款项

examples.en: Inter-company receivables and payables must net to zero in the consolidated accounts.
examples.zh: 在合并报表中，「公司间应收及应付款项」必须相互抵销为零。

examples.en: The two subsidiaries disputed inter-company receivables and payables for three months straight.
examples.zh: 两家子公司为「公司间应收及应付款项」整整争执了三个月。

words.enDefinition: dividends declared between companies but not yet paid

examples.en: The consolidation worksheet eliminates inter-company dividends unpaid to avoid double counting.
examples.zh: 合并工作底稿会抵销「公司间应付未付股利」，避免重复计算。

examples.en: Auditors traced inter-company dividends unpaid between the parent and its overseas subsidiary.
examples.zh: 审计员核对了母公司与海外子公司之间的「公司间应付未付股利」。

words.enDefinition: an audit of monthly balance sheet

examples.en: A monthly balance sheet audit keeps the bank's covenant figures beyond dispute.
examples.zh: 每月一次「月份资产负债表审计」，让银行的契约指标无可争辩。

examples.en: The client hates the monthly balance sheet audit, yet admits it catches errors early.
examples.zh: 客户嘴上嫌弃「月份资产负债表审计」，却也承认它能及早发现差错。

collocations: prioritise the monthly balance sheet audit
standardise the monthly balance sheet audit
monitor the monthly balance sheet audit

words.enDefinition: a manual of cost accounting methods and rates

examples.en: The cost manual fixes a standard hourly rate for every workshop process.
examples.zh: 「成本手册」为每道车间工序规定了标准工时费率。

examples.en: Everyone quotes from the cost manual, so two estimators never disagree by much.
examples.zh: 所有人都按「成本手册」报价，两个估价员的口径不会相差太多。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied on a corporation’s taxable profits

examples.en: Corporation profit tax is charged on adjusted profits, not on the published figure.
examples.zh: 「公司利润税」按调整后的利润征收，而不是按对外公布的数字。

examples.en: Smaller firms pay corporation profit tax at a reduced rate below the threshold.
examples.zh: 门槛以下的小公司按较低税率缴纳「公司利润税」。

words.zhGloss: 净价法(采购或销售折扣记帐)
words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling net price
acceptedZhAnswers: 净价法(采购或销售折扣记帐)

examples.en: Under the net price method, we record purchases assuming every discount is taken.
examples.zh: 按「净价法」，我们记账时假定所有购货折扣都会被享用。

examples.en: Missing a discount under the net price method shows up as an extra expense.
examples.zh: 在「净价法」下错失折扣，就会直接体现为一笔额外费用。

words.enDefinition: a manual of accounting used in professional practice

examples.en: The manual of accounting defines every code the branch offices must use.
examples.zh: 「会计手册」规定了各分支办事处必须使用的每一个科目编码。

examples.en: Whenever the standard changes, the manual of accounting gets a new page by email.
examples.zh: 准则一有变动，「会计手册」就会通过邮件增发新页。

words.enDefinition: accounting for manufacturing

examples.en: Manufacturing accounting tracks material, labour, and overhead from raw stock to finished units.
examples.zh: 「制造业会计」追踪从原材料到成品的材料、人工和间接费用。

examples.en: Her first job in manufacturing accounting was pricing a single bolt for the tender.
examples.zh: 她在「制造业会计」岗位上的第一项任务，是为投标核算一颗螺栓的成本。

words.enDefinition: accounting for manufacturing cost

examples.en: Manufacturing cost accounting charged the recall to the batch that failed inspection.
examples.zh: 「制造成本会计」把召回费用记到了未通过检验的那一批次头上。

examples.en: Through manufacturing cost accounting we learned the paint shop costs more than assembly.
examples.zh: 通过「制造成本会计」我们才发现，喷漆车间的成本竟然高于装配。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage manufacturing overhead

examples.en: The manufacturing overhead control account gathers every indirect factory cost for the month.
examples.zh: 「制造费用控制账户」归集了当月工厂的每一笔间接费用。

examples.en: When manufacturing overhead control shows an under-absorption, rates get recalculated for next quarter.
examples.zh: 一旦「制造费用控制账户」出现分配不足，下一季度就要重新测算分配率。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage inventory

examples.en: Good inventory control means the freezer never holds more than a fortnight of stock.
examples.zh: 良好的「存货控制」意味着冷柜里的货从不超过两周的用量。

examples.en: Barcodes on every carton made inventory control almost effortless for the volunteers.
examples.zh: 每个纸箱贴上条形码后，志愿者做「存货控制」几乎不费力气。

words.enDefinition: methods used to account for inventory

examples.en: The exam asked us to compare inventory accounting methods on identical purchases.
examples.zh: 考题要求我们就相同的进货比较各种「存货的会计处理方法」。

examples.en: Switching inventory accounting methods needs disclosure, because profits shift with the choice.
examples.zh: 变更「存货的会计处理方法」必须披露，因为利润会随选择而变动。

words.enDefinition: accounting for inventory

examples.en: Inventory accounting treats transport inward as part of the cost of every box.
examples.zh: 「存货会计」把进货运费计入每箱货物的成本。

examples.en: Her chapter on inventory accounting ends with the cut-off rules for deliveries.
examples.zh: 她那章「存货会计」以到货截止规则作结。

words.enDefinition: audits of marketing activities and effectiveness

examples.en: Annual marketing audits ask whether each campaign actually moved the numbers.
examples.zh: 年度「市场审计」要追问每场营销活动是否真正拉动了业绩。

examples.en: The consultants' marketing audits found the brochure budget outweighed every digital channel combined.
examples.zh: 顾问的「市场审计」发现，宣传册预算超过了所有数字渠道的总和。

words.enDefinition: the cost of invoice

examples.en: We value the returned goods at invoice cost, not at today's shelf price.
examples.zh: 退货按「发票价」计价，而不是按今天的货架价。

examples.en: Freight excluded, the invoice cost of each mixer came to forty-two pounds.
examples.zh: 不含运费，每台搅拌机的「发票价」为四十二英镑。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates inventory-sales

examples.en: A falling inventory-sales ratio means shelves turn faster than they did last spring.
examples.zh: 「存货销售比率」下降，意味着货架周转比去年春天更快了。

examples.en: The buyer watches the inventory-sales ratio weekly before committing to any reorder.
examples.zh: 采购员每周盯着「存货销售比率」，再决定是否补货。

words.enDefinition: liquidating for inventory

examples.en: Inventory liquidating began in March, when everything without a barcode went discounted.
examples.zh: 三月启动了「压缩库存」，没有条形码的货一律打折处理。

examples.en: Careful inventory liquidating freed the cash that funded the second cold van.
examples.zh: 有条不紊的「压缩库存」腾出了资金，买下第二辆冷藏车。

words.enDefinition: accounting for customs cost

examples.en: Customs cost accounting lands duty, brokerage, and demurrage on the right product lines.
examples.zh: 「关税成本会计」把关税、代理费和滞港费落到正确的产品线上。

examples.en: After customs cost accounting, the imported sofa line quietly lost its margin.
examples.zh: 「关税成本会计」核算之后，进口沙发产品线的利润悄悄归零了。

collocations: roll forward the customs cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record customer's

examples.en: Every credit customer has a page in the customer's ledger with monthly totals.
examples.zh: 每位赊账客户在「应收账款分户账」中都有一页，按月合计。

examples.en: The debt collector works straight from the customer's ledger, oldest balances first.
examples.zh: 收账员直接照着「应收账款分户账」办事，先从最老的余额催起。

words.enDefinition: goods held for sale or use in buffer

examples.en: The strike caught the plant by surprise, and buffer inventory kept orders shipping for a month.
examples.zh: 罢工来得突然，靠「缓冲存货」硬是又发了一个月的货。

examples.en: Keep buffer inventory low on fashion items; yesterday's trend is tomorrow's clearance bin.
examples.zh: 时尚单品别囤太多「缓冲存货」，昨天的爆款就是明天的打折货。

words.enDefinition: allocation of cost over time for bond premium

examples.en: Bond premium amortization trims the interest expense below the cash coupon paid.
examples.zh: 「债券溢价摊销」让利息费用低于实际支付的现金票息。

examples.en: Over five years, bond premium amortization walks the carrying value back down to par.
examples.zh: 五年里，「债券溢价摊销」把账面价值一步步拉回面值。

words.enDefinition: accounting for budget and fund

examples.en: The county college trains staff in budget and fund accounting every September.
examples.zh: 县立学院每年九月为员工培训「预算与基金会计」。

examples.en: Budget and fund accounting separates what was appropriated from what was actually spent.
examples.zh: 「预算与基金会计」把核准数与实际支出分开核算。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for outward

examples.en: Each outward invoice records the crates leaving for Rotterdam on Thursday's barge.
examples.zh: 每份「出口装货清单」都记录了周四驳船运往鹿特丹的板条箱。

examples.en: The outward invoice must match the packing list box for box at customs.
examples.zh: 在海关，「出口装货清单」必须与装箱单逐箱核对一致。

words.enDefinition: a tariff applied to import

examples.en: The new import tariff added eight percent to every consignment of steel.
examples.zh: 新的「进口关税」让每批钢材的成本多了百分之八。

examples.en: Farmers welcomed the import tariff on cheap grain, though bakers quietly objected.
examples.zh: 农户欢迎对廉价谷物征收「进口关税」，面包师们却私下反对。

words.zhGloss: 组成公司(社团)的会计师
words.enDefinition: an accountant specialising in incorporated
acceptedZhAnswers: 组成公司(社团)的会计师

examples.en: The incorporated accountant signed the audit report on behalf of the small practice.
examples.zh: 这位「注册公司会计师」代表小型事务所签署了审计报告。

examples.en: Her father qualified as an incorporated accountant back when ledgers were handwritten.
examples.zh: 她父亲考下「注册公司会计师」资格时，账簿还全靠手写。

words.enDefinition: organisation costs that have been written off

examples.en: Organization costs written off appear in the notes as a single annual charge.
examples.zh: 「开办费摊销」在附注中列作一笔年度费用。

examples.en: Lawyers, registration fees, and the launch dinner all became organization costs written off.
examples.zh: 律师费、注册费和开业晚宴，全都成了「开办费摊销」的项目。

collocations: accrue the organization costs written off
restate the organization costs written off
roll forward the organization costs written off

words.enDefinition: a tax charged on gains from disposing of capital assets

examples.en: Holding the shares past a year moves them into the lower capital gains tax bracket.
examples.zh: 持股满一年，就能适用较低的「资本利得税」档次。

examples.en: The country scrapped capital gains tax on property to restart the stalled market.
examples.zh: 该国取消了房产「资本利得税」，想让停滞的市场重新动起来。

words.enDefinition: assets associated with capital

examples.en: The fire destroyed capital assets that insurance would replace at today's prices.
examples.zh: 大火烧毁的「资本性资产」，保险将按当前价格重置。

examples.en: Selling capital assets to cover payroll is how struggling firms slide into trouble.
examples.zh: 靠变卖「资本性资产」发工资，正是困难企业滑向深渊的开始。

words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)

examples.en: Under the payment on receipt credit, the bank pays once the warehouse receipt appears.
examples.zh: 按「凭收据付款信用状」，银行一见到仓单就付款。

examples.en: The seller trusted the payment on receipt credit more than any open account.
examples.zh: 卖方更信任「凭收据付款信用状」，而不是任何挂账安排。

collocations: sample the payment on receipt credit
vouch the payment on receipt credit
tie out the payment on receipt credit

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage payroll

examples.en: Payroll control failed when one manager both hired staff and approved their pay.
examples.zh: 一位经理既雇人又批薪，「工资控制」随之失效。

examples.en: Hours are clocked electronically, giving payroll control something solid to check against.
examples.zh: 工时改为电子打卡，「工资控制」便有了可对照的实据。

words.enDefinition: ratios derived from balance sheet amounts

examples.en: Lenders compare balance sheet ratios across five years before renewing the facility.
examples.zh: 续授信之前，银行会对比五年的「资产负债比率」。

examples.en: The gearing and liquidity metrics are both balance sheet ratios drawn from the same date.
examples.zh: 杠杆与流动性指标都是取自同一时点的「资产负债比率」。

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to forwarding agent's

examples.en: The forwarding agent's receipt proves the crates left our dock on the eleventh.
examples.zh: 「运输代理人收据」证明板条箱于十一日离开了我们的码头。

examples.en: Attach the forwarding agent's receipt to the claim, or the insurer delays payment.
examples.zh: 索赔时要附上「运输代理人收据」，否则保险公司会拖延赔付。

words.enDefinition: a time span used for pay

examples.en: Our pay period runs fortnightly, so overtime splits across two wage runs.
examples.zh: 我们的「工资支付期」按两周一轮，加班费会分摊到两次发薪里。

examples.en: Casual workers are paid at the end of each pay period, never early.
examples.zh: 临时工只能在每个「工资支付期」结束时领薪，从不提前。

words.zhGloss: 销售(货)部门薪金和费用
words.enDefinition: a sales management salaries and expense used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 销售(货)部门薪金和费用

examples.en: Sales management salaries and expense are budgeted separately from the reps' commission pool.
examples.zh: 「销售部门薪金和费用」与销售代表的佣金池分开编列预算。

examples.en: The chief scrutinised sales management salaries and expense after two quarters of losses.
examples.zh: 连续两个季度亏损后，一把手仔细审查了「销售部门薪金和费用」。

collocations: record the sales management salaries and expense
disclose the sales management salaries and expense
reconcile the sales management salaries and expense

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to dividend payable in capital

examples.en: The board declared a dividend payable in capital stock, five new shares for every hundred.
examples.zh: 董事会宣布派发「应付股票股利」，每一百股送五股。

examples.en: Dividend payable in capital stock never drains cash, which suits fast-growing firms.
examples.zh: 「应付股票股利」不耗现金，正合高增长公司的需要。

words.zhGloss: 制造(间接)费用预算差异帐户
words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track factory expense budget variation
acceptedZhAnswers: 制造(间接)费用预算差异帐户

examples.en: The factory expense budget variation account holds the gap between allowed and actual overhead.
examples.zh: 「制造费用预算差异账户」记录预算间接费用与实际发生额之间的差额。

examples.en: Bookkeepers closed the factory expense budget variation account straight into cost of sales.
examples.zh: 簿记员把「制造费用预算差异账户」直接结转进销售成本。

collocations: prioritise the factory expense budget variation account
standardise the factory expense budget variation account
monitor the factory expense budget variation account

words.enDefinition: the systematic allocation of bond issuance costs over the life of the bonds

examples.en: Amortization of bond issue expense spreads the placement fees across the ten-year term.
examples.zh: 「公司债券发行费摊销」把承销费用分摊到十年期限里。

examples.en: Auditors questioned our amortization of bond issue expense against the shorter actual life.
examples.zh: 审计师质疑我们的「公司债券发行费摊销」与实际更短的存续期不符。

collocations: record the amortization of bond issue expense
disclose the amortization of bond issue expense
reconcile the amortization of bond issue expense

words.zhGloss: 存货成本计算方法的分析
words.enDefinition: an analysis comparing methods of costing inventory
acceptedZhAnswers: 存货成本计算方法的分析

examples.en: Our analysis of inventory costing methods showed FIFO overstating profit during inflation.
examples.zh: 我们对「存货成本计算方法的分析」显示，通胀期先进先出法会高估利润。

examples.en: The report's analysis of inventory costing methods filled eleven pages with worked examples.
examples.zh: 报告中的「存货成本计算方法的分析」部分用实例演算写了十一页。

collocations: classify analysis of inventory costing methods
measure analysis of inventory costing methods
disclose analysis of inventory costing methods

words.zhGloss: 应收帐款贴现佣金(手续费)支出
words.enDefinition: accounts used to track commission paid on discounted
acceptedZhAnswers: 应收帐款贴现佣金(手续费)支出

examples.en: As more invoices were factored, commission paid on discounted accounts climbed past budget.
examples.zh: 随着更多发票被贴现，「应收帐款贴现佣金（手续费）支出」超了预算。

examples.en: The controller asked why commission paid on discounted accounts doubled this quarter.
examples.zh: 财务总监质问，本季度「应收帐款贴现佣金（手续费）支出」为何翻倍。

collocations: prioritise the commission paid on discounted accounts
standardise the commission paid on discounted accounts
monitor the commission paid on discounted accounts

words.zhGloss: 基金会计中的项目结构
words.enDefinition: accounting for program structure in fund
acceptedZhAnswers: 基金会计中的项目结构

examples.en: The seminar explained program structure in fund accounting with a hospital grant example.
examples.zh: 研讨会用医院拨款案例讲解「基金会计中的项目结构」。

examples.en: Clear program structure in fund accounting keeps restricted grants from funding the wrong unit.
examples.zh: 清晰的「基金会计中的项目结构」，能防止限定用途拨款被错误部门挪用。

collocations: prioritise the program structure in fund accounting
standardise the program structure in fund accounting
monitor the program structure in fund accounting

words.enDefinition: a statement showing assets, liabilities, and equity at a point in time

examples.en: The balance sheet balances because every asset was funded by someone.
examples.zh: 「资产负债表」之所以平衡，是因为每项资产背后都有出资人。

examples.en: One glance at the balance sheet told the buyer the stock was overvalued.
examples.zh: 看一眼「资产负债表」，买方就明白存货被高估了。

words.enDefinition: a structure of balance sheet debt

examples.en: The group's balance sheet debt structure shifted from bank loans toward supplier credit.
examples.zh: 集团的「资产负债表债务结构」从银行贷款转向了供应商赊账。

examples.en: Analysts praised the balance sheet debt structure: maturities spread evenly over ten years.
examples.zh: 分析师称赞其「资产负债表债务结构」：到期日在十年内均匀分布。

collocations: test the balance sheet debt structure
refine the balance sheet debt structure
compare the balance sheet debt structure

words.enDefinition: a tariff applied to sliding

examples.en: A sliding tariff rises with the world price, cushioning local refiners.
examples.zh: 「浮动关税」随国际价格上行而提高，为本国炼厂提供缓冲。

examples.en: Under the sliding tariff, importers pay less duty when freight costs spike.
examples.zh: 在「浮动关税」下，运费飙升时进口商缴纳的关税反而减少。

words.enDefinition: an audit of bank

examples.en: The federal bank audit flagged two branches for sloppy loan documentation.
examples.zh: 联邦「银行审计」点名两家分行，贷款文件管理混乱。

examples.en: Bank audit season empties the file room for six straight weeks.
examples.zh: 一到「银行审计」季，档案室要连续清空六个星期。

words.enDefinition: credits related to delayed

examples.en: The auction house books delayed credits only once the buyer actually settles.
examples.zh: 拍卖行只等买方实际结清后才确认「过期账收入」。

examples.en: Half the delayed credits from November remained uncollected at the February review.
examples.zh: 到二月复核时，十一月的「过期账收入」还有一半没有收回。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of average held for sale or use

examples.en: We compute average stock by adding opening and closing balances, then halving.
examples.zh: 把期初与期末余额相加再除以二，就算出「平均存货」。

examples.en: Turnover based on average stock reads fairer than one built on a single date.
examples.zh: 用「平均存货」算周转率，比只用某一天的数字更公允。

words.enDefinition: an audit of site

examples.en: The site audit ran three days inside the client's Warrington depot.
examples.zh: 这次「就地审计」在客户的沃灵顿仓库现场进行了三天。

examples.en: A site audit lets us watch the loaders actually scan each pallet.
examples.zh: 「就地审计」让我们亲眼看到装卸工逐板扫码。

words.enDefinition: a systematic way of handling sinking fund depreciation

examples.en: The sinking fund depreciation method assumes each year's charge earns interest until replacement day.
examples.zh: 「偿债基金折旧法」假定每年计提的资金都生息，直到设备更新之日。

examples.en: Textbooks present the sinking fund depreciation method as rarely used in practice.
examples.zh: 教材指出「偿债基金折旧法」实务中很少采用。

collocations: apply the sinking fund depreciation method
adopt the sinking fund depreciation method
document the sinking fund depreciation method

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track balance sheet

examples.en: Balance sheet accounts carry forward, while income accounts close off every year.
examples.zh: 「资产负债表账户」逐期结转，而收益类账户每年结清。

examples.en: The software locks balance sheet accounts once the year-end journal is approved.
examples.zh: 年终分录一经批准，系统就会锁定「资产负债表账户」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for bank

examples.en: Bank accounting treats loan losses differently from ordinary receivable write-offs.
examples.zh: 「银行会计」对贷款损失的处理，与普通应收款核销并不相同。

examples.en: She switched from retail bookkeeping to bank accounting for the higher pay.
examples.zh: 为了更高的薪水，她从零售记账转行做「银行会计」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for standard cost

examples.en: Standard cost accounting flags every hour the line runs beyond the norm.
examples.zh: 「标准成本会计」会把产线超时运行的每一个小时都标出来。

examples.en: Under standard cost accounting, mixtures of cheap and dear flour show as mix variances.
examples.zh: 在「标准成本会计」下，贵贱面粉的掺配差异会体现为结构差异。

collocations: tie out the standard cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for stock

examples.en: The stock budget caps how much yarn the mill may buy each month.
examples.zh: 「存货预算」规定了纱厂每月最多可采购多少纱线。

examples.en: Season peaks blow the stock budget, so the board pre-approves a Christmas allowance.
examples.zh: 旺季会冲破「存货预算」，所以董事会预先批准了圣诞额度。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track stock

examples.en: The stock account shows one hundred thousand issued shares recorded at par.
examples.zh: 「股份帐」显示已发行股本10万股，按面值记账。

examples.en: Closing entries moved the year's profit into retained earnings, not the stock account.
examples.zh: 结账分录把本年利润转入留存收益，而非「股份帐」。

words.enDefinition: auditing of financial statement

examples.en: Financial statement auditing gives outsiders a reason to trust the printed numbers.
examples.zh: 「财务报表审计」给了外部人相信纸面数字的理由。

examples.en: My year of financial statement auditing taught me more than three lecture courses.
examples.zh: 一年的「财务报表审计」实务教给我的，比三门课加起来还多。

collocations: tie out the financial statement auditing

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record stock

examples.en: Transfers of shares are entered in the stock ledger the day they complete.
examples.zh: 股份转让完成的当天，就要登记进「股东分户账」。

examples.en: The registrar certifies holdings straight from the stock ledger at each dividend date.
examples.zh: 每次派息日，登记员都直接凭「股东分户账」核证持股。

words.enDefinition: a keeper of stock

examples.en: The stock keeper signs for every delivery before it crosses the warehouse door.
examples.zh: 每批到货都必须先由「存货管理人」签收，才能进仓库大门。

examples.en: Our stock keeper radios the floor the moment shelf two runs below ten.
examples.zh: 二号货架一旦少于十件，「存货管理人」立刻用电台通知楼层。

words.enDefinition: accounting for stewardship

examples.en: Stewardship accounting shows trustees exactly how they handled the money entrusted to them.
examples.zh: 「管理人会计」向受托人准确展示他们如何处置了受托资金。

examples.en: Estate stewardship accounting kept the heirs informed through every year of probate.
examples.zh: 遗产认证的每个年头，「管理人会计」都让继承人知情。

words.enDefinition: an agent acting for stocking

examples.en: A stocking agent holds goods locally so dealers never wait for the continent.
examples.zh: 「存货代理人」在当地备货，经销商无须苦等来自欧洲大陆的货。

examples.en: Our stocking agent arranges delivery within a day across the whole midlands.
examples.zh: 我们的「存货代理人」能让中英格兰全境一天之内到货。

words.enDefinition: a stop payment of salary used in professional practice

examples.en: The board voted to stop payment of salary until the missing stock was explained.
examples.zh: 在库存缺失问题交代清楚之前，董事会表决「停止支付薪金」。

examples.en: They cannot simply stop payment of salary without following the disciplinary procedure.
examples.zh: 不走完纪律处分程序，公司不能随意「停止支付薪金」。

words.enDefinition: profits arising from stock

examples.en: Stock profits vanish when buyers stop paying yesterday's prices for today's timber.
examples.zh: 一旦买家不再按昨天的价格购买今天的木材，「存货利润」便会蒸发。

examples.en: The builder's stock profits came simply from holding land and timber during inflation.
examples.zh: 建筑商的「存货利润」不过是通胀期间持有土地和木材赚来的。

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track stockholders' equity

examples.en: Share buybacks reduce the stockholders' equity accounts rather than the profit line.
examples.zh: 回购股份冲减的是「股东权益账户」，而不是利润行。

examples.en: Revaluation gains sit inside stockholders' equity accounts until the assets are sold.
examples.zh: 重估增值一直留在「股东权益账户」中，直到资产出售为止。

words.enDefinition: a godown for deposit

examples.en: The tea waits in the deposit godown until the excise stamps arrive.
examples.zh: 茶叶暂存「存货仓库」，等印花税票到了再提货。

examples.en: The deposit godown by the docks rents space by the pallet per week.
examples.zh: 码头边的「存货仓库」按托盘每周计收仓储费。

words.enDefinition: a statement of account sent to customers

examples.en: The statement to customers goes out on the first, listing every open invoice.
examples.zh: 「购货客户清单」每月一号寄出，逐笔列示未结发票。

examples.en: Customers who dispute the statement to customers get a copy of their ledger page.
examples.zh: 对「购货客户清单」有异议的客户，会收到其分户账页的副本。

words.enDefinition: a range of asset depreciation

examples.en: Our asset depreciation range gives delivery vans eight to twelve years of life.
examples.zh: 我们的「资产折旧幅度」规定送货货车可用年限为八至十二年。

examples.en: Within the asset depreciation range, we pick the shorter end for harsh-use vehicles.
examples.zh: 在「资产折旧幅度」之内，使用环境恶劣的车辆我们取较短的年限。

collocations: roll forward the asset depreciation range

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track assets and liabilities

examples.en: Assets and liabilities accounts stay open across years, unlike the sales accounts.
examples.zh: 与销售类账户不同，「资产负债账户」跨年连续存在。

examples.en: The trial balance lists all assets and liabilities accounts before the income items.
examples.zh: 试算平衡表先列全部「资产负债账户」，再列收益类项目。

words.enDefinition: accounting for automation of cost

examples.en: Automation of cost accounting freed the clerks to analyse rather than copy.
examples.zh: 「成本会计的自动化」让职员从抄录中解放出来，转做分析。

examples.en: Automation of cost accounting means machine hours flow straight from the sensors into the ledgers.
examples.zh: 有了「成本会计的自动化」，机器工时直接从传感器流入账簿。

collocations: accrue the automation of cost accounting
restate the automation of cost accounting
roll forward the automation of cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a department of accounting used in professional practice

examples.en: The department of accounting admitted eighty freshmen this September, the largest cohort yet.
examples.zh: 今年九月「会计系」录取了八十名新生，是历届最多的一届。

examples.en: Her office sits on the fourth floor of the department of accounting building.
examples.zh: 她的办公室在「会计系」大楼的四层。

words.zhGloss: 存货的平均成本计算法
words.enDefinition: an average costing of inventory used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 存货的平均成本计算法

examples.en: Average costing of inventory smooths the price swings between weekly flour deliveries.
examples.zh: 「存货的平均成本计算法」熨平了每周面粉到货之间的价格波动。

examples.en: Under average costing of inventory, each batch leaves the store at the same blended rate.
examples.zh: 在「存货的平均成本计算法」下，每批出库货物都按相同的混合单价计价。

words.enDefinition: accounting for average cost

examples.en: Average cost accounting spread the big steel order across the whole year's output.
examples.zh: 「平均成本会计」把那笔大额钢材订单的成本摊到了全年产量上。

examples.en: The shift to average cost accounting ended the monthly seesaw in reported margins.
examples.zh: 改用「平均成本会计」后，报表毛利率的月度大起大落消失了。

collocations: roll forward the average cost accounting

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to average deposit

examples.en: The average deposit receipt covered the jettisoned cargo after the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴过后，那批弃货由「海损保证金收据」提供担保。

examples.en: Claimants present the average deposit receipt before the maritime adjuster releases any funds.
examples.zh: 理算师放款之前，索赔方须出示「海损保证金收据」。

words.enDefinition: long-term capital invested in fixed assets such as plant and equipment

examples.en: The foundry ties most of its fixed capital into furnaces and cranes.
examples.zh: 这家铸造厂的「固定资本」大多压在熔炉和吊车上。

examples.en: Fixed capital wears out slowly, which is why factories borrow long.
examples.zh: 「固定资本」损耗缓慢，所以工厂借款期限都拉得很长。

words.enDefinition: investments held or made in relation to fixed

examples.en: Fixed investments in new cold-storage units lifted the grocer's capacity by a third.
examples.zh: 冷库的「固定资产投资额」让这家超市的仓储能力提升了三分之一。

examples.en: Quarterly reports track fixed investments to see whether firms still trust demand.
examples.zh: 季报追踪「固定资产投资额」，从中看出企业是否仍然相信需求。

words.enDefinition: customs invoices required for special clearance

examples.en: The consulate stamps the special customs invoices needed for clearance into that market.
examples.zh: 领事馆为进入该国市场所需的「特别海关发票」加盖印章。

examples.en: Without the special customs invoices, the shipment idled two weeks at the border.
examples.zh: 缺了「特别海关发票」，那批货在边境滞留了两周。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track special bank

examples.en: Payroll runs through a special bank account so wages never mix with operating cash.
examples.zh: 工资走「特种银行帐户」单独核算，绝不与经营现金混用。

examples.en: Auditors loved the special bank account because every grant dollar was traceable.
examples.zh: 审计师最喜欢「特种银行帐户」，每笔拨款都查得到去向。

words.enDefinition: an audit of special

examples.en: The board ordered a special audit into the missing petty cash.
examples.zh: 董事会就失踪的零用现金下令进行一次「特别审计」。

examples.en: A special audit traced the duplicate payments to one supplier account within days.
examples.zh: 「特别审计」几天内就把重复付款追到了同一个供应商账户。

words.enDefinition: a document presenting information about auditor's

examples.en: The auditor's report runs to nine pages, mostly about the warehouse valuation.
examples.zh: 「审计报告书」长达九页，主要内容是仓库估值。

examples.en: Every auditor's report carries the signature, the date, and the firm's registration number.
examples.zh: 每份「审计报告书」都载有签名、日期和事务所注册号。

words.enDefinition: fundamental rules applied to auditing

examples.en: Independence and evidence are the auditing principles every trainee recites first.
examples.zh: 独立性与证据是每个新人在「审计学原理」中首先背诵的原则。

examples.en: The course on auditing principles uses the vintage fraud cases as its spine.
examples.zh: 「审计学原理」课程以那些经典舞弊案例为主线。

words.enDefinition: a general principle applied in auditing

examples.en: The handbook condenses the auditing generality into a page every checker can quote.
examples.zh: 手册把「审计通则」压缩成一页，每位查账员都能脱口而出。

examples.en: Where statutes are silent, the auditing generality fills the gap for public bodies.
examples.zh: 法令未作规定之处，「审计通则」为公共机构补上依据。

words.enDefinition: a certificate documenting auditor's

examples.en: The bank wants the auditor's certificate before it releases the second tranche.
examples.zh: 银行要先拿到「审计证明书」，才会拨付第二笔款项。

examples.en: Each auditor's certificate confirms the figures agree with the underlying vouchers.
examples.zh: 每份「审计证明书」都确认报表数字与原始凭证相符。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for audit

examples.en: Audit expense rose this year because the group added two overseas subsidiaries.
examples.zh: 集团今年新增两家海外子公司，「查账费用」随之上升。

examples.en: We compare audit expense quotes from three firms every second year.
examples.zh: 每隔一年，我们就向三家事务所询价比较「查账费用」。

words.enDefinition: accounting for specific order cost

examples.en: Specific order cost accounting attaches every bolt and hour to a named job.
examples.zh: 「分批成本会计」把每颗螺栓、每个工时都挂到具名的订单上。

examples.en: Under specific order cost accounting, job 214 finally showed why it lost money.
examples.zh: 在「分批成本会计」下，214号订单终于露出了亏损的原因。

words.enDefinition: planning an audit and designing the audit programme/procedures

examples.en: Audit planning and programming happen in November, before anyone books the fieldwork.
examples.zh: 「审计计划和审计程序」的制定安排在十一月，先于现场工作的预订。

examples.en: Good audit planning and programming cut our second-year fieldwork almost in half.
examples.zh: 周到的「审计计划和审计程序」让第二年的现场工作几乎减半。

words.enDefinition: the objective an audit is designed to achieve

examples.en: The audit objective here is simple: prove the receivables exist and are collectible.
examples.zh: 这里的「审计目标」很简单：证明应收账款真实存在且可收回。

examples.en: Each programme line traces back to one audit objective and one assertion.
examples.zh: 方案中的每一行都能追溯到某一项「审计目标」和某一项认定。

words.enDefinition: a process used for audit

examples.en: The audit process starts with engagement acceptance, not with the first voucher.
examples.zh: 「审计程序」从承接业务开始，而不是从第一张凭证开始。

examples.en: Clients see only the tail of the audit process: the queries and the sign-off.
examples.zh: 客户看到的只是「审计程序」的尾声：问询函和签字确认。

words.zhGloss: 会计的各个专门化方面
words.enDefinition: a specialized phases of accounting used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 会计的各个专门化方面

examples.en: Tax, audit, and cost work are the specialized phases of accounting this degree covers.
examples.zh: 税务、审计和成本工作都是该学位所授「会计的各个专门化方面」。

examples.en: After qualifying she rotated through the specialized phases of accounting before choosing tax.
examples.zh: 取得资格后，她轮岗体验了「会计的各个专门化方面」，最后选定了税务。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied in respect of revenue

examples.en: The levy on imported tobacco is a revenue tax, aimed purely at the exchequer.
examples.zh: 对进口烟草征收的税属于「收入关税」，目的纯粹是充实国库。

examples.en: A revenue tax keeps rates modest so smuggling never becomes worthwhile.
examples.zh: 「收入关税」税率保持温和，走私便永远无利可图。

words.enDefinition: accounting for retail

examples.en: Retail accounting values the shop's stock using the retail method, not unit counts.
examples.zh: 「零售会计」采用零售价法为店铺存货计价，而不是逐件清点。

examples.en: Her textbook on retail accounting devotes a chapter to mark-downs and mark-ups.
examples.zh: 她那本「零售会计」教材专门用一章讲降价与加价。

words.enDefinition: an audit of responsibility

examples.en: The responsibility audit asked which manager signed off the cancelled orders.
examples.zh: 「责任审计」追查了究竟哪位经理批准取消了那些订单。

examples.en: A responsibility audit links each cost centre's overspend to a named budget holder.
examples.zh: 「责任审计」把每个成本中心的超支对应到具名的预算负责人。

words.enDefinition: tariffs imposed in retaliation for another country’s measures

examples.en: The government answered the steel duties with retaliatory tariffs on their cheese.
examples.zh: 针对对方的钢材关税，政府以奶酪「报复性关税」回敬。

examples.en: Retaliatory tariffs usually hurt both sides before the negotiators finally sit down.
examples.zh: 「报复性关税」往往两败俱伤，之后谈判代表才会最终坐下来。

words.enDefinition: routine financial accounting that records transactions and prepares general-purpose statements

examples.en: General accounting closes the monthly books by the fifth working day.
examples.zh: 「普通会计」在第五个工作日前完成月度结账。

examples.en: Her first job in general accounting covered everything from post to payroll postings.
examples.zh: 她在「普通会计」岗位的第一份差事，从收发室一直管到工资过账。

words.enDefinition: accounting for retail store

examples.en: Retail store accounting treats every till discrepancy above five pounds as an investigation.
examples.zh: 在「零售业会计」中，收银差异超过五英镑一律立案调查。

examples.en: The chain's retail store accounting merges each shop's cash summary every night.
examples.zh: 连锁店的「零售业会计」每晚汇总各家门店的现金日报。

words.enDefinition: written proof of payment related to general average deposit

examples.en: The general average deposit receipt secures every cargo owner's share of the sacrifice.
examples.zh: 「共同海损保证金收据」为每位货主分摊的牺牲份额提供担保。

examples.en: Without the general average deposit receipt, customs refuses to release the container.
examples.zh: 没有「共同海损保证金收据」，海关不予放行集装箱。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for general fixed assets

examples.en: The town records its fire trucks in the general fixed assets fund.
examples.zh: 小镇把消防车记在「一般固定资产基金」里。

examples.en: School buildings appear in the general fixed assets fund rather than the capital projects fund.
examples.zh: 校舍列入「一般固定资产基金」，而不是资本项目基金。

words.enDefinition: a glut the market used in professional practice

examples.en: Over-planting last spring threatened to glut the market with cooking apples.
examples.zh: 去春种植过量，烹饪用苹果眼看要出现「市场存货过剩」。

examples.en: Cheap imports glutted the market, and our margin fell for three straight quarters.
examples.zh: 廉价进口货令「市场存货过剩」，我们的利润率连续三个季度下滑。

words.enDefinition: inventory (stock) of goods in held for sale or use

examples.en: The website marks goods in stock in green, everything else in grey.
examples.zh: 网站把「库存货物」标成绿色，其余一律显示灰色。

examples.en: We insure the goods in stock at cost, not at the hopeful mark-up.
examples.zh: 「库存货物」按成本投保，而不是按一厢情愿的加价。

words.enDefinition: a tag marking stock that has been reserved

examples.en: A red reserved stock tag means that pallet is already promised to an order.
examples.zh: 红色「保留存货标签」表示该托盘已承诺给某张订单。

examples.en: Pickers must not touch anything carrying a reserved stock tag, however urgent the queue.
examples.zh: 无论队列多急，拣货员都不能碰挂有「保留存货标签」的货品。

words.enDefinition: accounting for replacement cost

examples.en: Replacement cost accounting revalues the fleet at what a new van would cost today.
examples.zh: 「重置成本会计」按今天购置新货车的价格对车队重新计价。

examples.en: Under replacement cost accounting, holding gains show separately from trading profits.
examples.zh: 在「重置成本会计」下，持有收益与经营利润分开列示。

collocations: roll forward the replacement cost accounting

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track rent payable

examples.en: The rent payable account shows two months accrued since the landlord moved abroad.
examples.zh: 房东移居国外后，「应付租金账户」已累计两个月的应计租金。

examples.en: Post the quarterly demand straight into the rent payable account, then schedule payment.
examples.zh: 把季度缴款通知直接记入「应付租金账户」，再安排付款。

words.enDefinition: an amount owed in respect of rent

examples.en: Rent payable for the kiosk is three hundred monthly, paid in advance.
examples.zh: 售货亭的「应付租金」为每月三百英镑，需预付。

examples.en: We negotiate rent payable down each renewal, trading a longer lease for the cut.
examples.zh: 每次续约我们都把「应付租金」谈低一些，用更长的租期交换减租。

words.enDefinition: a replacement method of depreciation used in professional practice

examples.en: The replacement method of depreciation charges what the asset would cost new today.
examples.zh: 「重置成本折旧法」按该资产今日全新重置价计提折旧。

examples.en: Under the replacement method of depreciation, inflation quietly raises the annual charge.
examples.zh: 在「重置成本折旧法」下，通胀会悄悄推高年度折旧额。

words.enDefinition: customers with debit balances owed to the entity

examples.en: Debit customers owe us money, while credit customers are the ones we owe.
examples.zh: 「借方客户」欠我们钱，而贷方客户是我们欠的人。

examples.en: The aged listing of debit customers feeds the collection calls every Monday.
examples.zh: 每周一的催收电话，就是照着「借方客户」账龄清单打的。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from reported

examples.en: Reported profit doubled, but the cash statement told a quieter story.
examples.zh: 「报告利润」翻倍，现金流量表讲的却平静得多。

examples.en: Analysts strip one-off gains before comparing reported profit across the three retailers.
examples.zh: 分析师会先剔除一次性收益，再比较三家零售商的「报告利润」。

words.enDefinition: a formal presentation of information about bank

examples.en: Tia reconciles the bank statement against her notebook every payday.
examples.zh: 每个发薪日，蒂亚都把「银行月结单」和自己的小本子对一遍。

examples.en: The fraud only surfaced when a duplicate charge appeared on the bank statement.
examples.zh: 直到「银行月结单」上出现重复扣款，骗局才露馅。

collocations: open an account at the bank statement

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning bank giro

examples.en: Pension payments arrive as a bank giro credit on the third of each month.
examples.zh: 养老金每月3号以「银行信用转帐」方式到账。

examples.en: The old bank giro credit slips confused teenagers used to tap-to-pay.
examples.zh: 习惯了闪付的年轻人，看不懂老式的「银行信用转帐」单据。

words.enDefinition: a voucher supporting bank payment

examples.en: Each bank payment voucher lists the cheque number, payee, and authorizing signature.
examples.zh: 每张「银行存款付出凭证」都写明支票号、收款人和批准签字。

examples.en: The clerk filed the bank payment voucher the same day the transfer cleared.
examples.zh: 转账当天，经办员就把「银行存款付出凭证」归了档。

words.enDefinition: a ledger used to record shareholders

examples.en: The shareholders ledger records each holding with its certificate numbers and dates.
examples.zh: 「股东明细分户账」逐笔记录各持仓及其股票凭证号和日期。

examples.en: Before the dividend, the company secretary prints the shareholders ledger for the register check.
examples.zh: 派息之前，公司秘书打印「股东明细分户账」以核对名册。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of bank credit

examples.en: Suppliers across the union are paid by bank credit transfer within two days.
examples.zh: 联盟内供应商的货款通过「银行信用转帐」两天内付清。

examples.en: Bank credit transfer replaced the courier who once carried sacks of cash between branches.
examples.zh: 「银行信用转帐」取代了过去往来分行之间扛现金的押运员。

words.enDefinition: a certificate documenting bank deposit

examples.en: Bring your bank deposit certificate when applying for the visa's financial proof.
examples.zh: 办签证的财力证明时，记得带上「银行存款凭证」。

examples.en: The auditor matched each bank deposit certificate to the ledger's interest entries.
examples.zh: 审计员把每张「银行存款凭证」与账上的利息记录一一核对。

words.enDefinition: a bill requesting payment for bank

examples.en: The bank invoice for the wire fee arrived with a reference number.
