examples.zh: 恶性通胀期间，「稳定币值会计」让工厂毛利不再像幻觉。

words.enDefinition: a card used for stock

examples.en: The storekeeper updates the stock card every time a batch leaves the warehouse.
examples.zh: 仓库管理员在每批货物出库时都会更新「存货卡」。

examples.en: When the auditor asked for the March figures, Manager Chen pulled out the stock card for that item.
examples.zh: 审计师询问三月的数据时，陈经理翻出了该物料的「存货卡」。

words.enDefinition: a book recording stock

examples.en: Every delivery is entered in the stock book before it goes onto the shelves.
examples.zh: 每批到货都要先登记进「存货簿」，然后才能上架。

examples.en: Our new clerk lost the stock book, so we spent Friday reconstructing the last month of entries.
examples.zh: 新来的文书把「存货簿」弄丢了，我们花了整个周五补录上个月的记录。

words.enDefinition: goods held for sale or use in stock

examples.en: The year-end count showed the stock inventory was worth less than the books claimed.
examples.zh: 年终盘点显示「存货」价值低于账面数。

examples.en: Slow-moving lines are piling up, so we will cut the stock inventory before the season changes.
examples.zh: 滞销品越积越多，换季前我们要压一压「存货」。

words.enDefinition: goods and materials a trader keeps for sale in the normal course of business

examples.en: A tailor's cloth and thread are his stock in trade.
examples.zh: 对裁缝来说，布料和线就是他的「存货」。

examples.en: The fire destroyed most of the shop's stock in trade a week before Christmas.
examples.zh: 火灾在圣诞前一周烧毁了店铺的大部分「存货」。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage stock

examples.en: Good stock control means you never promise a customer goods you cannot ship.
examples.zh: 「存货控制」做得好，就绝不会向客户承诺发不出的货。

examples.en: Since the barcode system came in, our stock control has stopped relying on guesswork.
examples.zh: 上了条码系统后，我们的「存货控制」不再靠拍脑袋了。

words.enDefinition: stock currently held on hand

examples.en: Let me check the stock in hand before I confirm your order of forty cases.
examples.zh: 确认你四十箱的订单之前，我先查一下「现有存货」。

examples.en: The stock in hand will cover December, but January needs a fresh purchase order.
examples.zh: 「现有存货」够撑到十二月底，一月份还得再下采购单。

words.enDefinition: a card used for stock control

examples.en: Each shelf in the store room carries a stock control card showing what came in and went out.
examples.zh: 库房里每个货架都挂着一张「存货控制卡」，记录物料进出情况。

examples.en: Write the date and quantity on the stock control card the moment you take a box.
examples.zh: 一取箱就要在「存货控制卡」上写明日期和数量。

words.enDefinition: subject to being assessed for tax

examples.en: Dividends from that subsidiary are assessable to tax in both countries, so plan the withholding early.
examples.zh: 那家子公司的股息在两国都属于「应纳税」所得，所以要提前安排预提税。

examples.en: The inspector ruled that the bonus was assessable to tax even though it was paid in kind.
examples.zh: 税务检查员认定这笔奖金虽以实物发放，仍属「应纳税」所得。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for assessment

examples.en: Sidewalk repairs are charged to the assessment fund, shared by the abutting owners.
examples.zh: 人行道修缮费从「估定税捐基金」列支，由临街业主分摊。

examples.en: The city audits the assessment fund every December to reset next year's levies.
examples.zh: 市政府每年12月审计「估定税捐基金」，据以调整次年税额。

words.enDefinition: a schedule or sheet presenting stock

examples.en: Hand me the stock sheet and I will match it against the warehouse count.
examples.zh: 把「存货表」给我，我来和仓库盘点数核对。

examples.en: The stock sheet lists each item twice, which is why the totals came out wrong.
examples.zh: 「存货表」把每种物料都列了两遍，所以合计数对不上。

words.enDefinition: stock currently on hand

examples.en: We can ship today because there is stock on hand for the blue model.
examples.zh: 蓝色款有「现货」，今天就能发货。

examples.en: The quote is valid only while stock on hand lasts, after which new lead times apply.
examples.zh: 本报价仅在「现货」售完前有效，之后按新交期计算。

words.enDefinition: a system for stock-control

examples.en: The new stock-control system flags any item that falls below its two-week level automatically.
examples.zh: 新的「存货控制系统」会自动标记低于两周用量的物料。

examples.en: Staff needed three weeks of training before the stock-control system stopped alarming them with false counts.
examples.zh: 员工培训了三周，「存货控制系统」才不再频繁误报盘点差异。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of stock subscriptions

examples.en: Investors paid half on signing, so the rest sits in stock subscriptions receivable until the second call.
examples.zh: 投资者签约时缴了一半，余款在第二次催缴前挂在「应收认购股款」里。

examples.en: Two shareholders still owe money, so stock subscriptions receivable stays on the balance sheet at year end.
examples.zh: 两名股东仍未缴清股款，所以「应收认购股款」在年末仍列在资产负债表上。

collocations: tie out the stock subscriptions receivable

words.enDefinition: the process of estimating the worth of stock

examples.en: Under FIFO, the stock valuation rises every time raw material prices climb.
examples.zh: 采用先进先出法时，原材料一涨价，「存货估价」就跟着上升。

examples.en: Auditors challenged our stock valuation of the damaged goods, which we had carried at full cost.
examples.zh: 审计师对我们按全额成本计列的受损货物「存货估价」提出了异议。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied in respect of stock transfer

examples.en: The stock transfer tax of half a percent barely dented the takeover arithmetic.
examples.zh: 0.5%的「股票转让税」对收购账几乎无感。

examples.en: Traders shifted business across the border to dodge the new stock transfer tax.
examples.zh: 为了避开新征的「股票转让税」，交易者把生意挪到了边境另一侧。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied in respect of stock transaction

examples.en: A tiny stock transaction tax on each trade funds the market regulator.
examples.zh: 每笔交易征收的少量「股票交易税」，用来养活市场监管机构。

examples.en: High-frequency firms complained the stock transaction tax erased their thinnest strategies.
examples.zh: 高频交易公司抱怨「股票交易税」把最薄利的策略抹掉了。

words.enDefinition: taking of stock

examples.en: The warehouse closes early on Friday for the monthly stock taking.
examples.zh: 周五仓库提前关门，进行每月的「存货盘点」。

examples.en: During stock taking, nothing moves in or out of the store room, not even a roll of tape.
examples.zh: 「存货盘点」期间库房物料一律不得进出，连一卷胶带都不例外。

words.enDefinition: an audit required by law or regulation

examples.en: As a listed company, we cannot escape the statutory audit no matter how busy the year has been.
examples.zh: 作为上市公司，无论这一年多忙，「法定审计」都躲不掉。

examples.en: Small companies below the turnover threshold are now exempt from the statutory audit.
examples.zh: 营业额低于门槛的小公司现在可以豁免「法定审计」。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track asset reduction

examples.en: Accumulated depreciation sits in an asset reduction account rather than reducing the machinery line directly.
examples.zh: 累计折旧记入「资产减项帐户」，而不是直接冲减机器设备科目。

examples.en: When we scrapped the old press, the asset reduction account finally cleared to zero.
examples.zh: 废旧压机后，「资产减项帐户」终于清零。

collocations: tie out the asset reduction account

words.enDefinition: a senior auditor who deputises for the chief auditor

examples.en: The assistant chief auditor signed off the working papers while the chief was at the client's site.
examples.zh: 主任审计师在客户现场期间，「助理主任审计师」复核签认了工作底稿。

examples.en: After five years on the engagement, she was promoted from senior to assistant chief auditor.
examples.zh: 在这个项目做了五年后，她从高级审计师升任「助理主任审计师」。

collocations: rely on the assistant chief auditor

words.enDefinition: a deputy to the auditor-general

examples.en: The assistant auditor-general will open tomorrow's briefing on the new performance-audit guidelines.
examples.zh: 「总审计长助理」将主持明天关于新绩效审计准则的吹风会。

examples.en: Questions about the regional offices go to the assistant auditor-general, not to the press office.
examples.zh: 有关各地审计特派办的问题要找「总审计长助理」，不要找新闻办。

words.enDefinition: a junior accountant who assists the chief accountant

examples.en: The assistant accountant matched every supplier invoice to its purchase order before month end.
examples.zh: 「助理会计员」在月底前把每张供应商发票都和采购订单核对上了。

examples.en: Our assistant accountant is studying for the CPA exam, so the chief accountant reviews her vouchers twice.
examples.zh: 我们的「助理会计员」正在备考注册会计师，所以总账会计会把她的凭证复核两遍。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with statutory

examples.en: Law requires lenders to hold statutory capital before writing a single mortgage.
examples.zh: 法律要求放贷机构先持有「法定股本（资本）」，才能签出第一笔按揭。

examples.en: Losses cannot push the bank below its statutory capital without triggering intervention.
examples.zh: 亏损一旦击穿「法定股本（资本）」红线，监管就会介入。

words.enDefinition: professional standards governing how audits are carried out

examples.en: The working papers cite the statement on auditing standards that covers confirming receivables directly with customers.
examples.zh: 工作底稿引用了有关直接向客户函证应收款的「审计准则说明」。

examples.en: Every trainee reads the statement on auditing standards before touching a live engagement file.
examples.zh: 每名实习生都要先读「审计准则说明」，才能碰正式项目的档案。

collocations: sample the statement on auditing standards
vouch the statement on auditing standards
tie out the statement on auditing standards

words.enDefinition: a formal published statement about auditing

examples.en: The institute issued a statement on auditing to clarify how auditors should document management override.
examples.zh: 协会发布了一份「关于审计的说明」，明确审计师应如何记录管理层凌驾内控的情形。

examples.en: Her essay quotes the 1988 statement on auditing almost word for word.
examples.zh: 她的论文几乎逐字引用了1988年那份「关于审计的说明」。

collocations: roll forward the statement on auditing

words.enDefinition: the transfer of accounts receivable to a lender as security for a loan

examples.en: The bank approved the assignment of accounts receivable only after checking each customer's credit.
examples.zh: 银行逐一核查客户资信后，才批准这笔「应收帐款的转让」。

examples.en: Under the assignment of accounts receivable, collections still reach us but the lender holds the security interest.
examples.zh: 按这笔「应收帐款的转让」安排，回款仍先进我们账户，但贷款方持有担保权益。

collocations: accrue the assignment of accounts receivable
restate the assignment of accounts receivable
roll forward the assignment of accounts receivable

words.enDefinition: the use of statistical methods in collecting and analysing accounting data

examples.en: Statistical accounting helped the hospital compare bed-occupancy costs across its four campuses.
examples.zh: 「统计(性)会计」帮助这家医院比较了四个院区的床位占用成本。

examples.en: Instead of judging single transactions, statistical accounting looks at patterns across thousands of them.
examples.zh: 「统计(性)会计」不评判单笔业务，而是分析成千上万笔业务的整体规律。

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track asset

examples.en: Cash, inventory, and equipment all live in separate asset accounts on our chart.
examples.zh: 在我们的科目体系中，现金、存货和设备分别记在不同的「资产帐户」里。

examples.en: The trial balance refused to agree until we found a posting that hit two asset accounts at once.
examples.zh: 试算一直不平衡，直到我们发现有一笔分录同时记入了两个「资产帐户」。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track assets

examples.en: Every vehicle we buy is opened in the assets account with its invoice number attached.
examples.zh: 每购入一辆车都会在「资产帐户」里立卡，并附上发票号。

examples.en: Deposits paid for machinery sit in the assets account until the equipment actually arrives.
examples.zh: 设备预付款在机器实际到货前一直挂在「资产帐户」里。

words.enDefinition: the conclusions and issues identified in an audit

examples.en: The findings of audit flagged thirty purchase orders that were approved after the goods arrived.
examples.zh: 「审计结果」点名了三十笔货物到货后才补审批的采购订单。

examples.en: Management must respond to the findings of audit in writing within thirty days.
examples.zh: 管理层须在三十天内书面回应「审计结果」。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied in respect of assets revaluation

examples.en: Revaluing the land upward triggered an assets revaluation tax bill for the subsidiary.
examples.zh: 土地重估增值让这家子公司收到一张「资产再估价税」税单。

examples.en: The finance director deferred the assets revaluation tax because the new rules allow payment over five years.
examples.zh: 财务总监递延了「资产再估价税」，因为新规允许分五年缴纳。

words.enDefinition: a tariff whose rate varies with market or cost conditions instead of staying fixed

examples.en: Under the flexible tariff, the duty falls automatically when world prices for the commodity rise.
examples.zh: 在「弹性(伸缩)关税」下，国际大宗商品价格上涨时关税会自动下调。

examples.en: Importers prefer the flexible tariff because it cushions them against wild swings in the exchange rate.
examples.zh: 进口商更喜欢「弹性(伸缩)关税」，因为它能缓冲汇率剧烈波动的影响。

words.enDefinition: a ledger recording credit sales and customer balances

examples.en: Before we approve credit for a new customer, I check their payment history in the sold ledger.
examples.zh: 给新客户赊销前，我会先在「销售分类帐」里查它的付款记录。

examples.en: The sold ledger still shows the March invoice as unpaid, but the bank statement says otherwise.
examples.zh: 「销售分类帐」里三月的发票还挂着未收，可银行流水却显示钱已到账。

words.enDefinition: capital available for a business’s day-to-day trading operations

examples.en: Late payments from two big clients squeezed our floating capital almost to nothing.
examples.zh: 两家大客户拖延付款，把我们的「流动资本」几乎抽干了。

examples.en: A supplier credit of sixty days lets the same floating capital fund twice the volume.
examples.zh: 供应商给60天账期，同样一笔「流动资本」就能撑起两倍的生意量。

words.zhGloss: 收取应收款项的自动化
words.enDefinition: the use of automated systems to collect amounts owed by customers
acceptedZhAnswers: 收取应收款项的自动化

examples.en: The automation of collecting receivables sends a polite reminder the day after an invoice falls due.
examples.zh: 「收取应收款项的自动化」会在发票到期次日自动发出礼貌提醒。

examples.en: Since the automation of collecting receivables went live, our average collection time dropped from fifty to thirty-one days.
examples.zh: 自从上了「收取应收款项的自动化」，平均回款时间从50天缩短到31天。

words.enDefinition: keeping separate accounts for each department of a business

examples.en: Departmental accounting lets us see that the bakery counter, not the deli, funds the rent.
examples.zh: 有了「部门会计」才看清，撑起房租的是面包档口而不是熟食档。

examples.en: Each branch used its own codes, so merging the departmental accounting took the whole summer.
examples.zh: 各分店科目编码各自为政，合并「部门会计」用掉了一整个夏天。

words.enDefinition: the Australian professional body for accountants that later became CPA Australia

examples.en: My supervisor qualified with the Australian Society of Accountants back when it was still independent.
examples.zh: 我的主管考的是「澳大利亚会计师协会」资格，那时它还是独立机构。

examples.en: The society's old journals show how the Australian Society of Accountants argued for standardized reporting in the 1970s.
examples.zh: 协会旧刊记录了上世纪七十年代「澳大利亚会计师协会」推动报表标准化的历程。

collocations: prioritise the australian society of accountants
standardise the australian society of accountants
monitor the australian society of accountants

words.enDefinition: the average number of days it takes to collect receivables

examples.en: Our average age of receivable jumped to fifty-two days after the biggest customer started paying late.
examples.zh: 最大客户开始拖延后，我们的「应收帐款平均帐龄」升到了52天。

examples.en: Keep the average age of receivable under forty days or the cash-flow forecast breaks.
examples.zh: 「应收帐款平均帐龄」要控制在40天以内，否则现金流预测就会失准。

collocations: sample the average age of receivable
vouch the average age of receivable
tie out the average age of receivable

words.enDefinition: accounting kept by an organisation’s supporting or auxiliary units

examples.en: The canteen and the staff clinic run on auxiliary unit accounting separate from the main ledgers.
examples.zh: 食堂和职工诊所单独采用「附属单位会计」，与总账分开。

examples.en: Auxiliary unit accounting answers to the finance department, though the units keep their own day books.
examples.zh: 附属单位虽有各自的日记账，但「附属单位会计」最终对财务部负责。

words.enDefinition: the level of average inventory

examples.en: Our average inventory level fell after we started ordering smaller batches twice a week.
examples.zh: 改成每周两次小批量进货后，我们的「平均存货水准」降了下来。

examples.en: A rising average inventory level with flat sales is usually a warning sign, not growth.
examples.zh: 销售平平而「平均存货水准」上升，通常是警讯而不是增长。

words.enDefinition: the mean value of inventory held over a period

examples.en: Divide cost of goods sold by average inventory and you get the turnover ratio.
examples.zh: 用销货成本除以「平均存货」，就得到周转率。

examples.en: We compare average inventory at the start and end of each season to spot overbuying.
examples.zh: 我们对比每季期初期末的「平均存货」，以便发现采购过量。

words.enDefinition: accounting for social performance

examples.en: The cooperative's annual report includes social performance accounting for its training and hiring programs.
examples.zh: 这家合作社的年报包含培训与用工项目的「社会业绩(成就)会计」。

examples.en: Critics argue that social performance accounting measures intentions more reliably than actual impact.
examples.zh: 批评者认为，「社会业绩(成就)会计」量得准意图，量不准实际影响。

words.enDefinition: an audit carried out at the branch or shop-floor level

examples.en: The floor audit turned up petty cash slips that nobody had signed for three months.
examples.zh: 这次「基层审计」查出三个月的零用现金单据无人签字。

examples.en: Branch managers dread the floor audit because it counts the till while staff are serving customers.
examples.zh: 分店经理最怕「基层审计」，因为它专挑员工接待顾客时盘收银机。

words.enDefinition: a tariff system a country sets independently rather than by treaty

examples.en: Because the two countries never signed a trade treaty, each runs its own autonomous tariff system.
examples.zh: 两国从未签署贸易条约，各自实行自己的「自主关税制度」。

examples.en: Parliament can raise duties overnight under the autonomous tariff system without consulting any partner.
examples.zh: 在「自主关税制度」下，议会无须与任何伙伴磋商就能一夜之间加税。

words.enDefinition: accounting that measures an organisation’s socio-economic effects

examples.en: Socio-economic accounting tries to put a number on the factory's effect on local employment and air quality.
examples.zh: 「社会经济会计」试图把工厂对当地就业和空气质量的影响量化成数字。

examples.en: The ministry piloted socio-economic accounting across state enterprises before publishing the framework.
examples.zh: 该部委在公布框架之前，先在国有企业中试点了「社会经济会计」。

words.enDefinition: an audit of an organisation’s social and ethical performance

examples.en: The garment factory passed its social audit, but the auditor noted overtime records missing for August.
examples.zh: 这家服装厂通过了「社会审计」，但审计师指出八月的加班记录缺失。

examples.en: Buyers now require a social audit before any new supplier can ship a single carton.
examples.zh: 现在采购方要求先通过「社会审计」，新供应商才能发出哪怕一箱货。

words.enDefinition: the reporting of an organisation’s social and environmental impact

examples.en: Through social accounting, the utility reports the villages it connected as seriously as its profits.
examples.zh: 通过「社会会计」，这家电力公司像报告利润一样郑重地报告它接通的村庄数。

examples.en: Social accounting grew out of the 1970s debate about what companies owe the public.
examples.zh: 「社会会计」源于上世纪七十年代关于企业对公众负有何种责任的争论。

words.enDefinition: a document used in audit

examples.en: Bring every audit document from last year; the successor auditor wants to see the confirmations.
examples.zh: 把去年的「审计文件」都带上，接任审计师要看函证回函。

examples.en: One missing audit document forced us to redo the entire payroll testing in November.
examples.zh: 因缺一份「审计文件」，我们十一月把工资测试整个重做了一遍。

words.enDefinition: the recurring sequence of steps in an audit, from planning to reporting

examples.en: Our audit cycle starts with planning in October and ends when the report is signed in April.
examples.zh: 我们的「审计循环」从十月的计划编制开始，到次年四月签署报告为止。

examples.en: Skipping interim work compresses the whole audit cycle into six frantic weeks at year end.
examples.zh: 省掉期中工作，整个「审计循环」就压缩成年底六个焦头烂额的星期。

words.enDefinition: a board committee overseeing financial reporting, internal control, and the external audit

examples.en: The audit committee questioned why the same supplier won every contract for three years running.
examples.zh: 「审计委员会」质询为何同一家供应商连续三年中标。

examples.en: Only the audit committee, not the CFO, decides which firm signs the external audit engagement letter.
examples.zh: 由「审计委员会」而非财务总监决定聘请哪家事务所签发外部审计业务约定书。

words.enDefinition: a government body responsible for public-sector auditing

examples.en: The audit administration published its yearly report on how the disaster relief funds were actually spent.
examples.zh: 「审计署」发布了关于救灾资金实际使用情况的年度报告。

examples.en: Every ministry must answer the audit administration's findings before the budget goes back to parliament.
examples.zh: 各部委须先回应「审计署」的审计发现，预算才能重新提交议会审议。

words.enDefinition: an audit that examines selected samples of transactions instead of every item

examples.en: An audit by test-checking examines every tenth invoice, so small errors can slip through.
examples.zh: 「抽查审计」每十张发票查一张，小差错可能漏网。

examples.en: The partner defended the audit by test-checking, noting that full verification would cost more than the fee.
examples.zh: 合伙人为「抽查审计」辩护说，全面核对的成本会超过审计收费。

words.enDefinition: a customs duty charged as a fixed amount per physical unit rather than as a percentage of value

examples.en: Coffee imports pay a specific tariff of twelve cents per kilogram, whatever the market price does.
examples.zh: 咖啡进口按每公斤12美分缴纳「从量税」，与市场价格无关。

examples.en: In a price slump a specific tariff quietly becomes heavier than an ad valorem duty.
examples.zh: 价格暴跌时，「从量税」的实际税负会悄悄超过从价税。

words.enDefinition: accounting for departments

examples.en: Under departments accounting, the kitchen and the gift shop report their results separately.
examples.zh: 在「部门会计」下，厨房和礼品店各自单独核算业绩。

examples.en: New hires spend their first week learning the departments accounting codes for every cost centre.
examples.zh: 新员工第一周要学的是各部门成本中心的「部门会计」编码。

words.enDefinition: describing something as informal in business contexts

examples.en: The dress code here is informal, so jeans are fine for client calls.
examples.zh: 这里的着装规范很「非正式」，见客户穿牛仔裤也没问题。

examples.en: Their agreement stayed informal until the first big order forced paperwork.
examples.zh: 他们的合作一直是「非正式的」，直到第一笔大单逼出了正式文件。

words.enDefinition: the public marketplace where shares and related securities are traded

examples.en: The whole stock market slid two percent after the inflation surprise.
examples.zh: 通胀数据爆冷，「证券市场」整体下挫2%。

examples.en: Her grandmother followed the stock market on paper quotes clipped from the evening paper.
examples.zh: 她祖母靠晚报上剪下来的行情，追了半辈子「证券市场」。

words.enDefinition: to continue firmly despite difficulty or opposition

examples.en: She persisted with the supplier even after two rejected prototypes.
examples.zh: 即使两版样品都被否决，她仍「坚持」与那家供应商合作。

examples.en: If the noise persists, maintenance will move us to another office.
examples.zh: 如果噪音「持续」存在，维修部会给我们换一间办公室。

words.zhGloss: 从事筹措长期资本的银行
words.enDefinition: a bank that provides financing for a transaction
acceptedZhAnswers: 从事筹措长期资本的银行

examples.en: The syndicate's financing bank arranged a fifteen-year facility for the toll road.
examples.zh: 牵头的「融资银行」为收费公路安排了15年期贷款。

examples.en: Power plants choose a financing bank that understands construction risk, not just deposits.
examples.zh: 电厂挑「融资银行」，看重的是懂建设风险，而不是会拉存款。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with regulated investment

examples.en: A regulated investment company passes its income through and skips entity-level tax.
examples.zh: 「受监管投资公司」将收益直接分配给持有人，公司层面免税。

examples.en: Funds reorganize as a regulated investment company to keep their favorable tax status.
examples.zh: 为了保住优惠税务地位，基金纷纷改组为「受监管投资公司」。

collocations: open an account at the regulated investment company
deal with the regulated investment company

words.enDefinition: bonds backed by the issuer’s general credit rather than specific collateral

examples.en: Debenture bonds pay half a point more because no collateral backs them.
examples.zh: 「无抵押公司债券」利率高半个点，因为背后没有任何抵押品。

examples.en: When the retailer wobbled, its debenture bonds slid ten points overnight.
examples.zh: 零售商传出风波，「无抵押公司债券」一夜跌了10个点。

words.enDefinition: the regular reports and statistical statements a bank submits to its supervisory authority

examples.en: Supervisors study the bank returns each quarter for early signs of stress.
examples.zh: 监管机构每季度研读「银行营业报告」，寻找风险的早期信号。

examples.en: The press leaked the bank returns before the official release.
examples.zh: 「银行营业报告」还没正式公布，内容就先被媒体泄露了。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of bank

examples.en: The bank commission on the standby letter of credit runs one percent a year.
examples.zh: 备用信用证的「银行佣金」按年收1%。

examples.en: Negotiate the bank commission before signing; it compounds with every renewal.
examples.zh: 签约前先把「银行佣金」谈好，每次续期它都会叠加。

words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)

examples.en: The exporter refuses to ship without a confirmed banker's credit in hand.
examples.zh: 拿不到保兑的「银行信用证」，出口商绝不发货。

examples.en: Discrepancies in the documents can invalidate even a solid banker's credit.
examples.zh: 单据哪怕有一处不符，再可靠的「银行信用证」也可能失效。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for dividend equalization

examples.en: The insurer feeds a dividend equalization fund in fat years to smooth thin ones.
examples.zh: 保险公司丰年往「股利均衡基金」里存钱，以平滑歉年。

examples.en: Policyholder payouts stayed level because the dividend equalization fund absorbed the shock.
examples.zh: 保单分红保持平稳，靠的正是「股利均衡基金」吸收波动。

words.enDefinition: the investor's share of an investee's profit recognized under the equity method

examples.en: Equity earnings from the supermarket stake flow in at one fifth of its profit.
examples.zh: 持有超市股权，每年按其利润五分之一确认「权益收益」。

examples.en: Equity earnings lifted group profit even though the associate itself paid no dividends.
examples.zh: 联营公司虽未分红，「权益收益」照样增厚了集团利润。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with equity

examples.en: Raising equity capital avoids interest bills but hands the founders a smaller slice.
examples.zh: 融「权益资本」免去利息负担，但创始人分到的蛋糕也变小了。

examples.en: Returns must clear the cost of equity capital or shareholders are being shortchanged.
examples.zh: 回报若跑不赢「权益资本」的成本，股东就是在被亏待。

words.zhGloss: 政府债券收益与普通股票收益的差额
words.enDefinition: the difference between yields on government bonds and equities
acceptedZhAnswers: 政府债券收益与普通股票收益的差额

examples.en: The yield gap between gilts and shares narrowed as dividend payouts soared.
examples.zh: 股息激增，「政府债券收益与普通股票收益的差额」随之收窄。

examples.en: Value investors watch the yield gap as a gauge of how cheap shares truly are.
examples.zh: 价值投资者用「政府债券收益与普通股票收益的差额」衡量股价究竟便宜与否。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for working capital

examples.en: Revolving sales receipts keep the working capital fund topped up through the season.
examples.zh: 销售回款滚动进来，「营运用基金」整个旺季都保持充足。

examples.en: The school district created a working capital fund to bridge the tax receipt gap.
examples.zh: 学区设立「营运用基金」，以填补税收到账前的空档。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with active

examples.en: Idle deposits do nothing; only active capital actually turns into sales.
examples.zh: 闲置存款毫无用处，真正转化为销售的只有「活动资本」。

examples.en: The factory owner shifted reserves into active capital to buy a second press.
examples.zh: 厂主把储备转成「活动资本」，添置了第二台冲床。

words.zhGloss: 附属公司(子公司)库存股票交易
words.enDefinition: transactions involving subsidiary treasury stock
acceptedZhAnswers: 附属公司(子公司)库存股票交易

examples.en: Consolidation nets out subsidiary treasury stock transactions so nothing is counted twice.
examples.zh: 合并报表会抵销「附属公司（子公司）库存股票交易」，避免重复计算。

examples.en: Regulators scrutinize subsidiary treasury stock transactions that mask a shrinking group equity base.
examples.zh: 监管层严查掩盖集团权益萎缩的「附属公司（子公司）库存股票交易」。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning trade

examples.en: Thirty days of trade credit from suppliers is the cheapest financing most shops ever get.
examples.zh: 供应商给的30天「商业信用」，是小店主能拿到的最便宜融资。

examples.en: Late-paying customers quietly destroy the trade credit that keeps the whole supply chain moving.
examples.zh: 拖欠账款的客户，正在悄悄毁掉维系整条供应链的「商业信用」。

words.enDefinition: long-term government debt securities issued by a national treasury

examples.en: Grandpa clipped coupons off his treasury bonds every January for forty years.
examples.zh: 爷爷每年一月剪「财政长期债券」的息票，整整四十年。

examples.en: When stocks cratered, money flooded into treasury bonds and pushed yields to record lows.
examples.zh: 股市崩盘时资金涌入「财政长期债券」，收益率被压到历史低点。

words.enDefinition: a letter of credit available to an exporter under an export sale

examples.en: The agency's export credit covers eighty-five percent of the machinery shipment value.
examples.zh: 出口信贷机构为这批机械提供货值85%的「出口信贷」。

examples.en: Rival exporters competed on longer export credit terms rather than lower prices.
examples.zh: 各出口商不拼价格，转而比拼更长的「出口信贷」账期。

words.enDefinition: a promise to cover obligations related to export credit

examples.en: An export credit guarantee lets the supplier ship to the politically risky market.
examples.zh: 有了「出口信用保险」，供应商才敢向政局不稳的市场发货。

examples.en: Claims on the export credit guarantee jumped after the buyer's country froze payments.
examples.zh: 买方所在国冻结付款后，「出口信用保险」的索赔量激增。

words.enDefinition: money received from net investment

examples.en: Net investment income of four million funded the scholarship without touching the endowment.
examples.zh: 400万的「投资净收益」撑起了奖学金，本金分文未动。

examples.en: Fees and taxes cut gross returns, so net investment income is what actually counts.
examples.zh: 费用和税收侵蚀毛收益，真正算数的是「投资净收益」。

words.enDefinition: the bank that issues a letter of credit or similar instrument

examples.en: The issuing bank pays against documents, never against the goods themselves.
examples.zh: 「信用状开证银行」只凭单据付款，从不看货物本身。

examples.en: If documents comply, the issuing bank must pay even if the buyer defaults.
examples.zh: 只要单证相符，哪怕买方违约，「信用状开证银行」也必须付款。

collocations: open an account at the issuing bank

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for consolidated working

examples.en: The merged councils pooled everything into one consolidated working fund.
examples.zh: 合并后的几个议会把资金归入同一个「合并营业基金」。

examples.en: Interest earned inside the consolidated working fund offsets next year's levies.
examples.zh: 「合并营业基金」里产生的利息，可以抵减来年税额。

words.enDefinition: a venture involving joint equity

examples.en: The chip plant is a joint equity venture between two governments and three firms.
examples.zh: 这家芯片厂是两国政府与三家企业组成的「合股经营企业」。

examples.en: Profits from the joint equity venture split according to the signed shareholding schedule.
examples.zh: 「合股经营企业」的利润按签署的持股表分配。

words.enDefinition: a charge payable for management

examples.en: The fund's two percent management fee eats twenty thousand a year on a million-dollar balance.
examples.zh: 按2%的「管理费」，百万元账户一年就要被吃掉2万。

examples.en: Investors now demand performance fees instead of a fat flat management fee.
examples.zh: 投资者如今要求按业绩收费，不再接受高额固定「管理费」。

words.enDefinition: an investment on which payment is in default

examples.en: The prospectus admitted the fund held investment in default bonds from three issuers.
examples.zh: 招募说明书承认，基金持有三家发行人的「投资信用较差的债券」。

examples.en: Auditors forced the bank to write its investment in default down to zero.
examples.zh: 审计师要求银行把「投资信用较差的债券」减记到零。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for investment

examples.en: The village's investment fund buys equipment for local farms and rents it back cheaply.
examples.zh: 村里的「投资基金」购置农机，再以低价租给本地农户。

examples.en: Regulators froze the investment fund after it promised impossible monthly returns.
examples.zh: 该「投资基金」许诺高得离谱的月收益，被监管冻结。

words.zhGloss: 场外交易市场或经营未上市股票的市场
words.enDefinition: a market for outside
acceptedZhAnswers: 场外交易市场或经营未上市股票的市场

examples.en: Unlisted shares change hands on the outside market, far from any exchange screen.
examples.zh: 未上市股票在场外易手，远离任何交易所屏幕——这就是「场外交易市场」。

examples.en: Prices on the outside market are negotiated by phone, not posted anywhere.
examples.zh: 「场外交易市场」的价格靠电话谈出来，别处查不到挂牌价。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for capital improvement

examples.en: The town set a capital improvement budget of two million for roof and boiler repairs.
examples.zh: 小镇为屋顶与锅炉维修编制了200万的「资本改良预算」。

examples.en: Voters approved the capital improvement budget but rejected the new sports hall.
examples.zh: 选民通过了「资本改良预算」，却否决了新体育馆。

words.enDefinition: output produced per unit of capital

examples.en: Second shifts doubled output without new machines, a masterclass in capital productivity.
examples.zh: 不添新设备就靠两班倒产量翻倍，堪称「资本的生产能力」教科书。

examples.en: Consultants measured capital productivity as output per machine, per shift, per dollar.
examples.zh: 顾问按每台设备、每个班次、每元钱来测算「资本的生产能力」。

words.enDefinition: the cost of capitalized

examples.en: Freight and installation join the machine's capitalized cost, not this month's expenses.
examples.zh: 运费和安装费一并计入设备的「资本化成本」，而非计入本月费用。

examples.en: The capitalized cost of the platform includes three years of development wages.
examples.zh: 平台的「资本化成本」包含三年的开发工资。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for capitalized

examples.en: The capitalized expense sits on the balance sheet and depreciates over five years.
examples.zh: 这笔「资本化的费用」留在资产负债表上，按五年折旧。

examples.en: Auditors reclassified the rushed capitalized expense back into operating costs.
examples.zh: 审计师把仓促确认的「资本化的费用」调回运营成本。

words.enDefinition: capitalistic production; a manufacturing method or production measure

examples.en: Textbooks define capitalistic production by wage labor combined with privately owned machinery.
examples.zh: 教科书把「资本主义生产」定义为雇佣劳动加上私有机器设备。

examples.en: The documentary contrasts village crafts with capitalistic production on an assembly line.
examples.zh: 纪录片把乡村手艺与流水线上的「资本主义生产」放在一起对比。

words.enDefinition: the cost of capital employed

examples.en: Every bid we submit must clear our capital cost of nine percent.
examples.zh: 我们提交的每个报价，都必须跑赢9%的「资本成本」。

examples.en: Older turbines carry lower capital cost because the debt is nearly repaid.
examples.zh: 老机组「资本成本」更低，因为贷款几乎还清了。

words.enDefinition: a bank that provides retail and commercial banking services

examples.en: A commercial bank earns its keep on the spread between deposits and loans.
examples.zh: 「商业银行」靠存款与贷款之间的利差吃饭。

examples.en: When the commercial bank refused the loan, the credit union stepped in.
examples.zh: 「商业银行」拒贷之后，信用社接下了这单生意。

words.enDefinition: the bank acceptance rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: The bank acceptance rate on trade paper eased after the central bank cut.
examples.zh: 央行降息后，商业票据的「银行承兑利率」随之回落。

examples.en: Importers compare the bank acceptance rate with straight borrowing before choosing either.
examples.zh: 进口商会先比较「银行承兑利率」与直接借款的成本，再作选择。

words.enDefinition: an annuity linked to bank

examples.en: The bank annuity pays a fixed sum on the fifth of every month.
examples.zh: 这份「银行年金」每月五号固定到账一笔。

examples.en: Retirees moved savings into a bank annuity when market yields collapsed.
examples.zh: 市场收益崩塌后，退休族把积蓄转成了「银行年金」。

words.enDefinition: financing arranged for foreign-trade

examples.en: Foreign-trade financing covered the shipper's costs from the dock to the buyer's warehouse.
examples.zh: 「外贸融资」覆盖了从码头到买方仓库的全部费用。

examples.en: Banks price foreign-trade financing against the letter of credit's tenor.
examples.zh: 银行按信用证期限来为「外贸融资」定价。

words.enDefinition: broking for stock

examples.en: Her aunt spent thirty years in stock broking before the terminals went digital.
examples.zh: 姑姑做了三十年「股票经纪」，直到交易终端全面数字化。

examples.en: Stock broking commissions collapsed once discount apps arrived on phones.
examples.zh: 手机上的折扣交易应用一出现，「股票经纪」的佣金应声崩塌。

words.enDefinition: a quotation for stock market

examples.en: Dad checks the stock market quotation over breakfast like other people read sports.
examples.zh: 爸爸早餐时看「股票市场行情」，就像别人看体育新闻。

examples.en: The old ticker printed the stock market quotation letter by letter.
examples.zh: 老式行情机一个字母一个字母地打出「股票市场行情」。

words.enDefinition: a sale of stock

examples.en: Proceeds from the stock sale covered the entire down payment on the flat.
examples.zh: 「股票销售」所得正好付清了公寓的首付。

examples.en: The founder staggered each stock sale so the market barely noticed.
examples.zh: 创始人把每笔「股票销售」拉开时间，市场几乎毫无察觉。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with authorized

examples.en: The charter sets authorized capital at five million, though only half is issued.
examples.zh: 章程规定「额定资本」为500万，实际只发行了一半。

examples.en: Directors must seek shareholder approval before exceeding the authorized capital ceiling.
examples.zh: 超出「额定资本」上限之前，董事必须先征求股东批准。

words.zhGloss: 投资有价证券的价格变动
words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to fluctuations in investment
acceptedZhAnswers: 投资有价证券的价格变动

examples.en: The bank books fluctuations in investment securities straight to a special reserve.
examples.zh: 银行把「投资有价证券的价格变动」直接计入专门准备。

examples.en: Quarterly reports disclose fluctuations in investment securities alongside the fair-value table.
examples.zh: 季报在公允价值表旁披露「投资有价证券的价格变动」。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for retirement

examples.en: Nina's retirement fund survived two crashes because she never sold in a panic.
examples.zh: 妮娜的「退休基金」扛过了两次崩盘，因为她从不恐慌抛售。

examples.en: Contributions to the retirement fund stop the month you turn seventy.
examples.zh: 年满七十的当月，「退休基金」的缴存就停止了。

words.enDefinition: financing arranged for risk in project

examples.en: Lenders price the risk in project financing higher for unproven technology.
examples.zh: 技术未经验证时，放贷方会给「项目贷款的风险」加价。

examples.en: Four banks shared the risk in project financing for the new tunnel.
examples.zh: 新隧道的「项目贷款的风险」由四家银行分摊。

words.zhGloss: 托收银行(出口人指定的银行)
words.enDefinition: the bank that remits documents or funds in a collection
acceptedZhAnswers: 托收银行(出口人指定的银行)

examples.en: The exporter hands documents to the remitting bank, which forwards them abroad.
examples.zh: 出口商把单据交给「托收银行」，由其转寄国外。

examples.en: Choose a remitting bank with a strong correspondent in the buyer's country.
examples.zh: 挑「托收银行」时，要看它在买方国家有没有得力的代理行。

collocations: open an account at the remitting bank

words.enDefinition: a renewal bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: The council issued a renewal bond to retire the maturing library debt.
examples.zh: 议会发行「更新债券」，用来偿还到期的图书馆债务。

examples.en: Investors accepted the renewal bond because the rate stepped down one point.
examples.zh: 「更新债券」利率还低了一个点，投资者欣然接受。

words.enDefinition: a bond registered in the owner’s name rather than payable to bearer

examples.en: A registered bond names its owner, so a stolen certificate is worthless.
examples.zh: 「记名债券」登记持有人姓名，证书被偷也一文不值。

examples.en: Interest on the registered bond mails directly to the owner of record.
examples.zh: 「记名债券」的利息直接寄给登记在册的持有人。

words.enDefinition: money received from bond interest

examples.en: Bond interest income kept the family trust afloat through the flat decade.
examples.zh: 市场横盘的十年里，全靠「债券利息收益」养着家族信托。

examples.en: The form asks for bond interest income separately from dividends.
examples.zh: 申报表要求把「债券利息收益」与股息分开填报。

words.zhGloss: 债券(公司债)折价及发行费用
words.enDefinition: bond discount and expenses used in professional practice
acceptedZhAnswers: 债券(公司债)折价及发行费用

examples.en: The prospectus itemizes bond discount and expenses before stating the net proceeds.
examples.zh: 募集说明书先列明「债券折价及发行费用」，再给出净筹资额。

examples.en: Bond discount and expenses together trimmed the million-dollar issue to 940,000 received.
examples.zh: 「债券折价及发行费用」合计后，100万的发行实际到账94万。

words.enDefinition: a cost incurred for bond interest

examples.en: Bond interest expense swallowed a third of operating profit last year.
examples.zh: 去年「公司债利息费用」吞掉了三分之一的营业利润。

examples.en: Refinancing trimmed bond interest expense by four hundred thousand a year.
examples.zh: 借新还旧后，「公司债利息费用」每年省下40万。

words.enDefinition: a fee or commission paid in respect of reinsurance

examples.en: The ceding company keeps a reinsurance commission to cover its acquisition costs.
examples.zh: 分出公司保留「再保险佣金」，用来覆盖展业成本。

examples.en: A higher reinsurance commission tempted the insurer to cede more of the book.
examples.zh: 更高的「再保险佣金」诱使保险公司分出更多业务。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with debenture

examples.en: Debenture capital funded the fleet, leaving the family's shares untouched.
examples.zh: 船队靠「债券资本」购置，家族股份分毫未动。

examples.en: Rating agencies frown when debenture capital crowds out true equity.
examples.zh: 「债券资本」挤占真正的权益时，评级机构会皱眉。

words.zhGloss: 无抵押(信用担保)收益债券
words.enDefinition: a surety or insurance bond covering obligations or risks related to debenture income
acceptedZhAnswers: 无抵押(信用担保)收益债券

examples.en: The utility floated a debenture income bond that pays only when revenue allows.
examples.zh: 这家公用事业公司发行「无抵押（信用担保）收益债券」，只有收入允许时才付息。

examples.en: Debenture income bond holders accepted the contingency for a higher coupon.
examples.zh: 「无抵押（信用担保）收益债券」的持有人接受这种不确定，换取更高票息。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with security

examples.en: The lender's security capital sits in pledged bonds rather than cash.
examples.zh: 这家放贷机构的「抵押证券资本」是质押债券，而非现金。

examples.en: When collateral prices dip, security capital erodes faster than anyone plans for.
examples.zh: 抵押品价格一下跌，「抵押证券资本」的侵蚀速度超出所有人的预案。

words.enDefinition: a security income and expense used in professional practice

examples.en: The fund statement separates security income and expense on facing pages.
examples.zh: 基金报表把「证券收益及费用」分列在对开的两页上。

examples.en: Trustees questioned whether security income and expense should be netted or shown gross.
examples.zh: 受托人追问，「证券收益及费用」该轧差列示还是按总额披露。

words.enDefinition: rates applied to free market exchange

examples.en: Money changers on the street corner quote free market exchange rates all day.
examples.zh: 街角的换钱摊整天挂着「自由市场汇率」。

examples.en: Economists compare official pegs against free market exchange rates to gauge real pressure.
examples.zh: 经济学家用官方钉住汇率对比「自由市场汇率」，判断真实的贬值压力。

collocations: calculate the free market exchange rates
compare the free market exchange rates
reduce the free market exchange rates

words.enDefinition: financing arranged for bank

examples.en: The wind farm closed bank financing at six percent after two years of talks.
examples.zh: 谈了两年，风电场终于以6%的利率敲定「银行融资」。

examples.en: When bank financing dried up, the founders maxed out personal credit cards.
examples.zh: 「银行融资」断供后，创始人把个人信用卡刷到了极限。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to bank

examples.en: Dividend hunters bought bank stock after the payout was reinstated.
examples.zh: 分红恢复后，追求股息的投资者买入了「银行股票」。

examples.en: Regulators cap how much bank stock any single shareholder may hold.
examples.zh: 监管限制单一股东持有「银行股票」的比例上限。

words.enDefinition: the interest rate at which a central bank lends to commercial banks (or an official discount rate)

examples.en: The bank rate rose half a point, and mortgage offers vanished within days.
examples.zh: 「银行贴现率」上调半个百分点，房贷优惠几天内就消失了。

examples.en: Newspapers once printed the bank rate beside the weather, it moved so rarely.
examples.zh: 从前「银行贴现率」难得一动，报纸都把它排在天气预报旁边。

words.enDefinition: the benchmark interest rate banks charge their most creditworthy borrowers

examples.en: Small firms watch the bank prime rate because their credit lines float above it.
examples.zh: 小企业紧盯「最优惠贷款利率」，因为自己的授信额度是在它基础上上浮的。

examples.en: Every credit card contract pegs its variable APR to the bank prime rate.
examples.zh: 信用卡合同的浮动APR都钉在「最优惠贷款利率」上。

words.enDefinition: a bank authorised to issue banknotes

examples.en: Hong Kong's bank of issue prints its own banknotes under license.
examples.zh: 香港的「发钞银行」凭授权自行印制钞票。

examples.en: Collectors prize notes signed by a retired bank of issue from the 1920s.
examples.zh: 收藏者珍视1920年代已停业的「发钞银行」签发的纸币。

collocations: bank with the bank of issue
open an account at the bank of issue
deal with the bank of issue

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning bank

examples.en: Tight bank credit after the crisis pushed builders toward private lenders.
examples.zh: 危机后「银行信贷」收紧，建筑商转向了民间放贷人。

examples.en: Expanding bank credit lifts house prices until the rate cycle turns.
examples.zh: 「银行信贷」扩张会推高房价，直到利率周期转向。

words.enDefinition: debits charged to bank accounts

examples.en: Bank debits jumped the week the payroll cleared twice by mistake.
examples.zh: 工资误发两次的那一周，「银行借项」猛增。

examples.en: Statement lines list the bank debits with their reference numbers.
examples.zh: 对账单逐行列出各笔「银行借项」及其摘要号。

words.enDefinition: funds deposited with banks

examples.en: Bank deposits doubled at the rural branch once the factory opened.
examples.zh: 工厂开业后，乡村网点的「银行存款」翻了一倍。

examples.en: Deposit insurance reassures customers, so bank deposits rarely flee in small panics.
examples.zh: 有了存款保险，小风浪中「银行存款」很少外逃。

words.enDefinition: the insolvency of a bank

examples.en: Rumors of bank insolvency emptied three branch offices before noon.
examples.zh: 「银行无力偿债」的传闻让三家网点不到中午就被取空。

examples.en: The deposit fund stepped in at the first sign of bank insolvency.
examples.zh: 一有「银行无力偿债」的苗头，存款保险基金就会介入。

words.enDefinition: the bank's selling rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: Always compare the bank's selling rate with the mid-market rate before exchanging.
examples.zh: 换汇前，务必把「银行卖价」与市场中间价比一比。

examples.en: The bank's selling rate for euros includes a three percent margin.
examples.zh: 欧元的「银行卖价」里含了3%的价差。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning banker's acceptance

examples.en: The importer settled the grain purchase through a banker's acceptance credit.
examples.zh: 进口商通过「银行承兑的信贷」结算了这批粮食货款。

examples.en: A banker's acceptance credit lets the seller bank discount the paper early.
examples.zh: 有了「银行承兑的信贷」，卖方银行可以提前贴现票据。

words.enDefinition: a bank’s conditional undertaking to pay a beneficiary when stipulated documents are presented (letter of credit)

examples.en: The deal closed only once the banker's commercial credit was issued.
examples.zh: 直到「银行商业信用证」开出，这笔交易才正式落定。

examples.en: Mismatched shipping papers can void the protection of a banker's commercial credit.
examples.zh: 装运单据对不上，「银行商业信用证」的保障就作废了。

words.enDefinition: the banker's rate used for pricing, costing, or charging

examples.en: Ask for the banker's rate before accepting the airport kiosk quote.
examples.zh: 接受机场柜台的报价之前，先问问「银行汇价」。

examples.en: The banker's rate on yen transfers improved after the merger.
examples.zh: 并购之后，日元汇款的「银行汇价」变好了。

words.enDefinition: a business activity or transaction carried out by a bank

examples.en: Each banking operation, from deposits to settlement, runs through the core system.
examples.zh: 从存款到清算，每一项「银行业务」都跑在核心系统上。

examples.en: Opening abroad means licensing every banking operation separately in each country.
examples.zh: 到海外开业，每项「银行业务」都要在各国单独拿牌照。

words.enDefinition: an amount set aside for funded

examples.en: The board topped up the funded reserve before approving the special dividend.
examples.zh: 批准特别股息之前，董事会先把「提存准备」补足。

examples.en: Auditors confirmed the funded reserve sits in real assets, not promises.
examples.zh: 审计师确认「提存准备」背后是真金白银的资产，不是空头承诺。

words.zhGloss: 以新的债券支付利息而不以现金支付
words.enDefinition: a charge or stake related to funded debenture
acceptedZhAnswers: 以新的债券支付利息而不以现金支付

examples.en: The railroad chose funded debenture interest, rolling coupons into new bonds instead of cash.
examples.zh: 铁路把票息滚入新债，采用「以新的债券支付利息而不以现金支付」来周转。

examples.en: Creditors accepted funded debenture interest once the court approved the reorganization.
examples.zh: 法院批准重组方案后，债权人接受了「以新的债券支付利息而不以现金支付」的安排。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to sales of investment

examples.en: Sales of investment securities funded the bridge loan without touching deposits.
examples.zh: 靠「投资证券的销售」筹到了过桥贷款，存款分文未动。

examples.en: Quarterly statements disclose sales of investment securities with realized gains.
examples.zh: 季报披露「投资证券的销售」及其已实现收益。

words.enDefinition: safe-deposit custody of valuables, typically in a bank vault

examples.en: Grandma keeps the deed and her rings under safe deposit at the branch.
examples.zh: 祖母把地契和戒指都放在网点的「保险箱保管」里。

examples.en: Safe deposit boxes require two keys: yours and the bank's.
examples.zh: 「保险箱保管」需要两把钥匙同时转动：你的和银行的。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the unlisted type

examples.en: The parish financed its hall through unlisted bonds sold only to parishioners.
examples.zh: 教区通过只卖给信众的「未上证券市场的债券」筹资建堂。

examples.en: Unlisted bonds trade by phone among a handful of dealers.
examples.zh: 「未上证券市场的债券」只在少数交易商之间电话询价成交。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with dividend paying

examples.en: Investors screen for a dividend paying company with debt below two times earnings.
examples.zh: 投资者筛选「股利支付公司」，还要求负债不超过盈利的两倍。

examples.en: A dividend paying company rarely burns cash on reckless acquisitions.
examples.zh: 「股利支付公司」一般不会把现金烧在鲁莽的收购上。

collocations: open an account at the dividend paying company
deal with the dividend paying company

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to dividend

examples.en: Telecom shares remain the classic dividend stock for income-hungry retirees.
examples.zh: 电信股一直是收息退休族眼中经典的「股利股份」。

examples.en: Cutting the payout turned the market's favorite dividend stock into a warning tale.
examples.zh: 削减分红后，市场最爱的「股利股份」成了警世故事。

words.enDefinition: money available or allocated for additional

examples.en: The board approved additional funds for the recall before year-end.
examples.zh: 董事会在年底前批准了召回行动的「追加资金」。

examples.en: Rain damage forced the parish to request additional funds from the diocese.
examples.zh: 雨灾之后，教区不得不向主教区申请「追加资金」。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with additional paid-in

examples.en: The funding round added thirty million to additional paid-in capital.
examples.zh: 本轮融资给「附加资本」科目增加了3000万。

examples.en: Additional paid-in capital grows when investors pay above the par value of shares.
examples.zh: 投资者以超面值价格入股时，「附加资本」就会增加。

words.enDefinition: a charge payable for agent bank

examples.en: The syndicate split a one percent agent bank fee among the lenders.
examples.zh: 银团把1%的「代理银行费用」在成员行之间分摊。

examples.en: Borrowers negotiated the agent bank fee down to a flat fifty thousand.
examples.zh: 借款人把「代理银行费用」谈到固定5万的包干价。

words.enDefinition: financial gain arising from underwriting

examples.en: The IPO priced badly, so the syndicate's underwriting profit nearly vanished.
examples.zh: IPO定价失手，银团的「包销证券利润」几乎归零。

examples.en: In the bubble years, underwriting profit on new issues outearned all trading desks.
examples.zh: 泡沫年代，新股「包销证券利润」超过了所有交易台的进账。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to undigested

examples.en: The syndicate still holds undigested securities from the botched winter offering.
examples.zh: 冬季那次发行搞砸了，银团手里还压着「未售出的证券」。

examples.en: Undigested securities weigh on the price until the underwriters quietly place them.
examples.zh: 「未售出的证券」会压制股价，直到承销商悄悄消化完。

words.enDefinition: a distribution of profits related to equalizing

examples.en: The board paid an equalizing dividend to top up the lean previous year.
examples.zh: 董事会派发「调剂历年股利」，把上一年的歉收补齐。

examples.en: Most shareholders noticed the equalizing dividend only deep in the footnotes.
examples.zh: 多数股东只在报表附注深处才注意到「调剂历年股利」。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to active

examples.en: Market makers only quote active securities where spreads stay razor thin.
examples.zh: 做市商只为「交易活跃的证券」报价，那里的价差薄如刀片。

examples.en: Illiquid bonds behave nothing like active securities during a rout.
examples.zh: 大跌时，冷门债券的表现与「交易活跃的证券」完全两样。

words.enDefinition: a market for active

examples.en: Fair value needs an active market; without one, models take over.
examples.zh: 公允价值需要「活跃市场」，否则就只能靠模型说话。

examples.en: The sell-off proved which positions had an active market behind them.
examples.zh: 这轮抛售检验出了哪些头寸背后真有「活跃市场」。

collocations: clear goods through the active market

words.enDefinition: a market for easiness of money

examples.en: Traders enjoyed the easiness of money market conditions, borrowing nearly for nothing.
examples.zh: 交易员享受着「市场利率低」的宽松日子，借钱几乎不要成本。

examples.en: The easiness of money market conditions ended the day the central bank blinked.
examples.zh: 央行一出手，「市场利率低」的宽松日子就到头了。

collocations: secure the easiness of money market
visit the easiness of money market
lease the easiness of money market

words.enDefinition: capital associated with subscribed

examples.en: The founders' subscribed capital of two hundred thousand anchors the new company.
examples.zh: 创始人「认缴资本」20万，构成新公司的底座。

examples.en: Subscribed capital converts to paid-in capital as each installment actually arrives.
examples.zh: 每一笔实缴到账，「认缴资本」就转成实收资本。

words.zhGloss: 附属公司(子公司)的股利
words.enDefinition: distributions of profits related to subsidiary stock
acceptedZhAnswers: 附属公司(子公司)的股利

examples.en: The parent waits for subsidiary stock dividends before planning group payouts.
examples.zh: 母公司先看「附属公司（子公司）的股利」，再规划集团分红。

examples.en: Consolidation eliminates subsidiary stock dividends to avoid double-counting group profit.
examples.zh: 合并报表抵销「附属公司（子公司）的股利」，避免集团利润重复计算。

words.enDefinition: tradable financial instruments related to substituted

examples.en: Collateral swaps release substituted securities into the pool every quarter.
examples.zh: 每季度质押置换后，「代替证券」就会进入抵押池。

examples.en: Trustees must approve substituted securities before the old collateral is released.
examples.zh: 旧抵押品放行之前，「代替证券」必须先经受托人批准。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for exchange stabilization

examples.en: The exchange stabilization fund stepped in when the peso slid past seven.
examples.zh: 比索跌破7之后，「外汇平准基金」出手了。

examples.en: Reserves for the exchange stabilization fund shrank for a third straight month.
examples.zh: 「外汇平准基金」的储备连续第三个月缩水。

words.enDefinition: dealers exempted from a regulatory requirement
acceptedZhAnswers: 可为自己买卖证券的商人

examples.en: Exempted dealers may trade for their own account without a full license.
examples.zh: 「豁免交易商」可以为自己的账户买卖证券，无需完整牌照。

examples.en: Regulators tightened reporting duties on exempted dealers after the flash rally.
examples.zh: 闪电式反弹之后，监管收紧了对「豁免交易商」的报告要求。

words.enDefinition: a hazard or risk arising in trade

examples.en: Piracy remains the classic trade hazard on the gulf route.
examples.zh: 海湾航线上，海盗仍是最典型的「贸易风险」。

examples.en: The contract assigns every trade hazard to the buyer once goods cross the ship's rail.
examples.zh: 合同约定，货物一旦越过船舷，「贸易风险」全部转移给买方。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from extensive

examples.en: Extensive investment spread the group across ten provinces before discipline returned.
examples.zh: 纪律回归之前，集团的「外延投资」铺到了十个省。

examples.en: Analysts now prefer intensive gains over extensive investment in new acreage.
examples.zh: 分析师如今更看重集约化收益，而非新垦土地上的「外延投资」。

words.enDefinition: bonds (debt securities) of the annuity type

examples.en: Annuity bonds repay a little of everything—principal and interest—in equal installments.
examples.zh: 「年金债券」本息合在一起，按相等的分期逐年偿还。

examples.en: Housing agencies financed estates with annuity bonds repayable over thirty years.
examples.zh: 住房机构以三十年期的「年金债券」为楼盘融资。

words.enDefinition: a binding agreement concerning insurance

examples.en: Read the exclusions page of the insurance contract before the flood season.
examples.zh: 汛期来临前，先读一读「保险契约」的免责条款页。

examples.en: The insurer denied the claim citing a clause buried in the insurance contract.
examples.zh: 保险公司引用「保险契约」深处的一条条款，拒绝了赔付。

words.zhGloss: 保险业者向股票的投资
words.enDefinition: a unit of ownership related to insurance
acceptedZhAnswers: 保险业者向股票的投资

examples.en: The regulator tracks the insurance share of listed equities each quarter.
examples.zh: 监管机构每季度跟踪「保险业者向股票的投资」情况。

examples.en: After the crash, insurers trimmed their insurance share to protect solvency margins.
examples.zh: 股灾之后，保险公司压缩「保险业者向股票的投资」，以保住偿付能力。

words.zhGloss: 在联邦存款保险公司投保的银行
words.enDefinition: banks whose deposits are protected by deposit insurance
acceptedZhAnswers: 在联邦存款保险公司投保的银行

examples.en: Insured banks display the FDIC decal beside every teller window.
examples.zh: 「在联邦存款保险公司投保的银行」在每个柜员窗口旁都贴着FDIC标识。

examples.en: Depositors moved balances to insured banks the week rumors spread.
examples.zh: 传闻一起，储户当周就把余额搬进了「在联邦存款保险公司投保的银行」。

words.enDefinition: loans related to international syndicated bank

examples.en: The refinery closed international syndicated bank loans from twelve lenders across three continents.
examples.zh: 炼油厂拿到了横跨三大洲、12家银行组成的「国际银团贷款」。

examples.en: International syndicated bank loans share documentation standards set in London and New York.
examples.zh: 「国际银团贷款」沿用伦敦和纽约确立的统一文本标准。

collocations: arrange the international syndicated bank loans
monitor the international syndicated bank loans
repay the international syndicated bank loans

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to commercial loan

examples.en: Our commercial loan rate floats at three points over the benchmark.
examples.zh: 我们的「商业贷款利率」按基准利率上浮3个点。

examples.en: The commercial loan rate for retailers climbed twice this spring.
examples.zh: 今春零售业的「商业贷款利率」两度上调。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with commercial investment trust

examples.en: The commercial investment trust company pooled shopkeepers' savings into property.
examples.zh: 这家「商业投资信托公司」把小店主的积蓄汇集起来投向物业。

examples.en: Depositors moved to the commercial investment trust company chasing double-digit coupons.
examples.zh: 为了两位数的票息，储户纷纷转投「商业投资信托公司」。

collocations: engage the commercial investment trust company
bank with the commercial investment trust company
instruct the commercial investment trust company

words.enDefinition: capital associated with interest on

examples.en: Partnership deeds often fix interest on capital at six percent flat.
examples.zh: 合伙协议常把「资本利息」固定在6%。

examples.en: Interest on capital is paid before profits are shared among partners.
examples.zh: 先付「资本利息」，再在合伙人之间分配利润。

words.enDefinition: securities that cannot be easily sold or transferred to other investors

examples.en: Savings bonds are classic non-marketable securities, transferable only by gift or death.
examples.zh: 储蓄国债是典型的「非流通证券」，只能因赠与或继承而转让。

examples.en: Valuing non-marketable securities demands a hefty discount for the missing exit.
examples.zh: 给「非流通证券」估值，得为卖不出去这点打个大折扣。

words.enDefinition: a corporation engaged in non-stock

examples.en: Universities often organize as a non-stock corporation with members instead of shareholders.
examples.zh: 大学常注册为「非股份公司」，只有成员而没有股东。

examples.en: A non-stock corporation reinvests every surplus instead of paying dividends.
examples.zh: 「非股份公司」把全部盈余再投入，从不分红。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with non-stock

examples.en: The symphony is a non-stock company run by its board of trustees.
examples.zh: 这支交响乐团是理事会治理的「非股份公司」。

examples.en: Without shares to sell, a non-stock company raises funds through memberships.
examples.zh: 没有股份可卖，「非股份公司」只能靠会费筹资。

words.enDefinition: the cost of floatation

examples.en: Underwriting fees pushed the cost of floatation to four percent of proceeds.
examples.zh: 承销费把「筹资成本」推到了募资额的4%。

examples.en: Smaller issues suffer a brutal cost of floatation because fixed fees bite harder.
examples.zh: 规模越小的发行，「筹资成本」越惨，固定费用分摊起来更狠。

words.enDefinition: a bank that provides services on behalf of another bank

examples.en: Our correspondent bank in Nairobi clears every payment in the region.
examples.zh: 内罗毕的「往来银行」替我们清算整个地区的付款。

examples.en: Without a correspondent bank abroad, small exporters wait weeks for dollars.
examples.zh: 海外没有「往来银行」，小出口商的美元要等上几个星期。

words.enDefinition: finance related to corporation

examples.en: Corporation finance asks one question: does this investment beat its funding cost?
examples.zh: 「公司理财」只问一个问题：这项投资能否跑赢它的资金成本。

examples.en: Her corporation finance class built actual valuation models for local businesses.
examples.zh: 她的「公司理财」课为本地企业搭建真实的估值模型。

words.enDefinition: an increase in value arising from net capital

examples.en: Subtracting last year's losses left a net capital gain of twelve thousand.
examples.zh: 抵掉去年的亏损后，「净资本利得」为1.2万。

examples.en: The tax form separates ordinary income from net capital gain.
examples.zh: 税表把普通所得与「净资本利得」分开申报。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with live on

examples.en: After selling the shop, they learned to live on capital for exactly one year.
examples.zh: 卖掉店铺后，他们整整一年「靠资本生活」。

examples.en: Financial advisors warn that choosing to live on capital too early drains the whole pile.
examples.zh: 理财顾问提醒：过早决定「靠资本生活」，会把老本整个掏空。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from contingent credit

examples.en: Guarantees create contingent credit risk that only shows up when borrowers fail.
examples.zh: 担保孕育着「或有信用风险」，只在借款人倒下时才显形。

examples.en: The bank stress-tests contingent credit risk from its off-balance-sheet guarantees.
examples.zh: 银行对表外担保带来的「或有信用风险」做压力测试。

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with management-investment

examples.en: A management-investment company earns fees for running the pooled portfolios.
examples.zh: 「管理投资公司」靠打理集合资产组合赚取管理费。

examples.en: Regulators classify it as a management-investment company, not a passive fund.
examples.zh: 监管把它的性质定为「管理投资公司」，而非被动型基金。

words.enDefinition: a stated policy or approach governing commercial

examples.en: Tariff hikes overnight reshaped the country's commercial policy on imports.
examples.zh: 关税一夜间重塑了国家的进口「商业政策」。

examples.en: Trade partners studied the new commercial policy before committing to supply deals.
examples.zh: 贸易伙伴研读新的「商业政策」，再决定是否签供货合同。

words.enDefinition: a market maker used in professional practice

examples.en: The market maker quotes both sides, earning the spread a thousand times a day.
examples.zh: 「做市商」双边报价，一天赚上千次价差。

examples.en: When the market maker stepped back, the stock traded in wild gaps.
examples.zh: 「做市商」一撤，这只股票的成交就变得七零八落。

words.enDefinition: an agency dealing with investment managing

examples.en: The county hired an investment managing agency to run its reserves.
examples.zh: 县里聘请「投资经营代理行」来管理结余资金。

examples.en: Fees at the investment managing agency undercut hiring a full treasury team.
examples.zh: 「投资经营代理行」的收费，比自建资金团队更划算。

words.enDefinition: a manager responsible for investment

examples.en: Our investment manager rebalanced into utilities the week rates peaked.
examples.zh: 利率见顶那一周，「投资管理人」把组合调向了公用事业股。

examples.en: Ask any investment manager what they did in 2008 and you get a story.
examples.zh: 问任何一位「投资管理人」2008年做了什么，你都会听到一段故事。

words.enDefinition: enterprises engaged in investment in productive

examples.en: Development banks favor investment in productive enterprises over pure property plays.
examples.zh: 开发银行偏爱「生产企业投资」，胜过单纯的地产炒作。

examples.en: The fund's investment in productive enterprises created four hundred factory jobs.
examples.zh: 基金的「生产企业投资」创造了四百个工厂岗位。

words.enDefinition: interests in investment

examples.en: His investment interests span four wineries and a logistics group.
examples.zh: 他的「投资股权」横跨四家酒庄和一家物流集团。

examples.en: Divorce court untangled overlapping investment interests in the family holding company.
examples.zh: 离婚诉讼理清了家族控股公司里交叠的「投资股权」。

words.enDefinition: units of ownership related to investment company

examples.en: Grandma bought investment company shares at the drugstore counter in 1962.
examples.zh: 1962年，祖母在药店柜台上买下了「投资公司股票」。

examples.en: Investment company shares trade at a premium when the manager's reputation soars.
examples.zh: 经理人声望高涨时，「投资公司股票」会溢价交易。

words.enDefinition: equity stock related to premium

examples.en: Blue-chip insurers count as premium stock in most defensive portfolios.
examples.zh: 蓝筹保险股在多数防御型组合中都属于「高信誉的股票」。

examples.en: Even premium stock slid thirty percent when the scandal broke.
examples.zh: 丑闻一爆发，连「高信誉的股票」也跌了三成。

words.enDefinition: the printed certificate evidencing ownership of a bond

examples.en: The leather portfolio still holds her grandfather's bond certificate from 1948.
examples.zh: 皮夹里还留着祖父1948年的「债券证书」。

examples.en: Bond certificates were printed with ornate borders and perforated coupon sheets.
examples.zh: 旧时的「债券证书」印着华丽花边，还带一排可撕的息票。

words.enDefinition: a trust arrangement for bond investment

examples.en: The bond investment trust pools small savers' money into municipal issues.
examples.zh: 这家「债券投资信托公司」把小储户的钱集中投向市政债。

examples.en: Distributions from the bond investment trust arrive on the fifth monthly.
examples.zh: 「债券投资信托公司」的分红每月五号准时到账。

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from bond

examples.en: Bond investment suits savers who lose sleep over every stock swing.
examples.zh: 「债券投资」适合那些被股价波动搅得睡不好觉的储户。

examples.en: The endowment shifted twenty percent of its bond investment into shorter maturities.
examples.zh: 捐赠基金把两成「债券投资」挪到了较短期限上。

words.enDefinition: yield earned from bond

examples.en: The bond yield jumped forty basis points after the inflation report.
examples.zh: 通胀数据公布后，「债券收益率」跳升40个基点。

examples.en: Compare each bond yield with the ten-year Treasury before buying anything.
examples.zh: 买之前，把每支「债券收益率」跟十年期国债比一比。

words.enDefinition: a register of bond

examples.en: The registrar's bond register lists every holder of the railway loan since 1912.
examples.zh: 登记处的「债券登记簿」记下了1912年以来铁路贷款的每一位持有人。

examples.en: Transfers only count once they are entered in the bond register.
examples.zh: 过户只有登记进「债券登记簿」才算数。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for bond retirement

examples.en: One cent of every ticket sale feeds the stadium's bond retirement fund.
examples.zh: 每张球票提一美分，注入体育场的「债券偿债基金」。

examples.en: The bond retirement fund bought back notes early when rates fell.
examples.zh: 利率一降，「债券偿债基金」就提前回购了票据。

words.enDefinition: a fund established or managed for bond sinking

examples.en: The bond sinking fund accumulates quarterly deposits until the balloon payment comes due.
examples.zh: 「债券偿债基金」每季度归集资金，一直攒到大额到期日。

examples.en: Trustees certify the bond sinking fund balance before every coupon date.
examples.zh: 每个付息日前，受托人都要核证「债券偿债基金」余额。

words.enDefinition: subscriptions to purchase newly issued bonds

examples.en: Bond subscriptions from employees alone covered a third of the new issue.
examples.zh: 仅员工「认缴债券」就占到新发行的三分之一。

examples.en: Bond subscriptions closed within hours once the ceiling was reached.
examples.zh: 认购额度一满，「认缴债券」几小时内就截止了。

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates cost-benefit

examples.en: The levee passed review with a cost-benefit ratio of five to one.
examples.zh: 防洪堤以5:1的「成本-收益率」通过审查。

examples.en: Anything below a cost-benefit ratio of one never survives the budget round.
examples.zh: 「成本-收益率」低于1的项目，绝难过预算审查这一关。

words.enDefinition: capital associated with paid-in

examples.en: Paid-in capital of five hundred thousand finally let the clinic order equipment.
examples.zh: 「实收资本」到账50万后，诊所终于下了设备订单。

examples.en: Paid-in capital only counts once the money truly sits in the bank.
examples.zh: 只有真金白银进了银行账户，「实收资本」才算数。

words.enDefinition: recovery of costs through charges or proceeds

examples.en: The utility filed for cost recovery on the storm repairs.
examples.zh: 电力公司就风灾抢修申请「成本补偿」。

examples.en: Ratepayers disputed the cost recovery request, calling the repairs long overdue maintenance.
examples.zh: 用户质疑这笔「成本补偿」，说那不过是拖了太久的日常维护。

words.enDefinition: a short-term loan used to finance day-to-day business operations

examples.en: An operating loan bridges the gap between planting season and harvest receipts.
examples.zh: 一笔「经营周转贷款」，正好衔接播种期与收成回款之间的空档。

examples.en: The co-op repaid its operating loan the week the soybeans shipped.
examples.zh: 大豆一发货，合作社当周就还清了「经营周转贷款」。

words.enDefinition: management of credit risk

examples.en: Credit risk management begins with limits per sector, not with hope.
examples.zh: 「信贷风险管理」从设定行业限额开始，而不是靠祈祷。

examples.en: Her team overhauled credit risk management after two defaulting chains.
examples.zh: 两条连锁企业违约后，她的团队彻底重构了「信贷风险管理」。

words.enDefinition: the ratio of fixed-interest debt to equity in a company's capital structure

examples.en: High capital gearing means small profit swings magnify into wild equity returns.
examples.zh: 「资本杠杆比率」高企时，利润的小幅波动会被放大成股东回报的剧烈起伏。

examples.en: Housebuilders cut their capital gearing long before the rate cycle turned.
examples.zh: 房建商赶在利率周期转向之前，早早压低了「资本杠杆比率」。

words.enDefinition: money received from capital

examples.en: Rent, dividends, and capital gains all count as capital income for the surtax.
examples.zh: 房租、股息和资本利得都计入附加税的「资本所得」。

examples.en: Retirees now draw more capital income than wages from their holdings.
examples.zh: 如今退休族从持仓获得的「资本所得」超过了工资。

words.enDefinition: a loan arranged for or secured by perpetual

examples.en: A perpetual loan pays interest forever and never asks for the principal back.
examples.zh: 「永续贷款」永远只付利息，从不过问本金归还。

examples.en: Two endowed halls were built on perpetual loans from a nineteenth-century benefactor.
examples.zh: 两座学院厅舍的建造资金，来自十九世纪恩主的「永续贷款」。

words.enDefinition: a market for call-money

examples.en: Brokers park overnight surpluses in the call-money market before opening.
examples.zh: 开盘前，经纪商把隔夜富余资金放进「拆息市场」。

examples.en: Tightness in the call-money market spread to longer maturities within days.
examples.zh: 「拆息市场」的紧张几天内就蔓延到了更长期限。

words.enDefinition: a capital expenditure and receipt used in professional practice

examples.en: The council publishes capital expenditure and receipt forecasts beside the tax rate.
examples.zh: 市政会公布「资本的收支」预测，与税率并列。

examples.en: Borrowing fills the gap whenever capital expenditure and receipt drift apart.
examples.zh: 「资本的收支」一旦失衡，缺口就得靠举债来填。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for capital

examples.en: The capital budget for new trams passed by one vote.
examples.zh: 新电车的「资本预算」以一票之差获得通过。

examples.en: Deferring the capital budget today doubles the fleet replacement bill tomorrow.
examples.zh: 今天推迟「资本预算」，明天的车队更新账单就要翻倍。

words.enDefinition: a planned amount of money set aside for cash flow

examples.en: The treasurer built a cash flow budget down to weekly payroll outflows.
examples.zh: 资金主管把「资金流动预算」细化到每周的工资支出。

examples.en: Their cash flow budget predicted the overdraft spike to the very week.
examples.zh: 他们的「资金流动预算」把透支高峰精确到了那一周。

words.zhGloss: 连同汇兑费用一并支付
words.enDefinition: the conversion or marketplace related to payable with
acceptedZhAnswers: 连同汇兑费用一并支付

examples.en: The invoice was drawn payable with exchange, so fees rode on top.
examples.zh: 发票开成「连同汇兑费用一并支付」，手续费就加在票面之上。

examples.en: Collectors abroad learned that drafts payable with exchange cost more than face value.
examples.zh: 国外收款方发现，「连同汇兑费用一并支付」的汇票实际成本高于票面。

words.zhGloss: 有现金股利收入的股票
words.enDefinition: a unit of ownership related to cash generated
acceptedZhAnswers: 有现金股利收入的股票

examples.en: Retirees chase every cash generated share that pays quarterly without fail.
examples.zh: 退休族追逐每一只按季稳定派现的「有现金股利收入的股票」。

examples.en: A cash generated share cushions the portfolio when growth names wobble.
examples.zh: 成长股摇晃时，「有现金股利收入的股票」能为组合兜底。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from performance

examples.en: Late steel deliveries transferred the performance risk squarely onto the exporter.
examples.zh: 钢材迟交，把「履行合同的风险」实实在在压到了出口商头上。

examples.en: The standby letter of credit exists precisely to cover performance risk.
examples.zh: 备用信用证的存在，正是为了覆盖这类「履行合同的风险」。

words.enDefinition: describing something as unpaid in business contexts

examples.en: The invoice has sat unpaid for sixty days, so legal is stepping in.
examples.zh: 这张发票「未付」已六十天，法务部门准备介入。

examples.en: Volunteers ran the food bank unpaid through the whole winter.
examples.zh: 整个冬天，志愿者「不取分文」地打理着食物银行。

words.enDefinition: to distribute or assign a share of something

examples.en: The trustee will allot the shares to each heir once probate closes.
examples.zh: 遗嘱认证一结束，受托人就会把股份「按规定分配」给每位继承人。

examples.en: HR will allot the new hires across three teams based on their skills.
examples.zh: 人事部会按技能把新员工「分配」到三个团队。

words.enDefinition: a ship or aircraft that carries freight

examples.en: The freighter docked at Mombasa a day early, so customs worked a weekend shift.
examples.zh: 「货轮」提前一天靠泊蒙巴萨，海关只好周末加班。

examples.en: A charter freighter flew the vaccine pallets straight into the highlands.
examples.zh: 一架包租的「货机」把疫苗托板直接送进了高原地区。

words.enDefinition: a discounted rate of return used in professional practice

examples.en: The project's discounted rate of return of eleven percent beats our hurdle by two points.
examples.zh: 项目「贴现投资收益率」为11%，比我们的门槛高出2个点。

examples.en: Analysts recompute the discounted rate of return whenever fuel assumptions change.
examples.zh: 燃油假设一变，分析师就重算「贴现投资收益率」。

collocations: calculate the discounted rate of return
compare the discounted rate of return
interpret the discounted rate of return

words.enDefinition: capacity for earning

examples.en: The valuation rests on the plant's earning capacity, not its replacement cost.
examples.zh: 这座工厂的估值看的是「收益能力」，而不是重置成本。

examples.en: Two bad harvests in a row halved the orchard's earning capacity.
examples.zh: 连续两年歉收，果园的「收益能力」被腰斩。

words.enDefinition: a debenture for subordinate

examples.en: Subordinate debenture holders stand behind every secured lender at liquidation.
examples.zh: 清算时，「附属信用公司债」持有人排在所有有担保债权人之后。

examples.en: Higher coupons are the price of holding subordinate debenture paper.
examples.zh: 拿着「附属信用公司债」的代价，就是更高的票息。

words.enDefinition: debentures backed by a guarantee

examples.en: The parent's guarantee turned the subsidiary's paper into guaranteed debentures.
examples.zh: 母公司的担保让子公司的债券成为「有保证的企业债券」。

examples.en: Pension funds buy guaranteed debentures precisely because an insurer stands behind them.
examples.zh: 养老基金买「有保证的企业债券」，图的就是背后有保险机构撑着。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to operating earning

examples.en: The division's operating earning rate of nine percent finally cleared its charge for capital.
examples.zh: 该事业部「营业资本收益率」达9%，终于覆盖了资本占用费。

examples.en: Weak operating earning rate forced the division to shed two product lines.
examples.zh: 「营业资本收益率」疲软，事业部砍掉了两条产品线。

words.enDefinition: a rate applicable to call

examples.en: The call rate spiked the afternoon cash ran short on the Street.
examples.zh: 现金告急的那个下午，「通知贷款利率」一路飙升。

examples.en: Dealers borrow at the call rate and lend it out by lunch.
examples.zh: 交易商上午按「通知贷款利率」借入，中午前就转手放出。

words.zhGloss: 权益年金人寿保险公司
words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with equity annuity life insurance
acceptedZhAnswers: 权益年金人寿保险公司

examples.en: The equity annuity life insurance company guarantees a floor on every retirement payout.
examples.zh: 这家「权益年金人寿保险公司」为每笔退休给付保底。

examples.en: Pension consultants compared three equity annuity life insurance company quotes before recommending one.
examples.zh: 养老顾问比较了三家「权益年金人寿保险公司」的报价才作推荐。

collocations: classify equity annuity life insurance company
measure equity annuity life insurance company
disclose equity annuity life insurance company

words.enDefinition: a financial ratio that relates net worth to debts

examples.en: A net worth to debts ratio above two comforts most lenders.
examples.zh: 「净值对负债比率」高于2，多数放贷方就安心了。

examples.en: Years of buybacks dragged the net worth to debts ratio toward one.
examples.zh: 多年回购下来，「净值对负债比率」被拖向1。

collocations: calculate the net worth to debts ratio
compare the net worth to debts ratio
interpret the net worth to debts ratio

words.zhGloss: 资本投资中工程项目的选择
words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from project selection in capital
acceptedZhAnswers: 资本投资中工程项目的选择

examples.en: Project selection in capital investment starts with a ranked list, not wishful thinking.
examples.zh: 「资本投资中工程项目的选择」要从一张排序清单开始，而不是凭空想象。

examples.en: A scoring sheet keeps project selection in capital investment honest across departments.
examples.zh: 一张评分表让各部门的「资本投资中工程项目的选择」保持公道。

collocations: arrange the project selection in capital investment
monitor the project selection in capital investment
repay the project selection in capital investment

words.enDefinition: a profit rate concerning net worth

examples.en: The chain's profit rate of net worth beats the sector average by four points.
examples.zh: 这家连锁的「资本利润率」比同业平均高出4个点。

examples.en: Debt buybacks flattered the profit rate of net worth without adding any profit.
examples.zh: 借债回购美化了「资本利润率」，却没有带来一分钱真实利润。

words.enDefinition: an accounting method that combines companies by pooling equity interests

examples.en: The textbook case contrasts pooling-of-interest accounting with the purchase method.
examples.zh: 教科书案例对比了「权益结合法」与购买法的处理。

examples.en: Regulators scrapped pooling-of-interest treatment after too many acquisitions dodged goodwill.
examples.zh: 由于太多并购借机规避商誉确认，监管机构废除了「权益结合法」。

words.zhGloss: 由库存股票交易所得资本
words.enDefinition: transactions involving capital from treasury stock
acceptedZhAnswers: 由库存股票交易所得资本

examples.en: Accountants credit capital from treasury stock transactions when resale prices exceed cost.
examples.zh: 库存股转售价格高于成本时，差额贷记「由库存股票交易所得资本」。

examples.en: Auditors traced capital from treasury stock transactions back to the original buyback contracts.
examples.zh: 审计师把「由库存股票交易所得资本」追溯到最初的回购合同。

words.enDefinition: the market for short-term, highly liquid debt instruments

examples.en: Corporate treasurers park idle cash in the money market overnight.
examples.zh: 公司资金主管把闲置现金隔夜存放在「货币市场」。

examples.en: Rates in the money market move hours before the official announcement.
examples.zh: 官方宣布之前几个小时，「货币市场」利率早已先行变动。

words.enDefinition: bank borrowings that are due for repayment within one year

examples.en: Short-term bank loans bridge the factory until the autumn order book pays out.
examples.zh: 「短期银行贷款」先撑住工厂，等秋季订单回款接上。

examples.en: Renewing short-term bank loans every quarter keeps the treasurer honest about margins.
examples.zh: 每季度续借「短期银行贷款」，资金主管对利润率就不敢含糊。

words.enDefinition: a credit facility or accounting credit concerning shopping list

examples.en: The grocer extends shopping list credit to regulars who settle on payday.
examples.zh: 杂货店给常客开「采购单贷款」，发薪日再结清。

examples.en: Shopping list credit built customer loyalty long before loyalty cards existed.
examples.zh: 早在会员卡出现之前，「采购单贷款」就在培养顾客的忠诚度。

words.enDefinition: an insurance policy covering goods in transit / shipment risks

examples.en: Check the shipment policy covers overland legs, not just the sea voyage.
examples.zh: 核对「装运保险单」是否覆盖陆运段，而不只是海运。

examples.en: The claim succeeded because the shipment policy named the container explicitly.
examples.zh: 索赔成功，正是因为「装运保险单」明确写明了那只集装箱。

words.enDefinition: an advance for bank

examples.en: The regional bank advance of forty thousand arrived within a week.
examples.zh: 4万的「银行贷款」一周内就放款到位。

examples.en: Bank advance paperwork doubled after the lending rules were tightened.
examples.zh: 放贷新规一出，「银行贷款」的手续翻倍。

collocations: open an account at the bank advance

words.enDefinition: a business entity associated with small loan

examples.en: The small loan company approved the tailor's machine purchase in one afternoon.
examples.zh: 「小额贷款公司」一个下午就批下了裁缝的缝纫机购置款。

examples.en: Strict caps now limit what a small loan company may charge.
examples.zh: 如今监管严格限制「小额贷款公司」的收费上限。

collocations: partner with the small loan company
switch to the small loan company

words.enDefinition: money committed with the expectation of return from shift in

examples.en: A sharp shift in investment moved from offices to warehouses almost overnight.
examples.zh: 「投资转移」几乎一夜之间从写字楼转向了仓库。

examples.en: Economists read the shift in investment as a vote against the tax change.
examples.zh: 经济学家把「投资转移」解读为对税改的一次用脚投票。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from average

examples.en: The underwriter rated the warehouse average risk and priced accordingly.
examples.zh: 核保员把这座仓库定为「平均风险」，照标准费率承保。

examples.en: Most small firms sit at average risk, neither scary nor spotless.
examples.zh: 多数小企业都处于「平均风险」水平，既不吓人也不完美。

words.enDefinition: exposure to loss or uncertainty arising from bad

examples.en: Insurers refuse to write bad risk on coastal piers at any price.
examples.zh: 对海滨码头这种「风险大的保险」标的，保险公司出多高价格都不接。

examples.en: The broker shopped the bad risk around until one syndicate blinked.
examples.zh: 经纪人四处推销这份「风险大的保险」，直到一家辛迪加松了口。

words.enDefinition: a quotation for foreign exchange

examples.en: The front page still prints a foreign exchange quotation grid each morning.
examples.zh: 报纸头版每天早上仍印着一张「外汇行情表」。

examples.en: Traders taped the foreign exchange quotation above their desks decades ago.
examples.zh: 几十年前，交易员把「外汇行情表」贴在办公桌上方。

words.enDefinition: loans related to foreign exchange

examples.en: Foreign exchange loans in dollars let the importer match its payables.
examples.zh: 美元「外汇贷款」让进口商的负债与应付账款币种匹配。

examples.en: When the currency slid, foreign exchange loans doubled in local-currency terms.
examples.zh: 本币一贬值，「外汇贷款」按本币计就翻了一倍。

words.enDefinition: a market for foreign exchange

examples.en: The foreign exchange market never closes; it just changes cities.
examples.zh: 「外汇市场」永不闭市，只是换一座城市继续交易。

examples.en: Intervention in the foreign exchange market barely dented the trend.
examples.zh: 央行在「外汇市场」的干预，几乎没有撼动这轮趋势。

words.enDefinition: a backed bond; a debt security with the stated features

examples.en: A backed bond tied to the toll revenue sold out in hours.
examples.zh: 这支以过路费收入作抵押的「有抵押债券」，几小时即售罄。
